articles.title: CELEBRATING 100 YEARS

paras.en: MEDINA, OH (January 6, 2025) – Carlisle Brake & Friction (CarlisleCBF), a global leader in brake and friction technology and part of the CentroMotion family of brands, has reached a momentous milestone – its 100th anniversary.
paras.zh: 俄亥俄州梅迪纳（2025 年 1 月 6 日）——制动和摩擦技术领域的全球领导者、CentroMotion 品牌家族的成员之一 Carlisle Brake & Friction (CarlisleCBF) 迎来了一个重要的里程碑——成立 100 周年。

paras.en: Since its founding in 1925, the company has lived up to its tagline, "Braking New Ground," by consistently pioneering innovative solutions that have propelled industries forward.
paras.zh: 自 1925 年成立以来，该公司一直践行其口号“开辟新天地”，不断开拓创新解决方案，推动行业向前发展。

paras.en: "For 100 years, Carlisle has been synonymous with groundbreaking innovation and unwavering reliability in the braking industry," says Tom Vanderlaan, Chief Commercial Officer (CCO) of CentroMotion. "This milestone is a testament to the dedication of our employees, the trust of our customers, and the enduring strength of our products. As we celebrate our centennial, we reaffirm our commitment to continuous innovation, strong partnerships, and giving back to the communities we serve."
paras.zh: CentroMotion 首席商务官 (CCO) Tom Vanderlaan 表示：“100 年来，Carlisle 一直是制动行业突破性创新和坚定可靠性的代名词。” “这一里程碑证明了我们员工的奉献、客户的信任以及我们产品的持久实力。在庆祝我们百年华诞之际，我们重申我们对持续创新、强有力的合作伙伴关系以及回馈我们所服务的社区的承诺。”

paras.en: A Century of Innovation in Motion Control
paras.zh: 运动控制的一个世纪的创新

paras.en: For a century, CarlisleCBF has been at the forefront of motion control, pushing the boundaries of performance with its industry-leading brakes and friction materials. Through unwavering commitment to R&D, the company has earned the trust of customers worldwide, establishing itself as a cornerstone of reliability.
paras.zh: 一个世纪以来，CarlisleCBF 一直处于运动控制领域的前沿，凭借其行业领先的制动器和摩擦材料突破了性能界限。通过坚定不移地致力于研发，该公司赢得了全球客户的信任，奠定了其可靠性的基石。

paras.en: Celebrating 100 Years of Braking New Ground: A Digital Celebration
paras.zh: 庆祝开拓新天地 100 周年：数字庆典

paras.en: To commemorate this historic milestone, CarlisleCBF is launching a comprehensive digital celebration. This virtual experience will allow customers, employees and industry partners to delve into the company’s rich history, groundbreaking innovations and commitment to excellence through historical photographs and stories.
paras.zh: 为了纪念这一历史性里程碑，CarlisleCBF 推出了全面的数字庆祝活动。这种虚拟体验将使客户、员工和行业合作伙伴能够通过历史照片和故事深入了解公司丰富的历史、突破性的创新和对卓越的承诺。

paras.en: A core aspect of the celebration is fostering a sense of community. CarlisleCBF invites customers, employees and industry partners to join the journey by visiting their dedicated anniversary webpage, www.CarlisleCBF.com, and following their story on social media.
paras.zh: 庆祝活动的一个核心方面是培养社区意识。 CarlisleCBF 邀请客户、员工和行业合作伙伴通过访问其专门的周年纪念网页 www.CarlisleCBF.com 并在社交媒体上关注他们的故事来加入这一旅程。

paras.en: The webpage and social media channels will serve as a virtual time capsule, showcasing CarlisleCBF's rich history, ground-breaking milestones and product innovations.
paras.zh: 网页和社交媒体渠道将充当虚拟时间胶囊，展示 CarlisleCBF 丰富的历史、突破性的里程碑和产品创新。

paras.en: To encourage participation and celebrate the impact CarlisleCBF has had, a social media campaign is launching with the hashtag #CarlisleCBF100. Participants are encouraged to share stories, photos and memories that illustrate how CarlisleCBF products have impacted their lives or businesses. The most engaging submissions will be featured on the company's social media channels and website.
paras.zh: 为了鼓励参与并庆祝 CarlisleCBF 所产生的影响，一项社交媒体活动正在启动，主题标签为#CarlisleCBF100。我们鼓励参与者分享故事、照片和回忆，以说明 CarlisleCBF 产品如何影响他们的生活或业务。最具吸引力的提交内容将在公司的社交媒体渠道和网站上展示。

paras.en: By combining digital storytelling with interactive social media, CarlisleCBF aims to create a lasting legacy for its first century of service, while fostering a spirit of community and appreciation.
paras.zh: 通过将数字故事讲述与互动社交媒体相结合，CarlisleCBF 旨在为其第一个世纪的服务创造持久的遗产，同时培养社区和欣赏精神。

paras.en: Carlisle Brake & Friction, a CentroMotion brand, is a globally recognized leader in the development and manufacture of highly innovative brake and friction system solutions to service a diverse range of motion control applications. The comprehensive nature of CarlisleCBF's brake system expertise includes hydraulic control products, industrial brake assemblies, and wet and dry friction material for brake, clutch, and transmission applications, as well as aftermarket replacement products. Our full-system product offering, supported by our industry-experience staff of experts, provides our customers with brake system solutions that set them apart from their competition. www.carlislecbf.com
paras.zh: Carlisle Brake & Friction 是 CentroMotion 旗下品牌，在开发和制造高度创新的制动和摩擦系统解决方案方面是全球公认的领导者，为各种运动控制应用提供服务。 CarlisleCBF 制动系统专业知识的综合性包括液压控制产品、工业制动组件、用于制动、离合器和变速箱应用的湿式和干式摩擦材料，以及售后替换产品。我们的全系统产品由具有行业经验的专家团队提供支持，为我们的客户提供制动系统解决方案，使他们在竞争中脱颖而出。 www.carlislecbf.com

paras.en: CentroMotion designs and delivers highly engineered products that enhance the safety, reliability and productivity of equipment used in transportation, agriculture, construction, mining and demanding industrial environments. Our innovative team works collaboratively with customers through our family of trusted, established brands, bringing deep subject-matter expertise in complementary technologies.
paras.zh: CentroMotion 设计并提供高度工程化的产品，可提高运输、农业、建筑、采矿和苛刻工业环境中使用的设备的安全性、可靠性和生产率。我们的创新团队通过值得信赖的知名品牌与客户合作，带来互补技术方面深厚的专业知识。

paras.en: This expertise, combined with our exceptional scale and geographic reach, makes us a reliable partner to help our customers achieve their goals, and provide end users with the best equipment possible. Our well-known brands include Power-Packer for hydraulic motion control and stabilization systems; CrossControl and maximatecc for operator information and human-machine interface systems; Elliott Manufacturing and Weasler Engineering for power and force transmission through flexible and rigid driveline systems; Gits Manufacturing for high-performance engine thermal and emission control solutions; and Carlisle Brake & Friction for materials and mechatronic solutions for off-highway brake and transmission products. Learn more about CentroMotion at www.centromotion.com.
paras.zh: 这种专业知识与我们卓越的规模和地理覆盖范围相结合，使我们成为可靠的合作伙伴，帮助我们的客户实现他们的目标，并为最终用户提供最好的设备。我们的知名品牌包括用于液压运动控制和稳定系统的 Power-Packer；用于操作员信息和人机界面系统的 CrossControl 和 maximatecc； Elliott Manufacturing 和 Weasler Engineering 通过柔性和刚性传动系统进行动力和力传输； Gits Manufacturing 提供高性能发动机热和排放控制解决方案；和 Carlisle Brake & Friction，为非公路制动和传动产品提供材料和机电一体化解决方案。如需了解有关 CentroMotion 的更多信息，请访问 www.centromotion.com。

articles.title: bauma 2025

paras.en: Carlisle Brake & Friction is one of five CentroMotion brands exhibiting at bauma, April 7–13 in Munich, booth A2, 402.
paras.zh: Carlisle Brake & Friction 是 4 月 7 日至 13 日在慕尼黑举行的 bauma 展会上参展的五个 CentroMotion 品牌之一，展位 A2, 402。

paras.en: CentroMotion is a global manufacturing company specializing in friction, information and controls, mechanical power transmission, and thermal and motion control products.
paras.zh: CentroMotion 是一家全球制造公司，专注于摩擦、信息和控制、机械动力传输以及热和运动控制产品。

paras.en: Our teams will showcase various products that serve the construction market:
paras.zh: 我们的团队将展示服务于建筑市场的各种产品：

paras.en: Sharing product highlights from their industry-leading brake, transmissions/clutch and motion control systems.
paras.zh: 分享其行业领先的制动、变速箱/离合器和运动控制系统的产品亮点。

paras.en: Showcasing display and on-board computing platforms.
paras.zh: 展示显示和机载计算平台。

paras.en: Featuring the latest solutions in thermal management solutions, including intake throttle valves, exhaust recirculation valves and exhaust back-pressure valves for diesel, gas, and hydrogen internal combustion engines.
paras.zh: 采用最新的热管理解决方案，包括柴油、燃气和氢气内燃机的进气节流阀、排气再循环阀和排气背压阀。

paras.en: Demonstrating micro-controller-based platforms for instrumentation and HMI.
paras.zh: 演示基于微控制器的仪器仪表和 HMI 平台。

paras.en: Exhibiting new electro-hydraulic actuators with a design focus on efficiency, perfectly suited for power-on-demand functions in mobile applications.
paras.zh: 展示新型电动液压执行器，其设计注重效率，非常适合移动应用中的按需供电功能。

articles.title: Visit Us @Agritechnica 2025

paras.en: CarlisleCBF is one of seven CentroMotion brands exhibiting at Agritechnica, November 9 - 15, 2025, in Hanover, Germany, stand No. B35, hall 17.
paras.zh: CarlisleCBF 是参加 2025 年 11 月 9 日至 15 日在德国汉诺威举行的 Agritechnica 展会的七个 CentroMotion 品牌之一，展位号为 B35，展厅 17。

paras.en: CentroMotion is a global manufacturing company specializing in friction, information, and controls, mechanical power transmission, and thermal and motion control products.
paras.zh: CentroMotion 是一家全球制造公司，专注于摩擦、信息和控制、机械动力传输以及热和运动控制产品。

paras.en: Our teams will showcase various products that serve the agriculture market:
paras.zh: 我们的团队将展示服务于农业市场的各种产品：

paras.en: Sharing a powerful lineup of brake system solutions engineered for the demands of modern agriculture equipment. Attendees can explore highlights from industry-leading brake assemblies, designed to deliver unmatched stopping power and durability in off-highway environments. The display will also feature both the EPD and N680 advanced friction technologies, built to optimize performance and reliability in high-torque applications. Together, these products represent a century of engineering excellence and a future-focused commitment to solving the toughest challenges in agricultural mobility.
paras.zh: 分享一系列强大的制动系统解决方案，专为满足现代农业设备的需求而设计。与会者可以探索行业领先的制动组件的亮点，这些组件旨在在非公路环境中提供无与伦比的制动力和耐用性。该显示器还将采用 EPD 和 N680 先进摩擦技术，旨在优化高扭矩应用中的性能和可靠性。这些产品共同代表了一个世纪以来的卓越工程技术和着眼于未来解决农业移动领域最严峻挑战的承诺。

paras.en: Showcasing the leading on-board computing platform for machine intelligence and HMI solutions. New products, designed specifically to meet the needs of agricultural machinery, include 10- and 12-inch smart terminals, central vehicle computing with monitors, and 5- and 7-inch displays featuring programmable soft keys for tactile control. The CCpilot V1090 and V1290 are the first displays with an integrated network switch that makes it easier to incorporate elements like camera systems, sensors and precision systems, into one display computer. The vehicle computer and monitors (CrossCore A100 with monitors from 10 to 12 inches) highlight the new centralized computing architecture. This approach provides a flexible, scalable platform for vehicle intelligence. It includes innovative component life cycle management and increased support for functional safety.
paras.zh: 展示用于机器智能和 HMI 解决方案的领先机载计算平台。专为满足农业机械需求而设计的新产品包括10英寸和12英寸智能终端、带显示器的中央车辆计算以及具有用于触觉控制的可编程软键的5英寸和7英寸显示器。 CCpilot V1090 和 V1290 是首款具有集成网络交换机的显示器，可以更轻松地将摄像头系统、传感器和精密系统等元素整合到一台显示计算机中。车载电脑和显示器（CrossCore A100，显示器尺寸从10英寸到12英寸）突出了新的集中式计算架构。这种方法为车辆智能提供了一个灵活、可扩展的平台。它包括创新的组件生命周期管理和增加对功能安全的支持。

paras.en: Highlighting how Elliott’s flexible planting products deliver precision performance, highly operational reliability and mechanical advantages without the need for additional power sources. The flexible drive and control shaft products bring enhanced performance to original equipment machinery, providing simple and dependable aftermarket upgrades for an ongoing return on your investment. Five different flexible drive shaft agricultural systems are available, and the assemblies fit most planters on the market today.
paras.zh: 重点介绍 Elliott 的灵活种植产品如何在无需额外电源的情况下提供精确的性能、高度的运行可靠性和机械优势。灵活的驱动和控制轴产品为原始设备机械带来了增强的性能，提供简单可靠的售后升级，为您带来持续的投资回报。有五种不同的柔性驱动轴农业系统可供选择，这些组件适合当今市场上的大多数播种机。

paras.en: Featuring the latest innovations in thermal management solutions, including intake throttle valves, hot- and cold-side exhaust gas recirculation valves, and exhaust back-pressure valves for diesel, gas and hydrogen internal combustion engines.
paras.zh: 采用热管理解决方案的最新创新，包括柴油、燃气和氢气内燃机的进气节流阀、热侧和冷侧废气再循环阀以及排气背压阀。

paras.en: Presenting the latest solutions to help operators sense, see and know more. Show attendees will find a broad portfolio of products, including displays, clusters and sensors for vehicle and equipment monitoring in demanding applications. The displays are built on a microcontroller architecture which offers lean performance with inherent support for key features including fast boot (typically around a second for instant access to machine data). Visitors to Agritechnica can get a hands-on look at the display range, from 1.3 to 4.3 inches, with demos to show general I/O, CAN channel support and application examples. The displays can share multiple screens of information, with intuitive navigation, including diagnostic codes and machine status. The platform offers devices with robust and compact housings suitable to withstand the toughest environments and designed to easily fit 52 or 86 mm SAE case sizes to make installation simple for new and existing cabins.
paras.zh: 呈现最新的解决方案，帮助操作员感知、看到和了解更多。展会与会者将发现广泛的产品组合，包括用于在要求苛刻的应用中监控车辆和设备的显示器、仪表组和传感器。这些显示器基于微控制器架构构建，可提供精益性能以及对快速启动（通常大约一秒即可即时访问机器数据）等关键功能的固有支持。 Agritechnica 的参观者可以亲身体验从 1.3 英寸到 4.3 英寸的显示屏范围，并通过演示展示通用 I/O、CAN 通道支持和应用示例。这些显示器可以共享多个信息屏幕，并具有直观的导航功能，包括诊断代码和机器状态。该平台提供的设备具有坚固而紧凑的外壳，适合承受最恶劣的环境，并可轻松安装 52 或 86 毫米 SAE 外壳尺寸，使新的和现有的驾驶室的安装变得简单。

paras.en: Showcasing the Power-Packer portfolio of manual and electric pumps and cylinders for hydraulic cab tilt and hood-lift applications, as well as the latest electro-hydraulic actuator. All products are designed with a focus on efficiency and perfectly suited for power-on-demand functions in mobile applications. Hydraulic solutions offer precise motion control and ensure reliable performance in the most demanding environments.
paras.zh: 展示用于液压驾驶室倾斜和发动机罩升降应用的手动和电动泵和油缸的 Power-Packer 产品组合，以及最新的电动液压执行器。所有产品的设计都注重效率，非常适合移动应用中的按需供电功能。液压解决方案提供精确的运动控制，并确保在最苛刻的环境中提供可靠的性能。

paras.en: Learn about Weasler’s range of products, from drive shafts and torque limiters to dampers and other components, all designed using the best technology to solve our customers’ power transmission problems. Products are engineered for reliability and precision, ensuring the seamless operation and longevity of agricultural equipment.
paras.zh: 了解 Weasler 的产品系列，从传动轴和扭矩限制器到阻尼器和其他组件，所有产品均采用最佳技术设计，旨在解决客户的动力传输问题。产品的设计注重可靠性和精确性，确保农业设备的无缝运行和使用寿命。

articles.title: Dealers warn of further delays after FCA finds motor finance data errors
articles.author: Andrew

paras.en: Dealers warn of further delays after FCA finds motor finance data errors
paras.zh: FCA 发现汽车金融数据错误后，经销商警告可能会出现进一步延误

paras.en: The National Franchised Dealers Association (NFDA) has raised fresh concerns over prolonged delays to the motor finance redress scheme after the Financial Conduct Authority (FCA) disclosed errors in the underlying compensation data.
paras.zh: 在金融行为监管局 (FCA) 披露基础补偿数据中的错误后，全国特许经销商协会 (NFDA) 对汽车金融补救计划的长期拖延提出了新的担忧。

paras.en: While the financial adjustment from the regulator’s error is expected to be minor, shifting the current 17 per cent APR benchmark by less than one percentage point, or an average of under £10 per agreement, industry leaders warn that the mistake compounds ongoing uncertainty for dealerships and consumers.
paras.zh: 虽然监管机构错误造成的财务调整预计很小，将当前 17% 的年利率基准调整不到 1 个百分点，即每份协议平均调整不到 10 英镑，但行业领袖警告称，这一错误加剧了经销商和消费者持续的不确定性。

paras.en: Despite lenders having already provisioned £7.5 billion to fund payouts, the NFDA noted that the sector still lacks a clear and credible timetable from the regulator to begin distributing funds.
paras.zh: 尽管贷款机构已经拨备了 75 亿英镑用于支付资金，但 NFDA 指出，该行业仍缺乏监管机构明确且可信的时间表来开始分配资金。

paras.en: Sue Robinson, chief executive of the NFDA, said: “Our members are on the front line, fielding customer questions about compensation they cannot yet answer.
paras.zh: NFDA 首席执行官苏·罗宾逊 (Sue Robinson) 表示：“我们的成员处于第一线，解答客户关于赔偿的问题，但他们还无法回答。

paras.en: “We urge the FCA to resolve this calculation issue quickly, confirm the litigation timetable and restore confidence in the scheme.”
paras.zh: “我们敦促FCA迅速解决这一计算问题，确认诉讼时间表并恢复对该计划的信心。”

paras.en: The association confirmed it will continue direct discussions with the FCA as dealerships await definitive guidance on when payouts will commence.
paras.zh: 该协会确认，将继续与 FCA 进行直接讨论，经销商正在等待有关何时开始付款的明确指导。

articles.title: Motorcycle dealers back new bill targeting illegal e-bikes and derestriction kits
articles.author: Andrew

paras.en: Motorcycle dealers back new bill targeting illegal e-bikes and derestriction kits
paras.zh: 摩托车经销商支持针对非法电动自行车和解除限制套件的新法案

paras.en: The National Motorcycle Dealers Association (NMDA) has welcomed the introduction of the Sale of Electric Personal Vehicles (Offences) Bill, which aims to curb the sale of non-compliant e-bikes and speed-limit removal kits.
paras.zh: 全国摩托车经销商协会 (NMDA) 对《电动个人车辆销售（违法行为）法案》的出台表示欢迎，该法案旨在遏制不合规电动自行车和限速清除套件的销售。

paras.en: Introduced in Parliament on 25 November ahead of its second reading on 5 February 2027, the legislation proposes making it an offence for retailers and online marketplaces to sell electric personal vehicles, such as e-bikes and electric dirt bikes, without taking reasonable steps to prevent illegal road use. It would also ban the sale and marketing of derestriction kits while empowering the Secretary of State to set clearer market standards.
paras.zh: 该立法于 11 月 25 日在议会于 2027 年 2 月 5 日二读之前提出，提议将零售商和在线市场在未采取合理措施防止非法道路使用的情况下销售电动个人车辆（例如电动自行车和电动越野车）的行为定为犯罪行为。它还将禁止销售和营销解除限制套件，同时授权国务卿制定更明确的市场标准。

paras.en: The NMDA noted that unregulated online imports continue to undercut franchised dealerships bearing full regulatory compliance costs. Meanwhile, industry data indicates moped registrations have dropped by roughly 40 per cent since 2022, a decline attributed to the cost and complexity of obtaining a licence, which has driven some riders toward illegal high-powered alternatives.
paras.zh: NMDA 指出，不受监管的在线进口继续削弱特许经销商承担全部监管合规成本的能力。与此同时，行业数据显示，自 2022 年以来，轻便摩托车的注册量下降了约 40%，下降的原因是获得许可证的成本和复杂性，这促使一些骑手转向非法的高性能替代品。

paras.en: Alongside the Motorcycle Industry Association (MCIA) and the National Motorcyclists Council (NMC), the NMDA previously urged ministers to reform training and licensing rules to boost legitimate two-wheeler uptake.
paras.zh: NMDA 此前与摩托车工业协会 (MCIA) 和国家摩托车手委员会 (NMC) 一起敦促部长们改革培训和许可规则，以促进合法两轮车的普及。

paras.en: Symon Cook, head of operations at NMDA, said: “It is encouraging to see parliamentary focus placed on legislation to supply safe, road-legal vehicles, and tackling non-compliant sales. It shows a positive step toward ensuring fairer competition across the market. NMDA urges the government to deliver practical licensing reforms that make legal riding more accessible for commuters and businesses. We will continue to liaise with government and industry partners on this issue as the Bill progresses.”
paras.zh: NMDA 运营主管西蒙·库克 (Symon Cook) 表示：“令人鼓舞的是，议会将重点放在供应安全、道路合法车辆和解决不合规销售的立法上。这表明朝着确保整个市场公平竞争迈出了积极的一步。NMDA 敦促政府进行切实可行的许可改革，使通勤者和企业更容易合法乘车。随着法案的进展，我们将继续就这一问题与政府和行业合作伙伴保持联系。”

articles.title: Autoglass appoints John Coombs as head of commercial B2B
articles.author: Andrew

paras.en: Autoglass appoints John Coombs as head of commercial B2B
paras.zh: Autoglass 任命 John Coombs 为商业 B2B 主管

paras.en: Autoglass has appointed John Coombs as its new head of commercial B2B as the vehicle glass repair and replacement specialist seeks to expand its footprint across the UK fleet, leasing, and rental markets.
paras.zh: Autoglass 任命约翰·库姆斯 (John Coombs) 为其新的商业 B2B 主管，这家汽车玻璃维修和更换专家寻求扩大其在英国车队、租赁和租赁市场的足迹。

paras.en: Coombs, who has spent more than 13 years with Autoglass and over two decades in the fleet and leasing industries, moves into the role from his previous position as head of commercial growth and innovation. He will oversee the company’s wider B2B strategy while continuing to spearhead the nationwide rollout of Mobile Recalibration Pro (MRP), a mobile advanced driver-assistance systems (ADAS) recalibration service he previously piloted.
paras.zh: 库姆斯在 Autoglass 工作了 13 年多，并在车队和租赁行业工作了 20 多年，他从之前的商业增长和创新主管职位调到了这一职位。他将监督公司更广泛的 B2B 战略，同时继续带头在全国范围内推出 Mobile Recalibration Pro (MRP)，这是他之前试点的移动高级驾驶员辅助系统 (ADAS) 重新校准服务。

paras.en: Ian Rowlands, sales and marketing director at Autoglass, commented: “Throughout his time with the business, John has consistently demonstrated an ability to identify new opportunities, build strong relationships and challenge us to think differently about how we support our customers. His passion for innovation and commitment to delivering for our clients are real strengths as he takes on this role.”
paras.zh: Autoglass 销售和营销总监伊恩·罗兰兹 (Ian Rowlands) 评论道：“约翰在公司任职期间，一直表现出发现新机会、建立牢固关系并挑战我们以不同方式思考如何支持客户的能力。他对创新的热情和为客户提供服务的承诺是他担任这一职位的真正优势。”

paras.en: Coombs said of his new role: “This is a tremendously exciting time to be taking on this new challenge. Autoglass has a clear reputation for delivering a premium service that ensures businesses can operate as efficiently as possible. We are also focused on innovation with a purpose, demonstrated by MRP, which is already making a significant difference to the operational efficiencies of a number of customers.
paras.zh: 库姆斯在谈到他的新角色时表示：“面对这一新挑战，这是一个非常激动人心的时刻。Autoglass 在提供优质服务方面享有盛誉，确保企业尽可能高效地运营。我们还专注于有目的的创新，MRP 就证明了这一点，它已经对许多客户的运营效率产生了重大影响。

paras.en: “I am very much looking forward to working with my colleagues across the Autoglass business to continue to develop fit-for-purpose service and solutions that go to the heart of our customers’ needs.”
paras.zh: “我非常期待与汽车玻璃业务部门的同事合作，继续开发适合客户需求的服务和解决方案。”

articles.title: Oklahoma’s New 70% Salvage Threshold Raises Concerns About Hail-Damage Total-Loss Settlements
articles.author: Jason Stahl

paras.en: Oklahoma vehicle owners whose automobiles have been declared total losses may have more to consider than whether their vehicles can be safely repaired. Even when an insurance company’s decision to total a vehicle is justified, inaccurate valuations or excessive salvage deductions can leave consumers with less money than they deserve.
paras.zh: 俄克拉荷马州的汽车已被宣布完全损失的车主可能需要考虑的不仅仅是他们的车辆是否可以安全修理。即使保险公司对车辆进行报废的决定是合理的，但不准确的估价或过多的报废扣除也可能导致消费者得到的钱少于他们应得的钱。

paras.en: That risk is especially relevant following a change in Oklahoma law that took effect Nov. 1, 2026. Senate Bill 1920 amended Oklahoma Statute Title 47, Section 1111, increasing the salvage-title threshold from 60% to 70% of a vehicle’s fair market value. Under the revised law, vehicles with qualifying repair costs between 60% and 70% of their fair market value may no longer be required to receive a salvage title, giving Oklahoma owners more options for keeping and repairing their vehicles.
paras.zh: 在俄克拉荷马州法律于 2026 年 11 月 1 日生效后，这种风险尤其重要。参议院 1920 年法案修改了俄克拉荷马州法规第 47 条第 1111 条，将报废所有权门槛从车辆公平市场价值的 60% 提高到 70%。根据修订后的法律，合格维修成本在其公平市场价值 60% 至 70% 之间的车辆可能不再需要获得报废所有权，这为俄克拉荷马州车主提供了更多保留和维修车辆的选择。

paras.en: For Oklahoma drivers dealing with hail damage, the new law raises questions about their options and the fairness of their insurance settlements. Robert L. McDorman, president and founder of Auto Claim Specialists (ACS), stresses that understanding how insurers make total-loss decisions and calculate settlements can make a difference in how much money consumers receive.
paras.zh: 对于遭受冰雹损害的俄克拉荷马州司机来说，新法律对他们的选择和保险理赔的公平性提出了质疑。汽车索赔专家 (ACS) 总裁兼创始人罗伯特·L·麦克道曼 (Robert L. McDorman) 强调，了解保险公司如何做出全损决策并计算和解金额可以对消费者收到的赔偿金产生影响。

paras.en: “Just because an insurance carrier declares a vehicle a total loss does not necessarily mean that vehicle cannot be safely repaired,” said McDorman. “There is a significant difference between a vehicle that is truly beyond safe repair and a vehicle that an insurance carrier determines is not economically advantageous to repair. When the numbers used to make those decisions are inaccurate, consumers could end up losing thousands of dollars they rightfully deserve.”
paras.zh: “仅仅因为保险公司宣布车辆完全损失，并不一定意味着车辆无法安全修复，”麦克多曼说。 “真正无法安全维修的车辆与保险公司认为维修不具有经济优势的车辆之间存在显着差异。如果用于做出这些决定的数据不准确，消费者最终可能会损失他们应得的数千美元。”

paras.en: Oklahoma’s new threshold focuses on how much it would cost to safely repair a vehicle compared to its fair market value, but insurance companies can still declare vehicles total losses based on the terms of the policy and factors such as repair costs, actual cash value (ACV) and salvage value. Consumers should understand what their policies cover, how their vehicles are valued and whether the settlement they’re being offered reflects what they’re entitled to receive.
paras.zh: 俄克拉荷马州的新门槛重点关注与公平市场价值相比安全维修车辆的费用，但保险公司仍然可以根据保单条款以及维修成本、实际现金价值（ACV）和残值等因素申报车辆总损失。消费者应该了解他们的保单涵盖的范围、他们的车辆的估值方式以及他们获得的和解是否反映了他们有权获得的赔偿。

paras.en: ““The vehicle’s pre-loss Actual Cash Value is the starting point for determining what the insurance carrier owes,” McDorman said. “If that value is too low, consumers could already be losing money before the settlement is even calculated. And if they choose to keep their vehicle, an excessive salvage deduction can take even more money out of their pockets. That’s why both values need to be accurate, backed by reliable evidence and open to independent review.””
paras.zh: 麦克道曼说：“车辆损失前的实际现金价值是确定保险公司欠款的起点。如果该价值太低，消费者可能在计算出赔偿金之前就已经赔钱了。”如果他们选择保留车辆，过多的报废扣除可能会从他们的口袋里掏出更多的钱。这就是为什么这两种价值观都需要准确、有可靠证据支持并接受独立审查。”

paras.en: This is especially important for vehicles damaged by hail. Unlike a serious collision that can affect a vehicle’s structure or safety systems, hail damage is often largely cosmetic. A car covered in dents may still run well, even if the insurance company decides it would cost too much to repair. Depending on the severity of the damage and the owner’s needs, repairing the vehicle or keeping it with a few dents may make more financial sense than replacing it.
paras.zh: 这对于被冰雹损坏的车辆尤其重要。与可能影响车辆结构或安全系统的严重碰撞不同，冰雹造成的损害通常主要是表面性的。即使保险公司认为修理费用过高，有凹痕的汽车仍可能运行良好。根据损坏的严重程度和车主的需求，修理车辆或保留其轻微凹痕可能比更换车辆更划算。

paras.en: According to McDorman, ACS has found cases where insurance companies valued vehicles at approximately 24% less than independent appraisals determined they were worth before the damage occurred. ACS has also identified concerns with salvage values for hail-damaged vehicles being calculated at rates roughly 10 percentage points higher than those for comparable collision-damaged vehicles.
paras.zh: McDorman 表示，ACS 发现保险公司对车辆的估价比独立评估在损坏发生前确定的价值低约 24%。 ACS 还发现，冰雹损坏车辆的残值计算率比同类碰撞损坏车辆的残值高出约 10 个百分点。

paras.en: While hail-damaged cars may be worth more after a loss because they’re often still in working condition, those values need to reflect actual market conditions, rather than assumptions. Otherwise, consumers could lose money on both ends of the settlement — receiving too little for pre-loss value and having too much deducted for keeping the vehicle afterward.
paras.zh: 虽然遭受冰雹损坏的汽车在损失后可能更值钱，因为它们通常仍处于工作状态，但这些价值需要反映实际的市场状况，而不是假设。否则，消费者可能会在和解的两端都遭受损失——损失前收到的金额太少，而事后保留车辆的金额则被扣除太多。

paras.en: The financial impact can be significant. Based on ACS’s experience handling disputed total-loss claims, consumers who gave up their vehicles received an average of $4,300 more after ACS challenged the original valuations. For those who chose to keep their vehicles, ACS secured an average increase of $6,600 by reviewing both the vehicle’s pre-loss value and the amount deducted for its salvage value. While every claim is different and results are not guaranteed, these figures show how much can be at stake when valuations are inaccurate.
paras.zh: 财务影响可能很大。根据 ACS 处理有争议的全损索赔的经验，在 ACS 对最初的估价提出质疑后，放弃车辆的消费者平均获得了 4,300 美元的额外赔偿。对于那些选择保留车辆的人，ACS 通过审查车辆的损失前价值和残值扣除金额，确保平均增加 6,600 美元。虽然每种说法都不同，并且不能保证结果，但这些数字表明，当估值不准确时，可能会面临多大的风险。

paras.en: Oklahoma’s higher threshold may also give collision repair shops more opportunities to help customers keep and repair vehicles that might previously have faced salvage-title requirements; however, McDorman stresses that making the right repair-or-replace decision starts with accurate vehicle valuations. Repair professionals can play a role by developing thorough repair plans that follow manufacturer procedures and helping customers recognize when an insurance company’s numbers deserve a closer look.
paras.zh: 俄克拉荷马州较高的门槛也可能为碰撞维修店提供更多机会来帮助客户保留和维修以前可能面临报废所有权要求的车辆；然而，麦克道曼强调，做出正确的维修或更换决定首先要对车辆进行准确的估价。维修专业人员可以发挥作用，制定遵循制造商程序的全面维修计划，并帮助客户识别何时值得仔细查看保险公司的数据。

paras.en: When figures are disputed, an independent appraisal may help resolve the disagreement, depending on the terms of the insurance policy.
paras.zh: 当数字存在争议时，独立评估可能有助于解决分歧，具体取决于保险单的条款。

paras.en: “Collision repair professionals are in a unique position because they understand what is actually required to return a damaged vehicle to its pre-loss condition safely,” said McDorman. “When a vehicle can be safely repaired, the consumer should have accurate information about that option. The insurance carrier’s initial valuation should not be the final word when there is a legitimate dispute over the numbers.”
paras.zh: 麦克道曼表示：“碰撞维修专业人员处于独特的地位，因为他们了解如何将受损车辆安全地恢复到损失前的状态。” “当车辆可以安全维修时，消费者应该获得有关该选项的准确信息。当对数字存在合法争议时，保险公司的初始估值不应成为最终决定。”

paras.en: McDorman recommends that consumers seek independent guidance before accepting a total-loss settlement, particularly when they disagree with the insurer’s valuation or want to explore options for retaining their vehicle.
paras.zh: 麦克道曼建议消费者在接受全损赔偿之前寻求独立指导，特别是当他们不同意保险公司的估值或想要探索保留车辆的选择时。

paras.en: “It’s your vehicle and your insurance policy. Consumers should never assume the insurance carrier’s initial recommendation represents every option available to them. The carrier determines its position under the policy, but the insured has the right to question the valuation, obtain independent advice and understand the financial consequences before deciding whether to repair, retain or replace the vehicle.”
paras.zh: “这是你的车辆和你的保单。消费者永远不应该认为保险公司的最初建议代表了他们可以选择的所有选择。保险公司决定其在保单下的立场，但被保险人有权在决定是否修理、保留或更换车辆之前质疑估价、获得独立建议并了解财务后果​​。”

paras.en: McDorman also encourages Oklahoma drivers whose vehicles were previously declared total losses to review their settlements, especially if they kept a hail-damaged vehicle and suspect the insurance company deducted too much for its salvage value. Understanding the vehicle’s pre-loss value, how much was deducted for keeping it and how the final settlement was calculated can help determine whether they received the money they deserved.
paras.zh: 麦克道曼还鼓励之前车辆被宣布全损的俄克拉荷马州司机审查他们的和解协议，特别是如果他们保留一辆被冰雹损坏的车辆并怀疑保险公司对其残值扣除过多。了解车辆的损失前价值、保留车辆时扣除的金额以及最终结算的计算方式可以帮助确定他们是否收到了应得的钱。

paras.en: Although Oklahoma’s new 70% threshold does not apply retroactively, that doesn’t necessarily mean consumers have no options when it comes to questioning an earlier settlement. Depending on the terms of their insurance policy and other applicable limitations, they may still be able to challenge an inaccurate vehicle valuation or excessive salvage deduction. Some policies include a right of appraisal, which provides a process for independent appraisers to help resolve disputes over a vehicle’s value.
paras.zh: 尽管俄克拉荷马州新的 70% 门槛不具有追溯力，但这并不一定意味着消费者在质疑早期和解时别无选择。根据保险单的条款和其他适用的限制，他们仍然可以对不准确的车辆估价或过多的报废扣除提出质疑。一些政策包括评估权，它为独立评估师提供了帮助解决车辆价值争议的流程。

paras.en: “Just because you’ve already accepted a total-loss settlement doesn’t necessarily mean you’ve run out of options,” McDorman said. “Every situation is different, and whether you can challenge an earlier settlement depends on your insurance policy, applicable legal deadlines, any agreements you’ve signed and the details of your claim. But if you believe you were paid less than you deserved, it’s worth finding out whether you still have options.”
paras.zh: 麦克道曼说：“仅仅因为你已经接受了全损和解，并不一定意味着你已经没有选择了。” “每种情况都是不同的，你是否可以对提前和解提出质疑取决于你的保险单、适用的法律截止日期、你签署的任何协议以及你的索赔细节。但如果你认为你得到的报酬低于应得的，那么值得看看你是否还有选择。”

paras.en: While Oklahoma’s new law puts a spotlight on these concerns, the potential for inaccurate vehicle valuations and unfair settlements extends beyond state lines. Salvage-title requirements and insurance policies vary, but consumers should know what their vehicles are worth, understand their rights and feel confident they’re receiving the compensation they’re owed.
paras.zh: 尽管俄克拉荷马州的新法律凸显了这些担忧，但车辆估值不准确和不公平解决的可能性超出了州界。报废所有权要求和保险政策各不相同，但消费者应该知道他们的车辆的价值，了解他们的权利，并对他们收到应得的赔偿充满信心。

paras.en: “Fair settlements start with knowing what your vehicle is worth and being willing to question the numbers,” McDorman said. “Whether you want to repair your vehicle, keep it after a total loss or replace it altogether, you deserve to understand your options and receive every dollar you’re entitled to. At the end of the day, knowing you’ve been treated fairly doesn’t just protect your wallet — it gives you peace of mind.”
paras.zh: 麦克多曼说：“公平和解首先要了解您的车辆的价值并愿意质疑这些数字。” “无论您是想修理您的车辆、在完全损失后保留它还是完全更换它，您都应该了解您的选择并收到您应得的每一块钱。归根结底，知道您受到公平对待不仅可以保护您的钱包，还可以让您安心。”

articles.title: Crash Champions Raises $45,000 for Susan G. Komen
articles.author: Jason Stahl

paras.en: Crash Champions announced that its annual Champions For a Cause campaign raised $45,000 in support of Susan G. Komen, bringing the company’s total fundraising contributions to more than $200,000 since 2023.
paras.zh: Crash Champions 宣布其年度 Champions For a Cause 活动筹集了 45,000 美元来支持 Susan G. Komen，使该公司自 2023 年以来的筹款总额超过 200,000 美元。

paras.en: Held throughout October for Breast Cancer Awareness Month, the campaign brought together Crash Champions team members across the country to raise awareness and funds in support of Komen’s mission to end breast cancer through research, advocacy and patient support.
paras.zh: 该活动于 10 月举办，旨在纪念乳腺癌宣传月，汇集了全国各地的 Crash Champions 团队成员，以提高人们的认识并筹集资金，以支持 Komen 通过研究、宣传和患者支持终结乳腺癌的使命。

paras.en: As a National Team Sponsor for Susan G. Komen, Crash Champions participated in MORE THAN PINK Walk and Race for the Cure events nationwide. Team members also supported the campaign through the purchase of custom Champions For a Cause apparel, with proceeds benefiting the organization.
paras.zh: 作为 Susan G. Komen 的国家队赞助商，Crash Champions 参加了全国范围内的 MORE THAN PINK Walk 和 Race for the Cure 活动。团队成员还通过购买定制 Champion For a Cause 服装来支持该活动，所得收益将使该组织受益。

paras.en: Since its inception in 2023, Champions For a Cause has become an annual tradition for Crash Champions.
paras.zh: 自 2023 年创办以来，Champions For a Cause 已成为 Crash Champions 的年度传统。

paras.en: “Everything we do is about helping people in their time of need, and the consistent response of our team members through the annual Champions For a Cause campaign is a strong reflection of that commitment,” said Matt Ebert, Founder and CEO of Crash Champions. “Susan G. Komen is a tremendous organization that helps patients, families and communities across the world. It’s our hope that the proceeds raised by our team members will make a positive impact.”
paras.zh: Crash Champions 创始人兼首席执行官马特·埃伯特 (Matt Ebert) 表示：“我们所做的一切都是为了在人们需要帮助时提供帮助，我们的团队成员通过年度 Champions For a Cause 活动做出的一致反应充分体现了这一承诺。” “Susan G. Komen 是一个伟大的组织，为世界各地的患者、家庭和社区提供帮助。我们希望我们的团队成员筹集的善款能够产生积极的影响。”

paras.en: “Susan G. Komen is incredibly grateful to Crash Champions for showing what it means to invest in people and communities,” said Mindy Scott, Executive Director, Susan G. Komen Illinois. “Crash Champions is demonstrating that the impact of a company can extend far beyond its business. They have gone above and beyond in bringing people together to make a meaningful difference.
paras.zh: “Susan G. Komen 非常感谢 Crash Champions 展示了投资于人和社区的意义，”伊利诺伊州 Susan G. Komen 执行董事 Mindy Scott 说道。 “Crash Champions 正在证明，一家公司的影响力可以远远超出其业务范围。他们在将人们聚集在一起以做出有意义的改变方面做出了卓越的贡献。

paras.en: “That same spirit of investment and possibility is at the heart of this partnership. Together, we are advancing lifesaving research, expanding access to care, and providing critical support to individuals and families facing breast cancer. This partnership transforms lives, inspires action, and drives progress toward a world without breast cancer.”
paras.zh: “同样的投资精神和可能性是这种伙伴关系的核心。我们共同推进挽救生命的研究，扩大获得护理的机会，并为面临乳腺癌的个人和家庭提供关键支持。这种伙伴关系改变了生活，激发了行动，并推动朝着没有乳腺癌的世界迈进。”

paras.en: Susan G. Komen continues to invest in research, advocacy, community health outreach and patient support programs. These efforts have contributed to a 44% decline in the breast cancer mortality rate among U.S. women since 1989.
paras.zh: Susan G. Komen 继续投资于研究、宣传、社区健康外展和患者支持项目。自 1989 年以来，这些努力使美国女性乳腺癌死亡率下降了 44%。

paras.en: For more information about Crash Champions, visit crashchampions.com.
paras.zh: 有关碰撞冠军的更多信息，请访问 crashchampions.com。

articles.title: VIVE Collision Acquires Town & County Auto Body in Connecticut
articles.author: Jason Stahl

paras.en: VIVE Collision has announced the acquisition of Town & County Auto Body in North Haven, Conn., from Mauro Motors, the family-owned automotive group behind BMW of Bridgeport, BMW of North Haven, Mercedes-Benz of North Haven and Mercedes-Benz Van Center of North Haven. The transaction marks VIVE’s second acquisition of a dealership-owned collision repair facility and reflects its experience assisting automotive dealer groups transition their body shop operations while maintaining valued relationships, OEM-focused repair standards and continuity for dealership customers.
paras.zh: VIVE Collision 宣布从 Mauro Motors 手中收购位于康涅狄格州北黑文市的 Town & County Auto Body。Mauro Motors 是一家家族汽车集团，旗下拥有 BMW of Bridgeport、BMW of North Haven、Mercedes-Benz of North Haven 和 Mercedes-Benz Van Center of North Haven。此次交易标志着 VIVE 第二次收购经销商拥有的碰撞修复设施，并反映了其在协助汽车经销商集团转型车身修理厂业务、同时保持有价值的关系、以 OEM 为中心的维修标准以及经销商客户的连续性方面的经验。

paras.en: Founded in 1985 by Mike Mauro, Town & County Auto Body holds a special place in Mauro Motors’ history. What began as a small auto body and towing operation in Hamden, Conn., eventually laid the foundation for the automotive group that would become Mauro Motors. As the family business grew, Town & County Auto Body relocated in 1999 to a newly constructed, 30,000-square-foot facility in North Haven, where it has continued serving Connecticut drivers with a focus on quality repairs, technical expertise and personalized customer care.
paras.zh: Town & County Auto Body 由 Mike Mauro 于 1985 年创立，在 Mauro Motors 的历史上占有特殊的地位。最初是康涅狄格州哈姆登的一家小型车身和拖车公司，最终为毛罗汽车公司的汽车集团奠定了基础。随着家族企业的发展，Town & County Auto Body 于 1999 年搬迁至北黑文新建的 30,000 平方英尺的工厂，继续为康涅狄格州的驾驶员提供服务，重点关注优质维修、技术专业知识和个性化客户服务。

paras.en: Town & County Auto Body, now Powered by VIVE, brings a strong OEM-focused foundation to VIVE’s footprint. Its investment in OEM-specific training, equipment, repair procedures and technical capabilities helps support safe, high-quality repairs on increasingly complex vehicles. With close ties to Mercedes-Benz of North Haven and BMW of North Haven, the facility has long understood dealership customer expectations and the importance of repairing vehicles according to applicable manufacturer procedures.
paras.zh: Town & County Auto Body 现已由 VIVE 提供支持，为 VIVE 的足迹奠定了以 OEM 为中心的强大基础。它对 OEM 特定培训、设备、维修程序和技术能力的投资有助于支持对日益复杂的车辆进行安全、高质量的维修。该工厂与北黑文的梅赛德斯-奔驰和北黑文的宝马有着密切的联系，长期以来了解经销商客户的期望以及根据适用的制造商程序维修车辆的重要性。

paras.en: “Town & County has an incredible history, and we’re proud to welcome a business that has meant so much to the Mauro family and the Connecticut automotive community,” said Vartan Jerian, Jr., CEO and founder of VIVE Collision. “This is our second acquisition of a dealership-owned collision repair operation, and we’ve seen firsthand how the right partnership can create value after a transaction closes. Dealership relationships and OEM repairs are important parts of our business. We have really enjoyed working with Jake and the Mauro Motors team and look forward to building on that relationship while investing in the talented Town & County team.”
paras.zh: VIVE Collision 首席执行官兼创始人 Vartan Jerian, Jr. 表示：“Town & County 拥有令人难以置信的历史，我们很自豪能够迎来一家对 Mauro 家族和康涅狄格州汽车界意义重大的企业。” “这是我们第二次收购经销商拥有的碰撞维修业务，我们亲眼目睹了正确的合作伙伴关系如何在交易完成后创造价值。经销商关系和 OEM 维修是我们业务的重要组成部分。我们非常享受与 Jake 和 Mauro Motors 团队的合作，并期待在投资才华横溢的 Town & County 团队的同时，进一步巩固这种关系。”

paras.en: The acquisition builds on VIVE’s experience working with dealership groups. In 2023, VIVE acquired its first dealer-owned collision center in Pennsylvania, leading to an ongoing partnership around OEM collision repair and customer service. With Town & County, VIVE brings that experience to a second dealer-owned operation, focusing on maintaining the strong connections that make these businesses successful.
paras.zh: 此次收购建立在 VIVE 与经销商集团合作的经验之上。 2023 年，VIVE 收购了位于宾夕法尼亚州的第一个经销商拥有的碰撞中心，从而在 OEM 碰撞维修和客户服务方面建立了持续的合作伙伴关系。通过 Town & County，VIVE 将这些经验带到了第二个经销商拥有的运营中，专注于维持使这些企业取得成功的强大联系。

paras.en: “Town & County was the first Mauro Motors business,” said Jake Mauro, president of Mauro Motors. “My father started it from nothing, and the success of that shop gave him the foundation and the credibility to buy our first dealership in 1993. Every store we own today traces back to it, so after 41 years this was a hard decision, but it was the right one.
paras.zh: “Town & County 是 Mauro Motors 的第一个业务，”Mauro Motors 总裁 Jake Mauro 说。 “我父亲白手起家，那家商店的成功为他在 1993 年购买我们的第一家经销店奠定了基础和信誉。我们今天拥有的每家商店都可以追溯到它，所以在 41 年后，这是一个艰难的决定，但这是正确的决定。

paras.en: “Collision repair is a good business, and it will always be part of how we take care of our customers. This was a strategic divestiture, and it was about Town & County specifically. With our recent focus on growing our dealership footprint, a shop with Town & County’s potential deserves someone whose entire focus is collision, and VIVE was the right fit. VIVE understood the business, respected our people and holds the same standards our customers expect. Our Mercedes-Benz and BMW customers will keep getting the same OEM-focused repairs from the same team they know today, and our dealerships will keep working hand in hand with Town & County. After 41 years, we’re handing it to people who will take care of it and take it to the next level.”
paras.zh: “碰撞维修是一项很好的业务，它永远是我们照顾客户的一部分。这是一项战略性剥离，特别是针对 Town & County。随着我们最近致力于扩大我们的经销商足迹，一家具有 Town & County 潜力的商店需要一个完全专注于碰撞的人，而 VIVE 正是合适的人选。VIVE 了解业务，尊重我们的员工，并持有与客户期望的相同标准。我们的梅赛德斯-奔驰和宝马客户将继续获得同样以 OEM 为中心的服务41 年后，我们的经销商将继续与 Town & County 携手合作，将其交给能够照顾它并将其提升到新水平的人。”

paras.en: Located at 18 Corporate Drive in North Haven, Town & County Auto Body, now Powered by VIVE, will continue serving drivers throughout the Greater New Haven area and beyond. Customers will benefit from the team’s existing OEM-focused repair expertise, supported by VIVE’s broader resources, ongoing training, technology and operational support.
paras.zh: Town & County Auto Body 位于北黑文 18 Corporate Drive，现已由 VIVE 提供支持，将继续为大纽黑文地区及其他地区的驾驶员提供服务。客户将受益于该团队现有的以 OEM 为中心的维修专业知识，并得到 VIVE 更广泛的资源、持续培训、技术和运营支持的支持。

paras.en: The acquisition further strengthens VIVE Collision’s presence in Connecticut and reinforces a differentiated approach to growth: partnering with established collision repair businesses, including dealership-owned facilities, while preserving their technical strengths and local relationships.
paras.zh: 此次收购进一步增强了 VIVE Collision 在康涅狄格州的影响力，并强化了差异化的增长方式：与成熟的碰撞修复企业（包括经销商拥有的设施）合作，同时保留其技术优势和当地关系。

paras.en: For more information on VIVE Collision, visit vivecollision.com.
paras.zh: 有关 VIVE Collision 的更多信息，请访问 vivecollision.com。

articles.title: AAA: Limitations remain for intersection AEB crash prevention
articles.author: Lurah Lowery

paras.en: To better understand how the latest intersection automatic emergency braking (AEB) systems perform, AAA tested four 2026 model-year vehicles across different intersection crash scenarios.
paras.zh: 为了更好地了解最新的路口自动紧急制动 (AEB) 系统的性能，AAA 在不同的路口碰撞场景中测试了四辆 2026 年款车辆。

paras.en: All four vehicles — 2026 model-year Chevrolet Equinox, Ford Explorer, Hyundai Tucson, and Tesla Model Y — avoided collisions in a standardized scenario where they turned left across oncoming traffic. However, when a vehicle entered their path from a side road, three of the four systems did not prevent a collision.
paras.zh: 所有四辆车——2026 年款雪佛兰 Equinox、福特 Explorer、现代 Tucson 和特斯拉 Model Y——在标准化场景中避免了碰撞，即在迎面驶来的车辆中左转。然而，当车辆从小路驶入道路时，四个系统中的三个并不能防止碰撞。

paras.en: Closed-course testing covered two intersection crash geometries, one turn-into-path scenario, and three left-turn-across-path scenario configurations. A robotic soft vehicle target represented the other vehicle.
paras.zh: 封闭路线测试涵盖了两种交叉路口碰撞几何形状、一种转入路径场景和三种左转跨路径场景配置。机器人软车辆目标代表另一辆车。

paras.en: AAA performed 74 closed-course runs conducted under controlled daytime conditions. AAA planned five runs for each vehicle and configuration. If a vehicle provided neither a forward collision warning nor AEB in the first three runs of a configuration, testing of that configuration was stopped to reduce the risk of damage.
paras.zh: AAA 在受控白天条件下进行了 74 次封闭路线跑步。 AAA 计划为每种车辆和配置进行五次测试。如果车辆在配置的前三次运行中既没有提供前方碰撞警告也没有提供 AEB，则停止该配置的测试以降低损坏风险。

paras.en: A press release from AAA provides an overview of the tests:
paras.zh: AAA 的新闻稿概述了测试：

paras.en: - “Turn-into-path: The robotic soft car made a right-hand turn into the path of the tested vehicle, which was traveling straight. The test vehicle traveled straight at 30 mph while the soft vehicle target turned right into its path from a perpendicular road at 5 mph.
paras.zh: - “转弯进入路径：机器人软车右转进入测试车辆的路径，该车辆一直直线行驶。测试车辆以 30 英里/小时的速度直线行驶，而软车辆目标以 5 英里/小时的速度从垂直道路右转进入其路径。

paras.en: - “Turn-across-path: standardized Euro NCAP configuration: With the turn signal activated, a steering robot guided the test. vehicle through a left turn at 15 km/h (9.3 mph) across the path of the soft vehicle target traveling at 30 km/h (18.6 mph). This test followed standardized Euro NCAP.
paras.zh: - “跨路径转弯：标准化 Euro NCAP 配置：转向灯激活后，转向机器人引导测试。车辆以 15 公里/小时（9.3 英里/小时）的速度左转，穿过以 30 公里/小时（18.6 英里/小时）行驶的软车辆目标的路径。该测试遵循标准化 Euro NCAP。

paras.en: - “Turn-across-path: no turn signal: With the turn signal off, a steering robot guided the test vehicle to make a left turn at 15 km/h (9.3 mph) across the path of an oncoming soft vehicle target traveling at 30 km/h (18.6 mph).
paras.zh: -“跨路径转弯：无转向灯：转向灯关闭时，转向机器人引导测试车辆以 15 公里/小时（9.3 英里/小时）的速度左转，穿过迎面而来的以 30 公里/小时（18.6 英里/小时）行驶的软车辆目标的路径。

paras.en: - “Turn-across-path: manual steering: The test was repeated at the same speeds with the turn signal activated, but a test driver manually steered the test vehicle through the left turn instead of the steering robot.”
paras.zh: - “交叉路径转弯：手动转向：在激活转向信号的情况下以相同的速度重复测试，但测试驾驶员手动驾驶测试车辆通过左转弯，而不是转向机器人。”

paras.en: “Intersections are some of the most dangerous places on the road,” said Greg Brannon, AAA’s director of automotive engineering and research, in a press release. “AEB is making progress in the limited intersection scenarios it is tested to handle. Unfortunately, performance outside those scenarios is spotty.”
paras.zh: “十字路口是道路上最危险的地方之一，”AAA 汽车工程和研究总监格雷格·布兰农 (Greg Brannon) 在一份新闻稿中表示。 “AEB 在经过测试处理的有限交叉路口场景中取得了进展。不幸的是，在这些场景之外的性能不稳定。”

paras.en: AAA says U.S. vehicle-to-vehicle AEB test protocols have historically focused on rear-end crashes.
paras.zh: AAA 表示，美国车对车 AEB 测试协议历来侧重于追尾事故。

paras.en: “[A]n analysis of 2020–2024 National Highway Traffic Safety Administration (NHTSA) Fatality Analysis Reporting System (FARS) data conducted by the AAA Foundation for Traffic Safety at AAA’s request found that angle crashes, including intersection-based configurations such as turn across path, turn into path, and T-bone crashes, accounted for approximately 41% of reported two-vehicle fatalities,” states a report on the AAA tests.
paras.zh: AAA 交通安全基金会应 AAA 的要求对 2020 年至 2024 年国家公路交通安全管理局 (NHTSA) 死亡分析报告系统 (FARS) 数据进行的分析发现，角度碰撞事故（包括基于交叉路口的配置，如跨过道路、转入道路和丁字形碰撞）约占报告的两车死亡事故的 41%，”AAA 测试报告指出。

paras.en: “In 2022, AAA evaluated vehicles whose standard AEB systems did not include manufacturer-identified intersection AEB functionality. Those systems did not provide alerting or braking intervention in the evaluated intersection scenarios.”
paras.zh: “2022 年，AAA 评估了标准 AEB 系统不包括制造商确定的交叉口 AEB 功能的车辆。这些系统在评估的交叉口场景中不提供警报或制动干预。”

paras.en: It adds that, in 2019, NHTSA developed a draft Intersection Safety Assist test procedure for research purposes, but hasn’t implemented a final test standard.
paras.zh: 它还补充说，2019年，NHTSA出于研究目的制定了交叉口安全辅助测试程序草案，但尚未实施最终测试标准。

paras.en: In 2020, a limited set of intersection tests, including a left turn across oncoming traffic, were added to the Euro New Car Assessment Programme (NCAP), according to the report. AAA says that under the Euro NCAP Car-to-Car Front Turn-Across-Path configuration, all four vehicles avoided the Principal Other Vehicle in every valid turn-across-path run.
paras.zh: 报告称，2020 年，欧洲新车评估计划 (NCAP) 中增加了一组有限的交叉路口测试，包括左转穿过迎面而来的车辆。 AAA 表示，在 Euro NCAP 车对车前交叉路径配置下，所有四辆车在每次有效的交叉路径运行中都避开了主要其他车辆。

paras.en: Based on its 2026 test results, AAA recommends automakers work with researchers, regulators, and safety organizations “to strengthen intersection AEB performance across a broader range of crash scenarios and real-world conditions, including the turn-into path scenario.”
paras.zh: 根据 2026 年的测试结果，AAA 建议汽车制造商与研究人员、监管机构和安全组织合作，“在更广泛的碰撞场景和现实条件下（包括转弯场景）加强交叉路口 AEB 性能。”

paras.en: “Regulators and safety organizations can support continued progress by collaborating with automakers and researchers to broaden vehicle testing protocols to include more intersection scenarios and real-world conditions,” AAA says.
paras.zh: AAA 表示：“监管机构和安全组织可以与汽车制造商和研究人员合作，扩大车辆测试协议，纳入更多交叉路口场景和现实条件，从而支持持续进步。”

paras.en: Drivers can also play a part, according to AAA.
paras.zh: 据 AAA 称，司机也可以发挥作用。

paras.en: “Drivers can use intersection AEB as an added layer of protection while staying attentive behind the wheel,” the release states. “When entering an intersection, consider ‘covering the brake’ by placing your right foot just above the brake pedal, with your heel on the floor. Be aware that nearby drivers may turn into your path and be ready to brake or steer if needed.”
paras.zh: 新闻稿称：“驾驶员可以使用交叉路口 AEB 作为额外的保护层，同时在驾驶时保持注意力集中。” “进入十字路口时，请考虑‘踩刹车’，将右脚放在制动踏板上方，脚跟放在地板上。请注意，附近的司机可能会驶入您的道路，并在需要时做好制动或转向的准备。”

paras.en: Featured image: One of AAA’s intersection AEB test runs with a 2026 Tesla Model Y.
paras.zh: 特色图片：AAA 的一项交叉路口 AEB 测试使用 2026 款 Tesla Model Y 进行。

articles.title: Opus IVS CEO gives insights on successful business growth at IDEAS Collide showcase
articles.author: Teresa Moss

paras.en: Brian Herron, CEO of Opus IVS, shared insights and lessons he’s learned about growing a business during the Society of Collision Repair Specialists (SCRS) IDEAS Collide showcase at the 2026 SEMA Show in Las Vegas.
paras.zh: Opus IVS 首席执行官 Brian Herron 在 2026 年拉斯维加斯 SEMA 展会上碰撞修复专家协会 (SCRS) IDEAS Collide 展示会上分享了他在发展业务方面学到的见解和经验教训。

paras.en: “My journey started 20-something years ago with six people on a team, and now when I go to work, there’s nearly 1,000 people that are in the organization that I’m responsible for,” Herron said.
paras.zh: “我的旅程始于 20 多年前，当时一个团队有 6 个人，现在当我上班时，我负责的组织中有近 1,000 人，”Herron 说。

paras.en: At the age of 19, Herron jumped into his first entrepreneur venture when he founded APTEN, a company that sold supercharger kits.
paras.zh: 19 岁时，Herron 创立了 APTEN（一家销售增压器套件的公司），开始了他的第一次创业。

paras.en: “I kept trying to do things and just kept failing,” Herron said. He added that he couldn’t find anyone to buy it.
paras.zh: “我一直在尝试做事，但总是失败，”赫伦说。他补充说，他找不到任何人购买它。

paras.en: After continually working on the company, he found some momentum, he said. However, he wasn’t able to scale the business.
paras.zh: 他说，在不断为公司工作后，他找到了一些动力。然而，他无法扩大业务规模。

paras.en: At the age of 23, Herron was offered the opportunity to be general manager of SCT Performance. The business had 50 employees.
paras.zh: 23 岁时，Herron 有机会担任 SCT Performance 的总经理。该企业有 50 名员工。

paras.en: “I had to really deal with people issues, technology issues, and legal issues,” Herron said.
paras.zh: “我必须真正处理人员问题、技术问题和法律问题，”赫伦说。

paras.en: A year later, in 2006, he partnered with Mike Drew to build Drew Technologies.
paras.zh: 一年后，即 2006 年，他与 Mike Drew 合作创建了 Drew Technologies。

paras.en: “That was a diagnostic business, and that has intersected a lot of my space and diagnostics from that point,” Herron said.
paras.zh: “那是一个诊断业务，从那时起它就与我的很多空间和诊断相交叉，”赫伦说。

paras.en: The company grew from six people to 50, he said.
paras.zh: 他说，公司人数从 6 人增加到 50 人。

paras.en: Herron said Drew Technologies eventually turned into Opus.
paras.zh: Herron 表示 Drew Technologies 最终变成了 Opus。

paras.en: “Opus is where I got the experience of putting companies together,” Herron said. “One of the first acquisitions I did, I didn’t even know how to do acquisitions, was a European company with 150 employees, and we had to close this deal in six weeks.”
paras.zh: “Opus 是我获得组建公司经验的地方，”赫伦说。 “我做的第一批收购之一是一家拥有 150 名员工的欧洲公司，我什至不知道如何进行收购，我们必须在六周内完成这笔交易。”

paras.en: “The most recent chapter has been asTech Opus, Herron said.
paras.zh: “最新一章是 asTech Opus，”赫伦说。

paras.en: “I have like a ton of extra energy, so this is not enough,” he said. “I flip airplanes and cars and land, and we have a wedding venue and a vineyard now in the backyard. My son and I started a robotic pet feeder company, so we designed how to do wet cat food feeding.”
paras.zh: “我有大量额外的能量，所以这还不够，”他说。 “我翻转飞机和汽车并着陆，我们的后院现在有一个婚礼场地和一个葡萄园。我和我的儿子创办了一家机器人宠物喂食器公司，所以我们设计了如何进行湿猫粮喂食。”

paras.en: Herron said his first experience with rapid scale was at Drew Technologies.
paras.zh: Herron 表示，他第一次经历快速扩张是在 Drew Technologies。

paras.en: “What I’ve seen is when you scale, you start with nothing, and you have no customers, no money,” he said. “You’re doing everything yourself. You’re trying things, and nothing’s working. You try this, and it doesn’t work. You feel like a failure every single day. You keep going, though, because either you have to or you want to.”
paras.zh: “我所看到的是，当你扩大规模时，你会白手起家，没有客户，没有钱，”他说。 “你什么事情都要自己做。你在尝试一些事情，但没有任何效果。你尝试了这个，但它不起作用。你每天都感觉自己是个失败者。不过，你继续前进，因为要么你必须这样做，要么你想要这样做。”

paras.en: You finally have something to sell, and other problems emerge, he said. Maybe a product doesn’t work, you have issues with shipments, or there’s a problem with manufacturing.
paras.zh: 他说，你终于有东西可以卖了，但其他问题却出现了。也许产品不起作用，运输出现问题，或者制造出现问题。

paras.en: “We’ve done onshore, offshore, software development, in-house, external, the whole deal,” Herron said. “But there’s just constant problems. Every step there’s another problem.”
paras.zh: “我们已经完成了在岸、离岸、软件开发、内部、外部的整个交易，”赫伦说。 “但问题始终存在。每走一步都会遇到另一个问题。”

paras.en: Scaling also means you want to have customers, he said.
paras.zh: 他说，规模化还意味着你想要拥有客户。

paras.en: Essentially, growing a business means a lot of problems, he said.
paras.zh: 他说，从本质上讲，发展业务意味着很多问题。

paras.en: Herron said the first thing he’s learned is that the most important part of a business is people.
paras.zh: 赫伦说，他学到的第一件事是，企业最重要的部分是人。

paras.en: “I’m a technology guy,” Herron said. “I’d like to disagree with that statement all day long. I’d think it would be software. But it’s actually the people. It’s the people in this room. It’s the people in this industry.”
paras.zh: “我是一名技术人员，”赫伦说。 “我整天都想不同意这种说法。我认为这会是软件。但实际上是人。是这个房间里的人。是这个行业的人。”

paras.en: You need the right people, and you need to challenge them on how to address the problem, Herron said.
paras.zh: 赫伦说，你需要合适的人，并且需要向他们提出如何解决问题的挑战。

paras.en: “There’s going to be some people who come in the door who aren’t the right cultural fit,” he said.
paras.zh: “将会有一些不适合文化的人进来，”他说。

paras.en: Herron said you can’t grow until you have great people.
paras.zh: 赫伦说，只有拥有优秀的人才，你才能成长。

paras.en: Another lesson learned is that you have to take care of your customer, he said.
paras.zh: 他说，另一个教训是你必须照顾你的顾客。

paras.en: “It starts with what they actually need,” Herron said. “When I came to Drew Tech, they had products that we were selling, but they were made by engineers, and the engineers were thinking about it at an abstract level.”
paras.zh: “这从他们的实际需要开始，”赫伦说。 “当我来到 Drew Tech 时，他们有我们正在销售的产品，但它们是由工程师制造的，工程师们在抽象层面上思考它。”

paras.en: Nobody was talking to customers, he said. He said there are some questions that businesses can ask customers.
paras.zh: 他说，没有人与顾客交谈。他说，企业可以向顾客询问一些问题。

paras.en: “Can I help you with your problem? Is anybody else helping with your problem? And when I help you with your problem, can I do it in a way that is repeatable, and I can build intellectual property, and can I build relationships with my customers?”
paras.zh: “我可以帮助您解决您的问题吗？还有其他人帮助您解决您的问题吗？当我帮助您解决您的问题时，我是否可以以可重复的方式做到这一点，并且我可以建立知识产权，并且我可以与客户建立关系吗？”

paras.en: Herron said he’s made many mistakes with customers throughout his journey.
paras.zh: 赫伦说，他在整个旅程中与客户犯了很多错误。

paras.en: “You ship a product, and it doesn’t work,” Herron said. “You make a promise to get something done, and there’s something else that gets in the way of it. You have to stand behind the customer every time. You have to make it right. It doesn’t matter what it costs. If you don’t, you might as well be out of business because you won’t be here in five years.”
paras.zh: “你发布了一个产品，但它不起作用，”赫伦说。 “你承诺要完成某件事，但还有其他事情阻碍了它。你每次都必须站在客户的身后。你必须把事情做好。成本多少并不重要。如果你不这样做，你可能会倒闭，因为五年后你就不会在这里了。”

paras.en: Successful businesses also have to focus on demand, he said.
paras.zh: 他说，成功的企业还必须关注需求。

paras.en: “You start selling a product, and your sales taper off; a lot of people don’t know what to do with that,” Herron said. “You have to think about where this product is going. How am I going to market this product?”
paras.zh: “你开始销售一种产品，然后销量逐渐减少；很多人不知道该怎么办，”赫伦说。 “你必须考虑这个产品的走向。我将如何营销这个产品？”

paras.en: This could mean expanding the product into different markets, he added.
paras.zh: 他补充说，这可能意味着将产品扩展到不同的市场。

paras.en: Lastly, the business has to be built on a solid foundation, he said.
paras.zh: 最后，他说，业务必须建立在坚实的基础上。

paras.en: “Every company has a handbook,” Herron said. “The joke is most of the handbook is full of problems that we’ve all learned about in the past. You have to do the basics. It has to be there.”
paras.zh: “每个公司都有一本手册，”赫伦说。 “开玩笑的是，手册的大部分内容都充满了我们过去都学过的问题。你必须做基础知识。它必须在那里。”

paras.en: Too much process is bad, but no process is also bad, he said.
paras.zh: 他说，太多的流程不好，但没有流程也不好。

paras.en: People, customers, demand, and foundation are four things that must be looked at when developing a business, he said.
paras.zh: 他说，做生意必须看“人”、“客户”、“需求”、“基础”。

paras.en: “There’s a lot more to it than that, but if you don’t get those right, in my opinion, you’re going to struggle,” Herron said. “I’ve struggled. I’ve been there.”
paras.zh: “事情远不止这些，但在我看来，如果你没有做好这些，你就会陷入困境，”赫伦说。 “我一直在挣扎。我也经历过。”

paras.en: Brian Herron, CEO of Opus IVS, suring IDEAS Collide November 2026 (Lurah Lowery/RDN).
paras.zh: Opus IVS 首席执行官 Brian Herron 将于 2026 年 11 月举办 IDEAS Collide (Lurah Lowery/RDN)。

articles.title: Nissan cybersecurity event shuts down diagnostic system
articles.author: Teresa Moss

paras.en: Nissan temporarily suspended a vehicle diagnostic system used by repairers late last week after identifying a cybersecurity incident, as first reported by The New York Times.
paras.zh: 据《纽约时报》首先报道，日产汽车在发现网络安全事件后，于上周晚些时候暂停了维修人员使用的车辆诊断系统。

paras.en: A notice on Nissan’s website states it initiated an emergency shutdown of certain CONSULT-related services on Nov. 13 in connection with a cybersecurity investigation.
paras.zh: 日产网站上的一则通知称，由于网络安全调查，该公司于 11 月 13 日紧急关闭了某些与 CONSULT 相关的服务。

paras.en: “The outage has been extended to allow additional time to complete the investigation and verify the security of affected services before they are restored,” the notice said Monday. “We regret the disruption and inconvenience this outage has caused and are working diligently to return system functionality as soon as practicable.”
paras.zh: 通知周一称：“停电时间已延长，以便有更多时间完成调查并在受影响的服务恢复之前验证其安全性。” “我们对此次中断造成的中断和不便表示遗憾，并正在努力尽快恢复系统功能。”

paras.en: Currently unavailable for CONSULT-III plus online functions include:
paras.zh: CONSULT-III plus 目前不可用的在线功能包括：

paras.en: Nissan notes that CONSULT-IV is currently not affected.
paras.zh: Nissan 指出 CONSULT-IV 目前未受到影响。

paras.en: The New York Times reports that the system shutdown also impacted dealers’ ability to make replacement key fobs for customers.
paras.zh: 《纽约时报》报道称，系统关闭还影响了经销商为客户更换钥匙扣的能力。

paras.en: “The shutdown means that service technicians cannot reprogram the electronic control units in Nissan and Infiniti vehicles manufactured since 1995, the company said in a notice to dealers and repair shops,” according to the article.
paras.zh: 该公司在给经销商和维修店的通知中表示，“停产意味着维修技术人员无法对 1995 年以来生产的日产和英菲尼迪汽车的电子控制单元进行重新编程”。

paras.en: The outage is among many that happened last week, including Microsoft, Apple, JPMorgan Chase, and the Federal Aviation Administration, the article notes.
paras.zh: 文章指出，此次停电是上周发生的众多停电事件之一，其中包括微软、苹果、摩根大通和联邦航空管理局。

paras.en: It adds that nearly all modern vehicles are equipped with electronic control units. The devices can control brakes, steering, and locks.
paras.zh: 它补充说，几乎所有现代车辆都配备了电子控制单元。这些设备可以控制刹车、转向和锁。

paras.en: Ari Lightman, a Carnegie Mellon University professor of digital media, told the newspaper that all computer systems can be compromised or fail. He says in the article that AI has given hackers new tools to exploit vulnerabilities.
paras.zh: 卡内基梅隆大学数字媒体教授阿里·莱特曼 (Ari Lightman) 告诉该报，所有计算机系统都可能受到损害或发生故障。他在文章中表示，人工智能为黑客提供了利用漏洞的新工具。

paras.en: Gang Wang, University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign associate professor of computer science, told the newspaper it is an unusually long shutdown.
paras.zh: 伊利诺伊大学厄巴纳-香槟分校计算机科学副教授王刚告诉该报，这是一次异常长时间的关闭。

paras.en: Last year, Jaguar Land Rover shut down its systems after a cyber incident.
paras.zh: 去年，捷豹路虎在网络事件后关闭了其系统。

articles.title: Think Twice Before Erasing Trouble Codes
articles.author: Jeff White

paras.en: Counter pros should avoid erasing diagnostic trouble codes when customers request it. Clearing codes without fixing the underlying problem will only temporarily turn off the check engine light.
paras.zh: 柜台专业人员应避免在客户要求时删除诊断故障代码。清除代码而不解决根本问题只会暂时关闭检查引擎灯。

paras.en: Erasing codes also deletes valuable freeze-frame data that technicians need for accurate diagnosis. Additionally, clearing codes resets emissions readiness monitors, potentially affecting vehicle emissions testing.
paras.zh: 擦除代码还会删除技术人员进行准确诊断所需的宝贵冻结帧数据。此外，清除代码会重置排放准备监视器，可能会影响车辆排放测试。

paras.en: This video is sponsored by The Pronto Network.
paras.zh: 该视频由 Pronto Network 赞助。

articles.title: Five Axes, New Possibilities for CNC Machining
articles.author: Greg Jones

paras.en: From intricate cylinder head ports to billet engine blocks and complex racing components, 5-axis CNC technology is giving engine builders new ways to improve precision, increase productivity and expand their machining capabilities.
paras.zh: 从复杂的气缸盖端口到钢坯发动机缸体和复杂的赛车部件，5 轴 CNC 技术为发动机制造商提供了提高精度、提高生产率和扩展加工能力的新方法。

paras.en: For decades, engine machining has been a combination of precision equipment, specialized fixtures and the knowledge of skilled machinists. Whether machining a cylinder head, modifying an engine block or manufacturing a custom component, achieving the desired result often meant moving a workpiece between several machines, establishing new reference points and performing multiple setups before the job was complete. Five-axis CNC machining is changing that approach.
paras.zh: 几十年来，发动机加工一直是精密设备、专用夹具和熟练机械师知识的结合。无论是加工气缸盖、修改发动机缸体还是制造定制部件，要获得所需的结果通常意味着在多台机器之间移动工件、建立新的参考点并在作业完成之前执行多次设置。五轴数控加工正在改变这种方法。

paras.en: By combining three linear axes with two rotational axes, modern 5-axis machines allow cutting tools to approach complex surfaces from multiple directions, often without removing or repositioning the workpiece. The result is greater flexibility, improved consistency and opportunities to perform operations that were previously difficult or impractical with conventional equipment.
paras.zh: 通过将三个线性轴与两个旋转轴相结合，现代 5 轴机床允许切削刀具从多个方向接近复杂表面，通常无需移除或重新定位工件。其结果是更大的灵活性、更高的一致性以及执行以前使用传统设备困难或不切实际的操作的机会。

paras.en: For performance engine builders, cylinder head manufacturers and automotive machine shops, those capabilities are becoming increasingly valuable as engine designs grow more complex and customers demand tighter tolerances, improved airflow and faster turnaround times.
paras.zh: 对于高性能发动机制造商、气缸盖制造商和汽车机械车间来说，随着发动机设计变得越来越复杂，以及客户要求更严格的公差、改进的气流和更快的周转时间，这些功能变得越来越有价值。

paras.en: According to Paul Russel, principal engineer at Okuma, one of the biggest changes is the ability to consolidate multiple machining operations into a single process.
paras.zh: Okuma 首席工程师 Paul Russel 表示，最大的变化之一是将多个加工操作整合到一个流程中的能力。

paras.en: Instead of repeatedly unclamping and relocating a cylinder head or block, a 5-axis machining center can rotate and tilt the workpiece to present different surfaces to the spindle. This reduces setup time while maintaining the positional relationship between critical features.
paras.zh: 5 轴加工中心无需反复松开和重新定位气缸盖或缸体，而是可以旋转和倾斜工件，以向主轴呈现不同的表面。这减少了设置时间，同时保持了关键特征之间的位置关系。

paras.en: Ryan Thompson, COO of Rottler Manufacturing also emphasizes this consolidation, noting that operations traditionally requiring three or four setups can often be reduced to one. Beyond saving labor, fewer setups mean more time spent machining and less time preparing the equipment.
paras.zh: Rottler Manufacturing 首席运营官 Ryan Thompson 也强调了这种整合，并指出传统上需要三到四个设置的操作通常可以减少到一个。除了节省劳动力之外，更少的设置意味着更多的加工时间和更少的设备准备时间。

paras.en: While the term 5-axis machining suggests simultaneous movement along five axes, not every application requires all five to move during the cutting process.
paras.zh: 虽然“5 轴加工”一词表示沿五个轴同时移动，但并非每个应用都需要在切削过程中所有五个轴都移动。

paras.en: Understanding the difference between simultaneous 5-axis machining and 3+2 positional machining is particularly important for engine builders evaluating the technology.
paras.zh: 了解同步 5 轴加工和 3+2 定位加工之间的差异对于评估该技术的发动机制造商尤为重要。

paras.en: With 3+2 machining, the two rotational axes position the workpiece or cutting tool at a specific angle. Once positioned, the machine performs the operation using its three linear axes. This approach is effective for compound-angle valve guides, seat pockets, lifter bores, angled passages and numerous other engine machining operations.
paras.zh: 在 3+2 加工中，两个旋转轴以特定角度定位工件或切削刀具。定位后，机器将使用其三个线性轴执行操作。这种方法对于复合角度气门导管、阀座套、挺杆孔、倾斜通道和许多其他发动机加工操作非常有效。

paras.en: Simultaneous 5-axis machining, meanwhile, allows all five axes to move together, continuously changing the tool’s orientation as it follows a complex surface.
paras.zh: 同时，同步 5 轴加工允许所有五个轴一起移动，在刀具遵循复杂表面时不断改变刀具的方向。

paras.en: Russel explains that most conventional engine machining operations can be accomplished using 3+2 positioning. However, applications involving continuously changing contours, such as intake and exhaust ports, often require simultaneous movement.
paras.zh: Russel 解释说，大多数传统的发动机加工操作都可以使用 3+2 定位来完成。然而，涉及连续变化轮廓的应用（例如进气口和排气口）通常需要同时移动。

paras.en: Richard Erhard, a senior applications and training engineer at Centroid CNC, makes a similar distinction. The company’s experience with cylinder head machining shows that guide holes, reaming and compound-angle drilling and tapping can frequently be completed using positional machining. Porting, however, presents a different challenge because the tool must continuously change its orientation to reach restricted areas.
paras.zh: Centroid CNC 的高级应用和培训工程师 Richard Erhard 也做出了类似的区分。该公司在缸盖加工方面的经验表明，导孔、铰孔、复合角度钻孔和攻丝通常可以使用定位加工来完成。然而，移植带来了不同的挑战，因为该工具必须不断改变其方向才能到达限制区域。

paras.en: That flexibility is one of the major advantages of a full 5-axis machine. Shops can combine simultaneous port machining with positional operations while keeping the cylinder head in the same fixture.
paras.zh: 这种灵活性是全五轴机器的主要优势之一。车间可以将同步端口加工与定位操作结合起来，同时将气缸盖保持在同一夹具中。

paras.en: Cylinder head porting is arguably the application most closely associated with 5-axis CNC machining. Intake and exhaust runners feature complex internal geometry, changing cross-sectional areas, short-side radii and obstructions that make conventional machining difficult.
paras.zh: 气缸盖移植可以说是与 5 轴 CNC 加工最密切相关的应用。进气和排气流道具有复杂的内部几何形状、不断变化的横截面积、短边半径和障碍物，这使得传统加工变得困难。

paras.en: With simultaneous 5-axis movement, a cutting tool can follow the contours of a developed port while adjusting its angle to maintain clearance and access otherwise unreachable surfaces.
paras.zh: 通过同步 5 轴运动，切削刀具可以沿着已开发端口的轮廓移动，同时调整其角度以保持间隙并进入其他无法到达的表面。

paras.en: Centroid points to the challenges created by guide bosses, head stud tubes and rocker stud bosses. Successfully machining around these features requires both continuous changes in tool orientation and specialized cutter geometry.
paras.zh: 质心指出了导向凸台、头螺柱管和摇杆螺柱凸台所带来的挑战。围绕这些特征成功加工需要不断改变刀具方向和专门的刀具几何形状。

paras.en: Combustion chambers present similar challenges, particularly when working with canted-valve configurations or shrouded chamber designs. Five-axis movement allows the cutter to reach beneath overhanging surfaces while maintaining the intended chamber geometry.
paras.zh: 燃烧室也面临类似的挑战，特别是在使用斜阀配置或罩室设计时。五轴运动使刀具能够到达悬垂表面下方，同时保持预期的腔室几何形状。

paras.en: Beyond access, the technology provides a major advantage in repeatability. A cylinder head port originally developed by hand can be digitized and converted into a CNC program. Once proven, that program can reproduce the same geometry across multiple ports and cylinder heads.
paras.zh: 除了访问之外，该技术还提供了可重复性的主要优势。最初由手工开发的气缸盖端口可以数字化并转换为 CNC 程序。一旦经过验证，该程序可以在多个端口和气缸盖上重现相同的几何形状。

paras.en: Centroid notes that a cylinder head requiring several days to roughly a week of hand porting can often be CNC ported in a few hours to less than a day.
paras.zh: Centroid 指出，需要几天到大约一周的手工移植的气缸盖通常可以在几个小时到不到一天的时间内完成 CNC 移植。

paras.en: One of the most significant advantages of 5-axis machining is its ability to reduce the accumulation of positioning errors associated with multiple setups.
paras.zh: 5 轴加工最显着的优势之一是能够减少与多个设置相关的定位误差的累积。

paras.en: Every time a cylinder head or block is removed from a fixture and relocated, small differences in alignment can be introduced. Even precision locating dowels, fixtures and machine components have manufacturing tolerances.
paras.zh: 每次将气缸盖或缸体从固定装置上拆下并重新定位时，都会在对准中引入微小的差异。即使是精密定位销钉、固定装置和机器部件也存在制造公差。

paras.en: When several setups are required, those variations can accumulate. Keeping the workpiece in one fixture allows multiple features to be machined relative to a common coordinate system.
paras.zh: 当需要多个设置时，这些变化可能会累积。将工件保持在一个夹具中允许相对于公共坐标系加工多个特征。

paras.en: On a cylinder head, that might include port geometry, combustion chambers, guide bores and other features that must maintain precise relationships.
paras.zh: 在气缸盖上，这可能包括端口几何形状、燃烧室、导向孔和其他必须保持精确关系的特征。

paras.en: Centroid recommends locating cylinder heads using the deck surface and precision dowel holes. Establishing those references allows subsequent operations to maintain a consistent relationship to the original geometry.
paras.zh: Centroid 建议使用甲板表面和精密定位销孔来定位气缸盖。建立这些参考允许后续操作保持与原始几何图形的一致关系。

paras.en: Tool orientation also influences machining quality. By approaching a surface from an optimal angle, machinists can use shorter, more rigid cutting tools and improve cutting engagement.
paras.zh: 刀具方向也会影响加工质量。通过从最佳角度接近表面，机械师可以使用更短、更坚固的切削刀具并改善切削啮合。

paras.en: Russel notes that avoiding the center of a ball end mill, where cutting performance is less favorable, can improve surface finish. Proper tool orientation also helps reduce deflection and chatter.
paras.zh: Russel 指出，避开切削性能较差的球头铣刀中心可以提高表面光洁度。正确的工具方向还有助于减少偏转和颤振。

paras.en: However, adding rotational axes does not automatically make a machine more accurate. Rotary-axis calibration, thermal stability, fixture rigidity and proper tooling remain essential. Okuma addresses these considerations through technologies such as its 5-Axis Auto Tuning System, which measures and compensates for geometric errors, and its Thermo-Friendly Concept, designed to manage thermal growth.
paras.zh: 然而，添加旋转轴并不会自动使机器变得更加精确。旋转轴校准、热稳定性、夹具刚性和适当的工具仍然至关重要。 Okuma 通过测量和补偿几何误差的 5 轴自动调谐系统以及旨在管理热增长的热友好概念等技术来解决这些问题。

paras.en: The underlying lesson remains familiar to experienced machinists: advanced equipment improves what is possible, but sound machining practices determine whether those capabilities produce consistent results.
paras.zh: 对于经验丰富的机械师来说，基本的教训仍然很熟悉：先进的设备可以提高可能性，但良好的加工实践决定了这些能力是否能产生一致的结果。

paras.en: Expanding Billet Manufacturing Capabilities
paras.zh: 扩大钢坯制造能力

paras.en: While cylinder heads are a major application, 5-axis machining is equally valuable in manufacturing billet engine components. Billet blocks, cylinder heads, intake manifolds, rocker stands, oil pans and other racing components often contain features positioned at multiple angles.
paras.zh: 虽然气缸盖是主要应用，但 5 轴加工在制造毛坯发动机部件方面同样有价值。钢坯缸体、气缸盖、进气歧管、摇臂支架、油底壳和其他赛车部件通常包含以多个角度定位的特征。

paras.en: Russel explains that the freedom 5-axis CNC machining allows for can influence component design itself. Engineers can position ribs, bosses, oil passages and mounting features according to their intended function rather than simply accommodating the limitations of available machining equipment, or even OEM placement.
paras.zh: Russel 解释说，5 轴 CNC 加工所带来的自由度可以影响组件设计本身。工程师可以根据其预期功能定位肋、凸台、油道和安装特征，而不是简单地适应可用加工设备甚至 OEM 放置的限制。

paras.en: That flexibility becomes particularly valuable in racing applications, where weight reduction and structural integrity must be balanced carefully.
paras.zh: 这种灵活性在赛车应用中变得特别有价值，因为在赛车应用中必须仔细平衡减重和结构完整性。

paras.en: Rottler’s Ryan Thompson highlights block lightening as another application. By following the irregular external geometry of a cast engine block, 5-axis equipment can remove material from selected areas while maintaining the desired structure.
paras.zh: Rottler 的 Ryan Thompson 强调块闪电是另一个应用程序。通过遵循铸造发动机缸体的不规则外部几何形状，5 轴设备可以从选定区域去除材料，同时保持所需的结构。

paras.en: The technology also supports increasingly complex billet designs, including raised-cam configurations, angled oil passages and integrated mounting features.
paras.zh: 该技术还支持日益复杂的坯料设计，包括凸起凸轮配置、成角度的油道和集成安装功能。

paras.en: Although mechanical capabilities attract much of the attention, improvements in CAD/CAM software, machine controls and simulation have played an equally important role in making 5-axis machining accessible.
paras.zh: 尽管机械功能备受关注，但 CAD/CAM 软件、机器控制和仿真的改进在实现 5 轴加工的普及方面也发挥了同样重要的作用。

paras.en: Programming a complex multi-axis toolpath once required considerable specialized knowledge. Modern CAM systems automate much of that process, including tool-axis positioning, collision checking and machining simulation.
paras.zh: 复杂的多轴刀具路径编程曾经需要大量的专业知识。现代 CAM 系统使大部分流程实现自动化，包括刀轴定位、碰撞检查和加工模拟。

paras.en: Rottler sees these advancements as a major reduction in the barriers to entry for shops transitioning from conventional equipment.
paras.zh: Rottler 认为这些进步大大降低了商店从传统设备过渡的进入壁垒。

paras.en: Centroid takes a turnkey approach, combining the machine, fixturing, tooling, software and training into a process intended to help shops convert developed hand-ported designs into repeatable CNC programs. Its training schedule includes six days for cylinder head porting and an additional two days for block machining.
paras.zh: Centroid 采用交钥匙方法，将机器、夹具、工具、软件和培训结合到一个流程中，旨在帮助商店将开发的手工移植设计转换为可重复的 CNC 程序。其培训计划包括六天的气缸盖移植和另外两天的缸体加工。

paras.en: Okuma emphasizes that learning to operate the machine is only part of the transition. Shops must also understand machine kinematics, toolpath verification, fixturing and the relationship between rotary-axis movement and work offsets.
paras.zh: Okuma 强调，学习操作机器只是过渡的一部分。车间还必须了解机器运动学、刀具路径验证、夹具以及旋转轴运动和工件偏移之间的关系。

paras.en: Modern simulation is especially important because complex multi-axis movements can be difficult to visualize. Accurate digital models of fixtures, toolholders and cutting tools allow programs to be checked before machining begins.
paras.zh: 现代模拟尤其重要，因为复杂的多轴运动很难可视化。夹具、刀柄和切削刀具的精确数字模型允许在加工开始之前检查程序。

paras.en: Okuma’s Collision Avoidance System provides another layer of protection by monitoring potential interference between machine components and the workpiece.
paras.zh: Okuma 的防撞系统通过监控机器部件和工件之间的潜在干扰提供另一层保护。

paras.en: Automation is also becoming increasingly important. Probing systems can establish work offsets and locate castings, while pallet changers and robotic loading systems help keep machines productive with less operator involvement.
paras.zh: 自动化也变得越来越重要。探测系统可以建立工作偏移并定位铸件，而托盘更换器和机器人装载系统有助于在减少操作员参与的情况下保持机器的生产效率。

paras.en: For engine shops considering 5-axis equipment, the financial justification extends beyond machining speed. Reduced setup time, fewer secondary operations, improved repeatability and the ability to bring outsourced work in-house can all contribute to profitability.
paras.zh: 对于考虑使用 5 轴设备的发动机车间来说，财务合理性不仅仅限于加工速度。减少设置时间、减少二次操作、提高可重复性以及将外包工作内部化的能力都有助于提高盈利能力。

paras.en: The right choice depends on the complexity of the parts, production volume and opportunities to eliminate unnecessary operations or create new revenue streams.
paras.zh: 正确的选择取决于零件的复杂性、产量以及消除不必要的操作或创造新收入来源的机会。

paras.en: Looking ahead, all three machine manufacturers anticipate further advancements in automation and software intelligence.
paras.zh: 展望未来，三大机器制造商都预计自动化和软件智能将进一步进步。

paras.en: Rottler is exploring artificial intelligence in port development, including integrating computational fluid dynamics and flow-bench data into its software to accelerate cylinder head optimization. Centroid expects AI-assisted toolpath generation to become more common. Okuma anticipates greater use of digital inspection, machine simulation, automated loading and intelligent controls capable of monitoring machine conditions and compensating for changing operating variables.
paras.zh: Rottler 正在探索港口开发中的人工智能，包括将计算流体动力学和流动台数据集成到其软件中，以加速气缸盖优化。 Centroid 预计人工智能辅助刀具路径生成将变得更加普遍。 Okuma 预计将更多地使用数字检测、机器模拟、自动装载和智能控制，能够监控机器状况并补偿不断变化的操作变量。

paras.en: Ultimately, 5-axis CNC machining does not replace the experience required to design a successful engine or develop an effective block or cylinder head. Instead, it gives skilled professionals a more capable manufacturing platform for turning that knowledge into repeatable results.
paras.zh: 最终，5 轴 CNC 加工并不能取代设计成功的发动机或开发有效的缸体或缸盖所需的经验。相反，它为熟练的专业人员提供了一个更有能力的制造平台，将知识转化为可重复的结果。

articles.title: National Technician Appreciation Week Set for June 13-19, 2027
articles.author: Kevin Linger

paras.en: National Technician Appreciation Week will take place June 13-19, 2027, the American Trucking Associations (ATA) and its Technology & Maintenance Council (TMC) announced. The eighth annual event will carry the theme “Celebrating technicians that keep us moving.”
paras.zh: 美国卡车运输协会 (ATA) 及其技术与维护委员会 (TMC) 宣布，全国技术员答谢周将于 2027 年 6 月 13 日至 19 日举行。第八届年度活动的主题是“庆祝让我们不断前进的技术人员”。

paras.en: The week recognizes professional technicians’ work supporting truck safety, reliability, and fleet operations.
paras.zh: 本周表彰专业技术人员在支持卡车安全、可靠性和车队运营方面所做的工作。

paras.en: “Professional technicians are indispensable to trucking operations, and our nation owes them an enormous debt of gratitude,” said Henry Hanscom, ATA chief advocacy and public affairs officer. “The exacting standards that technicians uphold help to keep everyone on the road safe and ensure trucks can travel hundreds of billions of miles each year to deliver to homes and businesses. ATA looks forward to leading the celebration of National Technician Appreciation Week next June and thanking these hardworking, highly skilled professionals for ensuring the wheels of our industry continue to turn.”
paras.zh: ATA 首席宣传和公共事务官亨利·汉斯科姆 (Henry Hanscom) 表示：“专业技术人员对于卡车运输业务来说是不可或缺的，我们的国家欠他们巨大的感激之情。” “技术人员所遵循的严格标准有助于保证道路上每个人的安全，并确保卡车每年能够行驶数千亿英里，为家庭和企业送货。ATA 期待明年 6 月领导国家技术人员答谢周庆祝活动，并感谢这些勤奋、高技能的专业人士确保我们行业的车轮继续运转。”

paras.en: “Professional technicians combine deep technical expertise with an unwavering commitment to safety and reliability,” said Robert Braswell, TMC executive director. “We are pleased to announce the dates for the eighth annual National Technician Appreciation Week to recognize their invaluable contributions. This is an opportunity for our industry to shine a spotlight on the talented men and women whose work is essential to keeping fleets operating safely and efficiently every day.”
paras.zh: TMC 执行董事 Robert Braswell 表示：“专业技术人员将深厚的技术专长与对安全性和可靠性的坚定承诺结合起来。” “我们很高兴地宣布第八届年度国家技术人员答谢周的日期，以表彰他们的宝贵贡献。这是我们行业关注才华横溢的男男女女的机会，他们的工作对于保持车队每天安全高效地运营至关重要。”

articles.title: BendPak Releases OctaFlex Series Lifts
articles.author: Alex Crissey

paras.en: BendPak Inc. released the OctaFlex Series of eight-arm car lifts. The OctaFlex12DPS two-post lift is now shipping.
paras.zh: BendPak Inc. 发布了 OctaFlex 系列八臂汽车举升机。 OctaFlex12DPS 两柱移位机现已发货。

paras.en: According to the company, this is how it works: “While the four primary arms support the vehicle, the four secondary arms can raise, lower or simply hold cabs, drivetrains, EV batteries, suspension assemblies and other heavy components without the need for additional equipment, helpers or bays. When they’re not required, the auxiliary arms can be moved up out of the way, so the lift can be used as a standard two-post model.”
