paras.zh: 据该公司介绍，它的工作原理是这样的：“四个主臂支撑车辆，四个辅助臂可以升高、降低或简单地支撑驾驶室、传动系统、电动汽车电池、悬架总成和其他重型部件，而无需额外的设备、助手或托架。当不需要时，辅助臂可以向上移开，因此升降机可以用作标准的两柱模型。”

paras.en: It also comes with a magnetic pendant controller with two-speed controls. The pendant controller lets technicians stand back from the lift columns for enhanced visibility around the vehicle. Each set of arms can be operated independently at either “normal” or new “slow” speed.
paras.zh: 它还配备了具有两种速度控制的磁性吊坠控制器。悬吊式控制器让技术人员可以站在升降柱后面，以增强车辆周围的视野。每组手臂都可以以“正常”或新的“慢速”速度独立操作。

paras.en: “As dealers and independent repair shops continue to struggle with an aging and shrinking technician workforce, they also face surging demand for labor-intensive tasks like cab-off repairs and EV service,” says Jeff Kritzer, BendPak president and CEO. “OctaFlex eases the pressure by helping technicians handle complex jobs independently with greater efficiency and less physical strain, maximizing throughput and profit potential.”
paras.zh: BendPak 总裁兼首席执行官杰夫·克里泽 (Jeff Kritzer) 表示：“随着经销商和独立维修店继续应对技术人员队伍老化和萎缩的问题，他们还面临着出租车维修和电动汽车服务等劳动密集型任务的需求激增。” “OctaFlex 通过帮助技术人员以更高的效率和更少的体力独立处理复杂的工作来减轻压力，从而最大限度地提高吞吐量和利润潜力。”

articles.title: Alliance Big Kahuna Sweepstakes Nearing End
articles.author: Alex Crissey

paras.en: The Aftermarket Auto Parts Alliance, Inc. announced that its fall Big Kahuna Getaway Sweepstakes is nearing an end, with a week left until the Nov. 30 deadline to win a trip to Hawaii.
paras.zh: 售后汽车配件联盟 (Aftermarket Auto Parts Alliance, Inc.) 宣布，其秋季 Big Kahuna Getaway 抽奖活动即将结束，距离赢得夏威夷之旅的最后期限 11 月 30 日还有一周时间。

paras.en: The promotion gives technicians the opportunity to participate through MyPlace4Parts by earning entries with qualifying purchases for a chance to win one of 25 trips for two to Oahu or a share of $45,000 in gift card prizes.
paras.zh: 此次促销活动让技术人员有机会通过 MyPlace4Parts 参与活动，通过符合条件的购买获得参赛资格，有机会赢得 25 次前往欧胡岛的两人旅行中的一次，或者分享 45,000 美元的礼品卡奖品。

paras.en: In May 2027, winners and their guests will enjoy six nights and seven days in Oahu, including accommodations, travel, exclusive meals and receptions, VIP experiences, and curated activities.
paras.zh: 2027 年 5 月，获奖者及其宾客将在欧胡岛享受 7 天 6 晚的住宿，包括住宿、旅行、专属餐食和招待会、VIP 体验和策划活动。

paras.en: “We want to thank every technician and shop participating in the Big Kahuna Getaway and helping make this promotion such an exciting opportunity,” said Kendall Lozano, sales and marketing manager for the Aftermarket Auto Parts Alliance, Inc. “We know how hard our customers work every day, and we’re excited to have the opportunity to give them something to look forward to. We also want to extend our sincere thanks to our channel partners whose continued support helps make experiences like this possible. We’re looking forward to celebrating with our winners and welcoming them to Oahu next May.”
paras.zh: 售后汽车零部件联盟公司销售和营销经理 Kendall Lozano 表示：“我们要感谢参与 Big Kahuna Getaway 的每一位技术人员和商店，他们帮助使这次促销活动成为一个令人兴奋的机会。我们知道我们的客户每天工作有多么辛苦，我们很高兴有机会为他们提供一些值得期待的东西。我们还要向我们的渠道合作伙伴表示诚挚的谢意，他们的持续支持使这样的体验成为可能。我们期待与获奖者一起庆祝，并欢迎明年五月他们将前往欧胡岛。”

articles.title: NMG Gives UAC, Precision Vendor of the Year Awards
articles.author: Alex Crissey

paras.en: NexaMotion Group (NMG) named UAC (Universal Air Conditioner, Inc.) and Precision International the recipients of its first annual Vendor of the Year award.
paras.zh: NexaMotion Group (NMG) 将 UAC (Universal Air Conditioner, Inc.) 和 Precision International 授予其首个年度供应商奖。

paras.en: According to NMG, honorees were selected by NMG’s executive and supply chain leadership on “availability, quality and responsiveness, and on a harder test: how far the supplier was willing to go in service of NMG’s strategy and its customers’ success.”
paras.zh: 据 NMG 称，获奖者是由 NMG 的高管和供应链领导层根据“可用性、质量和响应能力，以及更严格的测试：供应商愿意在多大程度上为 NMG 的战略和客户的成功服务”而选出的。

paras.en: “Anyone can fill an order. Our best partners help us build the business,” said Scott Weinstein, president of NexaMotion Group. “UAC and Precision International show up in the planning room, not just on the loading dock. They bring us coverage before our customers ask for it, they invest in our people and our shops, and when we make bold moves as a company they are right beside us. That is partnership, and it is what this award was created to honor.”
paras.zh: “任何人都可以填写订单。我们最好的合作伙伴帮助我们发展业务，”NexaMotion Group 总裁 Scott Weinstein 说道。 “UAC 和 Precision International 出现在规划室，而不仅仅是装货码头。他们在客户提出要求之前就为我们提供报道，他们对我们的员工和商店进行投资，当我们作为一家公司采取大胆行动时，他们就在我们身边。这就是合作伙伴关系，这也是这个奖项的设立的目的。”

articles.title: NABC, Partners Donate Recycled Ride to Navy Veteran
articles.author: Jason Stahl

paras.en: On Tuesday, Nov. 17, a U.S. Navy veteran and single mother from the Twin Cities received a refurbished vehicle to help her maintain employment, continue building a sustainable future and create greater opportunities for herself and her family. The donation was made possible by the NABC Recycled Rides program, vehicle donor Farmers and repair partner Heppner’s Auto Body & Glass.
paras.zh: 11 月 17 日星期二，一位来自双城的美国海军退伍军人和单身母亲收到了一辆翻新车辆，以帮助她维持就业、继续建设可持续的未来并为自己和家人创造更多机会。此次捐赠是由 NABC Recycled Rides 计划、车辆捐赠者 Farmers 和维修合作伙伴 Heppner’s Auto Body & Glass 共同促成的。

paras.en: The recipient was nominated by the Minnesota Assistance Council for Veterans, whose mission is to end veteran homelessness in Minnesota.
paras.zh: 获奖者是由明尼苏达州退伍军人援助委员会提名的，该委员会的使命是结束明尼苏达州退伍军人无家可归的现象。

paras.en: Stacya May is a U.S. Navy veteran who proudly served from 2012 to 2017, conducting mine countermeasures. During her military service, she deployed to Bahrain in June 2014 and earned her Air Warfare pin. She was honorably discharged after five years of service.
paras.zh: 斯塔西娅·梅 (Stacya May) 是一名美国海军退伍军人，曾在 2012 年至 2017 年期间服役，从事反水雷工作。在服兵役期间，她于 2014 年 6 月被部署到巴林并获得了空战徽章。服役五年后，她光荣退役。

paras.en: Today, May is focused on building a stable and successful future for her and her family. She is currently attending college, pursuing a degree in supply chain logistics. Her goal is to complete her two-year degree and transfer to the University of Minnesota to continue her education.
paras.zh: 如今，梅专注于为她和她的家人打造稳定和成功的未来。她目前正在上大学，攻读供应链物流学位。她的目标是完成两年制学位并转学到明尼苏达大学继续学业。

paras.en: This vehicle will allow her to transport her disabled cousin to medical appointments, provide safer and more dependable transportation for her child, help maintain her educational commitments and support the stability that she has worked hard to achieve.
paras.zh: 这辆车将使她能够运送她残疾的表弟去就医，为她的孩子提供更安全、更可靠的交通，帮助维持她的教育承诺，并支持她努力实现的稳定。

paras.en: Additional partners in this presentation included: Enterprise; O’Reilly; Finishing Touch Car Care; Roseville Midway Ford; Auto Images; Southeast Towing; Showroom Auto Care; PPG; Inver Grove Honda; Advanced Vehicle Solutions; Advanced Remarketing Services; Cars for Charity; and Copart.
paras.zh: 本次演示中的其他合作伙伴包括：Enterprise；奥莱利；画龙点睛的汽车护理；罗斯维尔中途福特；汽车图像；东南拖车；展厅汽车护理； PPG；因弗格罗夫本田；先进的车辆解决方案；高级再营销服务；慈善汽车；和科帕特。

paras.en: Individuals in the community can support this program in two ways — donate to the program directly or donate their unwanted or non-running vehicle through the Changing and Saving Lives Keys for Change program. They will receive a tax donation for their contribution, and proceeds will help provide reliable transportation for those in need across the country — and in their community.
paras.zh: 社区中的个人可以通过两种方式支持该计划——直接向该计划捐款，或者通过“改变和拯救生命钥匙促进改变”计划捐赠他们不需要或未运行的车辆。他们的贡献将获得税收捐赠，收益将有助于为全国各地及其社区有需要的人提供可靠的交通。

paras.en: Farmers, a level one partner of the NABC, has donated nearly 100 vehicles to people and organizations through the Recycled Rides program.
paras.zh: Farmers 是 NABC 的一级合作伙伴，已通过“回收乘车”计划向个人和组织捐赠了近 100 辆车辆。

paras.en: Heppner’s Auto Body & Glass is an I-CAR Gold Class repair facility. With six locations, they have been serving the Twin Cities for more than 65 years, and have presented multiple Recycled Rides to people in need in their local community.
paras.zh: Heppner 的车身和玻璃是 I-CAR 黄金级维修厂。他们拥有六个地点，为双子城提供服务已超过 65 年，并向当地社区有需要的人们提供了多个回收游乐设施。

articles.title: AUMOVIO’s Global Startup Co-pace Accelerates AI Innovation
articles.author: Mary DellaValle

paras.en: AUMOVIO’s global startup organization co-pace, recently hosted the Automotive AI Startup Innovation Challenge, bringing together 10 startups to explore AI technologies with potential real-world applications. It was hosted at Newlab Detroit.
paras.zh: AUMOVIO的全球创业组织co-pace最近举办了汽车人工智能创业创新挑战赛，汇聚了10家初创公司，共同探索人工智能技术与潜在的实际应用。它在底特律 Newlab 举办。

paras.en: The event was designed to connect startups with AUMOVIO in order to create opportunities to support the next generation of software-defined and AI-enabled vehicles.
paras.zh: 该活动旨在将初创公司与AUMOVIO联系起来，以创造支持下一代软件定义和人工智能车辆的机会。

paras.en: “Innovation and connectivity are intertwined,” said Dr. Otmar Schreiner, managing director of co-pace. “Our startup organization is experienced in connecting AUMOVIO with a global network of startups and exploring new opportunities, together. Expanding these connections in North America allows us to invest in the pursuit of what is next.”
paras.zh: “创新和连通性是交织在一起的，”copace 董事总经理 Otmar Schreiner 博士说。 “我们的初创企业组织在将 AUMOVIO 与全球初创企业网络联系起来并共同探索新机会方面拥有丰富的经验。在北美扩大这些联系使我们能够投资于追求未来。”

paras.en: Through co-pace, the company engages with several hundred startups annually around the world, helping bring innovation closer to the business. This challenge strengthens co-pace’s involvement in North America, welcoming new avenues to connect with external tech ecosystems.
paras.zh: 通过 co-pace，该公司每年与全球数百家初创公司合作，帮助创新更贴近业务。这一挑战加强了 copace 在北美的参与，欢迎与外部技术生态系统建立联系的新途径。

paras.en: Exploration Into the Next Generation of AI
paras.zh: 探索下一代人工智能

paras.en: The challenge focused on four technology areas relevant to AUMOVIO: AI compute platforms, AI orchestration software, intelligent zonal architecture, and fleet learning data platforms. Each addresses critical aspects of intelligent infrastructure needed to support advanced applications. As vehicles become more AI-enabled, the demand for secure, reliable integration throughout the vehicle’s life cycle is imperative, the company said.
paras.zh: 本次挑战赛重点关注与 AUMOVIO 相关的四个技术领域：AI 计算平台、AI 编排软件、智能分区架构和车队学习数据平台。每个解决方案都解决了支持高级应用程序所需的智能基础设施的关键方面。该公司表示，随着车辆越来越多地支持人工智能，在整个车辆生命周期中安全、可靠的集成的需求势在必行。

paras.en: Participating startups presented solutions that were evaluated for technical feasibility, integration capabilities, runtime monitoring, security, and measurable improvements in model performance and data usability. The objective was to identify an approach that could complement AUMOVIO’s existing capabilities while supporting further exploration, validation, and potential integration.
paras.zh: 参与的初创公司提出了解决方案，并对技术可行性、集成能力、运行时监控、安全性以及模型性能和数据可用性的可衡量改进进行了评估。目标是确定一种方法，可以补充 AUMOVIO 的现有功能，同时支持进一步的探索、验证和潜在的集成。

paras.en: A winner will be selected to advance toward a proof of concept (PoC). The next phase is to evaluate the selected technology’s potential application within AUMOVIO’s systems. For AUMOVIO, the collaboration provides an additional pipeline to startup talent, new ideas, and solutions in AI-enabled systems, the company said.
paras.zh: 将选出一名获胜者来推进概念验证 (PoC)。下一阶段是评估所选技术在 AUMOVIO 系统中的潜在应用。该公司表示，对于 AUMOVIO 来说，此次合作为人工智能系统中的初创人才、新想法和解决方案提供了额外的渠道。

paras.en: “Our innovation strategy requires us to anticipate what comes next and learn how to harness it,” shared Seyed Hajimirza, head of innovation, AUMOVIO, North America. “We can challenge conventional approaches and forge new pathways by collaborating with technology partners. That’s how we continue to lead.”
paras.zh: “我们的创新战略要求我们预测接下来会发生什么，并学习如何利用它，”AUMOVIO 北美创新主管 Seyed Hajimirza 分享道。 “我们可以通过与技术合作伙伴合作挑战传统方法并开辟新途径。这就是我们继续保持领先地位的方式。”

articles.title: How Technology Adoption, Duty Cycle Shape Fleet Fuel Economy
articles.author: Kevin Linger

paras.en: Fleet fuel economy improved 18% from 2010 to 2025, according to a North American Council for Freight Efficiency (NACFE) study. Participants averaged 7.48 MPG in 2025. The study results help show why equipment decisions need to reflect the work.
paras.zh: 根据北美货运效率委员会 (NACFE) 的一项研究，从 2010 年到 2025 年，车队燃油经济性提高了 18%。 2025 年，参与者平均每加仑行驶 7.48 英里。研究结果有助于说明为什么设备决策需要反映工作情况。

paras.en: The 2026 Fleet Efficiency Study separated linehaul and regional-haul results for the first time. Linehaul fleets reached a study record of 7.96 MPG, while regional fleets averaged 7.29 MPG.
paras.zh: 2026 年机队效率研究首次将长途运输和支线运输结果分开。长途运输车队的研究记录达到了 7.96 MPG，而支线车队的平均里程为 7.29 MPG。

paras.en: Those numbers provide benchmarks, but routes, payloads, and equipment affect how useful each comparison will be. A fleet moving toward shorter routes can face pressure on its average MPG while continuing to invest in efficiency.
paras.zh: 这些数字提供了基准，但路线、有效载荷和设备会影响每次比较的有用程度。转向较短航线的机队在继续提高效率的同时可能会面临平均每加仑行驶里程的压力。

paras.en: The report covers Class 8 tractors and trailers and tracks adoption of more than 80 technologies and practices. Fifteen fleets supplied 2024 and 2025 data for this update. Across the study’s history, 29 fleets contributed data reaching back to 2003.
paras.zh: 该报告涵盖 8 类牵引车和拖车，并跟踪 80 多种技术和实践的采用情况。十五支车队为本次更新提供了 2024 年和 2025 年的数据。纵观该研究的历史，有 29 个车队提供了可追溯到 2003 年的数据。

paras.en: Regional operations typically involve more stops and more time on local roads than linehaul work. Regional fleets represented 57% of study participants in 2025, compared with 35% in 2010, influencing the combined results.
paras.zh: 与长途运输工作相比，区域运营通常需要更多的停靠点和在当地道路上花费更多的时间。 2025 年，区域车队占研究参与者的 57%，而 2010 年这一比例为 35%，这会影响综合结果。

paras.en: During the report’s press conference, Mike Roeth, NACFE’s executive director, raised a familiar specification problem. One tractor may perform highway work overnight and local deliveries during the day, complicating choices about gearing, aerodynamics, and idle reduction.
paras.zh: 在报告的新闻发布会上，NACFE 执行董事 Mike Roeth 提出了一个常见的规范问题。一台拖拉机可能在夜间执行高速公路作业，并在白天执行本地交付，这使得有关传动装置、空气动力学和怠速减少的选择变得复杂。

paras.en: “Now, when you get into some LTL operations where you’ve got both a long distance, say nighttime run, and then that same truck’s used in the city during the day, that becomes an interesting and challenging spec challenge,” Roeth said.
paras.zh: “现在，当你进入一些零担运输业务时，你既要进行长距离（比如夜间运行），又要在白天在城市中使用同一辆卡车，这就成为一个有趣且具有挑战性的规格挑战，”罗思说。

paras.en: The practical question is how much time the truck spends in each part of that operation. Its highway mileage, stops, and idling needs help determine which features can earn their cost.
paras.zh: 实际问题是卡车在该操作的每个部分花费了多少时间。它的高速公路里程、停车和怠速需求有助于确定哪些功能可以赚取成本。

paras.en: Roeth also challenged the assumption that daycabs see too little highway use to benefit from aerodynamic equipment. He said growing recognition of their highway operation is supporting adoption of efficiency technologies.
paras.zh: 罗思还对日间出租车在高速公路上的使用太少而无法从空气动力设备中受益的假设提出了质疑。他说，人们对高速公路运营的日益认可正在支持高效技术的采用。

paras.en: Fleet practices and powertrain technologies were the most widely adopted categories in both duty cycles. Linehaul fleets generally adopted tractor aerodynamics and idle reduction at higher rates, reflecting differences in how the equipment operates.
paras.zh: 车队实践和动力总成技术是两个工作周期中采用最广泛的类别。长途运输车队通常采用拖拉机空气动力学技术并以更高的速率减少怠速，这反映了设备运行方式的差异。

paras.en: Among linehaul fleets, automated manual transmission adoption rose from 22% in 2007 to 86% in 2025. Downspeeding, defined in the report as a final drive ratio below 2.7:1, rose from 13% to 98%.
paras.zh: 在长途运输车队中，手自一体变速箱的采用率从 2007 年的 22% 上升到 2025 年的 86%。降速（报告中定义为最终传动比低于 2.7:1）从 13% 上升到 98%。

paras.en: The study also identified gains in routing optimization and vehicle data analysis for fuel efficiency. These practices give fleets opportunities to improve how they use equipment alongside changes to the truck itself.
paras.zh: 该研究还确定了路线优化和车辆数据分析在燃油效率方面的收益。这些做法为车队提供了改进设备使用方式以及卡车本身的机会。

paras.en: Higher technology adoption correlated with higher MPG, but NACFE cautioned that the relationship does not establish causation. Fleets investing heavily in equipment may also follow other practices contributing to their results.
paras.zh: 更高的技术采用率与更高的 MPG 相关，但 NACFE 警告说，这种关系并不能建立因果关系。大量投资设备的船队也可能会遵循其他有助于其结果的做法。

paras.en: Read the full article on fleetequipmentmag.com.
paras.zh: 请在 fancyequipmentmag.com 上阅读完整文章。

articles.title: AACF Golf Tournament Raises Record $700,000
articles.author: Jeff White

paras.en: The Automotive Aftermarket Charitable Foundation (AACF) celebrated the success of its 34th annual Bob Schoeberl Memorial Charity Golf Tournament. The event took place Nov. 1-2 at Spanish Trail Country Club in Las Vegas. The sold-out event brought together 216 golfers and other automotive aftermarket industry supporters for two days of networking and competition.
paras.zh: 汽车售后市场慈善基金会 (AACF) 庆祝其第 34 届年度鲍勃·舍伯尔纪念慈善高尔夫锦标赛取得成功。该活动于 11 月 1 日至 2 日在拉斯维加斯西班牙小径乡村俱乐部举行。此次活动门票全部售完，共有 216 名高尔夫球手和其他汽车售后市场行业支持者齐聚一堂，进行为期两天的交流和比赛。

paras.en: Fundraising activities included the tournament, live auction, prize drawings and golf pro experiences. These activities raised nearly $700,000, marking the highest total in the event’s history. The funds will help AACF provide financial assistance to aftermarket families facing unexpected hardships.
paras.zh: 筹款活动包括锦标赛、现场拍卖、抽奖和高尔夫职业体验。这些活动筹集了近 70 万美元，创下了该活动历史上的最高总额。这些资金将帮助 AACF 为面临意外困难的售后家庭提供经济援助。

paras.en: AACF Tournament Supports Aftermarket Families
paras.zh: AACF 锦标赛支持售后家庭

paras.en: “When a member of the automotive aftermarket community faces an unexpected hardship, the support of this industry can make all the difference,” said John Kairys, executive director of AACF. “The generosity of everyone who participated in this year’s tournament will help ensure that individuals and families facing some of life’s most difficult moments know they aren’t alone. We’re thankful and appreciative that this community comes together year after year for such an important cause.”
paras.zh: AACF 执行董事 John Kairys 表示：“当汽车售后市场社区的成员面临意想不到的困难时，该行业的支持可以发挥重要作用。” “参加今年比赛的每个人的慷慨将有助于确保面临生活中最困难时刻的个人和家庭知道他们并不孤单。我们感谢和赞赏这个社区年复一年地为了如此重要的事业聚集在一起。”

paras.en: Historic Hole-in-One Highlights Tournament
paras.zh: 历史性一杆进洞精彩赛事

paras.en: Among this year’s tournament highlights, Sean McLoraine became the first participant in the event’s 34-year history to win the hole-in-one contest. Interstate Batteries sponsored the contest, which featured a new 2026 Toyota Tundra as its grand prize.
paras.zh: 在今年赛事的亮点中，肖恩·麦克洛兰 (Sean McLoraine) 成为该赛事 34 年历史上第一位赢得一杆进洞比赛的参赛者。 Interstate Batteries 赞助了此次竞赛，其大奖为一辆全新 2026 款丰田坦途 (Toyota Tundra)。

paras.en: “I look forward to this tournament every year because I love seeing our industry come together to give back to the people who make it what it is,” said Jeff Helfrich, AACF golf committee chairman. “To raise a record amount for aftermarket families and have Sean McLoraine make the first hole-in-one for a vehicle in our 34 years of playing this event made this a year I’ll always remember. Congratulations to Sean on his new Toyota Tundra and thank you to Interstate Batteries for sponsoring the contest.”
paras.zh: AACF 高尔夫委员会主席杰夫·赫尔弗里奇 (Jeff Helfrich) 表示：“我每年都期待着这项赛事，因为我喜欢看到我们的行业齐心协力，回馈那些做出今天的贡献的人们。” “为售后家庭筹集了创纪录的金额，并让肖恩·麦克洛兰 (Sean McLoraine) 在我们参加这项赛事 34 年来首次打进一杆进洞，这让我永远铭记这一年。祝贺肖恩 (Sean) 拥有他的新丰田坦途 (Toyota Tundra)，并感谢 Interstate Batteries 对本次比赛的赞助。”

paras.en: AACF thanked the participants, sponsors, donors, volunteers and industry partners who supported this year’s tournament. Those interested in participating in or sponsoring the 2027 Bob Schoeberl Memorial Golf Tournament can click here for updates and additional information.
paras.zh: AACF 感谢支持今年比赛的参赛者、赞助商、捐助者、志愿者和行业合作伙伴。有兴趣参加或赞助 2027 年 Bob Schoeberl 纪念高尔夫锦标赛的人士可以点击此处获取更新和其他信息。

articles.title: Big Kahuna Getaway Sweepstakes Fall Promotion Wrapping Up
articles.author: Jeff White

paras.en: The Big Kahuna Getaway Sweepstakes is bringing an exciting fall promotion to a close, giving professional technicians across North America one final opportunity to earn entries, win prizes, and get one step closer to an unforgettable getaway to Oahu, Hawaii.
paras.zh: Big Kahuna Getaway 抽奖活动即将结束，激动人心的秋季促销活动即将结束，为北美各地的专业技术人员提供最后一次机会，赢得参赛资格、赢取奖品，距离夏威夷欧胡岛难忘的度假更近一步。

paras.en: Running from September through November, the promotion gives technicians the opportunity to participate through MyPlace4Parts by earning entries with qualifying purchases for a chance to win one of 25 trips for two to Oahu or a share of $45,000 in gift card prizes. With the promotion wrapping up November 30, there’s still time for eligible participants to get in on the excitement!
paras.zh: 该促销活动从 9 月持续到 11 月，技术人员有机会通过 MyPlace4Parts 参与活动，通过符合资格的购买获得参赛资格，有机会赢得 25 次前往瓦胡岛的两人旅行中的一次，或分享 45,000 美元的礼品卡奖品。促销活动将于 11 月 30 日结束，符合资格的参与者还有时间享受兴奋！

paras.en: The 25 lucky winners will soon have the opportunity to trade their toolboxes for tropical breezes. In May 2027, winners and their guests will enjoy six nights and seven days in Oahu, including accommodations, travel, exclusive meals and receptions, VIP experiences, and curated activities designed to showcase the beauty, culture, and aloha spirit of the island.
paras.zh: 25 名幸运获奖者很快将有机会用他们的工具箱换取热带微风。 2027 年 5 月，获奖者及其宾客将在欧胡岛享受 7 天 6 晚的住宿，包括住宿、旅行、专属餐食和招待会、VIP 体验以及旨在展示该岛美丽、文化和阿罗哈精神的精心策划的活动。

paras.en: “We want to thank every technician and shop participating in The Big Kahuna Getaway and helping make this promotion such an exciting opportunity,” said Kendall Lozano, sales and marketing manager for the Aftermarket Auto Parts Alliance, Inc. “We know how hard our customers work every day, and we’re excited to have the opportunity to give them something to look forward to. We also want to extend our sincere thanks to our channel partners whose continued support helps make experiences like this possible. We’re looking forward to celebrating with our winners and welcoming them to Oahu next May.”
paras.zh: 售后汽车配件联盟公司销售和营销经理 Kendall Lozano 表示：“我们要感谢参加 The Big Kahuna Getaway 的每一位技术人员和商店，他们帮助我们使这次促销活动成为一个令人兴奋的机会。我们知道我们的客户每天工作有多么辛苦，我们很高兴有机会为他们提供一些值得期待的东西。我们还要向我们的渠道合作伙伴表示诚挚的谢意，他们的持续支持使这样的体验成为可能。我们期待与获奖者一起庆祝，并欢迎他们的到来。”明年五月他们将前往欧胡岛。”

paras.en: The Big Kahuna Getaway is powered through MyPlace4Parts, giving participating technicians the opportunity to earn entries while placing their everyday orders. Every qualifying $150 invoice earns one entry, with bonus entries awarded for additional $150 increments purchased throughout the promotion.
paras.zh: Big Kahuna Getaway 由 MyPlace4Parts 提供支持，让参与的技术人员有机会在下日常订单的同时赚取参赛资格。每一张符合条件的 150 美元发票均可获得一次参与机会，在整个促销活动期间购买额外 150 美元的增量即可获得奖励参与机会。

paras.en: As the final days of the sweepstakes approach, anticipation continues to build for the 25 winners who will soon be on their way to Waikiki for an unforgettable island experience filled with adventure, relaxation, and plenty of aloha.
paras.zh: 随着抽奖活动最后几天的临近，人们对 25 名获奖者的期待不断增强，他们很快将前往威基基，享受充满冒险、放松和阿罗哈风情的难忘岛屿体验。

paras.en: “Promotions like The Big Kahuna Getaway are made possible through the incredible support of our customers, our channel partners, and the entire Auto Value and Bumper to Bumper network,” added Lozano. “We’re grateful to everyone participating and helping bring this promotion to life. We can’t wait to celebrate our winners and give them an experience they’ll remember for years to come. There’s still time to enter, and we look forward to seeing everyone in Oahu!”
paras.zh: “像 Big Kahuna Getaway 这样的促销活动是通过我们的客户、渠道合作伙伴以及整个 Auto Value 和 Bumper to Bumper 网络的大力支持才得以实现的，”Lozano 补充道。 “我们感谢所有参与并帮助实现这一促销活动的人。我们迫不及待地想要庆祝我们的获奖者，并为他们提供一次终生难忘的体验。还有时间参加，我们期待在欧胡岛见到大家！”

paras.en: With the promotion coming to a close on November 30, the countdown to May 2027 is just beginning. There’s still time to earn entries, get in on the excitement, and possibly find yourself headed to paradise!
paras.zh: 随着促销活动于 11 月 30 日结束，2027 年 5 月的倒计时才刚刚开始。现在还有时间赢得参赛资格，享受刺激，并可能发现自己正前往天堂！

paras.en: For complete promotion details, entry information, and to view the official list of winners as they are announced, visit BigKahunaGetaway.com.
paras.zh: 如需了解完整的促销详情、参赛信息以及查看公布的获奖者官方名单，请访问 BigKahunaGetaway.com。

articles.title: A woman gulped ice-cold drinks and ended up with torn arteries
articles.author: Anirban Mukhopadhyay

paras.en: The patient: A 46-year-old woman in California
paras.zh: 患者：加州一名46岁女性

paras.en: The symptoms: After an uneventful 10-hour work shift, the woman was walking to her car and drinking an ice-cold beverage when a sudden, burning pain struck the middle of her chest. The pain spread to both of her forearms and lasted about 20 minutes.
paras.zh: 症状：在平安无事地完成了 10 个小时的轮班后，这位女士正走向车并喝着冰冷的饮料，突然，胸部中部传来灼烧般的疼痛。疼痛蔓延到她的双前臂，持续了大约20分钟。

paras.en: About 10 minutes after this pain began, she started sweating and felt nauseated and lightheaded, as though she might pass out.
paras.zh: 疼痛开始大约10分钟后，她开始出汗，感到恶心、头晕，好像要昏倒一样。

paras.en: What happened next: The pain continued as the woman began driving home, so she changed course and instead drove to the nearest emergency department.
paras.zh: 接下来发生的事情：当这位女士开车回家时，疼痛仍在持续，所以她改变了路线，开车去了最近的急诊室。

paras.en: An electrocardiogram (EKG), which records the heart's electrical activity, showed subtle abnormalities. A blood test for troponin, a protein released into the bloodstream when heart muscle is damaged, was normal. However, a second troponin test taken before she left the hospital came back elevated after she had been discharged. Doctors called her about the new results and advised her to drive to the nearest emergency department.
paras.zh: 记录心脏电活动的心电图（EKG）显示出细微的异常。肌钙蛋白（心肌受损时释放到血液中的一种蛋白质）的血液检查结果正常。然而，在她出院前进行的第二次肌钙蛋白测试在她出院后又升高了。医生打电话告诉她新的结果，并建议她开车去最近的急诊室。

paras.en: There, a third blood test showed that her troponin level had risen even further, and doctors diagnosed a heart attack. An angiogram — a scan that shows the structure of blood vessels — revealed a small tear in a branch of her right coronary artery, which supplies blood to the heart.
paras.zh: 在那里，第三次血液检查显示她的肌钙蛋白水平进一步升高，医生诊断出她患有心脏病。血管造影（一种显示血管结构的扫描）显示，她为心脏供血的右冠状动脉分支有一个小撕裂。

paras.en: About 30 hours after she was discharged, the woman developed similar chest pain after taking several gulps of ice-cold green tea and subsequently jogging up a flight of stairs. The pain began when she reached the top of the stairs and was accompanied by the same lightheaded feeling she had experienced before.
paras.zh: 出院后约30小时，该女子在喝了几口冰绿茶并随后慢跑上一段楼梯后出现了类似的胸痛。当她到达楼梯顶部时，疼痛开始了，并伴随着她以前经历过的同样的头晕感觉。

paras.en: Get the world’s most fascinating discoveries delivered straight to your inbox.
paras.zh: 将世界上最迷人的发现直接发送到您的收件箱。

paras.en: She called 911 and was again brought to an emergency department, and although an initial EKG showed no clear signs of a heart attack, subsequent recordings revealed heart-activity changes consistent with one. A second angiogram revealed a new tear in the left circumflex artery, a branch of the left coronary artery.
paras.zh: 她拨打了 911，再次被送往急诊室，尽管最初的心电图显示没有明显的心脏病发作迹象，但随后的记录显示心脏活动的变化与心脏病发作的迹象一致。第二次血管造影显示左回旋动脉（左冠状动脉的一个分支）出现新的撕裂。

paras.en: The diagnosis: Doctors diagnosed the woman with spontaneous coronary artery dissection (SCAD), a condition in which a tear develops in the wall of a coronary artery. In SCAD, blood collects within the artery wall, and this compresses the channel that blood normally flows through to reach the heart. As in the patient's case, this compression can sometimes trigger heart attacks by drastically restricting the heart's blood supply.
paras.zh: 诊断：医生诊断该妇女患有自发性冠状动脉夹层（SCAD），即冠状动脉壁出现撕裂。在 SCAD 中，血液聚集在动脉壁内，这会压缩血液通常流经心脏的通道。正如患者的情况一样，这种压迫有时会严重限制心脏的血液供应，从而引发心脏病。

paras.en: Doctors also found fibromuscular dysplasia (FMD) in a blood vessel in the woman's pelvis. FMD changes the structure of artery walls, making them too weak or too stiff, and it's known to occur in some people with SCAD. It may have made her arteries more prone to tearing, the doctors wrote in a report of the case.
paras.zh: 医生还在该女子骨盆的血管中发现了纤维肌性发育不良（FMD）。 FMD 会改变动脉壁的结构，使动脉壁变得太弱或太僵硬，并且已知某些 SCAD 患者会发生这种情况。医生在病例报告中写道，这可能使她的动脉更容易撕裂。

paras.en: The treatment: During her first emergency department visit, doctors gave the woman aspirin, fluids, medicine for nausea and an antacid. Her chest pain eventually went away. At the second visit, doctors gave her the blood thinner heparin to reduce blood clotting and the beta-blocker metoprolol to slow her heart rate. She was discharged the following morning with prescriptions for cholesterol- and blood-pressure-lowering drugs.
paras.zh: 治疗：在她第一次急诊就诊时，医生给她服用了阿司匹林、液体、止恶心药和抗酸剂。她的胸痛最终消失了。第二次就诊时，医生给她服用血液稀释剂肝素以减少血液凝固，并给她服用β受体阻滞剂美托洛尔以减慢心率。第二天早上，她出院时服用了降胆固醇和降血压药物的处方。

paras.en: After the second episode, doctors gave her opioid painkillers and medicine for nausea to take as needed, along with aspirin and a cholesterol-lowering drug. The cholesterol-lowering drug was soon stopped because she did not have high cholesterol. Doctors eventually stopped the blood-pressure medication, too, after a follow-up heart ultrasound showed that the affected part of her heart was moving normally again.
paras.zh: 第二次发作后，医生根据需要给她服用阿片类止痛药和止恶心药，以及阿司匹林和降胆固醇药物。降胆固醇药物很快就停了，因为她的胆固醇并不高。在后续心脏超声检查显示她受影响的心脏部分再次正常运动后，医生最终也停止了降压药物。

paras.en: She continued taking nebivolol, a different beta-blocker that slows the heart rate and can reduce stress on the organ, for years after these two episodes. And for several months after the second episode, the woman avoided cold drinks on her own initiative. She gradually reintroduced them, taking small sips rather than gulping. Ten years later, she remained free of symptoms, the report noted.
paras.zh: 在这两次发作后的数年里，她继续服用奈必洛尔，这是一种不同的β受体阻滞剂，可以减慢心率并减轻器官的压力。在第二次发作后的几个月里，这位女士主动避免喝冷饮。她逐渐重新引入它们，小口抿而不是大口吞咽。报告指出，十年后，她仍然没有任何症状。

paras.en: What makes this case unique: Years later, the woman learned that cold drinks had been linked to atrial fibrillation (AFib), an irregular heart rhythm. She told her healthcare team that she suspected cold drinks might have triggered SCAD in her case, too.
paras.zh: 这个案例的独特之处在于：多年后，这位女士了解到冷饮与心房颤动（AFib）（一种心律不齐）有关。她告诉她的医疗团队，她怀疑冷饮也可能引发她的 SCAD。

paras.en: Separately, a 2017 case report described another woman who developed chest pain and a heart attack after drinking cold water. Doctors subsequently found that she had SCAD and FMD. However, that report did not investigate cold water as a possible trigger of the patient's symptoms.
paras.zh: 另外，2017 年的一份病例报告描述了另一名女性在喝冷水后出现胸痛和心脏病发作的情况。医生随后发现她患有 SCAD 和 FMD。然而，该报告并未调查冷水是否可能引发患者症状。

paras.en: The authors of the current report proposed that rapidly swallowing a cold drink may trigger a brief rise in blood pressure, known as a pressor response. This is associated with increased activation of the body's fight-or-flight system, which can then release stress hormones. These changes may make the heart contract more forcefully and cause the coronary arteries to narrow temporarily, thereby increasing the forces acting on their walls. In someone whose arteries are susceptible to tears, that added stress could contribute to rips in the tissue and the accumulation of blood within the artery wall.
paras.zh: 当前报告的作者提出，快速吞咽冷饮可能会引发血压短暂升高，称为升压反应。这与身体的战斗或逃跑系统的激活增加有关，该系统随后会释放压力荷尔蒙。这些变化可能会使心脏收缩得更有力，并导致冠状动脉暂时变窄，从而增加作用在其血管壁上的力。对于动脉容易撕裂的人来说，额外的压力可能会导致组织撕裂和动脉壁内血液积聚。

paras.en: However, the report authors stressed that they cannot establish that cold drinks caused the woman's dissections in this instance. They hope their findings will encourage doctors to ask patients with SCAD about potential triggers, but they said further research is needed to determine whether rapidly drinking cold beverages can really trigger the condition.
paras.zh: 然而，报告作者强调，他们无法确定冷饮导致了该女子的解剖。他们希望他们的发现能够鼓励医生询问 SCAD 患者潜在的触发因素，但他们表示，还需要进一步的研究来确定快速饮用冷饮是否真的会引发这种情况。

paras.en: For more intriguing medical cases, check out our Diagnostic Dilemma archives.
paras.zh: 如需更多有趣的医疗案例，请查看我们的诊断困境档案。

paras.en: This article is for informational purposes only and is not meant to offer medical advice.
paras.zh: 本文仅供参考，并不旨在提供医疗建议。

paras.en: Heringer, G. V., Smith, C. M., Takeuchi, K., Goh, C. H., & Vinson, D. R. (2026). Association of ice-cold drink ingestion with spontaneous coronary artery dissection: a case report. BMC Cardiovascular Disorders. https://doi.org/10.1186/s12872-026-06669-w
paras.zh: Heringer, G. V.、Smith, C. M.、Takeuchi, K.、Goh, C. H. 和 Vinson, D. R. (2026)。冰冷饮料摄入与自发性冠状动脉夹层的关联：病例报告。 BMC 心血管疾病。 https://doi.org/10.1186/s12872-026-06669-w

paras.zh: 你能猜出这些奇怪医疗病例的诊断吗？通过我们的诊断困境测验找出答案！

paras.en: Anirban Mukhopadhyay is an independent science journalist. He holds a PhD in genetics and a master’s in computational biology and drug design. He regularly writes for The Hindu and has contributed to The Wire Science, where he conveys complex biomedical research to the public in accessible language. Beyond science writing, he enjoys creating and reading fiction that blends myth, memory, and melancholy into surreal tales exploring grief, identity, and the quiet magic of self-discovery. In his free time, he loves long walks with his dog and motorcycling across The Himalayas.
paras.zh: Anirban Mukhopadhyay 是一位独立科学记者。他拥有遗传学博士学位以及计算生物学和药物设计硕士学位。他定期为《印度教徒报》撰稿，并为《The Wire Science》撰稿，以通俗易懂的语言向公众传达复杂的生物医学研究成果。除了科学写作之外，他还喜欢创作和阅读小说，将神话、记忆和忧郁融入超现实故事中，探索悲伤、身份和自我发现的安静魔力。在空闲时间，他喜欢与他的狗一起长途散步和骑摩托车穿越喜马拉雅山。

articles.title: 'You had one job': Astrophysicist and Star Trek science advisor Erin MacDonald on the secret to her success and the science flubs that haunt her
articles.author: Kenna Hughes-Castleberry

paras.en: From gravitational waves to time travel, science has always been at the heart of "Star Trek". While the franchise has never shied away from imagining the impossible, much of its appeal comes from making strange situations seem believable.
paras.zh: 从引力波到时间旅行，科学始终是《星际迷航》的核心。虽然该系列从不回避想象不可能的事情，但它的大部分吸引力来自于让奇怪的情况看起来可信。

paras.en: That's where the role of a science adviser comes in. It's not necessarily about making sure everything is scientifically accurate, but understanding the science well enough to know where creative liberties can be taken and how to make them come alive on screen.
paras.zh: 这就是科学顾问的作用所在。这不一定要确保一切都在科学上准确，而是要充分了解科学，知道在哪里可以发挥创造性自由以及如何使它们在屏幕上生动起来。

paras.en: Erin Macdonald knows this balance all-too-well. After studying general relativity and gravitational waves for her doctorate and spending years working at Laser Interferometer Gravitational-Wave Observatory (LIGO), Macdonald shifted gears and became a science advisor for six "Star Trek" series, including the "Discovery" franchise, as well as a variety of other television and film projects. Live Science spoke with Macdonald about how she brings the world of "Star Trek" to life, and her job's biggest pitfalls.
paras.zh: 艾琳·麦克唐纳（Erin Macdonald）非常了解这种平衡。在攻读广义相对论和引力波博士学位并在激光干涉仪引力波天文台 (LIGO) 工作多年后，麦克唐纳转变态度，成为六部《星际迷航》系列的科学顾问，其中包括《发现》系列以及各种其他电视和电影项目。 《Live Science》采访了麦克唐纳，讲述了她如何将《星际迷航》的世界变为现实，以及她工作中最大的陷阱。

paras.en: Erin Macdonald is an award-winning writer, science communicator, producer, and science advisor. She is most well-known for her advising work on 'Star Trek' and has played her own character across multiple iterations of the franchise. As a science communicator she has also appeared on NPR, BBC, CBS, and StarTalk Live.
paras.zh: 艾琳·麦克唐纳 (Erin Macdonald) 是一位屡获殊荣的作家、科学传播者、制片人和科学顾问。她因在《星际迷航》中担任顾问而闻名，并在该系列的多次迭代中扮演了自己的角色。作为一名科学传播者，她还出现在 NPR、BBC、CBS 和 StarTalk Live 上。

paras.en: KHC: How did you end up getting into the field of science advising?
paras.zh: KHC：您是如何进入科学咨询领域的？

paras.en: EM: After I got my Ph.D. and did a little bit of research, I realized academia and that world just weren't really for me. So I went into engineering, but I really missed teaching and being able to engage with students. I was trying to find more opportunities to do public science communication. I'm a big sci-fi nerd, so I started going to sci-fi conventions and giving solo panels and workshops that were basically, "Here's the physics behind faster-than-light travel," and "Here's all the physics in 'Star Trek'."
paras.zh: EM：当我获得博士学位后。做了一些研究，我意识到学术界和那个世界并不适合我。所以我进入了工程学领域，但我真的很怀念教学和与学生互动的时光。我试图寻找更多的机会进行公共科学传播。我是一个科幻迷，所以我开始参加科幻大会并举办个人小组讨论和研讨会，基本上是“这是超光速旅行背后的物理原理”和“这是《星际迷航》中的所有物理原理”。

paras.en: This article is part of a series called "Science Behind the Camera" which focuses on the role of science advisors. From helping to create engaging stories to set design and script rewrites, these experts shape some of the most compelling narratives on screen.
paras.zh: 本文是“镜头背后的科学”系列的一部分，该系列重点关注科学顾问的角色。从帮助创作引人入胜的故事到布景设计和剧本重写，这些专家在银幕上塑造了一些最引人注目的叙事。

paras.en: Through that particular talk and just life happening, I met a lot of people on the convention circuit. I decided I wanted to go to L.A. I learned that science advising was a job, so I moved out there, still working as an engineer.
paras.zh: 通过那次特别的演讲和生活中发生的事情，我在巡回会议上遇到了很多人。我决定去洛杉矶。我了解到科学咨询是一份工作，所以我搬到了那里，仍然担任工程师。

paras.en: CBS and "Star Trek" got wind of my talks, and they invited me to give presentations at their official licensed "Star Trek" events. That's how I got on their radar. A couple of years later, we were in a world where there were a lot of 'Star Trek' shows being produced, and they were looking for a science adviser for "Star Trek: Discovery". [Editor's Note: "Star Trek: Discovery" ran for five seasons (65 episodes) from Sept. 2017, to May 2024 on CBS] That went well, and they brought me on as an in-house science adviser.
paras.zh: 哥伦比亚广播公司和《星际迷航》听说了我的演讲，他们邀请我在他们官方授权的《星际迷航》活动中发表演讲。我就是这样进入他们的视线的。几年后，我们所处的世界正在制作许多“星际迷航”节目，他们正在为“星际迷航：发现号”寻找科学顾问。 [编者注：《星际迷航：发现号》从 2017 年 9 月到 2024 年 5 月在 CBS 播出了五季（65 集）] 进展顺利，他们聘请我担任内部科学顾问。

paras.en: KHC: You've now advised on how many shows?
paras.zh: KHC：您现在已经为多少场演出提供了建议？

paras.en: EM: Well, six "Star Trek" shows, but I'm starting to lose track of the films and other shows I've been called into for either one-off things or bigger jobs. It's been a great experience.
paras.zh: EM：嗯，六部《星际迷航》节目，但我开始忘记那些我被叫去参加的电影和其他节目，要么是一次性的事情，要么是更大的工作。这是一次很棒的经历。

paras.en: I think a lot of being successful in L.A. and Hollywood is that every job is an audition for your next job. You work on one show, everyone goes their separate ways and works on new shows, and if they know someone they might want to bring in, they'll give you a call. I've been very lucky in that regard.
paras.zh: 我认为在洛杉矶和好莱坞取得成功的很多原因在于每一份工作都是你下一份工作的试镜。你在一个节目中工作，每个人都各奔东西，在新节目中工作，如果他们认识可能想引进的人，他们会给你打电话。在这方面我非常幸运。

paras.en: KHC: What does the day-to-day look like for a science adviser?
paras.zh: KHC：科学顾问的日常生活是什么样的？

paras.en: EM: All the jobs I've done are different. When I get pulled in to talk to someone about a new project, it could be almost anything.
paras.zh: EM：我做过的所有工作都是不同的。当我被拉去和某人谈论一个新项目时，它几乎可以是任何东西。

paras.en: The biggest role, and the one I enjoy the most, is being brought in when a show is just getting off the ground and the writers' room is being established. They'll bring me in to sit in that writers' room and help contribute to the ideas and stories as they're being developed. If questions come up in real time, I can help answer them. That's the most ideal scenario for being a science adviser because you can get ahead of any issues as plots are starting to be developed.
paras.zh: 最重要的角色，也是我最喜欢的角色，是在一部剧刚刚起步、编剧室正在建立时被引入的。他们会带我坐在编剧室里，帮助我在构思和故事的发展过程中做出贡献。如果实时出现问题，我可以帮助回答。这是作为一名科学顾问的最理想的场景，因为当情节开始发展时，你可以领先于任何问题。

paras.en: But it can also look like being handed production scripts. Basically, they've gone through the whole process, they're nearing the point where they're going to start filming, and they're like, "Hey, can you check this for us?"
paras.zh: 但它也可能看起来像是被交给生产脚本。基本上，他们已经完成了整个过程，他们即将开始拍摄，他们会说，“嘿，你能为我们检查一下吗？”

paras.en: That can be a blessing and a curse because it's a little less work, but then you can't course-correct as much if there are big plot problems. You have to find a way to work with the story and try to get the science as accurate as possible. In that scenario, it can end up being, "Don't explain it. Take these lines out. You're getting yourself in trouble. Leave everything else."
paras.zh: 这可能是一件好事，也可能是一件坏事，因为它的工作量少了一点，但如果有大的情节问题，你就不能那么多地纠正路线。你必须找到一种方法来处理这个故事，并尝试让科学尽可能准确。在这种情况下，最终可能会是，“不要解释。把这些线去掉。你会给自己惹上麻烦。留下其他一切。”

paras.en: The last kind of job, and one I've had a lot of colleagues do, is set design. They'll be brought in when they're building sets or doing post-production and want to make sure what's on screen looks science-y.
paras.zh: 最后一种工作是布景设计，我的很多同事都在做。当他们在搭建场景或进行后期制作并希望确保屏幕上的内容看起来科学时，他们会被引入。

paras.en: The best example I can give is someone writing all the equations on "The Big Bang Theory". All those whiteboards you see? That's a scientist coming in to write all of that.
paras.zh: 我能给出的最好的例子是有人写出了《生活大爆炸理论》中的所有方程。你看到那些白板了吗？这是一位科学家来写下这一切。

paras.en: I worked on a show called "Good American Family" on Hulu. It's not a science show at all, but they had a kid who was really interested in physics. I went in and wrote all the equations and talked to the actor about how to say the things he was going to be saying.
paras.zh: 我在 Hulu 上制作了一个名为“Good American Family”的节目。这根本不是一个科学节目，但他们有一个对物理非常感兴趣的孩子。我进去写下了所有的方程式，并与演员讨论如何说出他要说的话。

paras.en: The process can vary greatly. Even within "Star Trek", my relationship has been different from show to show. That's an exciting part of it, but I think people can see that it's a very varied position.
paras.zh: 该过程可能会有很大差异。即使在《星际迷航》中，我的关系也因剧而异。这是其中令人兴奋的部分，但我认为人们可以看到这是一个非常多样化的立场。

paras.en: KHC: Out of all your 7 years of experience in science advising, is there a particular scene, moment, or script you're especially proud of?
paras.zh: KHC：在您 7 年的科学咨询经验中，有没有一个特定的场景、时刻或剧本让您特别自豪？

paras.en: EM: There are certainly ones that are really close to my heart. I'll give a couple of examples.
paras.zh: EM：当然有一些是我非常关心的。我举几个例子。

paras.en: One was the season two finale of "Star Trek: Lower Decks." I wasn't brought in until season two, At the end, the showrunner was basically like, "Hey, I have this vision, but we need to build the 'Star Trek' science around it."
paras.zh: 其中之一是《星际迷航：下层甲板》第二季结局。直到第二季我才被带进来，最后，制片人基本上是这样的，“嘿，我有这个愿景，但我们需要围绕它建立《星际迷航》的科学。”

paras.en: He just had a scene in his mind and wanted to build the story. We came up with this great story about an asteroid belt with a lot of charged particles that disrupted the [protective] shields. There was a lot of good technobabble in there, too. It was really fun. Watching that episode, it just feels like a really authentic "Star Trek" episode because of all the science in it. I'm really proud that I was able to contribute to that.
paras.zh: 他脑子里只有一个场景，想要构建这个故事。我们想出了一个关于小行星带的伟大故事，其中有大量带电粒子破坏了[保护]护盾。那里也有很多好的技术。真的很有趣。观看这一集，感觉就像是真正真实的“星际迷航”剧集，因为其中充满了科学知识。我真的很自豪我能够为此做出贡献。

paras.en: Another one that stands out to me is the musical episode of "Star Trek: Strange New Worlds". That was one of the first times the show was taking one of these big swings. The show is kind of known for doing all these big swings now, but that was one of the first. A lot of the time, when you're doing something wild like that, I'll just say, "Great, don't explain it. Do your thing. Try not to science it."
paras.zh: 另一个让我印象深刻的是《星际迷航：奇异新世界》的音乐剧。这是该剧第一次出现如此大的波动。该节目现在因进行所有这些大摇摆而闻名，但那是最早的之一。很多时候，当你做这样疯狂的事情时，我只会说，“很好，不要解释它。做你的事。尽量不要科学化。”

paras.en: But they pushed back on me and said, "No, no, no. We need a science explanation."
paras.zh: 但他们反驳我​​说：“不，不，不。我们需要一个科学的解释。”

paras.en: We really worked together and came up with a detailed science explanation. What I'm really proud of is that they created that ready room scene [Editor's note: a ready room scene is a dramatic sequence set usually in a command office before a major battle or mission] where Spock explains everything that's happening. It's probably one of the longest ready room scenes we've had in "Star Trek". It's like, "And then this, and then this, and this is why, and this is why, and this is why, and this is what we need to do."
paras.zh: 我们确实一起工作并提出了详细的科学解释。我真正感到自豪的是他们创造了准备室场景[编者注：准备室场景是通常在重大战斗或任务之前在指挥办公室设置的戏剧性序列]，史波克在其中解释了正在发生的一切。这可能是《星际迷航》中最长的准备室场景之一。就像，“然后这个，然后这个，这就是原因，这就是原因，这就是原因，这就是我们需要做的。”

paras.en: It's goofy, but there was a lot of science put into that episode, which was a really fun process.
paras.zh: 这很愚蠢，但那一集融入了很多科学知识，这是一个非常有趣的过程。

paras.en: KHC: I would be remiss if I didn't bring up the creation of Dr. Erin. How did that character come about, and how have you felt about the impact of the character?
paras.zh: KHC：如果我没有提到艾琳博士的创作，那就是我的失职。这个角色是如何产生的？您对这个角色的影响有何感受？

paras.en: EM: It's really funny. The character of Dr. Erin has now shown up in multiple series, video games, and comic books, which delights me.
paras.zh: EM：这真的很有趣。艾琳博士这个角色现在已经出现在多个系列、视频游戏和漫画书中，这让我很高兴。

paras.en: The origin of it started on "Star Trek: Prodigy". It was a "Star Trek" show aimed at children. They wanted me to come in not just to help make sure the science was right, but also to do more traditional science communication and help create a character who was a kid who wanted to be a scientist and talk about what that process is like. That's the character of Rok-Tahk, and she's adorable.
paras.zh: 它的起源始于《星际迷航：神童》。这是一部针对儿童的《星际迷航》节目。他们希望我进来不仅是为了帮助确保科学是正确的，也是为了进行更传统的科学传播，并帮助塑造一个想成为科学家的孩子的角色，并谈论这个过程是什么样的。这就是 Rok-Tahk 的角色，她很可爱。

paras.en: As they were reaching the end of season one, the kids were going to Starfleet Academy, and the showrunners were like, "She has to meet Dr. Erin. She is who she is because of Erin." That was just one of the greatest honors. It was a quick, one-line mention, not even named in the episode.
paras.zh: 当第一季即将结束时，孩子们要去星际舰队学院，制片人说，“她必须见到艾琳博士。因为艾琳，她才成为现在的样子。”这只是最大的荣誉之一。这是一个简短的一行提及，甚至没有在剧集中提及。

paras.en: KHC: Is there anything you wish you could change from your perspective?
paras.zh: KHC：从你的角度来看，有什么是你希望可以改变的吗？

paras.en: EM: Yeah, there are a few that haunt me a little bit.
paras.zh: EM：是的，有一些让我有点困扰。

paras.en: There are some shows where I was really involved, we meshed well together, and I helped with the story. There are very few things I would change. But then there are other shows where I'm just given the script at the 11th hour. Plot-wise, would I have suggested something different? Yes. But it was too late to course-correct.
paras.zh: 有一些节目我确实参与其中，我们配合得很好，而且我也为故事情节提供了帮助。我想要改变的事情很少。但也有其他节目，我是在第 11 个小时才拿到剧本的。从情节上来说，我会建议一些不同的东西吗？是的。但纠正方向为时已晚。

paras.en: One really good example was in "Star Trek: Discovery". They had an episode where they were trying to ride gravitational waves out of a nebula, as one does. They had that ready room explainer moment, and they were showing the gravitational waves as literal sine waves, like the ocean waves you think of. I was working with the visual effects team, and I pushed back. I said, "Really, these are compression waves." You could still make an argument that they were going to ride them out, but it's more like how sound waves move. They're compression waves.
paras.zh: 一个非常好的例子是《星际迷航：发现号》。他们有一个情节，他们试图像人们所做的那样，驾驭星云中的引力波。他们有准备室解释的时刻，他们将引力波显示为字面上的正弦波，就像你想到的海浪一样。我当时正在与视觉效果团队合作，但我拒绝了。我说：“真的，这些是压缩波。”你仍然可以说他们会克服它们，但这更像是声波的移动方式。它们是压缩波。

paras.en: To their credit, they animated that and put it in the scene. But as people were watching it, they felt that the way we were talking about it versus what we were seeing just wasn't working. It was pulling people out of the scene, so they had to revert back.
paras.zh: 值得赞扬的是，他们将其动画化并将其放入场景中。但当人们观看它时，他们觉得我们谈论它的方式与我们所看到的情况是行不通的。它把人们从现场拉了出来，所以他们不得不返回。

paras.en: It was funny because when that aired, I had three or four former gravitational wave colleagues who were like, "Erin, you had one job."
paras.zh: 这很有趣，因为当节目播出时，我有三四个前引力波同事说，“艾琳，你只有一份工作。”

paras.en: Another quick example was an episode in season one of "Strange New Worlds" where Spock says, "We're being pulled into the black hole."
paras.zh: 另一个简单的例子是《奇怪的新世界》第一季的一集，斯波克说：“我们被拉进黑洞了。”

paras.en: That's one of those moments where it's technically not correct. You fall into black holes. It's a very public misconception that I try to fight back against a lot. Black holes aren't hoovering things up. It's just deep gravity. But in the context of the scene, Spock is being very condescending and talking down to La'an, so he's simplifying the language for the public. I can sort of get away with that.
paras.zh: 这是技术上不正确的时刻之一。你掉进黑洞。这是一个非常公开的误解，我对此进行了多次反击。黑洞不会把东西吸起来。这只是深层引力。但在场景的背景下，史波克非常居高临下地对拉安说话，所以他为公众简化了语言。我可以摆脱这一点。

paras.en: KHC: Is there anything else you think our readers should know about science advising?
paras.zh: KHC：您认为我们的读者还应该了解有关科学建议的其他信息吗？

paras.en: EM: I meet a lot of people who, delicately or not, say, "I could do your job. I'd be a great science adviser." I think what's made me successful in science advising is that I take a very "yes, and" attitude.
paras.zh: EM：我遇到很多人，无论是否微妙，他们都会说：“我可以做你的工作。我会成为一名出色的科学顾问。”我认为我在科学咨询方面取得成功的原因是我采取了“是的，并且”的态度。

paras.en: I'm a fan first and foremost. If you spend your time just criticizing the science in films and TV, this is not the job for you. You need to work with the stories you're given, and you need to understand the mission.
paras.zh: 我首先是一个粉丝。如果你花时间只是批评电影和电视中的科学，那么这不适合你。你需要根据给你的故事进行工作，并且需要理解使命。

paras.en: - 'It's more than a hope, it's a guarantee': The Vera C. Rubin Observatory's 10-year movie of the universe is about to 'blow our minds,' chief scientist Tony Tyson says
paras.zh: - “这不仅仅是希望，更是保证”：首席科学家托尼·泰森表示，维拉·C·鲁宾天文台的 10 年宇宙电影即将“让我们大吃一惊”

paras.en: - Could Comet 3I/ATLAS teach us about life beyond Earth? Scientists say the story's not over yet.
paras.zh: - 彗星 3I/ATLAS 能否告诉我们地球以外的生命？科学家表示，故事还没有结束。

paras.en: - 'We only expect to encounter that once every 130 years': A huge new crater on the moon could mean a giant leap for lunar science
paras.zh: - “我们预计每 130 年才会遇到一次”：月球上的一个巨大的新陨石坑可能意味着月球科学的巨大飞跃

paras.en: There's a quick anecdote. I worked on another film called "Space Cadet," which is a stoner comedy on Amazon, and they were having a really hard time finding a science adviser because everyone was trashing the script. It's ridiculous, goofy, and fun. They were like, "Look, we just want someone who makes sure the NASA people know what NASA people would say. That's it."
paras.zh: 有一个轶事。我参与了另一部电影《太空学员》的制作，这是亚马逊上的一部瘾君子喜剧，他们很难找到科学顾问，因为每个人都在毁掉剧本。这很荒谬、愚蠢又有趣。他们说，“听着，我们只是想要有人确保 NASA 的人知道 NASA 的人会说什么。就是这样。”

paras.en: The job isn't for everyone. Storytelling comes first.
paras.zh: 这项工作并不适合所有人。讲故事是第一位的。

paras.en: Editor's note: This interview has been edited and shortened for length and clarity.
paras.zh: 编者注：为了篇幅和清晰度，本次采访经过编辑和缩短。

paras.zh: 帮助我们改进 Live Science Pro：我们一直在努力让我们的内容变得更好。请在此处给我们留下有关 Pro 的反馈。

paras.en: Kenna Hughes-Castleberry is the Content Manager at Live Science. Formerly, she was the Content Manager at Space.com and before that the Science Communicator at JILA, a physics research institute. Kenna is also a book author, with her upcoming book 'Octopus X' scheduled for release in spring of 2027. Her beats include physics, health, environmental science, technology, AI, animal intelligence, corvids, and cephalopods.
paras.zh: Kenna Hughes-Castleberry 是 Live Science 的内容经理。此前，她曾担任 Space.com 的内容经理，此前曾担任物理研究所 JILA 的科学传播员。肯纳还是一名书籍作者，她即将出版的新书《章鱼 X》计划于 2027 年春季发行。她的研究领域包括物理、健康、环境科学、技术、人工智能、动物智能、鸦科动物和头足类动物。

articles.title: Stars in your eyes? These are the best Black Friday telescopes, smart telescopes and binocular deals we've found to raise your skywatching game
articles.author: Kimberley Lane

paras.en: Black Friday is here once again, and if you've been waiting for the prices to drop before buying your next telescope, smart telescope or binoculars — this could be the time to pull the trigger.
paras.zh: 黑色星期五又来了，如果您一直在等待价格下跌，然后再购买下一台望远镜、智能望远镜或双筒望远镜，那么现在可能是扣动扳机的时候了。

paras.en: But as we all know by now, retailers use these sales as a sneaky way to inflate their prices before the sale starts, so in many instances, their "sale" price is actually the same as it was before they put the price up. So how can you be sure that the price you're seeing is truly a deal?
paras.zh: 但众所周知，零售商在促销开始前利用这些销售作为一种偷偷摸摸的方式抬高价格，因此在许多情况下，他们的“促销”价格实际上与提价之前相同。那么，您如何确定您所看到的价格确实是一笔交易呢？

paras.en: Well, we keep track of prices throughout the year, and use tools to check when they fluctuate. We know whether something is a genuine deal, and, crucially, whether the product is actually worth buying in the first place.
paras.zh: 嗯，我们全年跟踪价格，并使用工具检查价格何时波动。我们知道某件商品是否是正品，最重要的是，我们首先知道该产品是否真的值得购买。

paras.en: We've searched the web for the best genuine deals on the telescopes, smart telescopes and binoculars that we have actually tested ourselves, so you can be confident you're actually saving money and not getting played by capitalism.
paras.zh: 我们在网上搜索了有关望远镜、智能望远镜和双筒望远镜的最佳正品交易，并且我们已经亲自测试过这些望远镜，因此您可以放心，您实际上是在省钱，而不是被资本主义所欺骗。

paras.en: A great beginner telescope that the whole family can enjoy. This 4.5-inch Newtonian reflector comes with a 20mm eyepiece for scanning across the sky and a 10mm eyepiece for detailed views of the moon or spotting Saturn's rings.
paras.zh: 一款适合全家人都喜欢的入门级望远镜。这款 4.5 英寸牛顿反射镜配有 20 毫米目镜，用于扫描天空，以及 10 毫米目镜，用于详细观察月球或发现土星环。

paras.en: The EQ mount requires a bit of tinkering, but it's a useful skill to have once you've figured it out, as it makes tracking objects across the sky easier than an Alt-Az mount.
paras.zh: EQ 安装座需要一些修改，但一旦你掌握了它，它就会成为一项有用的技能，因为它比 Alt-Az 安装座更容易跟踪天空中的物体。

paras.en: This model usually retails for $319.99, so a $40 saving on a telescope of this quality is pretty good.
paras.zh: 该型号通常零售价为 319.99 美元，因此购买这种质量的望远镜可以节省 40 美元，非常不错。

paras.en: We've reviewed a smaller telescope in the AstroMaster range, the Celestron AstroMaster LT 70AZ, and our optics writer owns the Celestron AstroMaster 130EQ, which has a slightly larger aperture.
paras.zh: 我们评测了 AstroMaster 系列中的一款较小的望远镜——星特朗 AstroMaster LT 70AZ，我们的光学作家拥有星特朗 AstroMaster 130EQ，它的孔径稍大。

paras.en: The Celestron StarSense Explorer range is great for anyone who wants to start stargazing but doesn't yet have any knowledge of the night sky, and this model in particular is a good option if you want to invest in something you can grow with.
paras.zh: 星特朗 StarSense Explorer 系列非常适合那些想要开始观星但对夜空还没有任何了解的人，如果您想投资一些可以与您一起成长的东西，那么这款型号尤其是一个不错的选择。

paras.en: The setup is a straightforward Alt-Azimuth mount, and you can use the smartphone dock to navigate your way around the sky with the guidance of the StarSense app.
paras.zh: 该设置是一个简单的 Alt-Azimuth 安装，您可以使用智能手机底座在 StarSense 应用程序的指导下在天空中导航。

paras.en: It has a 5.1-inch (130mm) aperture and comes with 25mm and 10mm eyepieces, giving you beautiful views of the moon, Saturn's rings, Jupiter's cloud bands and wide views of some deep-sky objects like the Andromeda Galaxy and the Orion Nebula.
paras.zh: 它具有 5.1 英寸（130 毫米）光圈，并配有 25 毫米和 10 毫米目镜，让您可以欣赏到月球、土星环、木星云带的美丽景色，以及仙女座星系和猎户座星云等一些深空天体的广阔视野。

paras.en: The price tends to fluctuate throughout the year, although on average it sits between $420 and $450. However, it's been the full $499.95 since September, so this price is definitely worth taking advantage of.
paras.zh: 价格全年都会波动，但平均价格在 420 美元至 450 美元之间。然而，自 9 月份以来，它的全价为 499.95 美元，所以这个价格绝对值得利用。

paras.en: Read our full Celestron StarSense Explorer DX 130AZ review
paras.zh: 阅读我们完整的星特朗 StarSense Explorer DX 130AZ 评论

paras.en: Although it's very close in aperture to the StarSense DX 130AZ we listed above, the differences in optical design and focal length offer a different observing experience.
paras.zh: 虽然它的光圈与我们上面列出的 StarSense DX 130AZ 非常接近，但光学设计和焦距的差异提供了不同的观察体验。

paras.en: This model is the better choice if you want higher-magnification observations of the Moon and planets, thanks to its 1,250mm focal length. It also has a much shorter optical tube, so it's more compact and easier to transport. The Schmidt-Cassegrain design is more complex to manufacture than a Newtonian reflector, hence the difference in price between the two.
paras.zh: 如果您想要对月球和行星进行更高放大倍数的观测，由于其 1,250 毫米焦距，该型号是更好的选择。它还具有更短的光管，因此更紧凑且更易于运输。施密特-卡塞格伦设计比牛顿反射器制造起来更复杂，因此两者之间的价格存在差异。

paras.en: It was $579.99 throughout most of the year, rising to $589.99 in August, which it has been ever since.
paras.zh: 全年大部分时间价格为 579.99 美元，8 月份升至 589.99 美元，此后一直保持这一水平。

paras.en: Granted, it's not the biggest saving ever, and it isn't listed specifically as a Black Friday deal, but you can save $35 on the ZWO Seestar S30 Pro at Amazon. This is the cheapest we've seen it since its release, and it typically stays at the $699 RRP.
paras.zh: 当然，这并不是有史以来最大的折扣，也没有被特别列为黑色星期五促销，但你可以在亚马逊购买 ZWO Seestar S30 Pro 节省 35 美元。这是自发布以来我们见过的最便宜的价格，建议零售价通常为 699 美元。

paras.en: It's an incredible way to get into astrophotography, even for complete beginners. It's an all-in-one system that automatically locates, tracks and stacks images of stunning deep-space objects for you. It's compact and portable, with a quick and easy setup and produces beautiful 4K images.
paras.zh: 即使对于完全的初学者来说，这也是进入天文摄影的一种令人难以置信的方式。它是一个一体化系统，可以自动为您定位、跟踪和堆叠令人惊叹的深空物体的图像。它结构紧凑、便于携带，设置快速简单，可生成精美的 4K 图像。

paras.en: Read our full ZWO Seestar S30 Pro review
paras.zh: 阅读我们完整的 ZWO Seestar S30 Pro 评论

paras.en: The smallest and most affordable smart telescope on the market is now even more affordable (but still the same size).
paras.zh: 市场上最小、最实惠的智能望远镜现在更加实惠（但尺寸仍然相同）。

paras.en: It only produces 2K images, which is still plenty for sharing with friends and family or on social media. In practice, it just means you'll be more limited when it comes to cropping.
paras.zh: 它仅生成 2K 图像，但仍足以与朋友和家人分享或在社交媒体上分享。实际上，这只是意味着您在裁剪时会受到更多限制。

paras.en: It's been $419 since August, and this Black Friday deal is the cheapest we've seen it since its release.
paras.zh: 自 8 月份以来，它的价格一直是 419 美元，这次黑色星期五的促销是我们自发布以来见过的最便宜的促销。

paras.en: Read our full Dwarflab Dwarf Mini review
paras.zh: 阅读我们完整的 Dwarflab Dwarf Mini 评论

paras.en: If you're a more advanced user and have been waiting to upgrade, this is one of the best chances you'll get. You can now save a whopping $1,000 on the Unistellar eVscope 2 right now.
paras.zh: 如果您是更高级的用户并且一直在等待升级，那么这是您获得的最佳机会之一。现在购买 Unistellar eVscope 2 可节省高达 1,000 美元。

paras.en: It has an aperture of 114mm and a 450mm focal length, making it ideal for deep-sky imaging of even faint and small objects. And the electronic Nikon-produced eyepiece adds an immersive element to the experience, rather than viewing everything on your screen.
paras.zh: 它的光圈为 114 毫米，焦距为 450 毫米，非常适合对微弱和微小物体进行深空成像。尼康生产的电子目镜为体验增添了身临其境的元素，而不是观看屏幕上的所有内容。

paras.en: Read our full Unistellar eVscope 2 review
paras.zh: 阅读我们完整的 Unistellar eVscope 2 评论

paras.en: Another fantastic saving from Unistellar, and the Odyssey Pro doesn't have as much reach as the eVscope 2, meaning it works better on wider objects.
paras.zh: Unistellar 的另一项出色的节省，Odyssey Pro 的覆盖范围不如 eVscope 2，这意味着它在更广泛的物体上效果更好。

paras.en: The Odyssey Pro has an 85mm aperture with a 320mm focal length, which is still plenty to get stunning views of galaxies and nebulas. It also has a Nikon eyepiece that shows you how your image is doing as it's stacking — which is beneficial if you're not connected to the app.
paras.zh: Odyssey Pro 的光圈为 85 毫米，焦距为 320 毫米，足以拍摄令人惊叹的星系和星云景色。它还具有尼康目镜，可以向您显示图像在堆叠时的表现 - 如果您未连接到应用程序，这将非常有用。

paras.en: Vaonis describes the Vespera 3 as the "most affordable premium smart telescope on the market," and judging from its specs, we'd be inclined to agree.
paras.zh: Vaonis 将 Vespera 3 描述为“市场上最实惠的优质智能望远镜”，从其规格来看，我们倾向于同意。

paras.en: It has a new apochromatic quadruplet design that eliminates chromatic aberration and field curvature across the entire frame, excellent clarity even under city skies, a massive 11 hours of battery life and built-in multi-night capture.
paras.zh: 它采用全新的复消色差四片式设计，消除了整个画面的色差和场曲，即使在城市天空下也能实现出色的清晰度，电池续航时间长达 11 小时，并且内置多夜拍摄功能。

paras.en: It has a 50mm aperture and 245mm focal length, with a native image resolution of 8.3MP, or up to 24MP with covalENS mosaic mode.
paras.zh: 它具有 50mm 光圈和 245mm 焦距，原始图像分辨率为 8.3MP，或使用 covalENS 马赛克模式高达 24MP。

paras.en: If you liked the sound of the Vespera 3 but wanted something a little more powerful, the Vespera Pro 2 is $500 off for Black Friday.
paras.zh: 如果您喜欢 Vespera 3 的声音，但想要更强大的声音，Vespera Pro 2 黑色星期五可享受 500 美元折扣。

paras.en: It offers a higher resolution of 12.5MP native and 50MP mosaic, has more internal storage (225GB vs 115GB), and comes with a carbon fiber tripod (as opposed to aluminum) and a hard case, which are perhaps more suited for traveling to dark skies.
paras.zh: 它提供了更高分辨率的 12.5MP 原生和 50MP 马赛克，具有更多的内部存储空间（225GB 与 115GB），并配有碳纤维三脚架（而不是铝）和硬盒，这可能更适合在黑暗的天空中旅行。

paras.en: We've been testing it out over the past few weeks and are incredibly impressed. The images we've taken of the moon, for example, are breathtaking. The Vespera Pro 2 is currently the highest resolution smart telescope on the market.
paras.zh: 过去几周我们一直在对其进行测试，并且给我们留下了深刻的印象。例如，我们拍摄的月球图像令人惊叹。 Vespera Pro 2 是目前市场上分辨率最高的智能望远镜。

paras.en: If you're looking for a pair of binoculars you can take anywhere, with excellent optical quality and edge-to-edge sharpness, the Celestron Regal ED 10x42 is an excellent investment.
paras.zh: 如果您正在寻找一副可以随身携带、具有出色光学质量和边缘清晰度的双筒望远镜，星特朗 Regal ED 10x42 是一项绝佳的投资。

paras.en: The ED glass eliminates chromatic aberration, and it has field-flattening lenses to correct curvature, resulting in sharp, bright and detailed images with basically no defects. Perfect for observing the moon and stars with excellent clarity.
paras.zh: ED玻璃消除了色差，并具有平场镜片来校正曲率，从而产生锐利、明亮、细致的图像，基本没有缺陷。非常适合以极佳的清晰度观察月亮和星星。

paras.en: We have seen them cheaper at the start of the year, but over the summer they've been $379, so this price is worth taking advantage of.
paras.zh: 我们在年初看到它们更便宜，但整个夏天它们的价格为 379 美元，所以这个价格值得利用。

paras.en: Read our full Celestron Regal ED 10x42 review
paras.zh: 阅读我们完整的星特朗 Regal ED 10x42 评论

paras.en: If birdwatching is more your thing, the 8x42 variant is also in the Black Friday sale.
paras.zh: 如果您更喜欢观鸟，8x42 型号也在黑色星期五促销中。

paras.en: If the Regal ED is a little out of budget, the Nature DX ED range is an excellent, more affordable alternative that still offers great image quality.
paras.zh: 如果 Regal ED 有点超出预算，Nature DX ED 系列是一个优秀、更实惠的替代品，但仍能提供出色的图像质量。

paras.en: This variant in particular is ideal for birdwatching, thanks to the 8x magnification, and the ED glass is ideal for following birds in flight. Plus, you can enjoy views of the moon and get a closer look at the stars.
paras.zh: 由于具有 8 倍放大倍率，该型号特别适合观鸟，而 ED 玻璃非常适合跟踪飞行中的鸟类。此外，您还可以欣赏月亮美景并近距离观察星星。

paras.en: We have reviewed the Celestron Nature DX ED 10x42 variant, although this model isn't included in the Black Friday deals.
paras.zh: 我们已经评测了星特朗 Nature DX ED 10x42 变体，尽管该型号不包含在黑色星期五优惠中。

paras.en: Big astronomy binoculars are a must for any sky-lover, and the Celestron SkyMaster Pro ED 15x70 are perfect for getting detailed views of the moon, stars and even spotting Jupiter's moons.
paras.zh: 大型天文双筒望远镜是任何天空爱好者的必备品，星特朗 SkyMaster Pro ED 15x70 非常适合获得月亮、星星甚至木星卫星的详细视图。

paras.en: They typically fluctuate between $279 and $309, and although they aren't currently listed as a Black Friday offer, the $25 you can apply at checkout makes them the same price as the variant without ED glass. Personally, we'd always buy the pair with ED glass.
paras.zh: 它们的价格通常在 279 美元到 309 美元之间波动，尽管它们目前没有被列为黑色星期五优惠，但您可以在结账时支付 25 美元，这使得它们的价格与不带 ED 玻璃的版本相同。就我个人而言，我们总是购买带有 ED 玻璃的眼镜。

paras.en: Read our full Celestron SkyMaster Pro ED 15x70 review
paras.zh: 阅读我们完整的星特朗 SkyMaster Pro ED 15x70 评论

paras.en: With a massive 20x magnification and 80mm objective lenses, these are serious skywatching binoculars that provide stunning detail in the night sky. They're perfect for close-up views of the moon and stars, and you can also spot Jupiter's moons and some of the brighter deep-sky objects.
paras.zh: 这些是严肃的观天双筒望远镜，具有 20 倍的巨大放大倍率和 80 毫米物镜，可提供夜空中令人惊叹的细节。它们非常适合近距离观察月亮和星星，您还可以发现木星的卫星和一些更明亮的深空天体。

paras.en: This is the cheapest we've seen them since June, and they tend to fluctuate between around $270 and $319.
paras.zh: 这是自 6 月份以来我们见过的最便宜的价格，价格往往在 270 美元到 319 美元之间波动。

paras.en: Read our full Celestron SkyMaster Pro 20x80 review
paras.zh: 阅读我们完整的星特朗 SkyMaster Pro 20x80 评论

paras.en: The Pro ED version is also discounted, although not labelled as a Black Friday deal. There's a $30 coupon you can apply at checkout to get them down to $319.97.
paras.zh: Pro ED 版本也有折扣，尽管没有标记为黑色星期五优惠。您可以在结帐时使用 30 美元的优惠券，将其降至 319.97 美元。

paras.en: Black Friday technically starts at 00:00 AM on Friday, November 27, 2026, running all weekend until 23:59 on Monday, November 30, 2026, which is known as Cyber Monday. However, many retailers have been running early Black Friday deals for the past couple of weeks.
paras.zh: 从技术上讲，黑色星期五从 2026 年 11 月 27 日星期五上午 00:00 开始，整个周末持续到 2026 年 11 月 30 日星期一 23:59，即所谓的“网络星期一”。然而，过去几周，许多零售商一直在提前进行黑色星期五促销活动。

paras.en: What retailers take part in Black Friday?
paras.zh: 哪些零售商参加黑色星期五？

paras.en: Pretty much all of them! We've sourced these deals from our trusted retailers, including Amazon, B&H Photo, Best Buy, Walmart and others.
paras.zh: 几乎全部！我们从值得信赖的零售商处采购这些优惠，包括亚马逊、B&H Photo、百思买、沃尔玛等。

paras.en: How do I know if a Black Friday deal is genuine?
paras.zh: 我如何知道黑色星期五优惠是否真实？

paras.en: We've done the legwork for you. We've checked the price history of all these deals to make sure you aren't being fooled, and we have personally tried and tested all the products we have recommended.
paras.zh: 我们已经为您做好了跑腿工作。我们检查了所有这些交易的价格历史记录，以确保您没有被愚弄，并且我们亲自尝试和测试了我们推荐的所有产品。

paras.en: Get the world’s most fascinating discoveries delivered straight to your inbox.
paras.zh: 将世界上最迷人的发现直接发送到您的收件箱。

With over 6 years of photography experience, her skills span across landscape and seascape photography, wildlife, astrophotography and portrait work. Her photos have been featured in a number of national magazines, including Digital Camera World and Cosmopolitan. She has also contributed to our sister site Space.com and Tech Radar, and she regularly uses binoculars and telescopes to stargaze in the dark skies of South Wales.
paras.zh: Live Science 的电子商务撰稿人 Kimberley Lane 测试了多种光学设备，评测了索尼、佳能、OM System 等公司的相机设备。她拥有超过 6 年的摄影经验，技能涵盖风景和海景摄影、野生动物、天文摄影和肖像作品。她的照片曾出现在许多国家杂志上，包括《数码相机世界》和《Cosmopolitan》。她还为我们的姊妹网站 Space.com 和 Tech Radar 做出了贡献，她经常使用双筒望远镜和天文望远镜在南威尔士的黑暗天空中观察星空。

articles.title: Where Does Language Originate in the Brain? New Research Challenges Our 150-Year-Old Understanding

paras.en: For roughly 150 years, scientists have thought that a brain region called Wernicke’s area, located just above the left ear, was solely responsible for understanding spoken and written language. That’s because in the 1870s, German neurologist Carl Wernicke noticed that people with damage to that area struggled to comprehend words. Speech production, on the other hand, was believed to stem from a separate place called Broca’s area, near the left temple.
paras.zh: 大约 150 年来，科学家们一直认为位于左耳上方、称为韦尼克区的大脑区域唯一负责理解口语和书面语言。这是因为在 1870 年代，德国神经学家 Carl Wernicke 注意到该区域受损的人难以理解单词。另一方面，人们认为言语的产生源于左太阳穴附近一个名为布罗卡区的独立地方。

paras.en: However, individuals with damage to Wernicke’s area sometimes also spoke in fluent-sounding gibberish, talking in what’s described as “word salad,” perplexing researchers. Now, one team may have figured out why: Wernicke’s area actually pulls double duty, helping both process speech and produce it. The findings, published in the journal Science on November 19, rewrite our understanding of how the brain constructs language and can help scientists develop technologies that restore speech.
paras.zh: 然而，韦尼克区受损的人有时也会说一些听起来很流利的胡言乱语，被称为“单词沙拉”，这让研究人员感到困惑。现在，一个团队可能已经找到了原因：韦尼克的区域实际上担负着双重职责，既帮助处理言语，又帮助产生言语。该研究结果发表在 11 月 19 日的《科学》杂志上，重写了我们对大脑如何构建语言的理解，并可以帮助科学家开发恢复言语的技术。

paras.en: To conduct the study, scientists recruited 28 people undergoing brain surgery for epilepsy. Researchers implanted grids of either 128 or 256 electrodes in their heads to record the activity of nerve cells, or neurons. Then, the participants—who remained awake during the operation—repeated and listened to words and sentences.
paras.zh: 为了进行这项研究，科学家招募了 28 名接受脑部癫痫手术的人。研究人员在他们的头部植入了 128 个或 256 个电极网格，以记录神经细胞或神经元的活动。然后，在手术过程中保持清醒的参与者重复并聆听单词和句子。

paras.en: “What we saw was not what the textbook predicted,” said study co-author Edward Chang, a neurosurgeon at the University of California, San Francisco (UCSF), at a press briefing, reports Allison Parshall for Scientific American.
paras.zh: 据《科学美国人》艾莉森·帕歇尔报道，该研究的共同作者、加州大学旧金山分校 (UCSF) 的神经外科医生爱德华·张 (Edward Chang) 在新闻发布会上表示：“我们所看到的并不是教科书所预测的。”

paras.en: Neurons in a nickel-size part of Wernicke’s area fired as the patients listened to speech, and, surprisingly, about one-fourth of a second before they spoke. Activity strength in the subzone, called the left posterior superior temporal gyrus (lpSTG), depended on the complexity and length of the word.
paras.zh: 当患者听讲话时，韦尼克区域镍币大小的部分的神经元会放电，令人惊讶的是，在他们说话前大约四分之一秒的时间里，神经元会放电。该子区域（称为左后颞上回（lpSTG））的活动强度取决于单词的复杂性和长度。

paras.en: “It’s more active when you’re about to say the word caterpillar than when you’re about to say the word cat,” said study co-author Matthew Leonard, a cognitive neuroscientist at UCSF, during the press briefing, per Laura Sanders at Science News.
paras.zh: 据《科学新闻》的劳拉·桑德斯报道，该研究的合著者、加州大学旧金山分校的认知神经科学家马修·伦纳德在新闻发布会上说：“当你要说‘毛毛虫’这个词时，它比当你要说‘猫’这个词时更活跃。”

paras.en: For a long time, scientists have wondered whether different neural mechanisms govern each language within a bilingual speaker’s brain. A study published this past summer found that people who speak both English and Spanish rely on the same “grammatical engine” for the two tongues.
paras.zh: 长期以来，科学家们一直想知道双语使用者大脑中是否有不同的神经机制控制着每种语言。去年夏天发表的一项研究发现，同时讲英语和西班牙语的人依赖两种语言的相同“语法引擎”。

paras.en: About half of the surgery participants also received electrical stimulation to their lpSTG, which rendered them unable to understand spoken queries from the researchers. They also lost the ability to start talking or spoke in “word salad,” making errors similar to those of people with Wernicke’s aphasia, a condition where someone struggles with language because of damage to Wernicke’s area. Turning off the electrical stimulation restored the participants’ ability to comprehend and produce speech.
paras.zh: 大约一半的手术参与者还接受了对其 lpSTG 的电刺激，这使得他们无法理解研究人员的口头询问。他们还失去了开始说话或用“单词沙拉”说话的能力，犯下与韦尼克失语症患者类似的错误，韦尼克失语症是一种由于韦尼克区域受损而导致语言困难的疾病。关闭电刺激可以恢复参与者理解和产生言语的能力。

paras.en: The findings suggest that biology textbooks will need to be rewritten, since Wernicke’s and Broca’s areas’ previously assigned roles are foundational. But that idea doesn’t totally surprise Leigh Hochberg, a neurologist at Mass General Brigham who wasn’t involved in the study. As scientists develop better tools to study the brain, he tells National Geographic’s Helen Thompson, “placing a circle around a part of the brain and assigning it a single function, I suspect, is going to turn out to be a substantial oversimplification.”
paras.zh: 研究结果表明，生物学教科书需要重写，因为韦尼克区和布罗卡区之前分配的角色是基础性的。但这个想法并不完全令麻省总医院的神经学家 Leigh Hochberg 感到惊讶，他没有参与这项研究。他告诉《国家地理》杂志的海伦·汤普森，随着科学家们开发出更好的工具来研究大脑，“我怀疑，在大脑的一部分周围放置一个圆圈并为其分配一个单一的功能，结果将是一种严重的过于简单化。”

paras.en: The study’s findings could help researchers develop brain-computer interfaces (BCIs) that can restore speech in certain patients. Most clinical trials focus on people who have lost their ability to talk because of paralysis. But that doesn’t work for people with aphasia, per Scientific American, since the brain signals responsible for their intended speech don’t make it to the brain’s motor regions, which would have sent information to the mouth’s muscles. BCIs for aphasia patients therefore need to decode what the individuals want to communicate from the activation of undamaged parts of the lpSTG.
paras.zh: 该研究的结果可以帮助研究人员开发可以恢复某些患者言语能力的脑机接口（BCI）。大多数临床试验都针对因瘫痪而失去说话能力的人。但据《科学美国人》报道，这对失语症患者不起作用，因为负责他们想要讲话的大脑信号不会到达大脑的运动区域，而大脑的运动区域会向口腔肌肉发送信息。因此，失语症患者的脑机接口需要通过激活 lpSTG 未受损部分来解码个体想要传达的信息。

paras.en: To start on that, the researchers made experimental brain implants for two participants with paralysis. When tested, the BCIs detected what the individuals heard and what they wanted to say.
paras.zh: 首先，研究人员为两名瘫痪参与者进行了实验性脑植入。在测试时，脑机接口检测到人们听到了什么以及他们想说什么。

paras.en: The findings also open the door for future research on Wernicke’s area. Other primates don’t have a brain region resembling it, so that could explain why these animals haven’t evolved speech.
paras.zh: 这些发现也为韦尼克领域的未来研究打开了大门。其他灵长类动物没有类似的大脑区域，因此这可以解释为什么这些动物没有进化出语言。

paras.en: “This subzone, which turns the words that we hear into words that we say, may be part of what makes us human,” Chang tells National Geographic.
paras.zh: “这个分区将我们听到的话语转化为我们所说的话语，这可能是我们人类的一部分，”张告诉国家地理。

articles.title: In the Heart of Harlem, a New Museum Tells the Overlooked Story of the Civil Rights Movement in the North

paras.en: In many American classrooms and textbooks, the history of the civil rights movement is focused on the Jim Crow-era South, including the Selma march, the Montgomery Bus Boycott, the Greensboro sit-ins, Ruby Bridges’ role in desegregating her New Orleans elementary school and Rosa Parks’ refusal to change bus seats.
paras.zh: 在许多美国课堂和教科书中，民权运动的历史都集中在吉姆·克劳时代的南方，包括塞尔玛游行、蒙哥马利巴士抵制运动、格林斯伯勒静坐、鲁比·布里奇斯在新奥尔良小学废除种族隔离中所扮演的角色以及罗莎·帕克斯拒绝更换公交车座位的行为。

paras.en: But the struggle for civil rights was nationwide, in cities as well as rural communities. The overlooked civil rights fight in the North is the focus of the Urban Civil Rights Museum, which opened to the public earlier this month in New York City’s Harlem neighborhood.
paras.zh: 但争取公民权利的斗争是全国性的，在城市和农村社区都是如此。北方被忽视的民权斗争是城市民权博物馆的焦点，该博物馆于本月早些时候在纽约市哈莱姆区向公众开放。

paras.en: Spanning 12,000 square feet inside the headquarters of the National Urban League—the civil rights organization that was founded in 1910 to economically, socially and politically empower African Americans—the museum bills itself as the first institution to prioritize the story of civil rights movements in the urban American North. It is also the first civil rights museum in New York City.
paras.zh: 该博物馆占地 12,000 平方英尺，位于全国城市联盟总部内，该民权组织成立于 1910 年，旨在在经济、社会和政治上赋予非裔美国人权力。该博物馆自称是第一个优先介绍美国北部城市民权运动故事的机构。它也是纽约市第一家民权博物馆。

paras.en: “It preserves a chapter of American history that too many people never learned, right here on 125th Street, where so much of that history was made,” Marc H. Morial, president and CEO of the National Urban League, says in a statement. “For too long, the story of civil rights in America has been told as a Southern story, but the fight for fair housing, good jobs, quality schools and equal justice was waged just as fiercely in the cities of the North, and Harlem was at the heart of it. We built this museum so that the next generation can see themselves in that legacy and carry it forward.”
paras.zh: “它保留了太多人从未了解过的美国历史篇章，就在 125 街，很多历史都是在这里创造的，”全国城市联盟主席兼首席执行官马克·H·莫里尔 (Marc H. Morial) 在一份声明中表示。 “长期以来，美国的民权故事一直被当作南方故事来讲述，但在北方城市中，争取公平住房、良好就业、优质学校和平等正义的斗争也同样激烈，而哈莱姆区正是其中的核心。我们建造这座博物馆，是为了让下一代能够看到自己的遗产并将其发扬光大。”

paras.en: This value is reflected in the museum’s primary permanent exhibition, “Moving History Forward,” in which visitors walk through centuries of Civil Rights history, beginning in the 1500s and advancing into the present day. Eight separate galleries showcase different notable benchmarks, including the arrival of the first ships carrying enslaved Africans to American, in Jamestown, Virginia, in 1619; New York’s total abolition of slavery in 1827; the end of the Civil War in 1865; the passage of the 1968 Fair Housing Act, which outlawed discriminatory housing practices; and the 1980s HIV/AIDS crisis, which disproportionately impacted Black men, primarily in urban centers likes New York City.
paras.zh: 这一价值体现在博物馆的主要永久展览“推动历史前进”中，游客可以在其中回顾几个世纪的民权历史，从 1500 年代开始一直延续到今天。八个独立的画廊展示了不同的著名基准，包括 1619 年第一批载着被奴役的非洲人到达美国的船只于 1619 年抵达弗吉尼亚州詹姆斯敦； 1827年纽约彻底废除奴隶制； 1865 年内战结束； 1968 年《公平住房法》的通过，禁止歧视性住房做法； 20 世纪 80 年代的艾滋病毒/艾滋病危机对黑人男性造成了不成比例的影响，主要是在纽约市等城市中心。

paras.en: “We want people to, as soon as they enter the gallery, start seeing and thinking about how displacement is connected with injustice over time,” Jennifer Scott, the museum’s executive director and chief curator, tells NY1’s Cheryl Wills.
paras.zh: “我们希望人们一进入画廊，就开始看到并思考随着时间的推移，流离失所与不公正是如何联系在一起的，”博物馆执行董事兼首席策展人詹妮弗·斯科特 (Jennifer Scott) 告诉 NY1 的谢丽尔·威尔斯 (Cheryl Wills)。

paras.en: At every turn, the institution’s sense of place—beginning with its Harlem roots—is brought to the fore. Other permanent exhibits are devoted to the Harlem Renaissance and the Great Migration, which saw millions of Black southerners move to northern cities.
paras.zh: 在每一个转折点，该机构的地方感——从其哈莱姆根源开始——都被凸显出来。其他永久性展览致力于哈莱姆文艺复兴和大迁徙，数百万南方黑人迁移到北方城市。

paras.en: The museum’s first special exhibition, “Thriving! Harlem as Homeplace,” is a “love letter” to the historic neighborhood, its community spaces and creative movements that that ushered meaningful change and cultivated joy throughout the 20th century, per the statement.
paras.zh: 博物馆的第一个特别展览“繁荣！哈莱姆作为家园”是一封写给历史悠久的街区、其社区空间和创意运动的“情书”，这些运动在整个 20 世纪带来了有意义的变化并培养了欢乐。

paras.en: When Fidel Castro, the revolutionary leader of Cuba, visited the 1960 United Nations General Assembly in New York City, he made a provocative point of staying in Harlem, where he hoped to draw attention to America’s racial tensions. At the storied Hotel Theresa, Castro met with Malcom X and Soviet Premier Nikita Khrushchev.
paras.zh: 1960 年，古巴革命领袖菲德尔·卡斯特罗 (Fidel Castro) 出席在纽约举行的联合国大会时，提出了留在哈莱姆区的挑衅性观点，希望在那里引起人们对美国种族紧张局势的关注。在著名的特蕾莎酒店，卡斯特罗会见了马尔科姆·X和苏联总理尼基塔·赫鲁晓夫。

paras.en: The museum hopes that its permanent and special exhibitions will dispell two incomplete civil rights narratives.
paras.zh: 博物馆希望其常设展览和特别展览能够消除两种不完整的民权叙事。

paras.en: “First being that racism and segregation were really a Southern problem,” Jeanne Theoharis, a political scientist at Brooklyn College, tells the New York Times’ Derrick Bryson Taylor. “And, two, that there wasn’t a hugely robust kind of movement in places like New York, Los Angeles, Chicago.”
paras.zh: “首先，种族主义和种族隔离确实是南方的问题，”布鲁克林学院的政治学家珍妮·西奥哈里斯 (Jeanne Theoharis) 告诉《纽约时报》的德里克·布莱森·泰勒 (Derrick Bryson Taylor)。 “第二，在纽约、洛杉矶、芝加哥等地，并没有出现非常强劲的运动。”

paras.en: The institution raised roughly $225 million to support its creation and launch, including $4 million in federal funding. A café and gift shop are also housed inside, and public programs including group tours, story readings for children and film screenings will be regularly available to the public.
paras.zh: 该机构筹集了大约 2.25 亿美元来支持其创建和启动，其中包括 400 万美元的联邦资金。里面还设有咖啡馆和礼品店，并定期向公众提供团体旅游、儿童故事朗读和电影放映等公共活动。

paras.en: “We want people to know that they are key participants,” Scott tells the Associated Press’ Fabianna Rincon. “History is living, it’s unfinished, and we can impact it.”
paras.zh: “我们希望人们知道他们是关键参与者，”斯科特告诉美联社的法比安娜·林康。 “历史是鲜活的，它尚未完成，我们可以影响它。”

paras.en: “Thriving! Harlem as Homeplace” is on view at the Urban Civil Rights Museum in Harlem, New York, through May 17, 2027.
paras.zh: “繁荣！哈莱姆区作为家园”将在纽约哈莱姆区的城市民权博物馆展出，展览期将持续到 2027 年 5 月 17 日。

articles.title: The First-Ever Children's Booker Prize Revealed Its Eight Shortlisted Finalists. Meet the Four Young Judges Deciding the Winner

paras.en: Since 1969, the Booker Prize has been one of the literary world’s most prestigious honors for fiction. This year, for the first time ever, it will have a children’s literature counterpart. The inaugural Children’s Booker Prize has revealed its shortlist and recruited a panel of young readers to help decide who takes home the £50,000 (roughly $65,500) award in February.
paras.zh: 自 1969 年以来，布克奖一直是文学界最负盛名的小说奖项之一。今年，它将有史以来第一次有儿童文学对应的内容。首届儿童布克奖公布了入围名单，并招募了一组年轻读者来帮助决定谁能在 2 月份获得 50,000 英镑（约合 65,500 美元）的奖项。

paras.en: Announced this week, the 2027 shortlist—dubbed the “Great Eight”—comprises five novels, two graphic novels and an illustrated collection of short stories for readers of ages eight to 12. Selected from 89 submissions published in the United Kingdom or Ireland, the finalists showcase authors and illustrators from five countries across three continents. The announcement arrives just two weeks after M. John Harrison won the 2026 adult Booker Prize for The End of Everything.
paras.zh: 本周公布的 2027 年入围名单（被称为“八强”）包括五本小说、两本图画小说和一本适合 8 至 12 岁读者的插图短篇小说集。入围作品是从英国或爱尔兰出版的 89 篇作品中选出的，入围作品展示了来自三大洲五个国家的作家和插画家。这一消息是在约翰·哈里森 (M. John Harrison) 凭借《一切的终结》荣获 2026 年成人布克奖两周后发布的。

paras.en: “This list, like life, is full of surprises,” Frank Cottrell-Boyce, a children's author and screenwriter who is chairing the judging panel, says in a statement. “When we set out, we were not sure what we were looking for,” he adds, noting that the panel kept one guiding rule in mind: “Every one of the ‘Great Eight’ on our shortlist had to be a book that was truly FOR CHILDREN. Our brilliant child judges will tell us whether we’ve kept our promise!”
