paras.zh: “这份名单就像生活一样，充满了惊喜，”评审团主席、儿童作家兼编剧弗兰克·科特雷尔-博伊斯在一份声明中说道。 “当我们出发时，我们并不确定我们要寻找什么，”他补充道，并指出评审团牢记了一条指导原则：“入围名单上的每一本‘伟大八本’都必须是一本真正适合儿童的书。我们才华横溢的儿童评委将告诉我们是否兑现了我们的承诺！”

paras.en: The Booker Prize Foundation launched the award last year amid mounting concern over a steep slide in youth reading habits. According to the Britain’s Annual Literacy Survey from 2025, the share of children and teenagers who enjoy reading dropped to just one in three, the lowest level in the 20 years since the survey started asking the question.
paras.zh: 布克奖基金会去年设立该奖项，是因为人们越来越担心青少年阅读习惯急剧下降。根据英国 2025 年年度识字率调查，喜欢阅读的儿童和青少年比例降至三分之一，这是该调查开始提出该问题 20 年来的最低水平。

paras.en: Matching the adult Booker’s award money is a deliberate bid to elevate children’s literature. “There’s very little cultural conversation around children’s books and very little prestige,” Cottrell-Boyce tells the Guardian’s Emma Loffhagen. “Why shouldn’t a great children’s book have the same status as a great adult book?” Even in major bookstores, he argues, the entire breadth of children’s fiction is often crowded onto just a few shelves, “and half of that is going to be Roald Dahl.”
paras.zh: 与成人布克奖的奖金相匹配是为了提升儿童文学的水平。 “围绕儿童读物的文化对话很少，声望也很低，”科特雷尔-博伊斯告诉《卫报》的艾玛·洛夫哈根。 “为什么一本伟大的儿童读物不应该与一本伟大的成人读物享有同样的地位？”他认为，即使在大型书店，所有的儿童小说也常常被挤在几个书架上，“其中一半是罗尔德·达尔的作品。”

paras.en: The eight finalists span an eclectic mix of genres, from comedy and horror to science fiction and historical fantasy. The Rambler’s Curse, written and illustrated by BAFTA-winning animator Mikey Please, follows a human chef and a goblin waiter serving ogres and dragons at a woodland café. Irish author Jessica Scott-Whyte’s Séamus Almost Famous, illustrated by Becka Moor, tracks a boy determined to step out from the shadow of his notable family, including a baby sister who became an accidental internet sensation. For young readers with a taste for the eerie, Guy Bass and illustrator David Roberts offer The Worst Thing That Could Possibly Happen, a collection of unsettling short stories, while British-Pakistani former journalist Iqbal Hussain’s debut children’s novel, The Night I Borrowed Time, centers on a seventh son who discovers he can travel through time to mend his family’s lives.
paras.zh: 八名决赛入围者涵盖了各种类型，从喜剧和恐怖到科幻和历史奇幻。 《漫步者的诅咒》由英国电影和电视艺术学院奖获奖动画师 Mikey Please 创作并绘制插图，讲述了一位人类厨师和一位妖精服务员在一家林地咖啡馆为食人魔和龙提供服务的故事。爱尔兰作家杰西卡·斯科特·怀特（Jessica Scott-Whyte）的《SéamusAlmostFamous》由贝卡·摩尔（BeckaMoor）绘制，讲述了一个决心摆脱名门望族阴影的男孩的故事，其中包括一个意外成为网络红人的小妹妹。盖伊·巴斯 (Guy Bass) 和插画家大卫·罗伯茨 (David Roberts) 为喜欢怪诞事物的年轻读者提供了一本令人不安的短篇小说集《可能发生的最糟糕的事情》(The Worst Thing That Could Happen)，而英巴裔前记者伊克巴尔·侯赛因 (Iqbal Hussain) 的首部儿童小说《我借来的时间之夜》(The Night I Borrowed Time) 则以第七个儿子为中心，他发现自己可以穿越时空来修补家人的生活。

paras.en: Other contenders explore belonging, mystery and heavier emotional terrain. In The Teller of Tall Tales, by Liz Hyder and illustrator Tom de Freston, a grandmother in a remote cabin spins stories to connect her estranged grandchild with a hidden family history. Australian artist Shaun Tan’s Hometown follows a girl living on a distant planet who learns from a space-suited visitor that her true home lies far away. Graver realities anchor War, a graphic novel by Artemis Fowl-author Eoin Colfer, Andrew Donkin and illustrator Giovanni Rigano about a 14-year-old girl surviving inside a besieged European city. And in Catherine Bruton’s Tadpole Summer, a girl pitches a tent in her garden to seek solace in nature as her younger brother’s illness worsens.
paras.zh: 其他竞争者则探索归属感、神秘感和更沉重的情感领域。在莉兹·海德 (Liz Hyder) 和插画家汤姆·德·弗雷斯顿 (Tom de Freston) 合着的《荒诞故事的讲述者》中，一位住在偏僻小屋里的祖母编造故事，将她疏远的孙子与一段隐藏的家族历史联系起来。澳大利亚艺术家 Shaun Tan 的家乡讲述了一个生活在遥远星球上的女孩从一位穿着太空服的访客那里得知她真正的家在遥远的地方。 《战争》是《阿耳忒弥斯奇幻故事》的作者 Eoin Colfer、Andrew Donkin 和插画家 Giovanni Rigano 创作的图画小说，讲述了一个 14 岁女孩在被围困的欧洲城市中求生的故事，讲述了一个 14 岁女孩在一个被围困的欧洲城市中生存的故事。在凯瑟琳·布鲁顿的《蝌蚪之夏》中，当她弟弟的病情恶化时，一个女孩在她的花园里搭起了帐篷，在大自然中寻求安慰。

paras.en: Cottrell-Boyce notes that classic children’s books have never avoided dark subjects, pointing to the wartime Blitz backdrop of the Narnia series and the difficult beginnings of Anne of Green Gables.
paras.zh: 科特雷尔-博伊斯指出，经典儿童读物从不回避黑暗主题，他指出了《纳尼亚传奇》系列的战时闪电战背景和《绿山墙的安妮》的艰难开端。

paras.en: The opening lines of The Lion, the Witch and the Wardrobe, the first book in C.S. Lewis’ The Chronicles of Narnia series contain the only direct reference to the London Blitz, a World War II bombing campaign that battered the capital starting in September 1940.
paras.zh: 《狮子、女巫和魔衣橱》是 C.S. 刘易斯《纳尼亚传奇》系列的第一本书，它的开头几行唯一直接提到了伦敦闪电战，这是一场从 1940 年 9 月开始袭击伦敦的二战轰炸行动。

paras.en: - “Once there were four children whose names were Peter, Susan, Edmund and Lucy,” the book begins. “This story is about something that happened to them when they were sent away from London during the war because of the air raids.”
paras.zh: - “从前有四个孩子，他们的名字分别是彼得、苏珊、埃德蒙和露西，”书的开头说道。 “这个故事讲述了他们在战争期间因空袭而被送离伦敦时发生在他们身上的事情。”

paras.en: “Children’s books can be about anything, can deal with anything. But the tone has to convey hope,” Cottrell-Boyce tells the BBC’s Katie Razzall. For adults, Booker Prize Foundation chief executive Gaby Wood tells the Guardian, the books on the shortlist serve as a reminder “of the humor, empathy and resilience of young people, and offer a window on to the complexities of their worlds.”
paras.zh: “儿童读物可以讲述任何事情，可以处理任何事情。但语气必须传达希望，”科特雷尔-博伊斯告诉 BBC 的凯蒂·拉扎尔。布克奖基金会首席执行官加比·伍德告诉《卫报》，对于成年人来说，入围名单上的书籍可以提醒人们“年轻人的幽默、同理心和韧性，并为了解他们世界的复杂性提供一扇窗户。”

paras.en: To choose the winner, Cottrell-Boyce, actor Lolly Adefope and London bookseller Sanchita Basu De Sarkar will be joined by four child judges selected from more than 4,000 applicants: 12-year-olds Ibrahim and Lainey, 11-year-old Myla and 8-year-old Luna.
paras.zh: 科特雷尔-博伊斯、演员洛莉·阿德福普和伦敦书商桑奇塔·巴苏·德·萨卡将与从 4000 多名申请者中选出的四名儿童评委一起选出获胜者：12 岁的易卜拉欣和莱尼、11 岁的迈拉和 8 岁的卢娜。

paras.en: “If the children don’t love a book, it won’t win,” Cottrell-Boyce tells the BBC. Ibrahim, a young Hampshire reader who reads for an hour a day, shares that confidence, telling the BBC, “the adults are not going to control that meeting … 100 percent not!”
paras.zh: “如果孩子们不喜欢一本书，它就不会获胜，”科特雷尔-博伊斯告诉 BBC。易卜拉欣是一位每天阅读一小时的汉普郡年轻读者，他也有同样的信心，他告诉 BBC，“成年人不会控制这次会​​议……百分百不会！”

paras.en: Before the winner is announced at London’s Young V&A museum on February 2, 2027, at least 30,000 copies of the shortlisted books will be distributed to young readers through U.K. schools, libraries, hospitals, youth clubs and food banks.
paras.zh: 在 2027 年 2 月 2 日伦敦 Young V&A 博物馆宣布获奖者之前，至少 30,000 册入围书籍将通过英国学校、图书馆、医院、青年俱乐部和食品银行分发给年轻读者。

paras.en: If Ibrahim’s early reaction is any indication, the finalists are already hard at work. While reading one shortlisted book, he tells the BBC, “I had to tell my mum to confiscate it because I couldn’t stop reading it and I was getting a headache.”
paras.zh: 如果易卜拉欣的早期反应有任何迹象的话，那就是决赛入围者已经在努力工作了。在阅读一本入围的书时，他告诉英国广播公司，“我不得不告诉我妈妈把它没收，因为我无法停止阅读它，而且我感到头疼。”

articles.title: Home Depot Promo Codes: 30% Off in November 2026
articles.author: Molly Higgins

paras.en: The company pretty much invented the hardware superstore when it began in 1978, simply by being so big. It inflated the neighborhood tool shop into a whole city of lumber, hammers, caulk, power saws, and big rolls of wire. I would know I’m in a Home Depot blindfolded because of a distinct quality to the air—crisp and particulate, smelling like wood dust, paint, and the oiled metal of power tools. The Home Depot smell is buried deep in my childhood, filed somewhere between “building a deck” and “first day of spring.” Anyway, the Home Depot website is just as big. And while it doesn’t smell like sawdust, it’s easier to find stuff. Our roundup includes Home Depot promo codes from 20% to $100 off, new customer coupons, free shipping offers, and Pro discounts that can drop prices by as much as 50% when you buy online.
paras.zh: 该公司在 1978 年成立时几乎发明了硬件超市，只是因为规模太大了。它把附近的工具店变成了一座充满木材、锤子、填缝剂、电锯和大卷金属丝的城市。我知道自己是在家得宝 (Home Depot) 蒙着眼睛，因为空气中有一种独特的品质——清脆、颗粒状，闻起来像木屑、油漆和电动工具的涂油金属。家得宝的气味深深地埋藏在我的童年时代，介于“建造甲板”和“春天的第一天”之间。不管怎样，家得宝的网站也一样大。虽然它闻起来不像锯末，但更容易找到东西。我们的综述包括 Home Depot 促销代码，折扣从 20% 到 100 美元不等，新客户优惠券、免费送货优惠以及在线购买时可降低价格高达 50% 的 Pro 折扣。

paras.en: If you’re hoping to use this winter to make some much-needed improvements around the house, be sure to take advantage of the major discounts and deals during the Home Depot Black Friday sale. During the sale, you can save hundreds of dollars on home essentials like appliances, tools, furniture, storage, smart home tech, and more.
paras.zh: 如果您希望利用今年冬天对房屋进行一些急需的改进，请务必利用家得宝黑色星期五促销期间的主要折扣和优惠。在促销期间，您可以节省数百美元购买家用必需品，如电器、工具、家具、存储、智能家居技术等。

paras.en: Join the Home Depot Text Program for $5 Off
paras.zh: 加入 Home Depot 短信计划可享 5 美元折扣

paras.en: Shop Top Home Depot Sale Deals for up to $1,400 Off Appliances, Bath Items, and Tools
paras.zh: 购买热门 Home Depot 电器、沐浴用品和工具促销，最高可立减 1,400 美元

paras.en: And as it turns out, the hardware giant also goes hard on discounts, slashing prices on grills, garden and outdoor power tools, and smokers like the new Traeger Woodridge (8/10, WIRED Recommends), which is also sold at Home Depot.
paras.zh: 事实证明，这家硬件巨头还大力打折，大幅削减烤架、花园和户外电动工具以及新款 Traeger Woodridge（8/10，连线推荐）等吸烟者的价格，该产品也在 Home Depot 出售。

paras.en: But that’s not all; Home Depot is covering the whole house! There are appliance deals of up to $1,400 off, $1,000 off washer and dryer sets, and bathroom deals of up to 40% off vanities, 25% off bathtubs, 20% off toilets, and 15% off showers.
paras.zh: 但这还不是全部。 Home Depot 覆盖了整个房子！家电优惠高达 1,400 美元，洗衣机和烘干机套件优惠 1,000 美元，浴室优惠高达 40% 的梳妆台折扣、25% 的浴缸折扣、20% 的马桶折扣和 15% 的淋浴间折扣。

paras.en: Plus, Home Depot has appliance bundle deals where you can get major discounts when you purchase multiple appliances at once.
paras.zh: 此外，家得宝 (Home Depot) 还提供家电捆绑优惠，当您一次购买多件家电时，您可以享受大幅折扣。

paras.en: Get 40% Off With Home Depot Deal of the Day Coupons
paras.zh: 使用 Home Depot 每日特惠优惠券享受 40% 折扣

paras.en: Home Depot coupons of the moment include whopper deals like 15% off storage solutions and 35% off washers and dryers. Explore more deals on kitchen and other furniture by checking out the deals of the moment here. As we’ve stated, there are so many ways to save at Home Depot, even when you’re shopping online. Special Buy of the Day deals include steep price drops on select products or entire brands—but these significant discounts last only 24 hours. That’s a whole lot of savings for one of the most expensive home renovations you can do. Another savings hack? Jump on products marked with “New Lower Price” to find them at their lowest price yet.
paras.zh: 目前家得宝 (Home Depot) 优惠券包括诸如存储解决方案 15% 折扣以及洗衣机和烘干机 35% 折扣等巨额优惠。在这里查看当前的优惠，探索有关厨房和其他家具的更多优惠。正如我们所说，即使您在线购物，在家得宝也有很多省钱的方法。每日特价优惠包括精选产品或整个品牌的大幅降价，但这些大幅折扣仅持续 24 小时。对于您可以进行的最昂贵的家居装修之一来说，这是一大笔节省。另一个储蓄黑客？跳转到标有“新的更低价格”的产品，以找到迄今为止最低的价格。

paras.en: Winter is a great time to stay inside and focus on home improvement projects. Home Depot has everything you need for remodels (including bulk buys). Right now, vinyl plank and tile flooring is up to 30% off, with options starting at 99 cents per square foot. Plus, power tool kit combos can save even more, with bundle deals of up to 70% off—including Deals of the Day flash sales on tools and appliances with rebates of up to $1,000. Deals include smart home items WIRED has covered extensively, like Nest learning thermostats (9/10, WIRED Recommends). Need advice on setting up a smart home? WIRED has your back. Not only do Deals of the Day (and over 1 million products) qualify for free shipping, but you can also get free delivery to your local Home Depot store or straight to your door with online orders over $45.
paras.zh: 冬季是呆在室内并专注于家居装修项目的好时机。家得宝 (Home Depot) 拥有您改造所需的一切（包括批量购买）。目前，乙烯基木板和瓷砖地板最高可享受 30% 的折扣，起价为每平方英尺 99 美分。此外，电动工具套件组合还可以节省更多，捆绑交易最高可享受 70% 的折扣，其中包括工具和电器的每日特惠闪购，折扣最高可达 1,000 美元。优惠包括《连线》广泛报道的智能家居产品，例如 Nest 学习恒温器（9/10，《连线》推荐）。需要有关设置智能家居的建议吗？ 《连线》为您提供支持。每日特惠（以及超过 100 万种产品）不仅可以享受免费送货服务，而且您还可以免费送货到您当地的 Home Depot 商店，或者网上订单超过 45 美元可直接送货上门。

paras.en: Save 20% With Home Depot Pro Xtra Discounts
paras.zh: Home Depot Pro Xtra 折扣可节省 20%

paras.en: Home Depot also offers a loyalty program called Pro Xtra for frequent fliers, whether you’re a contractor or just undergoing a serious remodel this year. This means exclusive prices up to 20% off, 10% discounts on bulk buys, a rewards point system, and occasional $50 off $250 coupons. Painting the house? The program also nets you 10 to 20% off paint and primers. Pro Xtra offers multiple tiers, from basic membership to Elite and VIP.
paras.zh: 家得宝还为常旅客提供名为 Pro Xtra 的忠诚度计划，无论您是承包商还是今年刚刚进行重大改造。这意味着独家价格高达 20% 的折扣、批量购买 10% 的折扣、奖励积分系统以及偶尔 250 美元优惠券 50 美元的折扣。画房子？该计划还为您提供 10% 至 20% 的油漆和底漆折扣。 Pro Xtra 提供多个级别，从基本会员到精英会员和 VIP。

paras.en: Special Buys of the Week are bargains worth checking out, and pros can get discounts with the Pro Special Buy of the Week—and that’s on top of exclusive coupons, bulk product discounts up to 20% off, and everyday discounted pricing on items. Hot offers this week include: free tools or batteries with your purchase of tools from Milwaukee, RYOBI, and more premium brands, plus 20% off flooring. Also grab 40% off bathroom products like Kohler showers, tubs, vanities, faucets, and toilets, including luxury upgrades like Horow smart toilets and bidets.
paras.zh: 本周特惠商品是值得一试的便宜商品，专业人士还可以通过本周专业特惠商品获得折扣，此外还有独家优惠券、高达 20% 的大宗产品折扣以及商品的每日折扣价格。本周热门优惠包括：购买 Milwaukee、RYOBI 和更多优质品牌的工具即可免费获得工具或电池，以及地板 20% 的折扣。还可享受 Kohler 淋浴、浴缸、梳妆台、水龙头和马桶等浴室产品 40% 的折扣，包括 Horow 智能马桶和坐浴盆等豪华升级产品。

paras.en: Get 10% Off With the Home Depot Military Discount
paras.zh: 享受 Home Depot 军事折扣 10% 折扣

paras.en: Home Depot has long maintained a program offering discounts to active service members, veterans, and their spouses, offering 10% off all eligible purchases. You’ll need to register to verify your military status through SheerID, and from then on, you can just scan your virtual ID or enter your phone number at checkout, the same way you do at the grocery store. Note that military discounts are limited to $400 each calendar year, and this resets each year. Some commodity products are excluded, including lumber, wire, and building materials. Appliances are also out in the cold, but military families may still find special deals or tax-free shopping through Home Depot’s Military Exchange Program.
paras.zh: 家得宝长期以来一直维持一项为现役军人、退伍军人及其配偶提供折扣的计划，为所有符合条件的购买提供 10% 的折扣。您需要通过 SheerID 进行注册以验证您的军人身份，从那时起，您只需扫描您的虚拟身份证或在结帐时输入您的电话号码，就像在杂货店一样。请注意，每个日历年的军事折扣限额为 400 美元，并且每年都会重置。一些商品不包括在内，包括木材、电线和建筑材料。电器也受到冷落，但军人家庭仍然可以通过家得宝的军事交换计划找到特价或免税购物。

paras.en: Get $100 Off With Home Depot Coupon Codes for Credit Cardholders
paras.zh: 信用卡持卡人使用 Home Depot 优惠券代码可立减 100 美元

paras.en: If you haven’t opened a credit card account at Home Depot, now is a great time. If you have a new account, when you place your first order with your credit card, you can save up to $100 on qualifying purchases.
paras.zh: 如果您还没有在家得宝开设信用卡账户，现在正是好时机。如果您有新帐户，则当您使用信用卡下第一笔订单时，符合条件的购买最多可节省 100 美元。

paras.en: Plus, you can get up to 24 months of financing on special-order and installed purchases of blinds, shades, and shutters with Home Depot promo code YU8QTSVQ3. You can also get up to 24 months of financing on installed custom closet purchases with Home Depot coupon code 7MD4H2YQ2.
paras.zh: 此外，您还可以使用 Home Depot 促销代码 YU8QTSVQ3 购买百叶窗、百叶窗和百叶窗的特殊订单和安装产品，获得长达 24 个月的融资。您还可以使用 Home Depot 优惠券代码 7MD4H2YQ2 购买已安装的定制衣柜，获得长达 24 个月的融资。

articles.title: Ulta Promo Codes: Up to 20% Off in November 2026
articles.author: Boutayna Chokrane

paras.en: At Ulta Beauty, you can stock up on skin care, makeup, and haircare, then head to the salon for brows shaped, hair styled, and ears pierced, all in one visit. You’ll find brands like Dior, Estée Lauder, and Gucci alongside more affordable favorites and drugstore staples. Many locations feature a Benefit Cosmetics BrowBar, so you can sample products and book an in-store brow service in the same visit. Ulta’s return policy is very forgiving, allowing you to return “gently used” products within 30 days for a full refund. Add in its weekly sales, the 21+ Days of Beauty Event, and stackable Ulta coupons, and you’ll rarely pay full price.
paras.zh: 在 Ulta Beauty，您可以购买护肤品、化妆品和护发产品，然后前往沙龙进行修眉、做发型和打耳洞，这一切只需一次即可完成。您会发现迪奥、雅诗兰黛和古驰等品牌，以及更实惠的最爱和药店主打商品。许多门店都设有 Benefit Cosmetics BrowBar，因此您可以在一次访问店内品尝产品并预订店内修眉服务。 Ulta 的退货政策非常宽松，允许您在 30 天内退回“轻度使用”的产品并获得全额退款。再加上每周的促销、超过 21 天的美容活动以及可堆叠的 Ulta 优惠券，您很少会支付全价。

paras.en: I’ve tested a wide range of beauty products sold at Ulta, from hair tools and red-light therapy devices for hair growth to LED devices, pimple patches, and lip balms. Here’s how to shop smarter, with the best Ulta promo codes and Ulta coupons to keep on your radar.
paras.zh: 我测试过 Ulta 出售的各种美容产品，从美发工具和用于毛发生长的红光治疗设备到 LED 设备、痘痘贴和润唇膏。以下是如何更明智地购物，让您时刻关注最好的 Ulta 促销代码和 Ulta 优惠券。

paras.en: Basically, the only thing I like to shop for during Black Friday sales is skincare and beauty products at Ulta. Everyone knows makeup and skincare essentials can get super pricey, super quickly. Take advantage of Ulta Black Friday deals to save big on top brands like Medicube, Shark, Lancôme, and more, with discounts on everything from concealer to blow dryers.
paras.zh: 基本上，我唯一喜欢在黑色星期五促销期间购买 Ulta 的护肤品和美容产品。每个人都知道化妆品和护肤必需品可能会变得超级昂贵、超级快速。利用 Ulta 黑色星期五优惠，购买 Medicube、Shark、Lancôme 等顶级品牌商品，享受从遮瑕膏到吹风机等各种商品的折扣。

paras.en: One of the best ways to save regularly on both small, everyday purchases and bigger beauty tech and tools is to shop Ulta’s weekly and daily sales. With Ulta’s Daily & Weekly Beauty Steals, you’ll find up to 50% off everything from perfume to facial cleansers to makeup essentials. You can save big on brands like Ralph Lauren, Murad, Bumble & Bumble, and more.
paras.zh: 无论是日常小额购买还是大型美容技术和工具，定期节省开支的最佳方法之一就是购买 Ulta 的每周和每日促销活动。通过 Ulta 的每日和每周 Beauty Steals，您会发现从香水到洗面奶再到化妆必需品的所有商品均可享受高达 50% 的折扣。您可以节省大量购买 Ralph Lauren、Murad、Bumble & Bumble 等品牌的费用。

paras.en: 15% Off at Ulta Beauty When You Download the App
paras.zh: 下载 Ulta Beauty 应用程序即可享受 15% 折扣

paras.en: If you already shop at Ulta often, downloading and using the Ulta app is one of the best ways to save money on purchases you were planning to make. All you need to do is download the Ulta app (for free) by texting "Beauty" to 95637. From there, you’ll receive an Ulta promo code, APP15, for 15% off your next purchase. Plus, with the Ulta app, you’ll be able to virtually try on thousands of beauty products with GLAMlab, use the Ulta Foundation Matcher to match your skin tone and find your best shade, and get an AI-powered skin analysis for customized skin care recommendations.
paras.zh: 如果您已经经常在 Ulta 购物，下载并使用 Ulta 应用程序是您计划购买时省钱的最佳方法之一。您所需要做的就是发送短信“Beauty”至 95637，下载 Ulta 应用程序（免费）。从那里，您将收到 Ulta 促销代码 APP15，下次购买可享受 15% 的折扣。此外，借助 Ulta 应用程序，您将能够通过 GLAMlab 虚拟试用数千种美容产品，使用 Ulta Foundation Matcher 来匹配您的肤色并找到最佳色调，并获得人工智能驱动的皮肤分析以提供定制的皮肤护理建议。

paras.en: Plus, Ulta app members get exclusive in-app features, offers, and deals. You’ll also be able to monitor your membership rewards status and points, and get notified of app-exclusive deals, discounts, brand offers, and more. And with the handy barcode scanner, shopping has never been easier—you can scan any product’s barcode to see information on ingredients and product reviews. When you’re an Ulta member, you’ll get 1 point for every $1 spent and birthday perks.
paras.zh: 此外，Ulta 应用程序会员还可获得独家应用程序内功能、优惠和优惠。您还可以监控您的会员奖励状态和积分，并获得有关应用程序独家优惠、折扣、品牌优惠等的通知。借助方便的条形码扫描仪，购物变得前所未有的简单 - 您可以扫描任何产品的条形码以查看有关成分和产品评论的信息。当您是 Ulta 会员时，每消费 1​​ 美元即可获得 1 积分以及生日福利。

paras.en: Use Ulta Beauty Rewards for Ulta Discounts
paras.zh: 使用 Ulta Beauty Rewards 享受 Ulta 折扣

paras.en: The Ulta Beauty Rewards program is free to join and offers many perks with minimal effort. First, you earn points for every dollar you spend. The program has multiple tiers: standard members earn 1 point per dollar; platinum members earn 1.25 points; and diamond members earn 1.5 points. To qualify for platinum status, you need to spend $500 per year, and diamond members must spend $1,200 annually.
paras.zh: Ulta Beauty Rewards 计划可免费加入，并以最少的努力提供许多福利。首先，您花费的每一美元都可以赚取积分。该计划有多个等级：标准会员每消费 1​​ 美元可赚取 1 点积分；白金会员赚取1.25积分；钻石会员可获得1.5积分。要获得白金会员资格，您需要每年花费 500 美元，钻石会员则必须每年花费 1,200 美元。

paras.en: These points can be redeemed for discounts, and the best part is that they do not expire. (To activate your rewards, you need to download the Ulta Beauty app.) Here's how the points translate into savings: 100 points give you $3 off, 250 points offer an $8 discount, 500 points save you $17.50, and 750 points grant you $30 off.
paras.zh: 这些积分可以兑换折扣，而且最好的一点是它们不会过期。 （要激活您的奖励，您需要下载 Ulta Beauty 应用程序。）以下是积分如何转化为折扣：100 点积分可优惠 3 美元，250 点积分可优惠 8 美元，500 点积分可节省 17.5 美元，750 点积分可优惠 30 美元。

paras.en: During your birthday month, you get even more special perks. These include earning extra points on every qualifying purchase, a free gift, and a $10 coupon exclusively for platinum and diamond members. Other benefits include exclusive beauty deals, early access to sales, and full-size gifts for diamond members. Diamond members also get a $25 discount on beauty services and free shipping on orders over $25.
paras.zh: 在您的生日月份，您将获得更多特别福利。其中包括每次符合资格的购买即可赚取额外积分、一份免费礼物以及专为白金和钻石会员提供的 10 美元优惠券。其他福利包括独家美容优惠、抢先销售以及为钻石会员提供的全尺寸礼物。钻石会员还可享受美容服务 25 美元折扣，订单超过 25 美元可免运费。

paras.en: Unlock Free Standard Shipping on Your $35 Purchase
paras.zh: 购买满 35 美元即可解锁免费标准运费

paras.en: All online customers qualify for free standard shipping on purchases of $35 or more. It's easy to reach that amount at Ulta, even with all the discounts.
paras.zh: 所有在线客户购买满 35 美元或以上均可享受免费标准运费。即使有各种折扣，在 Ulta 也很容易达到这个金额。

paras.en: What We’ve Learned From Tracking Ulta Beauty Coupon Deals
paras.zh: 我们从跟踪 Ulta Beauty 优惠券交易中学到了什么

paras.en: We’ve been doing this for a while, and we’ve become pretty good at tracking and identifying the best offers available and bringing them to you, of course. We check Ulta often, testing the Ulta coupon codes ourselves and bringing them to you here weekly (if not more often). These are often deals for things like 20% off certain beloved brands or beauty categories, as well as BOGO deals.
paras.zh: 我们这样做已经有一段时间了，当然，我们已经非常擅长跟踪和识别可用的最佳优惠并将其带给您。我们经常检查 Ulta，亲自测试 Ulta 优惠券代码，并每周将它们带给您（如果不是更频繁的话）。这些优惠通常是某些受欢迎的品牌或美容类别的 20% 折扣，以及 BOGO 优惠。

paras.en: One of my favorite gifts to give (to myself or others) is an Ulta Beauty advent calendar. It’s a super fun gift, especially if you aren’t sure which brands or products the beauty guru in your life usually buys. These sets often come in themes, by product type, brand, and more. It’s a fun way to discover new products and brands and possibly find your next must-have.
paras.zh: 我最喜欢送给自己或他人的礼物之一是 Ulta Beauty 降临节日历。这是一份超级有趣的礼物，尤其是当您不确定生活中的美容大师通常购买哪些品牌或产品时。这些套装通常按产品类型、品牌等划分主题。这是发现新产品和品牌并可能找到您的下一个必备品的有趣方式。

articles.title: A New Breed of Chip Runs AI Models Using Waves of Light

paras.en: As artificial intelligence becomes an unavoidable part of everyday life and models become ever more sophisticated, the cost of the energy required to run the technology is ballooning.
paras.zh: 随着人工智能成为日常生活中不可避免的一部分，并且模型变得越来越复杂，运行该技术所需的能源成本正在不断膨胀。

paras.en: To rein in runaway costs, AI labs and cloud providers are trying to build new data centers in places with cheap and plentiful renewable energy—like Scandinavia. But logistical challenges, a scarcity of key components, and a swell of anti-data center protests are getting in the way.
paras.zh: 为了控制失控的成本，人工智能实验室和云提供商正在尝试在斯堪的纳维亚半岛等拥有廉价且充足的可再生能源的地方建立新的数据中心。但后勤方面的挑战、关键部件的缺乏以及反数据中心抗议活动的增多正在阻碍这一进程。

paras.en: An expanding field of hardware startups, among them German company Q.ANT, is coming at the problem from a different direction: by developing a new breed of chip—photonic processors—meant to minimize the amount of energy that AI models consume.
paras.zh: 包括德国公司 Q.ANT 在内的不断扩大的硬件初创公司正在从不同的方向解决这个问题：通过开发一种新型芯片——光子处理器——旨在最大限度地减少人工智能模型消耗的能量。

paras.en: Whereas regular GPUs transmit and process data by shuffling electrons around, photonic processors use waves of light. Because light doesn’t generate heat as it travels and allows more data to be processed simultaneously, photonic processors supposedly consume less energy and require minimal cooling—one of the largest sources of cost for data centers.
paras.zh: 常规 GPU 通过移动电子来传输和处理数据，而光子处理器则使用光波。由于光在传播时不会产生热量，并且可以同时处理更多数据，因此光子处理器消耗的能源更少，并且需要最少的冷却——这是数据中心成本的最大来源之一。

paras.en: The aim isn’t to replace GPUs with photonic processors, but to run them side-by-side. Whilst GPUs excel at grinding through masses of additions and multiplications—linear math—photonic processors are best suited to complex, nonlinear calculations.
paras.zh: 其目的不是用光子处理器取代 GPU，而是并行运行它们。虽然 GPU 擅长处理大量加法和乘法（线性数学），但光子处理器最适合复杂的非线性计算。

paras.en: Few photonic processors are running inside data centers today. But Q.ANT recently rolled out its chips to facilities operated by cloud company IONOS as part of a pilot program. It says that more than 30 teams of engineers are now developing AI models optimized for photonic computing.
paras.zh: 如今，很少有光子处理器在数据中心内运行。但作为试点计划的一部分，Q.ANT 最近将其芯片推广到云公司 IONOS 运营的设施中。据称，目前有 30 多个工程师团队正在开发针对光子计算优化的 AI 模型。

paras.en: Earlier this month, WIRED spoke with Michael Förtsch, founder and CEO of Q.ANT. We discussed the energy bottlenecks constraining AI development, how photonic processors differ from regular chips, and the challenges Q.ANT faces in trying to popularize a new class of hardware.
paras.zh: 本月早些时候，《连线》杂志采访了 Q.ANT 创始人兼首席执行官 Michael Förtsch。我们讨论了限制人工智能发展的能源瓶颈、光子处理器与普通芯片的不同之处，以及 Q.ANT 在尝试普及新型硬件时面临的挑战。

paras.en: This conversation has been edited for length and clarity.
paras.zh: 为了篇幅和清晰度，本次对话已被编辑。

paras.en: WIRED: Michael, could you start by outlining the problem Q.ANT is aiming to solve? Why does the world need photonic processors to run AI models?
paras.zh: 《连线》：Michael，您能先概述一下 Q.ANT 想要解决的问题吗？为什么世界需要光子处理器来运行人工智能模型？

paras.en: Michael Förtsch: The overall problem is the cost generated by the huge amount of energy consumption.
paras.zh: Michael Förtsch：总体问题是大量能源消耗产生的成本。

paras.en: If you compute the way we think light should be used—not as a direct replacement for a GPU, but as a coprocessor—you basically have a new processor that takes care of the heavy math.
paras.zh: 如果你按照我们认为应该使用光的方式进行计算——不是作为 GPU 的直接替代品，而是作为协处理器——你基本上就有了一个新的处理器来处理繁重的数学运算。

paras.en: The cost driver today is the access to the memory. The less data you need in order to complete a job, the more efficient and better your system. We execute complicated math in a single step, where [regular chips] need thousands of steps. This saves a bunch of data—or memory access points.
paras.zh: 如今的成本驱动因素是对内存的访问。完成工作所需的数据越少，您的系统就越高效、越好。我们一步执行复杂的数学运算，而[常规芯片]需要数千步。这可以节省大量数据或内存访问点。

paras.en: How would you explain to the layperson how photonic computing works? How can light be used to perform mathematical computations?
paras.zh: 您如何向外行解释光子计算的工作原理？如何利用光进行数学计算？

paras.en: Light is a wave. What is a wave? A sine function. [The sine function is a mathematical rule that, when plotted to a graph, produces a smooth repeating wave. —Editor] If I want to model something that’s round in shape with only linear functions, I need an infinite amount of data points and lines in order to describe something very simple: a circle. If I have the sine function at hand, because light is a wave, I need two points and I have already described the circle in all its beauty.
paras.zh: 光是一种波。什么是波？正弦函数。 [正弦函数是一种数学规则，当绘制成图形时，会产生平滑的重复波。 —编辑]如果我想用线性函数来模拟圆形的东西，我需要无限量的数据点和线来描述一些非常简单的东西：一个圆。如果我手头有正弦函数，因为光是波，我需要两个点，并且我已经描述了圆的所有美丽。

paras.en: Light is very, very gifted to operate on complicated equations.
paras.zh: 光在处理复杂的方程方面非常非常有天赋。

paras.en: What distinguishes the type of problem best left to regular chips from problems that should be delegated to photonic processors?
paras.zh: 最好留给常规芯片处理的问题类型与应该委托给光子处理器处理的问题类型有何区别？

paras.en: The Nvidia H200 GPU is a masterpiece of technology. It’s art. It’s truly hard to attack it in its homeground. But light has strengths where the GPU is weak—and vice versa.
paras.zh: Nvidia H200 GPU 是一项技术杰作。这是艺术。在它的主场确实很难攻击它。但光在 GPU 较弱的地方具有优势，反之亦然。

paras.en: Linear math? Please route it to the GPU. Non-linear and complex stuff? Please route it to us.
paras.zh: 线性数学？请将其路由到 GPU。非线性和复杂的东西？请将其发送给我们。

paras.en: We believe we will be much stronger in everything related to pictures and videos: image recognition, segmentation, and generation. Then, everything that’s related to robotics and physical AI.
paras.zh: 我们相信，我们在与图片和视频相关的所有方面都会变得更强：图像识别、分割和生成。然后是与机器人和物理人工智能相关的一切。

paras.en: What is the estimated gain in energy efficiency tied to using photonic processors alongside GPUs for AI tasks?
paras.zh: 将光子处理器与 GPU 一起用于 AI 任务时，能源效率的估计增益是多少？

paras.en: I’m not saying photonic computing will come for free. But I see that photonic computing, in combination with [CPUs and GPUs], can bring you a lot more artificial intelligence at a fraction of the energy.
paras.zh: 我并不是说光子计算将是免费的。但我发现光子计算与 [CPU 和 GPU] 相结合，可以用很少的能量为您带来更多的人工智能。

paras.en: Under simulation, we are ending up at around four or five times energy reduction. But in real hardware we are not yet demonstrating it.
paras.zh: 根据模拟，我们最终的能源减少量约为四到五倍。但在实际硬件中我们还没有演示它。

paras.en: Can any task run on photonic hardware by default, or do they need to be configured in a certain way?
paras.zh: 默认情况下，任何任务都可以在光子硬件上运行吗？还是需要以某种方式进行配置？

paras.en: There’s no need to learn a different language than C++ or Python. And you can already execute [preexisting] code on our machines.
paras.zh: 无需学习 C++ 或 Python 以外的语言。您已经可以在我们的机器上执行[预先存在的]代码。

paras.en: But if you take something that has been optimized for a GPU only, you should not expect that automatically things will run faster. You have to do some adaptations.
paras.zh: 但是，如果您采用仅针对 GPU 进行优化的东西，您就不应该指望事情会自动运行得更快。你必须做一些适应。

paras.en: It’s a chicken and egg problem, right? Until developers are building models to run on this type of processor, it’s going to be difficult to sell them to cloud providers. Equally, until photonic processors are available for people to use, it’s going to be tough to convince developers to design for them.
paras.zh: 这是一个先有鸡还是先有蛋的问题，对吧？在开发人员构建在此类处理器上运行的模型之前，将很难将它们出售给云提供商。同样，在光子处理器可供人们使用之前，很难说服开发人员为其设计。

paras.en: Whether it’s photonic or any other processor technology, it will need time to get the credibility and trust that’s needed for a company like Google to build data center infrastructure around it.
paras.zh: 无论是光子还是任何其他处理器技术，都需要时间来获得像谷歌这样的公司围绕其构建数据中心基础设施所需的可信度和信任。

paras.en: That’s the reason we chose to go into data centers with proof of concept systems, to validate that photonic computing is robust enough to withstand that environment.
paras.zh: 这就是我们选择使用概念验证系统进入数据中心的原因，以验证光子计算是否足够强大以承受该环境。

paras.en: We want to invite the world to compute on our systems. We are building a new chicken, so you can start producing eggs. Let’s find out together whether they’re tasty or not.
paras.zh: 我们希望邀请全世界在我们的系统上进行计算。我们正在建造一只新鸡，以便您可以开始产蛋。让我们一起来看看它们到底好吃不好吃。

paras.en: What else should I understand about why photonic processors are not already widely in use?
paras.zh: 关于光子处理器尚未广泛使用的原因，我还应该了解什么？

paras.en: If hypothetically we received an order of 100,000 [photonic processors], we at Q.ANT are ready, but I’m not sure about the suppliers.
paras.zh: 如果假设我们收到 100,000 个[光子处理器]的订单，我们 Q.ANT 就准备好了，但我不确定供应商的情况。

paras.en: Hardware is not software. On the assembly side, it will need [time] before we have the same robust supply chain as the semiconductor world.
paras.zh: 硬件不是软件。在组装方面，我们需要[时间]才能拥有与半导体世界一样强大的供应链。

paras.en: Do you expect to suffer from the same problem as other hardware challengers in securing capacity with the big chip manufacturers?
paras.zh: 在确保与大型芯片制造商的产能方面，您是否预计会遇到与其他硬件挑战者相同的问题？

paras.en: [To produce Q.ANT chips] you only need 90 nanometer node technology, from the 2000s. A lot of foundries already use this capability to produce chips that are super cheap. With this technology, you can use the same line to produce high-performance chips with a much higher street price, without massive upfront investment in your assets.
paras.zh: [生产Q.ANT芯片]只需要2000年代的90纳米节点技术。许多代工厂已经利用这种能力来生产超便宜的芯片。借助这项技术，您可以使用同一条生产线以更高的市场价格生产高性能芯片，而无需对资产进行大量前期投资。

paras.en: Are Q.ANT processors built to function alongside a particular brand of GPUs—say, Nvidia or AMD—or are they totally agnostic?
paras.zh: Q.ANT 处理器是为了与特定品牌的 GPU（例如 Nvidia 或 AMD）一起运行而设计的，还是完全不可知的？

paras.en: There’s no need to go single-sided with a particular GPU. We want to have the freedom to cooperate with any of them.
paras.zh: 没有必要单方面使用特定的 GPU。我们希望能够自由地与他们中的任何一个合作。

paras.en: Either way, we are not competitive to GPUs, we complete their function set.
paras.zh: 无论哪种方式，我们都无法与 GPU 竞争，我们完成了他们的功能集。

paras.en: Can you imagine a future in which AI models run entirely on photonic processors, or will they always be a sidekick?
paras.zh: 你能想象人工智能模型完全在光子处理器上运行的未来吗？或者它们将永远是一个助手？

paras.en: If we see an opportunity in five years to attack the GPU as well, we would not be shy about taking it. But at the same time, I do not know what workloads in five years are going to be like.
paras.zh: 如果我们在五年内看到一个攻击 GPU 的机会，我们会毫不犹豫地抓住它。但与此同时，我不知道五年后的工作量会是什么样。

paras.en: It depends on the architecture of future AI models, you mean?
paras.zh: 这取决于未来人工智能模型的架构，你的意思是？

paras.en: Could the chance to perform certain calculations more cheaply with photonic processors change the way that AI engineers design future models?
paras.zh: 使用光子处理器更便宜地执行某些计算的机会是否会改变人工智能工程师设计未来模型的方式？

paras.en: The core message is that we need to do something to fight the energy cost in the AI stack.
paras.zh: 核心信息是我们需要采取一些措施来应对人工智能堆栈中的能源成本。

paras.en: That’s where we see the future of AI: very data-optimized models that allow for tasks of the same quality, but at a fraction of the energy—and therefore a fraction of the operating cost.
paras.zh: 这就是我们看到人工智能未来的地方：数据经过高度优化的模型，可以完成相同质量的任务，但能耗却只有一小部分，因此运营成本也只有一小部分。

articles.title: 2027 BRIT Awards Trophy Designed by ‘One of Britain’s Greatest Living Artists’: See Photos
articles.author: Thomas Smith

paras.en: The 2027 BRIT Awards trophy has been designed by former Turner Prize-winning visual artist Dame Rachel Whiteread (Nov. 27).
paras.zh: 2027 年全英音乐奖奖杯由前特纳奖获得者视觉艺术家 Dame Rachel Whiteread 设计（11 月 27 日）。

paras.en: Each year a different designer shapes a distinct creative vision for their trophy, modeled on the image of Britannia, traditionally represented by a female warrior with a shield and helmet.
paras.zh: 每年都有不同的设计师为他们的奖杯塑造独特的创意愿景，以不列颠尼亚的形象为蓝本，传统上由一位手持盾牌和头盔的女战士代表。

paras.en: In recent years, the trophy has been designed by iconic names such as Dame Vivienne Westwood, Sir Peter Blake, Tracey Emin, Dame Zaha Hadid, and last year’s designer, Matthew Williamson.
paras.zh: 近年来，该奖杯由 Vivienne Westwood 女爵士、Peter Blake 爵士、Tracey Emin、Zaha Hadid 女爵士以及去年的设计师 Matthew Williamson 等标志性人物设计。

paras.en: Whiteread took on 2027’s assignment, and her trophy will be presented to winners at the ceremony on Feb. 27 at the Co-op Live in Manchester.
paras.zh: Whiteread 接受了 2027 年的任务，她的奖杯将于 2 月 27 日在曼彻斯特 Co-op Live 举行的颁奖典礼上颁发给获奖者。

paras.en: In 1993, Whiteread became the first woman to win the Turner Prize, an accolade presented annually to a British visual artist; previous victors include Damien Hirst, Gilbert & George, and Anish Kapoor. Four years after her win, in 1997, she was the first woman to represent Britain at the Venice Biennale.
paras.zh: 1993 年，Whiteread 成为第一位获得特纳奖的女性，该奖项每年颁发给英国视觉艺术家；之前的获奖者包括达米安·赫斯特、吉尔伯特和乔治以及安尼什·卡普尔。获奖四年后，即 1997 年，她成为第一位代表英国参加威尼斯双年展的女性。

paras.en: Her work primarily focuses on casting, and her Turner Prize-winning exhibit House (1993) featured a life-sized concrete cast of a Victorian terraced house in east London. Whiteread’s work has been exhibited in the Tate Museum, Paris’ Centre Pompidou and New York’s Metropolitan Museum of Art and the Museum of Modern Art.
paras.zh: 她的工作主要集中在铸造方面，她的特纳奖获奖展览《房子》（1993）展示了伦敦东部一座维多利亚式联排别墅的真人大小的混凝土铸件。怀特雷德的作品曾在泰特博物馆、巴黎蓬皮杜中心、纽约大都会艺术博物馆和现代艺术博物馆展出。

paras.en: Whiteread’s vision for the 2027 trophy features a steely, silver frame with holes punctuated throughout a silver frame alongside holes. “I used the motif of the BRIT Award and tried to change it in some way,” she said in a statement. “I exposed the interior of the statue – as an artist would do with their music.”
paras.zh: Whiteread 对 2027 年奖杯的愿景是采用钢质银色框架，银色框架上布满了孔。 “我使用了全英音乐奖的主题，并试图以某种方式改变它，”她在一份声明中说。 “我暴露了雕像的内部——就像艺术家对待他们的音乐一样。”

paras.en: Speaking on the appointment, Glyn Aikins, co-president of RCA Records at Sony Music U.K., called Whiteread one of “Britain’s greatest living artists.” He added, “Rachel has created something that is unmistakably her own and is a fitting tribute to the limitless imagination of the artists we celebrate each year and that also captures what the BRITs stands for in celebrating the very best of British creativity. The artists who lift this trophy will be holding a genuine work of art.”
paras.zh: 英国索尼音乐公司 RCA 唱片公司联席总裁格林·艾金斯 (Glyn Aikins) 在谈到这一任命时称怀特雷德是“英国在世的最伟大的艺术家”之一。他补充道，“雷切尔创造了一些毫无疑问是她自己的东西，这是对我们每年庆祝的艺术家的无限想象力的适当致敬，同时也体现了全英在庆祝英国最好的创造力方面所代表的意义。举起这个奖杯的艺术家将拥有一件真正的艺术作品。”

paras.en: Nominations for the 2027 BRIT Awards will be announced in the coming months. No performers have yet been confirmed.
paras.zh: 2027 年全英音乐奖提名将在未来几个月内公布。尚未确认表演者。

articles.title: ‘True Family’: Nile Rodgers Remembers Duran Duran’s Andy Taylor
articles.author: Lars Brandle

paras.en: You can’t choose you family. But you can choose your true family. That’s how Nile Rodgers remembers Andy Taylor, the founding guitarist of Duran Duran and The Power Station, who died this week following a years-long battle with prostate cancer, at the age of 65.
paras.zh: 你无法选择你的家人。但你可以选择你真正的家人。 Nile Rodgers 就是这样缅怀 Duran Duran 和 The Power Station 乐队的创始人吉他手 Andy Taylor 的，他在与前列腺癌抗争多年后于本周去世，享年 65 岁。

paras.en: Rodgers, like millions of music fans around the globe, is mourning the Englishman’s passing.
paras.zh: 罗杰斯和全球数百万乐迷一样，正在哀悼这位英国人的去世。

paras.en: “Dear Andy Taylor RIP. How many countless great days and nights did we have?,” he writes. “I was sleeping last night when I heard the news of your passing. #RIP my dear friend. We were always happy when we were together. I love you.”
paras.zh: “亲爱的安迪·泰勒，安息吧。我们度过了多少个无数美好的日日夜夜？”他写道。 “昨晚我正在睡觉时听到你去世的消息。#安息吧我亲爱的朋友。我们在一起的时候总是很开心。我爱你。”

paras.en: Rodgers and Taylor go way back. The Chic mainstay and elite record producer worked with Duran Duran on many of their hits, a friendship that began with the British new wave legends’ first U.S. No. 1 “The Reflex” from 1984.
paras.zh: 罗杰斯和泰勒的历史可以追溯到很久以前。这位别致的中流砥柱和精英唱片制作人与 Duran Duran 合作制作了许多热门歌曲，这种友谊始于 1984 年英国新浪潮传奇人物的第一张美国第一“The Reflex”。

paras.en: Chic’s bass player Bernard Edwards produced the 1985 debut album from The Power Station, which gathered Duran Duran’s Andy and John Taylor, along with English singer Robert Palmer and U.S. drummer Tony Thompson. Rodgers provided some informal assistance to the project, which yielded the hits “Some Like It Hot” and a cover of Marc Bolan’s “Get It On (Bang A Gong)”.
paras.zh: Chic 的贝斯手 Bernard Edwards 制作了 The Power Station 1985 年的首张专辑，这张专辑聚集了 Duran Duran 的 Andy 和 John Taylor，以及英国歌手 Robert Palmer 和美国鼓手 Tony Thompson。罗杰斯为该项目提供了一些非正式的帮助，该项目产生了热门歌曲“Some Like It Hot”和翻唱马克·博兰的“Get It On (Bang A Gong)”。

paras.en: “#BernardEdwardsRIP loved you, and #TonyThompsonRIP loved you,” adds Rodgers, a cancer survivor. “Our two bands will be forever linked in the most special way. True family. Peace and eternal love.”
paras.zh: “#BernardEdwardsRIP 爱你，#TonyThompsonRIP 爱你，”癌症幸存者罗杰斯补充道。 “我们的两个乐队将以最特别的方式永远联系在一起。真正的家庭。和平与永恒的爱。”

paras.en: Rodgers shared a happy snap of himself with Andy, from somewhere, sometime in the 1980s, slapped with the caption: “The way I’ll always think of us…guitarist brothers.”
paras.zh: 罗杰斯分享了一张他和安迪在 20 世纪 80 年代某个时候的快乐合照，并配上了标题：“我永远都会这样想我们……吉他手兄弟。”

paras.en: It’s been a heartbreaking month for Duranies. Earlier, the band’s founding drummer Roger Taylor announced he was hanging up his sticks due to worsening tinnitus.
paras.zh: 对于杜兰尼斯来说，这是令人心碎的一个月。早些时候，乐队的创始鼓手罗杰·泰勒宣布，由于耳鸣恶化，他将挂起鼓棒。

paras.en: Andy Taylor (no relation with John and Roger) had multiple stints in Duran Duran, scoring 13 hits on the Billboard Hot 100, including No. 1s with “The Reflex” and “A View to a Kill” in 1985. The group’s beloved second album Rio album (which housed “Hungry Like the Wolf,” “Save a Prayer,” “My Own Way,” and the title track) hit the Billboard 200 in 1982 and remained on the chart for a whopping 128 weeks.
paras.zh: 安迪·泰勒（与约翰和罗杰没有关系）曾多次在杜兰杜兰乐队演出，在 Billboard Hot 100 中获得 13 首单曲，其中包括 1985 年凭借《The Reflex》和《A View to a Kill》排名第一。该乐队深受喜爱的第二张专辑《Rio》（收录了《Hungry Like the Wolf》、《Save a Prayer》、《My Own Way》和主打歌）于 2017 年进入 Billboard 200 强。 1982 年，并在排行榜上停留了长达 128 周。

paras.en: He had two stints with Duran Duran, including their all-conquering run through the first half of the ’80s, during which he gave true grit to the band’s sound, both with his guitar and rockstar swagger.
paras.zh: 他曾两次与 Duran Duran 合作，包括他们在 80 年代上半叶所向披靡的演出，在此期间，他用吉他和摇滚明星的气势为乐队的声音注入了真正的勇气。

paras.en: Taylor was inducted into the Rock & Roll Hall of Fame in 2022 in absentia due to his illness, which his bandmates revealed for the very first during their induction speech.
paras.zh: 泰勒因病于 2022 年缺席入选摇滚名人堂，这是他的乐队成员在入职演讲中首次透露的。

articles.title: John Farnham’s Family Gives Rare Update on Legendary Singer’s Health
articles.author: Lars Brandle

paras.en: John Farnham’s spirits remain high, his mind is sharp, but his body is failing. That’s the gist of a rare health update, shared from the legendary Australian singer’s family.
paras.zh: 约翰·法纳姆的精神依然高昂，头脑敏锐，但他的身体却日渐衰弱。这是这位澳大利亚传奇歌手的家人分享的罕见健康更新的要点。

paras.en: These days, the veteran singer is at home but gets around in a wheelchair and requires oxygen.
paras.zh: 这些天，这位经验丰富的歌手待在家里，但需要依靠轮椅行动并需要氧气。

paras.en: “His mental state is really good,” Rob Farnham, John’s son, told 102.5 ABC Perth Breakfast. “He’s spending a lot of time with his grandson whom he loves. He’s doing a lot of physical therapy. He’s happy, he’s laughing, he’s joking.”
paras.zh: “他的精神状态非常好，”约翰的儿子罗布·法纳姆 (Rob Farnham) 告诉 102.5 ABC 珀斯早餐节目。 “他花了很多时间和他深爱的孙子在一起。他做了很多物理治疗。他很高兴，他在笑，他在开玩笑。”

paras.en: John Farnham’s wife is a constant at his side. “Mum definitely sacrifices herself for dad and to help dad and she’s an amazing woman and we’re very proud of her as well,” Rob Farnham explains. “Obviously sometimes she gets a bit down but she has us to lean on and that’s what your family support is.”
paras.zh: 约翰·法纳姆的妻子始终陪伴在他身边。 “妈妈确实为爸爸牺牲了自己，帮助爸爸，她是一位了不起的女人，我们也为她感到骄傲，”罗布·法纳姆解释道。 “显然，有时她会有点情绪低落，但她有我们可以依靠，这就是家人的支持。”

paras.en: The revered pop singer continues to stay out of the spotlight after undergoing marathon surgery in 2022 to remove a cancerous tumor from his throat. He will never sing again, his reps confirmed in May, but the time away from the public glare hasn’t dimmed his superstar status in these parts.
paras.zh: 这位受人尊敬的流行歌手在 2022 年接受了马拉松手术切除喉咙癌瘤后，继续远离聚光灯。他的经纪人在五月份证实，他再也不会唱歌了，但远离公众视线的时间并没有削弱他在这些领域的超级巨星地位。

paras.en: Farnham was the focus of an all-star concert at Melbourne’s Rod Laver Arena on Sept. 20, featuring 120 artists and musicians, all of them selected by Farnham. The concert, a swift sellout, was cinecast into Hoyt’s theaters and served as a fundraiser for Head and Neck Cancer Australia. He was unable to attend, due to his condition. And when a jukebox musical based on Farnham’s career premiered recently in Sydney, he stayed away, which prompted the health update.
paras.zh: 法纳姆是 9 月 20 日在墨尔本罗德拉沃尔竞技场举行的全明星音乐会的焦点，共有 120 名艺术家和音乐家参加，他们都是法纳姆挑选的。这场音乐会很快就卖光了，在霍伊特的剧院进行了转播，并为澳大利亚头颈癌组织筹款。由于身体状况原因，他无法出席。当一部以法纳姆职业生涯为基础的点唱机音乐剧最近在悉尼首演时，他没有离开，这促使了健康更新。

paras.en: With 1986’s Whispering Jack, Farnham orchestrated one of the all-time great comebacks. The album spent 25 weeks at No. 1 in Australia, en route to shifting more than one million copies, becoming the first domestic LP to do so. It remains the highest-selling album ever in Australia by a local talent.
paras.zh: 凭借 1986 年的《Whispering Jack》，法纳姆精心策划了史上最伟大的复出之一。这张专辑在澳大利亚排名第一的时间为 25 周，销量超过 100 万张，成为第一张取得这一成绩的国内唱片。它仍然是澳大利亚本土音乐人有史以来销量最高的专辑。

paras.en: Whispering Jack, of course, features Farnham’s signature song, “You’re The Voice,” a top 10 hit in the United Kingdom, and, four decades on, the unofficial anthem of Australia. He was named Australian of the Year in 1987, was named Officer of the Order of Australia in 1996, was inducted into the ARIA Hall of Fame in 2003 and has collected 19 career ARIA Awards.
paras.zh: 当然，《Whispering Jack》以法纳姆的标志性歌曲《You're The Voice》为特色，该歌曲在英国排名前十，并且在四十年后成为澳大利亚的非官方国歌。他于 1987 年被评为澳大利亚年度人物，于 1996 年被授予澳大利亚军官勋章，于 2003 年入选 ARIA 名人堂，并获得了 19 项职业 ARIA 奖。

articles.title: Scott Caan Is “100 Percent” Open to Reprising Role in ‘Ocean’s 14’ With Casey Affleck
articles.author: Carly Thomas

paras.en: If it’s up to Scott Caan and Casey Affleck, the Malloy brothers, aka “Mormon twins,” will be returning in Ocean’s 14.
paras.zh: 如果由斯科特·凯恩和卡西·阿弗莱克决定，马洛伊兄弟（又名“摩门双胞胎”）将在《十四罗汉》中回归。

paras.en: While recently chatting with The Hollywood Reporter about his new movie The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth, Caan was happy to share he and Affleck are “100 percent” open to reprising Turk and Virgil Malloy, respectively, in the follow-up that’s in development at Warner Bros.
paras.zh: 最近，在与《好莱坞报道》谈论他的新片《克里夫·布斯的进一步不幸冒险》时，卡恩很高兴地透露，他和阿弗莱克“100%”愿意在华纳兄弟正在制作的后续电影中分别重新扮演特克和维吉尔·马洛伊。

paras.en: “If the movie gets made, I’m 100 percent in. I actually have not read the script yet, but I hear the script is great,” he said, adding, “I just saw Casey the other night too, and I asked him and he was like, ‘Yeah, let’s go.’ So I can speak for Casey. We’re in if it happens.”
paras.zh: “如果这部电影拍成，我百分百投入。实际上我还没有读过剧本，但我听说剧本很棒，”他说，并补充道，“前几天晚上我也看到了凯西，我问他，他说，‘是的，我们走吧。’所以我可以为凯西说话。如果发生的话我们会参与。”

paras.en: THR has reached out to Warner Bros. for comment.
paras.zh: 《好莱坞报道》已联系华纳兄弟征求意见。

paras.en: Caan and Affleck first appeared in 2001’s Ocean’s Eleven, playing two bickering brothers that Danny Ocean (George Clooney) and Rusty Ryan (Brad Pitt) recruited from Utah to serve as the crew’s getaway drivers and mechanics. The pair reprised their roles in 2004’s Ocean’s Twelve and 2007’s Ocean’s Thirteen.
paras.zh: 卡恩和阿弗莱克首次亮相于2001年的《十一罗汉》，饰演一对争吵不休的兄弟，他们被丹尼·奥申（乔治·克鲁尼饰）和拉斯蒂·莱恩（布拉德·皮特饰）从犹他州招募来，担任团伙的逃跑司机和机械师。这对搭档在2004年的《十一罗汉2》和2007年的《十一罗汉3》中再次饰演这两个角色。

paras.en: David Leitch (John Wick and The Fall Guy) is attached to direct the latest installment in the heist movie franchise that is also expected to see Clooney, Pitt, Matt Damon, Julia Roberts and Don Cheadle return.
paras.zh: 大卫·雷奇（《疾速追杀》和《替罪羊》）将执导最新一部抢劫系列电影，预计克鲁尼、皮特、马特·达蒙、朱莉娅·罗伯茨和唐·钱德尔也将回归。

paras.en: “Working with those guys, I got so spoiled,” Caan recalled of previously working with the stacked cast and filmmaker Steven Soderbergh. “I was young and I’m like, ‘Oh, this is what making big movies is,’ and it isn’t always like that. I remember walking into a room with all those guys thinking like, ‘All right, where’s the bad guy going to be or the guy who’s no fun?’ And I learned very quickly in my early 20s [that] the most talented people are always the coolest people and the nicest people.”
paras.zh: “和这些人一起工作，我被宠坏了，”凯恩回忆起之前与众多演员和电影制片人史蒂文·索德伯格的合作。 “I was young and I’m like, ‘Oh, this is what making big movies is,’ and it isn’t always like that. I remember walking into a room with all those guys thinking like, ‘All right, where’s the bad guy going to be or the guy who’s no fun?’ And I learned very quickly in my early 20s [that] the most talented people are always the coolest people and the nicest people.”

paras.en: Ocean’s 14 is expected to begin filming in late 2027.
paras.zh: 《十四罗汉》预计将于 2027 年底开始拍摄。

paras.en: Leitch recently told People that “everybody’s excited about moving it forward,” but that “getting all those people together, and their schedules are always the issue.”
paras.zh: 雷奇最近告诉《人物》杂志，“每个人都对推动这一计划感到兴奋”，但“让所有这些人聚集在一起，他们的日程安排始终是问题所在。”

articles.title: Melissa Gilbert Expresses “Undying Gratitude” After Timothy Busfield’s Child Sex Abuse Case Dismissed
articles.author: Carly Thomas

paras.en: Melissa Gilbert took to her Instagram on Thanksgiving to express her “undying gratitude” after husband Timothy Busfield’s child sex abuse case was dismissed.
paras.zh: 在丈夫蒂莫西·布斯菲尔德（Timothy Busfield）的儿童性虐待案被驳回后，梅丽莎·吉尔伯特（Melissa Gilbert）在感恩节在她的 Instagram 上表达了“无尽的感激之情”。

paras.en: “This Thanksgiving I’m incredibly grateful for all those who came running toward us this year,” she wrote.
paras.zh: “这个感恩节，我非常感谢今年所有跑向我们的人，”她写道。

paras.en: “To those who checked in, took care of our home and animals when we were away, came to hearings, fed us, housed us, spoke up, testified, wrote letters, listened, comforted us, held our hands and checked in regularly, we love you.”
paras.zh: “对于那些在我们离开时照顾我们的家和动物、参加听证会、为我们提供食物、为我们提供住宿、为我们发言、作证、写信、倾听、安慰我们、握着我们的手并定期来报到的人们，我们爱你们。”

paras.en: “Our undying gratitude also, to our extraordinary team who bravely fought and continue to fight for so hard for what is right and true. On this day, as we all acknowledge the blessings in our lives, we send our love and eternal gratitude to each and every one of you,” Gilbert added, who has been married to Busfield since 2013.
paras.zh: “我们也对我们非凡的团队表示永远的感激之情，他们勇敢地奋斗并继续为正确和真实的事情而奋斗。在这一天，当我们所有人承认我们生活中的祝福时，我们向你们每一个人致以我们的爱和永恒的感激之情，”自 2013 年与布斯菲尔德结婚的吉尔伯特补充道。

paras.en: Last month, a judge overseeing the proceedings tossed out Busfield’s case in Albuquerque, New Mexico, accusing prosecutors of failing to “act in a fair and impartial manner” and of violating grand jury statutes that are “designed to protect the structural integrity of our grand jury system.”
paras.zh: 上个月，负责监督诉讼程序的法官在新墨西哥州阿尔伯克基驳回了布斯菲尔德的案件，指责检察官未能“以公平和公正的方式行事”，并违反​​了“旨在保护我们大陪审团系统结构完整性的大陪审团法规”。

paras.en: He had been accused of child sex abuse on the set of the former Fox/Warner Bros. Television series The Cleaning Lady, episodes of which he directed between 2022 and 2024.
paras.zh: 他被指控在前福克斯/华纳兄弟电视连续剧《清洁女工》的片场性虐待儿童，该剧集是他在 2022 年至 2024 年间执导的剧集。

paras.en: Throughout the proceedings, Gilbert defended Busfield, who denied the allegations. She told ABC’s George Stephanopoulos in April 2026, “For Tim, it’s done. He’s canceled. Even if he’s exonerated, he will always be that guy, the last person in the world who would hurt a child. And believe me, if I thought for a second that Tim Busfield hurt a child, he’d have a lot more to worry about than prison.”
paras.zh: 在整个诉讼过程中，吉尔伯特为布斯菲尔德辩护，但布斯菲尔德否认了这些指控。 2026 年 4 月，她告诉美国广播公司 (ABC) 的乔治·斯特凡诺普洛斯 (George Stephanopoulos)，“对蒂姆来说，一切都结束了。他已经被取消了资格。即使他被无罪释放，他也永远是那个人，世界上最后一个伤害孩子的人。相信我，如果我有那么一瞬间想到蒂姆·布斯菲尔德伤害了一个孩子，他会比监狱更值得担心。”

articles.title: Candace Cameron Bure Says She Gets “Substantial” Residuals From ‘Full House’
articles.author: Carly Thomas

paras.en: Candace Cameron Bure is getting candid about the residuals she still earns from Full House.
paras.zh: 坎迪斯·卡梅伦·布尔 (Candace Cameron Bure) 坦诚地谈论了她仍然从欢乐满屋获得的剩余收入。

paras.en: The actress appeared on a recent episode of The McBride Rewind podcast, where she revealed that she gets “substantial” payouts from the sitcom, which ran for eight seasons from 1987 to 1995.
paras.zh: 这位女演员出现在最近一集的 The McBride Rewind 播客中，她透露自己从这部从 1987 年到 1995 年播出了八季的情景喜剧中获得了“可观”的报酬。

paras.en: “They’re substantial… I think it’s like quarterly,” she said, noting that while some residual checks for other projects might be a few cents or dollars, the ones for Full House are “still substantial.”
paras.zh: “它们的金额很大……我认为就像每季度一样，”她说，并指出虽然其他项目的一些剩余支票可能是几美分或美元，但 Full House 的剩余支票“仍然很大”。

paras.en: “I’m always happy when I open that check and deposit it,” Bure added.
paras.zh: “当我打开支票并将其存入时，我总是很高兴，”布尔补充道。

paras.en: The actress played D.J. Tanner, the eldest sister to Stephanie (Jodie Sweetin) and Michelle (Mary-Kate/Ashley Olsen), throughout the show’s run. She also reprised her role in the sitcom’s spin-off Fuller House, which ran for five seasons from 2016 to 2020.
paras.zh: 这位女演员饰演 D.J.坦纳是斯蒂芬妮（朱迪·斯威汀饰）和米歇尔（玛丽·凯特/阿什莉·奥尔森饰）的姐姐，在整个剧组中。她还在情景喜剧衍生剧《欢乐满屋》中再次扮演自己的角色，该剧从 2016 年到 2020 年播出了五季。

paras.en: Host Josh McBride also brought up Sweetin’s appearance on the podcast in April 2026, where she shared that her residuals aren’t as great as they used to be.
paras.zh: 主持人乔什·麦克布莱德 (Josh McBride) 还在 2026 年 4 月的播客中提到了斯威廷的露面，她在播客中表示，她的残余物不像以前那么好。

paras.en: “I got a one-cent check the other day. No, there’s no syndication anymore because it’s all in streaming. Who gets paid for that? Nobody gets paid for that,” Sweetin said at the time. “Sure, in my 20s, there would be money, but not reliable. You don’t know how much it’s going to be or how often they’re going to run the show. So, sometimes you’re like, ‘Oh, cool. That was nice.’ And then sometimes you’re like, ‘All right, well, there’s a nice dinner out.'”
paras.zh: “前几天我收到了一张一美分的支票。不，不再有联合组织了，因为一切都在流媒体中。谁会为此得到报酬？没有人因此得到报酬，”斯威廷当时说道。 “当然，在我 20 多岁的时候，会有钱，但不可靠。你不知道会有多少钱，也不知道他们会多久举办一次演出。所以，有时你会说，‘哦，太酷了。那很好。’然后有时你会说，‘好吧，好吧，有一顿丰盛的晚餐。’”

paras.en: In response, Bure told McBride, “I actually saw that and she said she doesn’t get much now. And I was like, ‘Jodie, you gotta check with your agent or you gotta call your bank,’ ’cause I still get residuals.”
paras.zh: 作为回应，布尔告诉麦克布莱德，“我实际上看到了这一点，她说她现在得到的不多。我当时想，‘朱迪，你得咨询你的经纪人，或者你必须打电话给你的银行，’因为我仍然有剩余。”

paras.en: Elsewhere on the podcast, Bure also addressed the Olsen twins’ decision not to appear on the spin-off. “It was a bummer because it would have been fun to have everybody back,” she said of Fuller House. “But at the same time, it wasn’t surprising just because none of us really have stayed close with the girls.”
paras.zh: 在播客的其他地方，布尔还谈到了奥尔森双胞胎决定不出现在衍生剧中的问题。 “这真是令人失望，因为如果每个人都回来的话会很有趣，”她谈到富勒之家时说道。 “但与此同时，这并不奇怪，因为我们没有人真正与这些女孩保持密切联系。”

paras.en: “Not because anything went wrong or there was any bad blood. I just think they were kids. They were [filming from] 9 months old until they were 8 years old. They have very different memories than we do. Even me being 10 years older than them, I have significant, great, wonderful memories,” she continued. “They were babies. They probably don’t even remember half the stuff [we do]. They didn’t have the attachment to the crew and the people like we did being older. And they had such a successful fashion business. They haven’t been actors for a long time. They just haven’t been in that part of entertainment.”
paras.zh: “不是因为出了什么问题或者有什么不和。我只是认为他们还是孩子。他们从 9 个月大一直到 8 岁都在拍摄。他们的记忆和我们非常不同。即使我比他们大 10 岁，我也有重要、伟大、美好的记忆，”她继续说道。 “他们还是婴儿。他们甚至可能不记得（我们所记得的）一半的事情。他们不像我们这些年长的人那样对工作人员和人们有依恋。而且他们拥有如此成功的时尚业务。他们已经很长时间没有成为演员了。他们只是没有进入娱乐圈。”

articles.title: SpaceX shares jump on alternative trading platform after Musk says he will expand on Trump Account share donations

paras.en: Shares of SpaceX jumped 7.47% in overnight trading on Blue Ocean ATS after CEO Elon Musk expanded his SpaceX share-donation plan for U.S. children.
paras.zh: 在首席执行官埃隆·马斯克 (Elon Musk) 扩大了 SpaceX 为美国儿童捐赠股票的计划后，SpaceX 的股价在 Blue Ocean ATS 隔夜交易中上涨了 7.47%。

paras.en: "I will be donating another share of SpaceX to all kids in America every year," Musk said in a post on X.
paras.zh: “我每年都会向美国所有孩子捐赠 SpaceX 的另一份股份，”马斯克在 X 上的一篇帖子中说道。

paras.en: Blue Ocean ATS is an alternative trading system for U.S. equities that operates from 8 p.m. to 4 a.m. ET, outside regular U.S. stock market hours. According to the platform's holiday schedule, overnight trading resumed at 8 p.m. ET on Thanksgiving Day. U.S. stock exchanges were closed Thursday and are scheduled to close early Friday.
paras.zh: Blue Ocean ATS 是一种美国股票的替代交易系统，从晚上 8 点开始运营。至美国东部时间凌晨 4 点，美国股市正常交易时间以外。根据平台放假安排，隔夜交易于晚上8点恢复。东部时间感恩节。美国证券交易所周四休市，预计周五早些时候休市。

paras.en: SpaceX shares closed 1.30% higher on Wednesday ahead of Thanksgiving.
paras.zh: 周三感恩节前夕，SpaceX 股价收盘上涨 1.30%。

paras.en: The latest pledge follows SpaceX's announcement Wednesday that it would donate one share of its Class A stock to every active Trump Account, tax-advantaged investment accounts for American children, with Musk personally matching the gift.
paras.zh: 在做出最新承诺之前，SpaceX 周三宣布将向每个活跃的特朗普账户（美国儿童的税收优惠投资账户）捐赠一股 A 级股票，并由马斯克亲自配捐。

paras.en: In a separate post on X, Musk said SpaceX's contribution would be transferred next month, while his personal donation would follow when his lockup period expires in June next year.
paras.zh: 马斯克在 X 上的另一篇帖子中表示，SpaceX 的捐款将于下个月转移，而他的个人捐款将在明年 6 月锁定期到期时转移。

paras.en: Nearly 70 million Trump Accounts had been created as of October, according to the White House.
paras.zh: 据白宫称，截至 10 月，已创建近 7000 万个特朗普账户。

paras.en: Since the program's launch in July, families and friends have contributed more than $1 billion to the accounts, bringing total deposits from all sources to more than $9 billion, CNBC reported earlier this week.
paras.zh: 据 CNBC 本周早些时候报道，自 7 月推出该计划以来，家人和朋友已向账户存入超过 10 亿美元，使所有来源的存款总额超过 90 亿美元。

articles.title: Tech German software major SAP is reportedly weighing cutting at least 10,000 jobs in AI push

paras.en: SAP is preparing a plan to eliminate at least 10,000 positions as the German firm reshapes its software business for the artificial intelligence era, Bloomberg reported on Thursday, citing people familiar with the matter.
paras.zh: 彭博社周四援引知情人士的话报道称，随着这家德国公司为人工智能时代重塑其软件业务，SAP 正在制定一项计划，裁减至少 10,000 个职位。

paras.en: The report came as the company flagged a cybersecurity attack, but said it had found "no evidence of unauthorized access to customer business data."
paras.zh: 该报告发布之际，该公司标记了一次网络安全攻击，但表示“没有发现未经授权访问客户业务数据的证据”。

paras.en: "SAP has identified suspicious activity and promptly implemented the necessary measures to protect its customers and preserve the security of its services," a company spokesperson said.
paras.zh: 公司发言人表示：“SAP 已发现可疑活动，并立即采取了必要措施来保护其客户并维护其服务的安全。”

paras.en: "Our customers trust us to protect their data, and that remains our highest priority. In a highly dynamic threat environment, we will continue to strengthen our security to provide the secure and resilient environment our customers depend on."
paras.zh: “我们的客户信任我们能够保护他们的数据，这仍然是我们的首要任务。在高度动态的威胁环境中，我们将继续加强安全性，以提供客户所依赖的安全且有弹性的环境。”

paras.en: The company did not respond to a request for comment on the reported job cuts. The number could change after labor negotiations.
paras.zh: 该公司没有回应对裁员报道发表评论的请求。劳资谈判后，这个数字可能会发生变化。

paras.en: Other software companies have also tied workforce reductions to AI initiatives, though for different reasons. WiseTech Global said in February it planned to cut about 2,000 jobs over two years as it integrated AI into its products and operations.
paras.zh: 其他软件公司也将裁员与人工智能计划联系起来，尽管出于不同的原因。 WiseTech Global 今年 2 月表示，计划在两年内裁员约 2,000 人，将人工智能融入其产品和运营中。

paras.en: Atlassian said in March it would cut about 1,600 jobs partly to fund further AI investment, while Cloudflare said in May it would eliminate more than 1,100 roles as it moved toward an AI-first operating model.
paras.zh: Atlassian 在 3 月份表示，将裁员约 1,600 个职位，部分原因是为进一步的人工智能投资提供资金，而 Cloudflare 在 5 月份表示，随着转向人工智能优先的运营模式，将裁减 1,100 多个职位。

paras.en: In the U.S., employers cited AI in 121,401 job-cut announcements through October 2026, accounting for about 20% of the total, according to a Nov. 5 report from outplacement and executive coaching firm Challenger, Gray & Christmas.
paras.zh: 根据就业和高管培训公司 Challenger, Gray & Christmas 11 月 5 日的报告，截至 2026 年 10 月，美国雇主在 121,401 份裁员公告中提到了人工智能，约占总数的 20%。

paras.en: SAP employs more than 110,000 people worldwide. Bloomberg reported that all departments had been asked to identify potential cuts, with product, engineering and sales in particular focus.
paras.zh: SAP 在全球拥有超过 110,000 名员工。彭博社报道称，所有部门都被要求确定潜在的削减，特别是产品、工程和销售部门。

paras.en: The company also underwent a reorganization in 2024, when it eliminated around 10,000 positions through a program that relied mainly on voluntary departures and retraining.
paras.zh: 该公司还于 2024 年进行了重组，通过一项主要依靠自愿离职和再培训的计划削减了约 10,000 个职位。

paras.en: Its headcount later remained relatively flat as it hired for new roles, Bloomberg reported.
paras.zh: 据彭博社报道，随着公司招聘新职位，其员工人数后来保持相对平稳。

paras.en: In 2023, SAP CEO Christian Klein told CNBC he did not necessarily expect a reduction in the workforce, saying he expected the company to grow and "accelerate" its total revenue.
paras.zh: SAP 首席执行官克里斯蒂安·克莱因 (Christian Klein) 向 CNBC 表示，到 2023 年，他预计员工数量不一定会减少，他预计公司会增长并“加速”其总收入。

paras.en: The reported cuts come as Klein pushes SAP toward an AI-first strategy. This year, SAP completed four acquisitions — Reltio, Dremio, Prior Labs and TechWolf — and made strategic investments in AI-focused companies including Parloa, n8n and Conduct.
paras.zh: 据报道，此次裁员是在 Klein 推动 SAP 实施人工智能优先战略之际进行的。今年，SAP 完成了四项收购——Reltio、Dremio、Prior Labs 和 TechWolf——并对 Parloa、n8n 和 Conduct 等专注于人工智能的公司进行了战略投资。

paras.en: The acquisitions are intended to help SAP organize company data, develop AI models for business information and analyze workforce skills.
paras.zh: 这些收购旨在帮助 SAP 整理公司数据、开发业务信息的人工智能模型并分析员工技能。

articles.title: Private markets are more accessible than ever for investors. Getting out is another matter

paras.en: Retail investors are lining up to back private funds. But education on how restrictive these funds can be, particularly on when and how much money they can get back, may not be keeping pace with the influx of new capital.
paras.zh: 散户投资者正在排队支持私募基金。但有关这些资金的限制性的教育，特别是有关何时以及可以收回多少资金的教育，可能跟不上新资本涌入的步伐。

paras.en: PwC research has found that 77% of fund distributors surveyed said access to private markets is becoming important or very important to what they plan to offer clients, but just 15% of asset managers said they provide comprehensive education for retail investors.
paras.zh: 普华永道的研究发现，77% 的受访基金分销商表示，进入私募市场对于他们计划向客户提供的服务变得越来越重要或非常重要，但只有 15% 的资产管理公司表示，他们为散户投资者提供全面的教育。

paras.en: Unlike the public markets retail investors are more used to, some private-market vehicles limit when investors can get their money back to set repurchase windows, and even then may return only part of what they request.
paras.zh: 与散户投资者更习惯的公开市场不同，一些私募市场工具会限制投资者何时可以收回资金以设定回购窗口，即使这样也可能只返还他们要求的部分资金。

paras.en: A spike in redemption requests at several private-credit funds earlier this year exposed the tension between giving investors regular opportunities to cash out and holding assets that can be difficult to sell quickly.
paras.zh: 今年早些时候，几家私人信贷基金的赎回请求激增，暴露了为投资者提供定期套现机会与持有难以快速出售的资产之间的紧张关系。

paras.en: Blackstone restricted withdrawals from its $79 billion flagship nontraded BCRED private credit fund to 5% of shares in June, after redemption requests hit 10% during the second quarter. Apollo also capped withdrawals in its Apollo Debt Solutions vehicle at 5% after second-quarter redemption requests surged to almost 17%. Blue Owl, Morgan Stanley and Partners Group also limited investor withdrawals from some of their funds.
paras.zh: 在第二季度赎回请求达到 10% 后，黑石集团于 6 月份将其 790 亿美元旗舰非交易 BCRED 私人信贷基金的撤资比例限制在 5%。在第二季度赎回请求飙升至近 17% 后，Apollo 还将其 Apollo Debt Solutions 工具的提款上限限制在 5%。 Blue Owl、摩根士丹利和合众集团也限制了投资者从其部分基金中提取资金。

paras.en: Limitations on redemptions are a key trade-off in structures such as LTAFs in the U.K., ELTIFs in the EU and interval funds in the U.S., which broaden access to less-liquid assets.
paras.zh: 对赎回的限制是英国 LTAF、欧盟 ELTIF 和美国间隔基金等结构的一个关键权衡，这些结构扩大了流动性较低的资产的获取范围。

paras.en: It's emerged as a major pressure point as those structures come under closer scrutiny.
paras.zh: 随着这些结构受到更严格的审查，它已成为一个主要压力点。

paras.en: "Private markets can have very different characteristics from the products many wealth clients are used to, particularly around liquidity, valuations and holding periods," said Albertha Charles, global asset and wealth management leader at PwC.
paras.zh: 普华永道全球资产和财富管理负责人艾伯塔·查尔斯表示：“私募市场可能与许多财富客户习惯的产品具有非常不同的特征，特别是在流动性、估值和持有期限方面。”

paras.en: "Investors and advisers need to understand how these products work, including their liquidity and valuation characteristics, so they can make informed decisions about whether they are appropriate."
paras.zh: “投资者和顾问需要了解这些产品的运作方式，包括它们的流动性和估值特征，以便他们能够就它们是否合适做出明智的决定。”

paras.en: PwC's 2026 Asset Management Revolution report, published Nov. 23, surveyed 250 asset managers, 100 institutional investors and 100 distributors across 36 countries and regions. More than half of respondents represented firms with over $20 billion in assets under management.
paras.zh: 普华永道于 11 月 23 日发布的《2026 年资产管理革命》报告对 36 个国家和地区的 250 家资产管理公司、100 家机构投资者和 100 家分销商进行了调查。超过一半的受访者代表管理资产超过 200 亿美元的公司。

paras.en: Among the study's key findings, education and liquidity are seen as the main hurdles as private markets reach a broader investor base. Distributors said better advisor and client education would help expand access, while liquidity, lock-ups and suitability requirements remain major barriers. Private equity and private credit were also the areas where distributors saw some of the biggest gaps in advisor knowledge.
paras.zh: 在该研究的主要发现中，教育和流动性被视为私募市场扩大投资者基础的主要障碍。经销商表示，更好的顾问和客户教育将有助于扩大准入范围，而流动性、锁定和适用性要求仍然是主要障碍。私募股权和私人信贷也是分销商在顾问知识方面存在最大差距的领域。

paras.en: Private credit appears likely to draw the strongest demand — two-thirds (66%) of distributors expect it to lead client interest in private markets, compared with 46% for private equity.
paras.zh: 私人信贷似乎可能会吸引最强劲的需求——三分之二 (66%) 的分销商预计它会引领客户对私人市场的兴趣，而私募股权的这一比例为 46%。

paras.en: Regulators in several major markets are creating structures to widen access to long-term and illiquid assets. The U.K. uses long-term asset funds, or LTAFs, while the EU's European long-term investment funds, known as ELTIFs, can be marketed across member states.
paras.zh: 几个主要市场的监管机构正在建立结构，以扩大长期和非流动资产的准入范围。英国使用长期资产基金（LTAF），而欧盟的欧洲长期投资基金（ELTIF）可以在成员国之间销售。

paras.en: In the U.S., interval funds provide periodic, rather than daily, liquidity. Singapore, Japan and Hong Kong have also taken steps to broaden retail or listed access to private assets. The frameworks differ, but all aim to make less-liquid investments workable within existing distribution, suitability and liquidity requirements.
paras.zh: 在美国，间隔基金提供定期而非每日的流动性。新加坡、日本和香港也采取措施扩大零售或上市私人资产的准入。这些框架各有不同，但都旨在使流动性较低的投资在现有的分配、适用性和流动性要求下可行。

paras.en: Yen Sum, global chair of the private capital practice at Latham & Watkins, and a member of its executive committee, said access to private-market funds is generally limited to investors who certify they are qualified or sophisticated.
paras.zh: 瑞生国际律师事务所 (Latham & Watkins) 私人资本业务全球主席兼执行委员会成员 Yen Sum 表示，获得私募市场基金的机会通常仅限于证明自己合格或经验丰富的投资者。

paras.en: She told CNBC on Thursday that the key issue for investor education centers on how private assets differ in liquidity, maturities and return-of-capital terms, and how higher rates can pressure leveraged companies — rather than simply whether regulation should curb access.
paras.zh: 她周四对 CNBC 表示，投资者教育的关键问题集中在私人资产在流动性、期限和资本回报率方面有何不同，以及更高的利率如何给杠杆公司带来压力，而不仅仅是监管是否应该限制准入。

articles.title: Read The Age of Alchemy by Kit Chapman with Scientific American in December

paras.en: The history of chemistry predates science itself; for thousands of years, kings and servants relied on alchemists to concoct “magical” ointments and elixirs. That practice morphed over the years into a formal field of investigation. Chemistry is the field of science that tells us what stars are made of, what’s safe to eat and how our species will live on a changing planet in the future. Chemistry is everywhere and connects to nearly everything. As Kit Chapman says in the prologue of The Age of Alchemy: How Early Innovators Shaped Modern Chemistry: “Before the Enlightenment, there were only wizards, witches and wishful thinking,” but slowly a “new science arrived to change our world.” The scientific study of chemistry has saved lives, caused massive destruction and informed a greater understanding of who we are and what we’re made of.
paras.zh: 化学的历史早于科学本身。几千年来，国王和仆人依靠炼金术士来配制“神奇”的药膏和长生不老药。多年来，这种做法逐渐演变成一个正式的调查领域。化学是一门科学领域，它告诉我们恒星是由什么构成的、吃什么是安全的以及我们的物种未来将如何生活在不断变化的星球上。化学无处不在，几乎与一切事物都有联系。正如基特·查普曼在《炼金术时代：早期创新者如何塑造现代化学》的序言中所说：“在启蒙运动之前，只有巫师、女巫和一厢情愿的想法”，但慢慢地，“新科学的到来改变了我们的世界”。化学科学研究拯救了生命，造成了巨大的破坏，并让人们更好地了解我们是谁以及我们是由什么构成的。

paras.en: This month Scientific American staff will be reading The Age of Alchemy together, and on December 16 we’ll share our staff discussion in our Science Quickly podcast. We’ll talk about our favorite chemistry facts and the places where we encounter chemistry in our everyday lives.
paras.zh: 本月《科学美国人》的工作人员将一起阅读《炼金术时代》，12 月 16 日，我们将在 Science Quickly 播客中分享我们的工作人员讨论。我们将讨论我们最喜欢的化学事实以及我们在日常生活中遇到化学的地方。

paras.en: If you're enjoying this article, consider supporting our award-winning journalism by subscribing. By purchasing a subscription you are helping to ensure the future of impactful stories about the discoveries and ideas shaping our world today.
paras.zh: 如果您喜欢这篇文章，请考虑通过订阅来支持我们屡获殊荣的新闻报道。通过购买订阅，您将有助于确保有关塑造当今世界的发现和想法的影响力故事的未来。

paras.en: Join our discussion where we've posted some questions to get us started.
paras.zh: 加入我们的讨论，我们在其中发布了一些问题以帮助我们开始。

articles.title: Slime molds beat mathematicians at complex problems

paras.en: Imagine you’ve been asked to build a new subway network for your city. The points that the network should connect at are naturally predetermined: important downtown locations need a stop, as do train stations, airports, universities and cultural institutions, such as museums and parks. At the same time, you have a limited budget. The system should therefore be as efficient as possible: every location must be accessible, while the total tunnel length should be kept to a minimum. How do you solve this challenge?
paras.zh: 想象一下，您被要求为您的城市建设一个新的地铁网络。网络应该连接的点自然是预先确定的：重要的市中心地点需要停靠，火车站、机场、大学和文化机构（例如博物馆和公园）也需要停靠。同时，您的预算有限。因此，系统应尽可能高效：每个位置都必须易于到达，同时隧道总长度应保持在最低限度。你如何解决这个挑战？

paras.en: If you're enjoying this article, consider supporting our award-winning journalism by subscribing. By purchasing a subscription you are helping to ensure the future of impactful stories about the discoveries and ideas shaping our world today.
paras.zh: 如果您喜欢这篇文章，请考虑通过订阅来支持我们屡获殊荣的新闻报道。通过购买订阅，您将有助于确保有关塑造当今世界的发现和想法的影响力故事的未来。

paras.en: These so-called Steiner tree problems are not easy to solve. They first arose in the early 19th century. Although named after Swiss mathematician Jakob Steiner, who did indeed work on them, they were first investigated in 1811 by French scholar Joseph Diez Gergonne. After more than 200 years, it has become clear to mathematicians that Steiner tree problems are among the most complex problems in the field. Yet there are living organisms that find this kind of optimal network planning very easy: slime molds.
paras.zh: 这些所谓的斯坦纳树问题并不容易解决。它们最早出现于 19 世纪初。尽管以瑞士数学家雅各布·施泰纳 (Jakob Steiner) 的名字命名，而他确实对这些问题进行了研究，但它们最早是在 1811 年由法国学者 Joseph Diez Gergonne 进行研究的。 200 多年后，数学家们已经清楚斯坦纳树问题是该领域最复杂的问题之一。然而，有些生物体很容易找到这种最佳网络规划：粘菌。

paras.en: The gifted urban planner Physarum polycephalum is a single-celled organism that can grow to several square meters in size. Slime molds of this species possess neither a complex nervous system nor a brain. And yet they can master astonishing tasks, some of which we mammals struggle with. They find the shortest routes within mazes, appear to possess a kind of short-term memory and can reconstruct the connections of the rail network in the Tokyo metropolitan area.
paras.zh: 天才的城市规划师多头绒泡菌是一种单细胞生物，可以长到几平方米大小。该物种的粘菌既没有复杂的神经系统，也没有大脑。然而，它们却能完成令人惊叹的任务，其中一些任务是我们哺乳动物难以完成的。他们在迷宫中找到最短的路线，似乎拥有一种短期记忆，并且可以重建东京都市区铁路网络的连接。

paras.en: To observe the slime mold as it plans an optimal rail network, it must be lured with food—specifically, oat flakes. In 2010 researchers at Hokkaido University in Japan conducted an experiment in which the oats were arranged to represent Tokyo and 35 surrounding cities in the metropolitan area. They then placed Physarum polycephalum on the Tokyo oat flake. The slime mold grew by about one centimeter per hour. The researchers observed the single-celled organism for 26 hours as it began to spread out flat in all directions in search of oat flakes. To conserve resources in the long run and utilize the finite food supply as efficiently as possible, the slime mold then contracted again.
paras.zh: 为了观察粘菌规划最佳铁路网络的情况，必须用食物（特别是燕麦片）来引诱它。 2010年，日本北海道大学的研究人员进行了一项实验，将燕麦排列成代表东京和首都圈周边35个城市的燕麦。然后他们将多头绒泡菌放在东京燕麦片上。粘菌每小时生长约一厘米。研究人员对这种单细胞生物体进行了 26 小时的观察，它开始向各个方向平铺开来寻找燕麦片。为了从长远来看节约资源并尽可能有效地利用有限的食物供应，粘菌随后再次收缩。

paras.en: In the end, it spanned the various food sources with a network of gossamer-thin threads. The resulting pattern resembled the rail network of the Tokyo metropolitan area. The researchers wrote in a study that the shape of the network developed by the slime mold is similar to real-life networks in “efficiency, fault tolerance and cost,” which—it must be admitted—is remarkable for a single-celled organism.
paras.zh: 最终，它以蛛丝般的细线网络跨越了各种食物来源。由此产生的模式类似于东京都市区的铁路网络。研究人员在一项研究中写道，粘菌形成的网络形状在“效率、容错性和成本”方面与现实生活中的网络相似，必须承认，这对于单细胞生物来说是非常了不起的。

paras.en: Planning a rail network is challenging in many respects. Imagine designing a network connecting three cities arranged in an equilateral triangle. You could simply lay tracks from one city to the next, tracing the perimeter of the triangle. But an arguably better solution puts one stop at the center of the triangle and then extends three tracks from the cities to this center point.
paras.zh: 规划铁路网络在许多方面都具有挑战性。想象一下设计一个连接三个呈等边三角形排列的城市的网络。您可以简单地沿着三角形的周长从一个城市铺设到另一个城市的轨道。但可以说更好的解决方案是在三角形的中心停一站，然后从城市延伸三条轨道到该中心点。

paras.en: That second design requires less track material—something you can quickly verify. If the three cities are each a distance of l from each other, the perimeter of the triangle is 3l. In the second scenario, however, the tracks run along the angle bisectors to the center of the triangle. These sections each have a length of l/√3. Therefore, the rail system in the second case would have a total length of √3l, which is only about 58 percent of the total length in the first scenario.
paras.zh: 第二种设计需要更少的轨道材料——您可以快速验证这一点。如果三个城市彼此之间的距离均为 l，则三角形的周长为 3l。然而，在第二种情况下，轨道沿着角平分线延伸到三角形的中心。这些部分的长度均为 l/√3。因此，第二种情况下的轨道系统总长度为√3l，仅为第一种情况下总长度的约58%。

paras.en: Allowing flexibility in the construction of stops can clearly reduce the overall length of the network connections considerably. But, of course, the more points you want to connect, the more complex the task becomes.
paras.zh: 允许灵活地构建站点可以明显减少网络连接的总长度。但是，当然，您想要连接的点越多，任务就会变得越复杂。

paras.en: Complexity theory, a subfield of theoretical computer science, classifies problems into different categories. It uses algorithms to determine how the number of computational steps relate to the size of the task. For example, though factoring a large number into its prime factors is extremely difficult, it’s easy for computers to check whether a number is prime. The latter falls into the complexity class of problems that theoretical computer scientists denote as “P.” In simpler terms, P encompasses all those problems that remain efficiently solvable as their size increases—the number of computational steps grows with the size of the task but doesn’t explode. More precisely, the computation time grows polynomially with the size of the input.
paras.zh: 复杂性理论是理论计算机科学的一个子领域，它将问题分为不同的类别。它使用算法来确定计算步骤数与任务大小的关系。例如，虽然将一个大数分解为它的素数因子非常困难，但计算机检查一个数是否是素数却很容易。后者属于理论计算机科学家称为“P”的复杂问题类别。简单来说，P 涵盖了所有那些随着规模的增加而仍然可以有效解决的问题——计算步骤的数量随着任务规模的增加而增加，但不会爆炸。更准确地说，计算时间随着输入的大小呈多项式增长。

paras.en: For certain problems, however, the computation time increases exponentially. Although any computer can very quickly factor the number 15 into its prime factors 3 and 5, if you give the computer a number thousands of digits long, it may give up. This is, of course, annoying for number theorists, but a blessing for cryptographers, who use such complex problems to design encryption methods.
paras.zh: 然而，对于某些问题，计算时间呈指数增长。尽管任何计算机都可以非常快速地将数字 15 分解为其质因数 3 和 5，但如果您给计算机提供数千位数长的数字，它可能会放弃。当然，这对数论学家来说很烦人，但对密码学家来说却是一件幸事，因为他们利用如此复杂的问题来设计加密方法。

paras.en: Certain tasks may be very complex, but their solutions—once identified—can be easily verified. These tasks are classified as “NP,” a complexity group that contains all problems whose solutions can be easily verified (that is, in polynomial time). The NP class thus contains all problems from P (because they are easy to solve, their solutions are also easy to verify) and also some problems that are difficult to compute.
paras.zh: 某些任务可能非常复杂，但它们的解决方案一旦确定，就可以轻松验证。这些任务被归类为“NP”，这是一个复杂性组，包含其解决方案可以轻松验证（即在多项式时间内）的所有问题。因此，NP 类包含 P 中的所有问题（因为它们很容易解决，因此它们的解决方案也很容易验证）以及一些难以计算的问题。

paras.en: The definition of complexity classes such as P and NP now stands or falls with the algorithms we know for solving certain tasks. But what if someone suddenly finds a completely new way to calculate, for example, the prime factors of a number—and the computation time only increases polynomially with the size of the number? Such questions form the core of theoretical computer science: the biggest unsolved puzzle is to find out whether P and NP are the same. In other words: For all tasks whose solutions can be easily verified, is there actually an efficient solution algorithm that we simply haven’t discovered yet?
paras.zh: P 和 NP 等复杂性类别的定义现在取决于我们所知道的用于解决某些任务的算法。但是，如果有人突然找到一种全新的方法来计算，例如，计算一个数字的质因数，并且计算时间仅随着数字的大小以多项式方式增加，该怎么办？这些问题构成了理论计算机科学的核心：最大的未解决难题是找出P和NP是否相同。换句话说：对于所有解决方案可以轻松验证的任务，是否真的存在我们尚未发现的有效解决算法？

paras.en: The Steiner Problem Is Extremely Complex
paras.zh: 斯坦纳问题极其复杂

paras.en: To determine the complexity of a problem, the crucial idea is to reduce it to another. In other words, if every algorithm that solves task A can also solve B, then B is reducible to A. Therefore, A is more complex than B. In the early 1970s computer scientists Stephen A. Cook and Leonid Levin were able to show that there is a specific problem in NP, the so-called Boolean satisfiability problem or SAT problem, to which all other NP problems can be reduced. That conclusion would make SAT the hardest problem in NP.
paras.zh: 要确定一个问题的复杂性，关键是将其简化为另一个问题。换句话说，如果解决任务 A 的每个算法也可以解决 B，那么 B 就可以简化为 A。因此，A 比 B 更复杂。在 20 世纪 70 年代初期，计算机科学家 Stephen A. Cook 和 Leonid Levin 能够证明 NP 中存在一个特定问题，即所谓的布尔可满足性问题或 SAT 问题，所有其他 NP 问题都可以简化为该问题。这个结论将使 SAT 成为 NP 中最难的问题。

paras.en: Yet as it turns out, there are other problems to which all other NP problems are reducible (including SAT). These problems are called NP-complete. If P and NP were to turn out to be unequal, then NP-complete problems would certainly not be contained in P. For them, there would be no efficient solution algorithm, no matter how long you searched. In 1972 computer scientist Richard Karp identified 21 problems that are NP-complete—including a simplified version of the Steiner problem.
paras.zh: 然而事实证明，还有其他所有其他 NP 问题都可以简化为的问题（包括 SAT）。这些问题称为 NP 完全问题。如果P和NP不相等，那么NP完全问题肯定不会包含在P中。对于它们来说，无论你搜索多久，都不会有有效的求解算法。 1972 年，计算机科学家理查德·卡普 (Richard Karp) 发现了 21 个 NP 完全问题，其中包括斯坦纳问题的简化版本。

paras.en: So bringing us back to the slime molds at work: planning a rail network is at least as difficult as an NP-complete problem. (We know this because Karp had investigated a simplified version of the Steiner tree problem.)
paras.zh: 因此，让我们回到工作中的粘菌：规划铁路网至少与 NP 完全问题一样困难。 （我们知道这一点是因为卡普研究了斯坦纳树问题的简化版本。）

paras.en: If you want to connect many stations, the optimal solution can require a great deal of computing power. Fortunately, there are approximation methods that bring us at least close to an optimal solution. Thanks to that, computer programs can solve Steiner tree problems that involve more than a million cities in just a few minutes. Furthermore, the problem can be simplified in practice by, for example, limiting the number of additional stations (Steiner points) to be added. After all, you wouldn’t want to build 60 additional interchange stations for a rail network that is supposed to connect 30 cities.
paras.zh: 如果要连接许多站，最佳解决方案可能需要大量的计算能力。幸运的是，有一些近似方法至少可以让我们接近最优解。正因为如此，计算机程序可以在短短几分钟内解决涉及超过一百万个城市的斯坦纳树问题。此外，在实践中可以通过例如限制要添加的附加站（斯坦纳点）的数量来简化该问题。毕竟，您不会想为连接 30 个城市的铁路网络额外建造 60 个换乘站。

paras.en: Still, it’s striking that a problem that takes computer scientists considerable time and power, requiring sophisticated algorithms and powerful hardware, can be resolved by Physarum polycephalum within a few hours.
paras.zh: 尽管如此，令人惊讶的是，一个需要计算机科学家花费大量时间和精力、需要复杂算法和强大硬件的问题，可以通过多头绒泡菌在几个小时内解决。

paras.en: This article originally appeared in Spektrum der Wissenschaft and was reproduced with permission. It was translated from the original German version with the assistance of artificial intelligence and reviewed by our editors.
paras.zh: 本文最初发表于 Spektrum der Wissenschaft 并经许可转载。它是在人工智能的帮助下从德语原文翻译而来，并由我们的编辑审阅。

articles.title: Secrecy surrounds claims of Russia’s push for nukes in space
