articles.title: Apple AirTag leads firefighters to cat stuck in narrow gap between cement walls

paras.en: Firefighters in Southern California rescued a missing cat wedged in a narrow gap between two concrete walls after the pet was tracked to the location thanks to an Apple AirTag on its collar.
paras.zh: 南加州的消防员通过项圈上的 Apple AirTag 追踪到一只被困在两堵混凝土墙之间狭窄缝隙中的失踪猫，并成功救出该猫。

paras.en: The orange-and-white feline was stuck in a 4 to 5-inch-wide gap between two 8-foot-tall retaining walls in Indian Wells, the Riverside County Fire Department said on social media.
paras.zh: 河滨县消防局在社交媒体上表示，这只橙白色的猫科动物被困在印第安维尔斯两座 8 英尺高的挡土墙之间 4 到 5 英寸宽的缝隙中。

paras.en: The owner located the missing cat using an AirTag attached to its collar, and firefighters were then able to free the animal from the tight spot.
paras.zh: 主人使用项圈上的空气标签找到了失踪的猫，然后消防队员将它从险境中救了出来。

paras.en: With help from Riverside County Animal Services, "firefighters used specialized equipment to gain access through the wall and safely extricate the cat," the fire department said.
paras.zh: 消防部门表示，在河滨县动物服务中心的帮助下，“消防队员使用专门的设备穿过墙壁并安全地救出了这只猫”。

paras.en: "Great teamwork by all involved in bringing this furry family member to safety!" the post added.
paras.zh: “所有参与者都出色的团队合作，将这个毛茸茸的家庭成员带到了安全的地方！”该帖子补充道。

paras.en: The cat was then reunited with its owner and transported to an emergency veterinarian for medical treatment.
paras.zh: 随后，这只猫与主人团聚，并被送往紧急兽医处接受治疗。

paras.en: Video posted by the fire department showed a firefighter drilling into a concrete wall before pulling the cat free and lifting it out of the wall.
paras.zh: 消防部门发布的视频显示，一名消防员钻入混凝土墙，然后将猫从墙上拉出来。

paras.en: Images also show a firefighter holding the cat after it was rescued from the gap.
paras.zh: 图片还显示，猫从缝隙中被救出后，一名消防员抱着它。

paras.en: It was unclear how the animal managed to get stuck in the narrow gap.
paras.zh: 目前尚不清楚这只动物是如何卡在狭窄的缝隙中的。

paras.en: While the AirTag was used as a useful tool to rescue the cat, Apple typically does not recommend using the device for tracking pets.
paras.zh: 虽然 AirTag 被用作拯救猫的有用工具，但苹果通常不建议使用该设备来跟踪宠物。

paras.en: Apple wrote on its website in January, while announcing the release of the new AirTag, that the device is designed "exclusively for tracking objects, and not people or pets."
paras.zh: 苹果一月份在其网站上宣布推出新的 AirTag 时写道，该设备“专门用于跟踪物体，而不是人或宠物”。

articles.title: Houthi attacks test Saudi Arabia's image of security

paras.en: Ten days after fleeing his home in Yemen's capital, Sanaa, Abu Khalil is selling socks on the streets of Riyadh.
paras.zh: 逃离也门首都萨那的家十天后，阿布·哈利勒正在利雅得街头卖袜子。

paras.en: "I walked out of Sanaa, I crossed the front line," he says, adding that he "hitched a ride into Saudi Arabia".
paras.zh: “我走出萨那，穿过前线，”他说，并补充说他“搭便车进入沙特阿拉伯”。

paras.en: Families in Yemen are "struggling to provide for [their] children", he says, as he tries to earn enough to send some money home.
paras.zh: 他说，也门的家庭“正在努力养活他们的孩子”，同时他试图赚到足够的钱寄回家。

paras.en: He asks us not to use his full name because his wife and four children are still in Sanaa, and he is frightened of what might happen to them if he is identified speaking out against the Houthis. "I ran away from the Houthis but I couldn't bring my family with me. May God protect them," he says.
paras.zh: 他要求我们不要使用他的全名，因为他的妻子和四个孩子仍在萨那，他担心如果他被发现公开反对胡塞武装，他们可能会遭遇什么。 “我逃离了胡塞武装，但我无法带上我的家人。愿上帝保护他们，”他说。

paras.en: Backed by Iran, the armed group has controlled much of northern Yemen since a civil war erupted more than a decade ago. It is fighting the internationally recognised government, which is supported by neighbouring Saudi Arabia.
paras.zh: 自十多年前内战爆发以来，在伊朗的支持下，该武装组织已经控制了也门北部的大部分地区。它正在与得到邻国沙特阿拉伯支持的国际公认政府作斗争。

paras.en: And Saudi cities, such as Riyadh, are now coming under regular drone and missile attacks from the very group Abu Khalil fled.
paras.zh: 利雅得等沙特城市现在经常受到阿布·哈利勒逃离的组织的无人机和导弹袭击。

paras.en: An informal ceasefire in Yemen unravelled in July, and since the fighting escalated, the Houthis have stepped up attacks on Saudi Arabia. They have said they were retaliating against deadly Saudi air strikes in Yemen and what they say is a Saudi blockade of ports and airports in Houthi-controlled territory.
paras.zh: 也门的非正式停火于七月破裂，自战斗升级以来，胡塞武装加强了对沙特阿拉伯的袭击。他们表示，他们是在报复沙特对也门发动的致命空袭，以及沙特封锁胡塞武装控制地区的港口和机场。

paras.en: One Houthi strike on Riyadh's international airport on 10 October killed 13 people and injured more than 300 - the deadliest attack on Saudi soil in years.
paras.zh: 10 月 10 日，胡塞武装对利雅得国际机场发动袭击，造成 13 人死亡、300 多人受伤，这是沙特境内多年来最严重的一次袭击。

paras.en: Having been granted rare permission to report from Riyadh, we spoke to locals, including Majid, a 25-year-old engineer who works for the Saudi state oil company Aramco. He was passing through the airport that day, rushing for a flight to Jeddah for a religious pilgrimage.
paras.zh: 在获得从利雅得进行报道的罕见许可后，我们采访了当地人，其中包括为沙特国家石油公司阿美公司工作的 25 岁工程师马吉德。那天他正路过机场，赶搭飞往吉达进行宗教朝圣的航班。

paras.en: He says he was watching a mother push her children in a pushchair when the terminal was hit.
paras.zh: 他说，当终端被击中时，他正在看着一位母亲用婴儿车推着孩子。

paras.en: He remembers seeing a man covered in blood. "I went to him in shock, asking him, 'Are you OK?'" He says he saw injured and unconscious passengers being taken to the airport's first aid clinic.
paras.zh: 他记得看到一个浑身是血的男人。 “我震惊地走向他，问他，‘你还好吗？’”他说，他看到受伤和昏迷不醒的乘客被送往机场的急救诊所。

paras.en: "Some of them, I still don't know whether they were alive or not."
paras.zh: “有些人，我还不知道他们是否还活着。”

paras.en: The experience left him shaken. "The threat is real," he tells me. "But I will not let the Houthis make me feel unsafe in my own country."
paras.zh: 这次经历让他震惊不已。 “威胁是真实的，”他告诉我。 “但我不会让胡塞武装让我在自己的国家感到不安全。”

paras.en: The airport attack was far from an isolated incident. BBC analysis of data from the US-based Armed Conflict Location and Event Data Project (Acled), a non-profit organisation, which collects data on political violence and protests around the world, identified 274 attacks on Saudi Arabia in almost five months between 1 July and 25 November.
paras.zh: 机场袭击绝非孤立事件。英国广播公司 (BBC) 对美国武装冲突地点和事件数据项目 (Acled) 的数据进行分析后发现，7 月 1 日至 11 月 25 日之间的近 5 个月内，沙特阿拉伯发生了 274 起袭击事件。Acled 是一个非营利组织，专门收集世界各地政治暴力和抗议活动的数据。

paras.en: According to Acled, most of these were intercepted, but at least 41 were not and in some cases debris from the interception also caused damage.
paras.zh: 据 Acled 称，其中大部分被拦截，但至少 41 个未被拦截，在某些情况下，拦截产生的碎片还造成了损害。

paras.en: Drones featured in almost two-thirds of the attacks, while ballistic missiles were used in more than half, according to the data.
paras.zh: 数据显示，近三分之二的袭击使用了无人机，而超过一半的袭击使用了弹道导弹。

paras.en: In the previous five months, Acled recorded just one Houthi attack on the country.
paras.zh: 在过去的五个月里，阿克莱德仅记录了一次胡塞武装对该国的袭击。

paras.en: Backed by Iran, the Houthis have developed an increasingly sophisticated arsenal, dramatically extending their ability to repeatedly strike deep in Saudi territory.
paras.zh: 在伊朗的支持下，胡塞武装已经发展出日益复杂的武器库，极大地扩展了其反复深入沙特领土的能力。

paras.en: For years, Houthi attacks were largely concentrated near the Yemeni border, with Riyadh targeted far less frequently. But since the collapse of the unofficial ceasefire, the Saudi capital, more than 700km (430 miles) away from the Yemeni border, is now coming under regular attack.
paras.zh: 多年来，胡塞武装的袭击主要集中在也门边境附近，利雅得的袭击频率要低得多。但自从非正式停火破裂以来，距离也门边境700多公里（430英里）的沙特首都现在经常受到袭击。

paras.en: As well as the airport, oil installations and prominent buildings in the capital have been in danger.
paras.zh: 除了机场外，首都的石油设施和著名建筑也处于危险之中。

paras.en: Saudi Arabia has spent billions transforming its cities, attracting international investment and presenting itself to the world as a safe place to live, work and visit - the attacks have put this promise to the test.
paras.zh: 沙特阿拉伯花费了数十亿美元改造其城市，吸引国际投资，并向世界展示自己是一个安全的生活、工作和旅游场所——这些袭击事件使这一承诺受到了考验。

paras.en: Two prominent skyscrapers have been hit in Riyadh's financial district this month.
paras.zh: 本月，利雅得金融区的两座著名摩天大楼遭到袭击。

paras.en: Eleven people were injured in a strike on the Public Investment Fund (PIF) Tower, which is the tallest in Saudi Arabia and is the headquarters of the country's sovereign wealth fund. The other was the Aramco building, home to the state oil company.
paras.zh: 公共投资基金 (PIF) 大楼遭到袭击，造成 11 人受伤，该大楼是沙特阿拉伯最高的大楼，也是该国主权财富基金的总部。另一座是阿美石油公司大楼，是国有石油公司的所在地。

paras.en: As we drove past the Aramco tower, the damage was a clear reminder of the threat facing the kingdom.
paras.zh: 当我们开车经过阿美石油公司塔楼时，损坏的情况清楚地提醒我们王国面临的威胁。

paras.en: But within days, the building's exterior had been completely repaired, any visible sign of the attack erased. It was perhaps a reflection of Saudi Arabia's determination to project an image of stability and business as usual, even as the attacks continue.
paras.zh: 但几天之内，大楼的外部就完全修复了，任何明显的袭击痕迹都被抹去了。这或许反映了沙特阿拉伯决心在袭击仍在继续的情况下展现出稳定和一切照旧的形象。

paras.en: The government has condemned "terrorist attacks targeting civilian and economic facilities" and said it would "take all necessary measures" to defend itself.
paras.zh: 政府谴责“针对民用和经济设施的恐怖袭击”，并表示将“采取一切必要措施”保卫自己。

paras.en: Even so, flights to the capital have been severely disrupted by the strikes, which have also targeted other locations, such as Medina and the airport in the eastern city of Dammam.
paras.zh: 即便如此，飞往首都的航班仍因罢工而严重中断，罢工还针对其他地点，例如麦地那和东部城市达曼的机场。

paras.en: Many passengers travelling to Riyadh are being routed through different airports and making the final leg of the journey on land.
paras.zh: 许多前往利雅得的乘客会经过不同的机场，并在陆地上完成旅程的最后一站。

paras.en: The flight we took to Dammam was almost empty. Riyadh's streets tell a different story, though.
paras.zh: 我们飞往达曼的航班几乎是空的。不过，利雅得的街道却讲述着不同的故事。

paras.en: Restaurants are bustling, families browse at shopping centres and people go about their evenings seemingly undeterred by the threat overhead.
paras.zh: 餐馆里熙熙攘攘，一家人在购物中心逛街，人们似乎没有被头顶上的威胁吓倒，继续度过夜晚。

paras.en: But getting people to speak openly about the conflict is difficult in a country where strict censorship laws and restrictions on freedom of expression make many wary of talking to the media.
paras.zh: 但在一个严格的审查法和对言论自由的限制使许多人对与媒体交谈持谨慎态度的国家，让人们公开谈论冲突是很困难的。

paras.en: Many of those who did speak to us expressed confidence in their country's ability to protect them. At a busy market, Badr says the airport attack was worrying, but life has quickly returned to normal. "I sleep comfortably," he says, praising the country's security forces.
paras.zh: 许多与我们交谈过的人都表示对自己国家保护他们的能力充满信心。巴德尔说，在一个繁忙的市场，机场袭击令人担忧，但生活很快就恢复了正常。 “我睡得很舒服，”他称赞该国的安全部队。

paras.en: Another man, Rashid, gestures towards the stalls around us: "The market is booming. People are buying and selling, going about their business. Everything is good."
paras.zh: 另一个名叫拉希德的男子指着我们周围的摊位说：“市场很繁荣。人们在买卖，做着自己的生意。一切都很好。”

paras.en: But the normality he describes is periodically disturbed by a sudden buzz on the phone with an alert warning of an incoming attack. Then come the loud booms of air defences intercepting missiles and drones overhead.
paras.zh: 但他所描述的正常状态会定期被电话突然响起的嗡嗡声和即将到来的攻击的警报所扰乱。然后是防空系统拦截头顶导弹和无人机的巨响。

paras.en: We experienced one at 04:00 one morning, and the knowledge that not every attack is being intercepted can leave people afraid.
paras.zh: 一天早上 04:00，我们经历了一次，了解到并非所有攻击都会被拦截，这会让人们感到害怕。

paras.en: British expatriate Alex Malouf, who has lived in Saudi Arabia on and off since 2006, says he worries about the psychological impact on his 11-year-old daughter, who has experienced security alerts while at school.
paras.zh: 自 2006 年以来断断续续居住在沙特阿拉伯的英国侨民亚历克斯·马卢夫 (Alex Malouf) 表示，他担心自己 11 岁的女儿会受到心理影响，因为她在学校时曾经历过安全警报。

paras.en: "There have been times when my daughter has said, 'Daddy, I'm scared.' It has been something which I think has shaken our reality."
paras.zh: “有时候我女儿会说，‘爸爸，我很害怕。’我认为这已经动摇了我们的现实。”

paras.en: Despite the attacks, Abu Khalil says he feels much safer in Saudi Arabia than at home in Yemen where fighting has intensified.
paras.zh: 尽管发生了袭击，阿布·哈利勒表示，他觉得在沙特阿拉伯比在也门的家安全得多，那里的战斗已经加剧。

paras.en: The Houthis' renewed offensive in western Yemen has seen the group capture territory along the Red Sea coast and threaten strategic routes towards the southern city of Aden, the government's temporary base.
paras.zh: 胡塞武装在也门西部重新发动攻势，夺取了红海沿岸领土，并威胁到通往政府临时基地南部城市亚丁的战略路线。

paras.en: The fighting has also intensified around Taiz, a government-controlled city that has endured years of siege and conflict.
paras.zh: 塔伊兹周围的战斗也愈演愈烈，这座政府控制的城市经历了多年的围困和冲突。

paras.en: Road closures resulting from the latest Houthi siege there have severely restricted deliveries of essential supplies, leaving more than 800,000 people cut off from humanitarian assistance, according to the UN children's agency Unicef. Food and fuel that can be found have shot up in price.
paras.zh: 据联合国儿童基金会称，最近胡塞武装围困造成的道路封闭严重限制了基本物资的运送，导致超过 80 万人无法获得人道主义援助。能找到的食物和燃料的价格已经飙升。

paras.en: More than 360,000 people have been forced from their homes in Yemen since August, according to the International Organization for Migration (IOM). And the UN Human Rights Office has verified 323 civilian casualties since then, including 76 killed, with children accounting for half of the dead.
paras.zh: 据国际移民组织 (IOM) 称，自 8 月以来，也门已有超过 36 万人被迫离开家园。此后，联合国人权高专办已核实了323名平民伤亡，其中76人死亡，其中儿童占死亡人数的一半。

paras.en: A Saudi-led coalition of Arab states has responded to the Houthi advances and attacks on the kingdom with intensified air strikes, adding to the dangers faced by civilians. One strike in Sanaa earlier this month killed 44 people, according to Houthi authorities. Saudi Arabia says these operations were to protect the Yemeni population and global trade from the Houthis.
paras.zh: 以沙特为首的阿拉伯国家联盟针对胡塞武装的进攻和对沙特的袭击，加大了空袭力度，加剧了平民面临的危险。据胡塞武装当局称，本月早些时候萨那发生的一次袭击造成 44 人死亡。沙特阿拉伯表示，这些行动是为了保护也门人民和全球贸易免受胡塞武装的侵害。

paras.en: Saudi-led bombing campaigns during the earlier years of the war killed thousands of civilians and devastated homes, hospitals and schools.
paras.zh: 战争初期，沙特领导的轰炸行动造成数千名平民死亡，房屋、医院和学校被毁。

paras.en: The Houthis have also inflicted enormous suffering on civilians through shelling, missile and ground attacks on government-held territory, as well as repression in areas under their control.
paras.zh: 胡塞武装还对政府控制的领土进行炮击、导弹和地面袭击，并在其控制下的地区进行镇压，给平民造成巨大痛苦。

paras.en: Abu Khalil hopes that he will soon be able to bring his wife and children over to Saudi Arabia, away from the dangers in Sanaa, and says he "will not go back until the Houthis are gone".
paras.zh: 阿布·哈利勒希望他很快就能将妻子和孩子带到沙特阿拉伯，远离萨那的危险，并表示“在胡塞武装消失之前他不会回去”。

paras.en: Additional reporting by Jasmin Dyer and Ahmed Nour
paras.zh: Jasmin Dyer 和 Ahmed Nour 的补充报道

articles.title: Could housing decide Spain's general election?

paras.en: Could housing decide Spain's general election?
paras.zh: 住房能否决定西班牙大选？

paras.en: Housing has been the biggest issue for voters ahead of Spain's general election on Sunday, with millions of people protesting across the country in recent weeks over a lack of affordable homes.
paras.zh: 在周日西班牙大选之前，住房一直是选民面临的最大问题，最近几周全国数百万人因缺乏经济适用房而举行抗议活动。

paras.en: Final opinion polls suggest the conservative People's Party will receive the most votes and that the right-wing Vox party is set to enter the national government for the first time. It would mean an end to Socialist prime minister Pedro SÃ¡nchez's eight years in power.
paras.zh: 最终民意调查显示，保守派人民党将获得最多选票，右翼 Vox 党将首次进入国家政府。这将意味着社会党总理佩德罗·桑切斯八年执政的结束。

paras.en: Europe correspondent Nick Beake speaks to a young couple from Valencia, who have been kept apart due to high rents in their city.
paras.zh: 欧洲记者尼克·比克采访了一对来自瓦伦西亚的年轻夫妇，他们由于所在城市的高租金而被分开。

articles.title: Millions of wives in South Asia unprotected from marital rape - study

paras.en: Failure to fully criminalise marital rape leaves millions of women and girls unprotected in eight South Asian countries, where intimate partner violence is 35% higher than the global average, says a new study.
paras.zh: 一项新的研究表明，由于未能将婚内强奸完全定为刑事犯罪，导致八个南亚国家数百万妇女和女童得不到保护，这些国家的亲密伴侣暴力行为比全球平均水平高出 35%。

paras.en: More than 100 countries have outlawed marital rape, but a large part of South Asia - India, Afghanistan, Sri Lanka and Bangladesh - remain among the three dozen countries which haven't.
paras.zh: 已有 100 多个国家宣布婚内强奸为非法，但南亚的大部分地区——印度、阿富汗、斯里兰卡和孟加拉国——仍属于尚未禁止婚内强奸的三打国家之列。

paras.en: The only South Asian country where rape within marriage attracts the same penalty as any other rape is The Maldives.
paras.zh: 马尔代夫是唯一一个婚内强奸受到与其他强奸相同处罚的南亚国家。

paras.en: Nepal and Bhutan have criminalised marital rape, but apply lesser penalties, says the study by Samaj, a coalition of women's rights groups in the region.
paras.zh: 该地区妇女权利团体联盟 Samaj 的研究表明，尼泊尔和不丹已将婚内强奸定为刑事犯罪，但处罚较轻。

paras.en: South Asia's marital rape laws largely stem from British colonial rule, says Ranjeeta Silwal of Equality Now, a global women's rights group part of Samaj.
paras.zh: Samaj 下属的全球妇女权利组织 Equality Now 的兰吉塔·西尔瓦尔 (Ranjeeta Silwal) 表示，南亚的婚内强奸法很大程度上源于英国殖民统治。

paras.en: The law, dating to 1860 in India and Bangladesh and 1885 in Sri Lanka, lists exceptions to rape - including sex by a man with his adult wife.
paras.zh: 印度和孟加拉国的法律可追溯到 1860 年，斯里兰卡的法律可追溯到 1885 年，该法律列出了强奸的例外情况，其中包括男子与其成年妻子发生性关系。

paras.en: Campaigners say the law is outdated and forced sex is rape, regardless of the perpetrator. Experts warn marital sexual violence harms women's physical, psychological, emotional and sexual well-being.
paras.zh: 活动人士表示，这项法律已经过时，强迫性行为就是强奸，无论肇事者是谁。专家警告说，婚姻性暴力会损害女性的身体、心理、情感和性健康。

paras.en: More than 100 countries have criminalised marital rape, including the UK, which changed its law in 1991. But the exemption remains in India, Sri Lanka and Bangladesh.
paras.zh: 100 多个国家将婚内强奸定为刑事犯罪，其中包括英国，该国于 1991 年修改了法律。但印度、斯里兰卡和孟加拉国仍保留豁免。

paras.en: Pakistan removed the marital rape exception in 2006, but no higher court has confirmed that rape laws apply within marriage. A recent high court ruling, meanwhile, granted husbands broad immunity for non-consensual sex.
paras.zh: 巴基斯坦于 2006 年取消了婚内强奸例外，但尚无高级法院确认强奸法适用于婚内。与此同时，高等法院最近的一项裁决赋予丈夫对非自愿性行为的广泛豁免权。

paras.en: Since returning to power in 2021, the Taliban have steadily dismantled women's protections in Afghanistan.
paras.zh: 自2021年重新掌权以来，塔利班不断瓦解阿富汗对妇女的保护。

paras.en: A new penal code introduced in January made matters worse, Silwal says. Under it, a husband can be prosecuted for violence against his wife only if he causes a broken bone, open wound or severe bruising. Even then, he faces just 15 days in prison if convicted.
paras.zh: 西尔瓦尔说，一月份推出的新刑法使情况变得更糟。根据该法，只有当丈夫造成骨折、开放性伤口或严重瘀伤时，才可以因对妻子的暴力行为而受到起诉。即便如此，如果罪名成立，他也仅面临 15 天的监禁。

paras.en: Unsurprisingly, the code makes no mention of marital rape. But its narrow definition of punishable violence effectively denies women protection against it.
paras.zh: 毫不奇怪，该守则没有提及婚内强奸。但其对应受惩罚的暴力的狭隘定义实际上剥夺了妇女免受暴力侵害的保护。

paras.en: "The idea comes from the belief that consent for sex is implied in marriage, that marriage is a threshold where consent ends," Silwal told the BBC.
paras.zh: 西尔瓦尔告诉英国广播公司：“这个想法源于这样一种信念，即婚姻中隐含着对性行为的同意，婚姻是同意结束的门槛。”

paras.en: "But it shows a lack of awareness, it shows we are still treating women as property, that we are still very patriarchal."
paras.zh: “但这表明我们缺乏意识，表明我们仍然将女性视为财产，我们仍然非常重男轻女。”

paras.en: The report comes amid renewed debate over marital rape across the region.
paras.zh: 该报告发布之际，该地区关于婚内强奸的争论再次展开。

paras.en: In India, 10 petitions challenging the law are pending before the Supreme Court, which is due to begin final hearings on 9 December.
paras.zh: 在印度，10 份质疑该法律的请愿书正在等待最高法院审理，最高法院将于 12 月 9 日开始最终听证会。

paras.en: Courts have delivered contradictory rulings over the years, with some judges acknowledging the law's archaic nature and urging parliament to criminalise marital rape.
paras.zh: 多年来，法院做出了相互矛盾的裁决，一些法官承认该法律过时，并敦促议会将婚内强奸定为犯罪。

paras.en: There was outrage last year when a court let go a man whose wife had died after he brutally raped her.
paras.zh: 去年，法庭释放了一名男子，该男子的妻子在被残忍强奸后死亡，这引起了愤怒。

paras.en: But the Indian government, religious organisations and men's rights activists have opposed petitions in the top court, saying criminalisation of marital rape would be "excessively harsh".
paras.zh: 但印度政府、宗教组织和男权活动人士反对向最高法院提出请愿，称将婚内强奸定为刑事犯罪“过于严厉”。

paras.en: Rights groups in Bangladesh have also challenged the marital rape exception, arguing it violates constitutional rights to life, liberty and protection from torture and cruel treatment, the report says.
paras.zh: 报告称，孟加拉国的人权组织也对婚内强奸例外提出质疑，认为这侵犯了宪法赋予的生命权、自由权以及免遭酷刑和残忍待遇的权利。

paras.en: "Those who oppose criminalising marital rape say it would undermine the family unit and break them apart. And family is very important in our countries," Silwal says.
paras.zh: “那些反对将婚内强奸定为犯罪的人说，这会破坏家庭单位并使家庭破裂。家庭在我们国家非常重要，”西尔瓦尔说。

paras.en: "They say it will affect our religious and cultural values and worry that there would be false accusations against men."
paras.zh: “他们说这会影响我们的宗教和文化价值观，并担心会对男性提出虚假指控。”

paras.en: Also a change in law, she says, may not necessarily mean justice for survivors.
paras.zh: 她说，法律的改变也不一定意味着幸存者得到正义。

paras.en: Silwal points to Bhutan where marital rape is a criminal offence but it's treated as a petty misdemeanour and is punishable by one month to one year.
paras.zh: 西尔瓦尔指出，在不丹，婚内强奸是一种刑事犯罪，但它被视为一种轻微的轻罪，可判处一个月至一年的刑罚。

paras.en: In Nepal, the punishment for rape is between six and 20 years, but it's only up to five years for a husband who rapes his wife.
paras.zh: 在尼泊尔，强奸罪的刑罚为6至20年有期徒刑，但强奸妻子的丈夫最多只能判处5年有期徒刑。

articles.title: How Paper-Based Friction Materials Power Modern Machinery

paras.en: How Paper-Based Friction Materials Power Modern Machinery

Have you ever wondered what enables everything from roaring construction machinery to agricultural machinery plowing the fields to industrial equipment shuttling through factories—the precise starting, smooth operation, and reliable braking they achieve?

The answer lies in a seemingly insignificant yet crucial core component: friction material. It acts as the "safety guard" and "power link" of machinery, ensuring every brake is safe and effective, and every power transmission is smooth and flawless.

Among the vast family of friction materials, wet friction materials are becoming the new favorite in modern machinery due to their exceptional reliability, safety, and exceptionally long lifespan. Among wet materials, paper-based friction materials stand out as a leading force thanks to their excellent overall performance, cost-effectiveness, and broad application prospects.
Today, let's delve deeper into the fascinating world of this "unsung hero"—paper-based friction materials.
What is Paper-Based Friction Material? — A Sponge-Like Power Core
Imagine a "sponge" with countless tiny pores—that's the most intuitive image of paper-based friction material.

It is a material with a reticular porous structure composed of three core components: reinforcing fibers, functional fillers, and a binder resin. This unique structure gives it extraordinary capabilities:
- Oil Storage Capacity: The porous structure acts like a miniature "oil depot," capable of storing large quantities of lubricant.

- Dynamic Lubrication: When the friction plate and mating plate engage and are subjected to pressure, the lubricant within the material is instantly squeezed onto the friction surface, forming a tough lubricant film, enabling smooth, gentle "wet" friction.
- Self-Recovery: When the friction plates separate, the material rebounds like memory foam, "absorbing" the lubricant back into the pores, ready for the next operation.

It is this dynamic cycle of "oil storage-oil squeezing-oil return" that allows paper-based friction materials to perform well in an oil bath environment, achieving a perfect combination of high durability and stable friction performance.
Exploring Core Performance: How Do Three Key Factors Affect It?

The performance of paper-based friction materials is not static. Like a top athlete, its performance is influenced by the "field," "equipment," and "condition." Let's examine how these three key factors shape its performance.
Factor 1: The "Stage Effect" of Lubricants

Paper-based friction materials are highly sensitive to lubricants, and different lubricants create distinct "stages" for their performance. Even the same friction material can exhibit significantly different friction characteristics (especially the kinetic friction coefficient) when exposed to different lubricants.
Figure 1: Kinetic friction coefficient curve for a paper-based friction material in gear oil
Figure 2: Dynamic friction coefficient curve of the same material in hydraulic oil

Interpretation: The above chart clearly shows that the same material behaves very differently in gear oil and hydraulic fluid. Furthermore, various additives added to lubricating oils (such as dispersants and anti-wear agents) can interact complexly with the material surface, further affecting its friction properties. Therefore, choosing the right oil for paper-based friction materials is the first step in achieving optimal performance.
Density is a trump card for paper-based friction materials. It is directly related to the material's porosity, leading to a delicate balancing act in terms of performance.

High density (low porosity) means a denser material, resulting in better strength and thermal conductivity, lower wear rate, and longer life. However, the downside is reduced oil storage capacity, which can lead to a lower coefficient of friction and compromise power transmission.

Low density (high porosity) means the material is more porous, resulting in greater oil storage capacity and a higher coefficient of friction, which can provide greater braking force or transmit torque. However, the downside is reduced mechanical strength and wear resistance, shortening service life.
Figure 3: Comparison of the dynamic coefficient of friction for materials of varying densities (Type 2 to Type 6, increasing density)
Figure 4: Comparison of wear rates of materials with different densities

Interpretation: Figures 3 and 4 vividly illustrate this balancing act. There's no such thing as absolute good or bad, only suitability. When selecting a paper-based friction material, the optimal trade-off between friction coefficient and durability must be determined based on specific application requirements (e.g., high torque versus long life).
Factor 3: Extreme Challenges of Operating Conditions

In addition to oil type and density, actual operating conditions, such as surface pressure, sliding speed, and oil temperature, pose extreme challenges to paper-based friction materials. These factors directly affect the temperature of the friction interface, the thickness and stability of the oil film, and thus dynamically alter the coefficient of friction.

Therefore, please remember: the coefficient of friction of a particular paper-based friction material is not a fixed value, but rather a performance range determined through extensive and repeated testing under specific operating conditions.
Broad Applications: Injecting a Powerful "Heart" into Machinery

Thanks to its excellent overall performance and customizability, Carlisle Brake & Friction's paper-based friction materials have been successfully applied to the core components of various heavy-duty machinery, becoming their powerful and reliable "heart."
We understand that different machines and applications require significantly different friction materials. For example:
- Service brakes for construction machinery (such as excavators and loaders) require materials that provide a stable, powerful braking force under high loads to ensure safety.
- Powershift transmissions for agricultural machinery (such as tractors) require materials that provide smooth engagement and excellent heat resistance to handle frequent shifting.
- Clutches for industrial machinery require materials that respond quickly and have a long lifespan to ensure continuous and efficient operation of production lines.

To this end, Carlisle Brake & Friction has developed a series of special paper-based friction materials for different application scenarios, providing each customer with the most suitable and reliable solution.
Continuous Innovation, Driving the Future
Technological advancement is endless. To meet increasingly demanding application requirements and broaden market prospects, Carlisle Brake & Friction remains at the forefront of innovation.

We are not only continuously optimizing the formulation and processing of paper-based friction materials to push their performance limits, but are also actively exploring next-generation wet friction materials with even higher performance. These R&D efforts have made significant progress, aiming to provide global customers with more diverse and advanced options, driving the infinite possibilities of future machinery.

articles.title: Celebrating 100-Years with Medina Mayor and Employees

paras.en: Celebrating 100-Years with Medina Mayor and Employees

MEDINA, OHIO — September 24, 2025 — Carlisle Brake & Friction (CBF), a global leader in the development and manufacture of high-performance brake and friction solutions, today welcomed Medina Mayor Dennis Hanwell, Economic Development Director Kimberly Marshall, and Executive Director of the Medina Chamber of Commerce Jaclyn Ringstmeier, for a special photo op at the company’s headquarters, located at 920 Lake Road. The event was a commemorative celebration of CarlisleCBF’s 100-year anniversary and its enduring presence in the Medina community.

articles.title: Halfords points to strong tyre performance within HY27 results, announces new national distribution centre
articles.author: Chris

paras.en: Halfords points to strong tyre performance within HY27 results, announces new national distribution centre

In parallel with the publication of its first-half 2027 results, Halfords Group has announced plans for new national distribution centre investment designed to move the business forward from its “optimise” phase towards its “evolve” phase.

Halfords Group plc specifically announced interim results for the 26-week period ended 2 October 2026 (HY27), which show that group revenue grew to £953.3 million in the period, up 6.7 per cent from £893.3 million the same time last year. Of that, £381.3 million was derived from the Autocentres (up 5.9% from HY26). Underlying profit before tax (PBT) shot up 66 per cent to £39.0 million (HY26: £23.5 million).

articles.title: Automechanika Birmingham teams up with Fleet Guy to boost garage fleet work
articles.author: Andrew

paras.en: Automechanika Birmingham teams up with Fleet Guy to boost garage fleet work
Automechanika Birmingham (8-10 June 2027) has partnered with Fleet Guy to help independent workshops unlock new revenue streams in fleet servicing, maintenance, and repair (SMR).

The collaboration will introduce a dedicated Fleet VIP Lounge at the 2027 NEC exhibition, hosted by Fleet Guy’s Tim and Judith. Designed to bridge the gap between workshops, fleet operators, and suppliers, the space will host networking, practical advice, and open discussions alongside a new fleet-focused education programme.

Joanne Knowles, event director at show organiser Messe Frankfurt UK, said: “Garage owners want to know where their next business opportunity could come from and how to make the most of it. This partnership gives them a place to explore fleet work, ask questions and start conversations with people they could go on to work with.

“Tim and Judith understand both the garage and fleet sides of that relationship. Bringing their experience and community into the show will help visitors make useful connections and leave with a clearer idea of their next steps. It gives garages another compelling reason to join us at the NEC in June.”

Tim from Fleet Guy added: “The biggest blocker is often misconception. There is so much opportunity for garages and fleets to work together, but you need relationships and an understanding of each other’s businesses to make it happen.

“We want garage owners to come along; ask the questions they have always wanted to ask and see what fleet work could mean for them. Automechanika Birmingham gives us the platform to take those conversations and partnerships to the next level.”
Returning to the NEC Birmingham on 8-10 June 2027, the event is expected to draw over 15,000 professionals and 550 exhibitors, including Bosch, Castrol, Delphi, MAHLE, and Snap-on.

articles.title: T&A talks with Hubtrac Tyres general manager, Ali Guo
articles.author: Chris

paras.en: T&A talks with Hubtrac Tyres general manager, Ali Guo

Hubtrac Tyres plans to launch its first passenger car tyre range in Bologna in 2027, with its Serbian factory serving as the main production base for Europe. The initial line-up will cover around 200 sizes across high-performance, ultra-high-performance, all-season and commercial van tyres, with winter and electric vehicle tyres to follow.

In an interview with Tyres & Accessories, Hubtrac Tyres general manager, Ali Guo scheduled for publication in the December editions of the magazine, explains how more than three decades in the tyre industry shaped his approach. Building Aeolus Tyre’s overseas business taught him to adapt products to local conditions, invest in distributors and after-sales service, and build a brand rather than chase sales through low prices.

For the passenger car launch, Hubtrac is developing tyres around European driving conditions and using European regulations and tyre labelling standards as benchmarks. Guo says the company will prioritise keeping its most popular sizes in stock, with a central warehouse and local stockholding intended to support delivery across Europe within two to seven days.

articles.title: Allstate, Gerber Donate Refurbished 2020 Subaru at NHRA Finals
articles.author: Jason Stahl

paras.en: On Saturday, Nov. 14, a single mother in need of reliable transportation received a refurbished vehicle through the NABC Recycled Rides program, with the vehicle donated by Allstate and repairs completed by Gerber Collision & Glass.

The presentation took place at the NHRA Finals in Pomona, Calif., as part of Gerber Collision & Glass support of the NHRA. This is the third Recycled Rides presentation at an NHRA event this year, thanks to Gerber Collision & Glass.
Recipient Alondra Leyva Herrara, a single mother nominated by The Orange County United Way, was presented a fully refurbished 2020 Subaru Forrester.

Herrara is a single mom of three and a strong voice in her community, always looking for ways to give back, volunteering and informing her community of available resources, despite the challenges she’s endured while having no vehicle. Herrara had a secure job for more than 10 years, until she recently found herself in a difficult situation where her work permit had not been renewed and was left to expire. She then lost her vehicle in an accident and did not have the funds to replace it. She shares a vehicle with a family friend which means taking her friend to their workplace, her son to his job at a grocery store and herself to work. Despite the situation, she is someone who is always there for others and has always given back to her community.

articles.title: Books from two industry veterans: one to draw kids to skilled trades, another to offer claims guidance
articles.author: Lurah Lowery

paras.en: Two longtime collision repairers have written books they hope will help the industry and consumers, with one seeking to show children a full range of career options in the skilled trades.
paras.zh: 两位资深的碰撞维修技师撰写了书籍，希望能够帮助行业和消费者，其中一位希望向孩子们展示技术行业中各种各样的职业选择。

paras.en: Jaime Shewbridge, a welding and automotive instructor with a 30-plus-year career, said she discovered fourth grade is the ideal time to start talking to kids about the careers that are out there. She believes targeting high school students is waiting until it’s too late because by then, most have already chosen the career they want to pursue.
paras.zh: Jaime Shewbridge是一位拥有30多年从业经验的焊接和汽车专业教师，她说她发现四年级是开始向孩子们介绍各种职业的最佳时机。她认为，等到高中生再来介绍职业已经为时过晚，因为到那时，大多数人已经选择了自己想要从事的职业。

paras.en: “There’s so much more than just going to school to get a four-year degree; they don’t really tell kids that,” Shewbridge said. “When they do, it’s late middle school, early high school, and a lot of times they’ve already made up their mind, or they’ve had the adults in their life kind of funnel them towards college… It’s not for everybody. We have to do a better job explaining to kids: if it’s not for you and you love taking model airplanes apart, then maybe you would like to be an airplane mechanic, and we need those.”
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: That’s just one example career she plans to cover in a book series. She said each role she writes about will be based on real-life experience from professionals she knows.
paras.zh: 这只是她计划在系列丛书中介绍的一个职业例子。她说，她所写的每个角色都将基于她所认识的专业人士的真实生活经历。

paras.en: Shewbridge said she hopes her books will address two stigmas: “white collar” jobs are better than “blue collar” jobs, and that the skilled trades are just for boys.
paras.zh: Shewbridge表示，她希望自己的书能消除两种成见：“白领”工作比“蓝领”工作好，以及技术工种只适合男生。

paras.en: The first book, “Levi Doesn’t Know,” is written from the perspective of 9-year-old Levi, who is often asked by adults: “What do you want to be when you grow up?”
paras.zh: 第一本书《Levi Doesn’t Know》（利维不知道）是从9岁的利维的视角撰写的，他经常被大人们问：“你长大后想做什么？”

paras.en: Shewbridge said, unfortunately, adults her age, and possibly the generation after her, “still believe that being in a shop or any type of blue-collar trade is dirty and ‘less than’ somehow.”
paras.zh: Shewbridge表示，不幸的是，与她同龄的成年人，甚至可能是她之后的这一代人，“仍然认为在车间工作或从事任何类型的蓝领行业都是肮脏的，在某种程度上‘低人一等’。”

paras.en: “It’s not,” she said. “These technicians are incredible. They do things we could never do… I have a college degree; I’m not discounting it. It’s very useful and necessary for a lot of jobs, but it’s not the only way. It’s not the only door there is. There’s trade schools, there’s on-the-job training, there’s the military.”
She added that the “blue collar” versus “white collar” stigma causes many technicians to lose confidence in their skills.

“I have a lot of them that will tell me when I hand them paperwork, ‘I’m doing this because I didn’t do well in school and you’re handing me a bunch of paperwork to read,'” Shewbridge said. “They always discount how smart they are; they discount their own ability, and they act like they’re a body man because they couldn’t do anything else. It’s so not true. They’re some of the smartest people you’ll ever meet.

“One thing I don’t think the public realizes is they literally have your life in their hands. If they don’t fix that car right, you might not live the next time… It really comes down to their talent, skill, and ability, whether your car wrecks the next time correctly or not.”
“Levi Doesn’t Know” covers what it’s like to work as a welder, her own career.

“My favorite part of the first book is when Levi comes home from school, and he’s disheartened that he didn’t know what he wanted to be, but all of his friends knew,” Shewbridge said. “He walked into the garage, and he was talking to his grandmother and, at some point, realizes that she’s a welding teacher. And his first thing was, ‘But you’re a girl.’ And even in the fourth grade, there’s still that perception of boy jobs and girl jobs from watching TV and maybe seeing a certain job done by a certain demographic.”
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: Shewbridge said, looking back to when she was a fourth grader, she wouldn’t have thought then she would become a welding teacher.

“I would’ve never said that was true; never, ever,” she said. “That was the farthest thing from my mind that could have been. To know that I am one, I am female, and there aren’t that many of us, I think that ‘aha’ moment for Levi will also bring that same moment for kids in the class that reads it to say, ‘Well, I am a girl, but I could also be a welding instructor, or I could be a welder, or I could be a body tech, or I could be an airplane mechanic, or whatever. Just because I’m X, Y, and Z doesn’t define what job I can have.’ I think women in the skilled trades still face that stigma even as adults. Most of the time, I’m the only female in the room.”
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: Another book in the series will cover several body shop careers. Shewbridge said the goal of that book is to show kids that if, for example, they start as a body technician or painter and want to transition into another role, they don’t have to start over.

“You could be a manager, you could be a production manager, you could be a parts person, you could own a shop,” she said. “There’s so many more jobs just within each skilled trade… I think we’re doing a disservice to a lot of kids that would thrive in a job with their hands that are never given the opportunity to even know that it’s out there.”
Shewbridge said she also hopes kids will talk to their parents about what they learn from her books, including that they will be paid well if they choose careers in the skilled trades.

“I gave the book to a fourth-grade teacher to read, and she said, ‘I love the part where you said you can’t dream about a job that you don’t even know exists’ because a lot of these jobs that you brought up, we don’t talk about,'” she said. “I don’t think it’s done intentionally. I don’t think they’re withheld on purpose. I think that it’s one of those ‘you don’t know what you don’t know.'”

With each book, Shewbridge provides student and teacher resource guides with questions, vocabulary lists, and activities. She hopes the books will be used in homeschooling as well as in-person school settings.
Shewbridge’s first book is available on Amazon, Kindle, and Bookspace.com.
A Claims ‘Playbook’ for Shops and Consumers
A second author and collision repair industry veteran, Charles Whitaker, focuses on a different subject: teaching shops how they can inform consumers of their options during the claims process.
Whitaker, owner of Collision Claims Advisors, says he took his 25-plus years of experience to write “The Collision Recovery Playbook.”
He said he has traveled the country and has seen the pressures shops experience from insurance companies.

“Shops always want to ‘educate customers,’ but when they do it, it oftentimes comes across as a negative,” he said. “While they believe they’re helping in many cases, and I think they have big hearts, my question has always been, did they get that outcome that they intended? And oftentimes I don’t think they do,” Whitaker said, referring to shops educating customers. “While they had the best intentions, the outcome didn’t necessarily always align.”
Whitaker added that his book is also designed for direct consumer use by topic so they can navigate straight to what is relevant to them.

“I’ve just seen too many people taken advantage of at the shop level and at the consumer level,” he said. “It always comes back to having to deal with the insurer pushback and steering; that’s the piece that they really struggle with.”
Some of the topics covered in the book are:
- “What to do immediately after an accident;
- “Are aftermarket parts really ‘like kind and quality?’;
- “Fair claims practice laws — and why they often don’t protect you;
- “How to take back control of your collision repair;
- “What happens when your vehicle is declared a total loss;
- “Diminished value — and why it matters;
Whitaker’s book is available on Amazon, or Whitaker’s company website offers a bulk order discount.
Photos provided by Jaime Shewbridge and Charles Whitaker.

articles.title: What Goes Into Developing an OE Tire?
articles.author: Christian Hinton

paras.en: OE tire development requires manufacturers to engineer tires that match the performance requirements of new vehicles. This process involves balancing safety, rolling resistance, noise and sustainability. These priorities can vary depending on the vehicle, market and emerging technologies such as electric vehicles.
paras.zh: 配套轮胎的开发要求制造商设计出符合新车性能要求的轮胎。这一过程涉及在安全性、滚动阻力、噪音和可持续性之间取得平衡。这些优先事项可能因车辆、市场以及电动汽车等新兴技术而异。

paras.en: Many tire manufacturers now begin the development process with virtual testing.
paras.zh: 如今，许多轮胎制造商在开始开发流程时都会先进行虚拟测试。

paras.en: Some manufacturers, like Continental, use simulators and virtual testing to evaluate handling, noise and rolling resistance before producing physical prototypes.
paras.zh: 一些制造商（如德国马牌轮胎）在生产实体原型之前，会使用模拟器和虚拟测试来评估操控性、噪音和滚动阻力。

paras.en: Following virtual evaluations, tires undergo laboratory testing and real-world driving assessments. These tests help manufacturers determine whether simulated performance results translate to actual road conditions. The development process helps tire manufacturers produce OE tires that meet vehicle-specific requirements and support the performance characteristics intended by the automaker.
paras.zh: 在虚拟评估之后，轮胎将接受实验室测试和真实驾驶评估。这些测试有助于制造商确定模拟性能结果是否能反映到实际路况中。开发过程有助于轮胎制造商生产符合车辆特定要求的原厂轮胎，并支持汽车制造商所期望的性能特性。

articles.title: Separating AGM Battery Facts From The Myths
articles.author: Andrew Markel

paras.en: Have you noticed more batteries are moving into the trunks and under the seats of some vehicles? Chances are, if the battery is not under the hood, it is an absorbent glass mat (AGM) or gel cell battery. AGM eliminates acid spilling in an accident because it is sealed. They can be installed at odd angles.
paras.zh: 您是否注意到，越来越多的电池被移到了一些车辆的后备箱和座椅下方？如果电池不在机舱盖下，很可能是吸收式玻璃纤维隔板 (AGM) 电池或凝胶电池。AGM是密封的，因此可以避免在事故中发生酸液泄漏。它们可以以不规则的角度安装。

paras.en: These batteries pack a lot of power for their size and weight, which allows manufacturers to shave off a few pounds from the vehicle. That’s a big reason why they are being found more and more on late-model vehicles. Also, these batteries have a greater reserve capacity to support stop/start systems and key-off functions.
paras.zh: 这些电池相对于其尺寸和重量而言具有很大的功率，这使制造商能够将车辆的重量减轻几磅。这就是为什么在新款车型上越来越多地使用这类电池的一个重要原因。此外，这些蓄电池具有更大的储备容量，可支持启停系统和熄火功能。

paras.en: Here are the four AGM battery myths that you may have heard.
paras.zh: 以下是您可能听说过的关于AGM电池的四个谬论。

paras.en: You can use your regular battery charger on AGM or gel cell batteries.
paras.zh: 您可以使用常规电池充电器为AGM或凝胶电池充电。

paras.en: These batteries like to be charged slow and low due to differences in internal resistance.
paras.zh: 由于内部电阻的差异，这些电池喜欢以缓慢、低电流的方式充电。

paras.en: Many AGM battery chargers have microprocessors that collect information from the battery and adjust the current and voltage accordingly. Some have different settings for charging flooded or AGM batteries. Overcharging can kill these batteries. Also, alternators are not chargers. Don’t rely on an alternator to do the work of a charger. If a battery is discharged to the point that it cannot start the vehicle, use a charger as soon as possible to make sure the battery gets fully charged.
paras.zh: 许多AGM电池充电器都配备了微处理器，这些微处理器从电池收集信息，并相应地调整电流和电压。有些充电器对铅酸电池或AGM电池的充电有不同的设置。过度充电会损坏这些电池。此外，交流发电机不是充电器。不要指望交流发电机来完成充电器的充电工作。如果蓄电池放电到无法起动车辆的程度，请尽快使用充电器，以确保蓄电池充满电。

paras.en: Can AGMs and gel cells be tested the same way as conventional batteries?
paras.zh: AGM和胶体电池是否可以像传统电池那样进行测试？

paras.en: These types of batteries have lower internal resistance than flooded batteries. Older capacitance battery testers/analyzers may not be able to accurately read these batteries. Most new battery analyzers have a special mode for AGM/gel cell batteries. Old-school load testers might not provide conclusive results.
paras.zh: 这些类型的电池的内阻比铅酸电池低。较旧的电容式蓄电池测试仪/分析仪可能无法准确读取这些蓄电池。大多数新型蓄电池分析仪都具有针对AGM/胶体蓄电池的特殊模式。老式负载测试仪可能无法提供确凿的结果。

paras.en: Using a multimeter to measure the state of charge is not the same as with a conventional flooded battery. After the surface charge is removed, the voltage of an AGM with 100% state of charge might be 13.0-volts. A flooded battery might have only 12.6-volts.
paras.zh: 使用万用表测量充电状态与使用传统铅酸电池的情况不同。在消除表面电荷后，电量为100%的AGM电池的电压可能为13.0伏。富液式蓄电池的电压可能只有12.6伏。

paras.en: AGM or gel cell battery replacement is the same as flooded battery replacement.
paras.zh: AGM或凝胶电池的更换与铅酸电池的更换相同。

paras.en: While the installation of the battery may be the same for the two battery styles, some vehicles require an extra step to tell the vehicle that the battery has been replaced.
paras.zh: 虽然两种电池的安装方式可能相同，但有些车辆需要额外操作一步，以告知车辆电池已更换。

paras.en: Newer GM vehicles have a Battery Sensor Module on the negative battery cable. Ford has the Battery Monitoring System (BMS). Other manufacturers have similar systems. These systems require recalibration with a scan tool if the battery is replaced. If the system is not recalibrated, the alternator might overcharge the new battery and cause the battery to fail soon after replacement.
paras.zh: 较新的通用汽车车型在蓄电池负极线上配备了蓄电池传感器模块。福特配备了蓄电池监测系统 (BMS)。其他制造商也有类似的系统。如果更换了蓄电池，这些系统需要使用诊断仪进行重新校准。如果不对系统进行重新校准，交流发电机可能会对新蓄电池过度充电，导致蓄电池在更换后不久就发生故障。

paras.en: Some vehicles can perform a self-learn for the battery by measuring the internal resistance
paras.zh: 一些车辆可以通过测量内阻来对蓄电池进行自学习。

paras.en: of the battery. But often a scan tool can force the procedure so you know there will be no issues with
paras.zh: 但通常可以使用诊断仪强制执行此程序，这样您就知道

paras.en: You can’t upgrade a customer to an AGM battery if the vehicle originally came with a flooded battery.
paras.zh: 如果车辆最初配备的是铅酸电池，则不能将客户升级为AGM电池。

paras.en: You can install an AGM battery into a flooded battery application. An AGM battery will give the vehicle more cold cranking power and greater resistance to heat and vibration. However, you never want to downgrade a vehicle that came with an AGM battery to a flooded battery.
paras.zh: 您可以将AGM电池安装到使用铅酸电池的应用中。AGM电池将为车辆提供更大的低温起动功率，并具有更强的耐热性和耐振性。但是，您绝不希望将原配AGM电池的车辆降级为使用铅酸电池。

articles.title: YANG Launches 2027 Mentorship Program
articles.author: Jeff White

paras.en: The Young Auto Care Network Group (YANG), a community of the Auto Care Association, recently launched its 2027 YANG Mentorship Program. Now in its fifth year, the program averages 125 mentees and 24 volunteer mentors annually. Anyone under age 40 who joins the YANG community can participate for free.
paras.zh: 汽车保养协会旗下的社区——青年汽车保养网络集团（YANG）近日启动了2027年YANG导师计划。该计划现已进入第五个年头，每年平均有125名学员和24名志愿导师参与。任何加入YANG社区的40岁以下人士均可免费参与。

paras.en: “One of the most valuable aspects of my involvement with YANG has been the relationships I’ve built with individuals who genuinely challenge me to grow, both personally and professionally,” said Brandon Crenshaw, chair, YANG. “The Mentorship Program creates an opportunity to go beyond networking, by building meaningful connections, challenging your own perspectives, and developing the confidence and perspective to lead in new ways. It’s an experience I encourage every young professional in our industry to embrace.”
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: Each YANG mentee will rank industry-specific topics by preference to form mentorship circles. Examples of topics include:
paras.zh: 每位 YANG 学员都将根据自己的偏好对行业特定主题进行排名，以形成导师圈。主题示例包括：

paras.en: - Navigating change, building influence and earning your seat at the table
paras.zh: - 驾驭变革、建立影响力并赢得一席之地

paras.en: - Standing out and the importance of networking
paras.zh: - 脱颖而出和建立人脉的重要性

paras.en: Each mentorship circle consists of approximately five mentees and one mentor focused on a unique topic.
paras.zh: 每个导师圈由大约五名学员和一名导师组成，专注于一个独特的主题。

paras.en: Organizers will assign groups after registration closes Nov. 30. Participants will then join the YANG Mentorship Program kickoff meeting in January 2027. Each mentorship circle will meet once per quarter throughout 2027. The program runs from January through December 2027.
paras.zh: 报名将于 11 月 30 日截止，之后主办方将分配小组。随后，参与者将参加 2027 年 1 月举行的 YANG 导师计划启动会议。在整个 2027 年，每个导师小组将每季度举行一次会议。该计划的实施时间为2027年1月至12月。

paras.en: The YANG Mentorship Program aims to help mentees experience all three YANG pillars: networking, professional development and giving back. Through this small-group mentorship program, mentees will benefit from the experience of automotive aftermarket veterans.
paras.zh: YANG导师计划旨在帮助学员体验YANG的所有三大支柱：人脉拓展、职业发展和回馈。通过这个小规模的导师计划，学员将受益于汽车售后市场资深人士的经验。

paras.en: The program targets young automotive aftermarket professionals who want to advance their careers. It provides opportunities for members to focus on individual professional goals while developing the skills to become future leaders.
paras.zh: 该计划面向希望提升职业生涯的年轻汽车售后市场专业人士。它为会员提供了专注于个人职业目标的机会，同时培养成为未来领导者的技能。

articles.title: The Group Begins 2026 Toys for Tots Drive
articles.author: Jeff White

paras.en: For the 15th consecutive year, members of the Automotive Parts Services Group (a.k.a. The Group) are supporting the U.S. Marine Corps Reserve Toys for Tots campaign by collecting toy and monetary donations for children in need in their communities.
paras.zh: 美国海军陆战队预备役“玩具送孤儿”活动（Toys for Tots）旨在为社区中需要帮助的儿童收集玩具和金钱捐赠，汽车零部件服务集团（简称“集团”）的成员已连续15年为该活动提供支持。

paras.en: “Over the years, our Toys for Tots partnership has continued to grow as we collect toys and raise funds to bring holiday cheer to children in need across the country,” said John Marcum, director of marketing at Federated Auto Parts. “The Group’s members have played an important role in growing the campaign through their commitment to promoting the program and encouraging community support. What began as a holiday effort has grown into a year-round initiative. We extend our sincere thanks to the Federated Alliance, The Pronto Network and our supplier partners for their ongoing generosity and commitment to this cause.”
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: Since partnering with the U.S. Marine Corps Reserve Toys for Tots Program, The Group, its members and vendor partners have helped raise over $4 million for Toys for Tots.
paras.zh: 自与美国海军陆战队预备役“玩具送儿童”计划合作以来，本集团、其成员和供应商合作伙伴已帮助为“玩具送儿童”筹集了超过400万美元的资金。

paras.en: In addition to toy donations at participating locations, financial contributions can be made online by visiting The Group’s Toys for Tots website and clicking on “Make a Donation.” Donors can use a credit card securely or print out a form and mail it with a check made payable to Toys for Tots.
paras.zh: 除了在参与活动的地点捐赠玩具外，还可以访问该集团的Toys for Tots网站并点击“捐款”在线捐款。捐款人可以使用信用卡安全捐款，也可以打印表格，并附上收款人为Toys for Tots的支票邮寄捐款。

paras.en: “All donations made online or at participating member locations are distributed in the area where the toys and money are collected, helping make the holidays brighter for deserving children in their own communities,” said Marcum.
paras.zh: “所有在线或在参与会员网点进行的捐赠都会分发到玩具和款项的收集地，帮助当地社区中应受关爱的儿童度过一个更加愉快的节日。”Marcum表示。

paras.en: Last year, the campaign delivered 24 million toys to nearly 11 million children and since 1947, the Marine Toys for Tots Foundation has distributed more than 732 million toys to more than 325 million children.
paras.zh: 去年，该活动向近1100万名儿童发放了2400万件玩具；自1947年以来，海军陆战队玩具捐赠基金会已向3.25亿多名儿童发放了7.32亿多件玩具。

articles.title: Advance Auto Parts Opens New Store in Bradenton
articles.author: Mary DellaValle

paras.en: Advance Auto Parts opened its newest store in Bradenton, expanding access to parts, tools and expertise for local drivers and automotive professionals. The company marked the opening of the store at 10010 State Road 64 alongside local officials and representatives from Manatee Technical College who were on site to accept a donation for the school’s automotive technology program.
paras.zh: Advance Auto Parts 在布雷登顿开设了最新门店，为当地驾驶员和汽车专业人士提供更多获取零部件、工具和专业知识的渠道。公司与当地官员以及马纳提技术学院的代表一同庆祝位于10010 State Road 64的门店开业，后者到场接受了对该校汽车技术专业的捐赠。

paras.en: The donation will help students gain hands-on experience, training, and career opportunities through the school’s automotive technology programs. Skilled automotive technicians continue to be in high demand, with approximately 70,000 openings projected annually through 2034, according to U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics.
paras.zh: 这笔捐款将帮助学生通过学校的汽车技术课程获得实践经验、培训和职业机会。根据美国劳工统计局的数据，熟练的汽车技术人员仍然供不应求，预计到2034年，每年将有约7万个职位空缺。

paras.en: “Opening our seventh store in Bradenton is an exciting milestone that allows us to better serve customers across the community,” said Mark Ortiz, regional vice president, Advance Auto Parts. “Whether helping drivers maintain their vehicles or supporting professional shops and technicians, our team is focused on providing the service and products customers depend on. We’re also proud to support Manatee Technical College as they prepare future technicians for careers in the automotive industry.”
paras.zh: Advance Auto Parts区域副总裁Mark Ortiz表示：“在布雷登顿开设第七家门店是一个令人振奋的里程碑，使我们能够更好地为整个社区的顾客提供服务。“无论是帮助驾驶员保养车辆，还是为专业维修店和技师提供支持，我们的团队都致力于提供客户所依赖的服务和产品。我们还很自豪能够为马纳提技术学院提供支持，帮助他们培养未来的技术人员，为汽车行业的职业生涯做好准备。”

paras.en: Customers can access a variety of free services at Advance, including battery testing, battery and wiper blade installation with purchase, and check engine light scanning through ReliaScan, which enables a team member to quickly scan the vehicle and identify what may be causing the issue, with no appointment needed.
paras.zh: 顾客可以在Advance享受各种免费服务，包括蓄电池检测、购买蓄电池和雨刮器后提供安装服务，以及通过ReliaScan进行发动机故障灯扫描。ReliaScan使团队成员能够快速扫描车辆并确定可能导致问题的原因，无需预约。

articles.title: MANN+HUMMEL’s Hasmeet Kaur and Cedric Dackam on Anticipating What’s Next
articles.author: Mary DellaValle

paras.en: This episode of DriveTime features Hasmeet Kaur, president, Transportation Division, MANN+HUMMEL, and Cedric Dackam, president & GM, Automotive Aftermarket, MANN+HUMMEL.
paras.zh: 本期DriveTime节目邀请了MANN+HUMMEL运输事业部总裁Hasmeet Kaur和MANN+HUMMEL汽车售后市场总裁兼总经理Cedric Dackam。

paras.en: As the automotive industry undergoes significant transformation, MANN+HUMMEL is leveraging its presence in both the original equipment and aftermarket sectors to deliver solutions throughout a vehicle’s lifecycle. Kaur explained how the company’s integrated business model enables it to anticipate customer needs, beginning with vehicle design and continuing through aftermarket service and repair. Rather than treating OE and aftermarket operations as separate businesses, Kaur emphasized how the two segments complement each other, allowing MANN+HUMMEL to address evolving customer requirements while positioning both for long-term growth.
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: Dackam highlighted the growing complexity facing aftermarket suppliers and customers. An aging vehicle fleet, electrification, advanced vehicle technologies and increasing parts proliferation are reshaping the industry’s challenges and opportunities. He said customers increasingly expect more than quality products, placing greater importance on predictive analytics, accurate coverage and access to vehicle data. He also emphasized how MANN+HUMMEL’s OE engineering expertise helps the company prepare aftermarket solutions for emerging technologies, including filtration applications in battery safety, thermal management and battery venting. Its established WIX, Purolator and MANN-FILTER brands further support the company’s ability to serve different market segments and distribution channels.
paras.zh: 达卡姆强调了售后市场供应商和客户面临的日益复杂的问题。车队老化、电气化、先进的车辆技术和零部件的激增正在重塑该行业的挑战和机遇。他表示，客户对优质产品的期望越来越高，他们更加重视预测分析、准确的覆盖范围和车辆数据的访问。他还强调了曼胡默尔的原厂工程专业知识如何帮助公司为新兴技术准备售后解决方案，包括电池安全、热管理和电池通风方面的过滤应用。其成熟的 WIX、Purolator 和 MANN-FILTER 品牌进一步支持了公司服务不同细分市场和分销渠道的能力。

paras.en: Looking ahead, Kaur emphasized MANN+HUMMEL’s commitment to innovation, sustainability and its core mission of separating the useful from the harmful. She pointed to investments in filtration media development and vertical integration that enable the company to accelerate innovation and tailor solutions to customer needs. Kaur also discussed her leadership philosophy, emphasizing trust, empowerment and creating an environment where teams can perform at their best. Dackam reinforced the importance of anticipating industry change and translating emerging technologies into aftermarket opportunities, noting that the company’s engineering capabilities, established brands and customer relationships provide a foundation for navigating the industry’s evolving landscape.
paras.zh: Looking ahead, Kaur emphasized MANN+HUMMEL’s commitment to innovation, sustainability and its core mission of separating the useful from the harmful. articles.title: The AAM Group Celebrates 20 Years of Total Truck Centers
articles.author: Jeff White

paras.en: The AAM Group is celebrating the 20th anniversary of Total Truck Centers, its flagship marketing program for independent truck accessory retailers and installers. Looking back on the past two decades, The AAM Group said the need for greater support in the truck accessories aftermarket led to the creation of Total Truck Centers. Distributing large, difficult-to-ship products presented unique challenges. In 2005, four distributors—Weller’s Auto Supply, North Central Truck, Nelson Truck and Titan Equipment—joined The AAM Group. Their participation laid the foundation for a dedicated truck accessories program.
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: Total Truck Centers officially launched in 2006 with a clear purpose: helping independent truck accessory retailers compete and grow.
paras.zh: Total Truck Centers于2006年正式成立，宗旨明确：帮助独立卡车配件零售商参与竞争并实现发展。

paras.en: As the truck accessories aftermarket has evolved, so have the challenges facing independent retailers. Jobbers often lack the time, staff and resources to manage their own marketing. Recognizing these challenges, The AAM Group developed four core tools to help level the playing field.
paras.zh: 随着卡车配件售后市场的发展，独立零售商面临的挑战也随之而来。兼职者往往缺乏时间、人员和资源来管理自己的营销。认识到这些挑战，AAM Group 开发了四个核心工具来帮助创造公平的竞争环境。

paras.en: Aftermarket Websites® helps retailers establish an online presence and connect with customers searching for products. ReadyPosts provides free social media content and automation to help shops stay visible without adding to their workload.
paras.zh: Aftermarket Websites® 帮助零售商建立在线形象，并与搜索产品的顾客建立联系。ReadyPosts提供免费的社交媒体内容和自动化功能，帮助店铺保持曝光度，而不会增加其工作量。

paras.en: N-Store TV brings supplier product education into showrooms, streaming more than 3 million minutes of content each month. Meanwhile, PRO Rebates has returned thousands of dollars to participating jobbers.
paras.zh: N-Store TV 将供应商产品教育带入展厅，每月播放超过 300 万分钟的内容。与此同时，PRO Rebates 已向参与活动的工作人员返还了数千美元。

paras.en: “We started Total Truck Centers because we recognized a need to better support independent truck accessory retailers,” said Tim Oddom, president of The AAM Group. “Twenty years later, the tools have changed, but our purpose hasn’t. Everything we do comes back to helping our jobbers sell more products and grow their businesses.”
paras.zh: AAM Group总裁Tim Oddom表示：“我们之所以创立Total Truck Centers，是因为我们认识到有必要为独立卡车配件零售商提供更好的支持。“二十年后，工具发生了变化，但我们的宗旨没有变。我们所做的一切最终都是为了帮助我们的批发商销售更多产品，并发展他们的业务。”

paras.en: As Total Truck Centers enters its next chapter, The AAM Group said it continues listening to its members and jobbers. The organization aims to understand their challenges and develop resources that meet their changing needs.
paras.zh: 随着 Total Truck Centers 进入新篇章，AAM 集团表示将继续倾听其会员和经销商的意见。该组织旨在了解他们的挑战并开发资源来满足他们不断变化的需求。

paras.en: “The past 20 years have been about listening to our members and jobbers and responding to their needs,” said Andy Stacy, marketing director. “That same commitment will guide us for the next 20 years. As the industry changes, we’ll continue finding ways to help independent retailers succeed.”
paras.zh: 营销总监Andy Stacy表示：“过去的20年里，我们一直在倾听会员和批发商的意见，并响应他们的需求。“同样的承诺将指引我们度过接下来的20年。随着行业的变化，我们将继续寻找方法，帮助独立零售商取得成功。”

articles.title: 'I would love to discover Attila's grave': Live Science readers weigh in on which archaeological discoveries they would want to find
articles.author: Kenna Hughes-Castleberry

paras.en: From people's backyards to famous excavation sites, archaeological discoveries found the world over give clues about the cultures and lives of ancient peoples. For instance, the discovery of 1,200-year-old pennies in Denmark revealed that the Vikings melted down silver from the Muslim world, while an excavation of a 2,800-year-old tomb with sacrificed horses in Siberia revealed ties to the nomadic Scythians.
paras.zh: 从人们的后院到著名的考古发掘现场，世界各地的考古发现为我们提供了有关古代人民文化和生活的线索。例如，在丹麦发现的1200年前的便士表明，维京人曾熔化来自穆斯林世界的银币；而在西伯利亚发掘的一座有祭祀马匹的2800年前古墓则揭示了与游牧的斯基泰人的联系。

paras.en: Other archaeological discoveries are important due to their historical significance or extraordinary preservation. For example, the 40,000-year-old "Lion Man" statuette was carved by humans in what is now Germany during the last ice age, and it may be the earliest known evidence of religious belief in the world.
paras.zh: 其他考古发现因其历史意义或非凡的保存而非常重要。 For example, the 40,000-year-old "Lion Man" statuette was carved by humans in what is now Germany during the last ice age, and it may be the earliest known evidence of religious belief in the world.

paras.en: Meanwhile, ancient texts can provide clues about mysterious and long-lost languages, such as the Linear A writing system from the ancient Minoans of Crete. Other texts, like the Rosetta stone, helped crack the code of Egyptian hieroglyphics, allowing researchers to better understand this ancient culture.
paras.zh: 与此同时，古文献可以为我们提供有关神秘且早已失传的语言的线索，例如克里特岛古米诺斯文明的线形文字 A。像罗塞塔石碑这样的其他文本则帮助破解了埃及象形文字的密码，使研究人员能够更好地了解这种古老文化。

paras.en: Each type of archaeological discovery unearths something new about the ancient world. This week, Live Science polled its readers on which of these types of findings they'd most like to uncover.
paras.zh: 每种类型的考古发现都揭示了古代世界的新事物。本周，《生活科学》杂志对读者进行了民意调查，询问他们最想发现哪些类型的发现。

paras.en: Over 290 readers weighed in, with 69% choosing that they'd like to discover an ancient text "that helps decipher a language."
paras.zh: 超过290名读者参与了投票，其中69%的人选择他们希望发现一篇“有助于破译一种语言”的古文。

paras.en: The comments also reflected this trend, with one reader writing: "The interpretation of a newly deciphered language can lead to the discovery of other things like tombs and documents, as was the case with the Rosetta stone. Once Egyptologists could read hieroglyphs, they could discover other information which helped them in their research and digs."
paras.zh: 评论也反映了这一趋势，一位读者写道：“对新破译的语言进行解读可能会导致发现其他东西，比如墓葬和文献，就像罗塞塔石碑的情况一样。一旦埃及古物学家能够读懂象形文字，他们就能发现其他信息，帮助他们开展研究和发掘工作。”

paras.en: - 2,900-year-old sanctuary discovered on Greek mountaintop may have been a destination for Artemis worship
paras.zh: - 在希腊山顶发现的拥有 2,900 年历史的圣所可能是阿耳忒弥斯崇拜的目的地

paras.en: - 2 giant Ramesses II statues, one wearing a double crown, discovered by man in Egypt
paras.zh: - 2座巨型拉美西斯二世雕像，其中一座戴着双王冠，由埃及人发现

paras.en: - 'Unlike anything seen before': Archaeologists unearth a unique, 11,000-year-old statue of a person riding a leopard from one of the world's earliest settlements
paras.zh: -“与以前见过的任何东西都不一样”：考古学家在世界上最早的定居点之一挖掘出一尊独特的、有 11,000 年历史的骑着豹子的雕像

paras.en: Other readers highlighted the importance of finding ancient weapons, which 4% of participants voted for. As one commenter wrote: "War has always been responsible for where people gather and settle down together. Weapons therefore can reveal the ebb and flow of people across the countries, which for many years never existed. This therefore reveals a lot about the specific development in many different areas and ultimately perhaps as to why we actually live where we do."
paras.zh: 其他读者强调了发现古代武器的重要性，4%的参与者对此投了赞成票。正如一位评论者所写：“战争一直是人们聚集和定居在一起的原因。因此，武器可以揭示人们在各国之间的迁徙，而这些国家在许多年里并不存在。因此，这揭示了许多不同地区具体发展情况的许多信息，最终也许还能揭示我们为何实际居住在当前所在地的原因。”

paras.en: In a similar vein, one commenter wished that they could "discover Attila's grave site, since no one has found [it] as of today."
paras.zh: 同样，一位评论者希望他们能够“发现阿提拉的墓地，因为到目前为止还没有人找到它。”

paras.en: Another reader reflected on the importance of finding ancient burial sites, writing: "I think that tombs are the most valuable finds in archaeology."
paras.zh: 另一位读者反思了寻找古代墓地的重要性，写道：“我认为坟墓是考古学中最有价值的发现。”

paras.en: Do you agree or disagree with these readers? What would you most like to find? Let us know in the comments!
paras.zh: 您同意还是不同意这些读者的看法？您最想找到什么？请在评论中告诉我们！

paras.en: Kenna Hughes-Castleberry is the Content Manager at Live Science. Formerly, she was the Content Manager at Space.com and before that the Science Communicator at JILA, a physics research institute. Kenna is also a book author, with her upcoming book 'Octopus X' scheduled for release in spring of 2027. Her beats include physics, health, environmental science, technology, AI, animal intelligence, corvids, and cephalopods.
paras.zh: Kenna Hughes-Castleberry 是 Live Science 的内容经理。此前，她曾担任 Space.com 的内容经理，此前曾担任物理研究所 JILA 的科学传播员。肯纳还是一名书籍作者，她即将出版的新书《章鱼 X》计划于 2027 年春季发行。她的研究领域包括物理、健康、环境科学、技术、人工智能、动物智能、鸦科动物和头足类动物。
