articles.title: 'Alpha-gal follows none of the rules': Why a red-meat allergy triggered by tick bites is perplexing scientists
articles.author: Amber Dance

paras.en: Sandra Tiguila, an adventurous eater, enjoyed a bison sausage breakfast sandwich while dining out in August of 2025. On the drive home, she noticed a rash appearing on her wrist. The burning sensation spread to her arms and legs, making it nearly impossible to sleep. In the days to come, she tried creams, pills, injections; nothing helped.
paras.zh: 2025 年 8 月，爱冒险的桑德拉·蒂吉拉 (Sandra Tiguila) 在外出就餐时享用了野牛香肠早餐三明治。在开车回家的路上，她注意到手腕上出现了皮疹。灼热的感觉蔓延到她的手臂和腿上，让她几乎无法入睡。接下来的日子里，她尝试过药膏、药丸、打针；没有任何帮助。

paras.en: Ten days later, Tiguila ate out again, ordering a steak. When her face swelled up, her boyfriend drove her to the emergency room. A doctor tested her for diseases carried by ticks. Tiguila, who lives in Carbondale, Illinois, had been bitten twice that June.
paras.zh: 十天后，蒂吉拉再次外出就餐，点了一份牛排。当她的脸肿起来时，她的男朋友开车送她去急诊室。医生对她进行了检查，看是否有蜱虫携带的疾病。蒂吉拉住在伊利诺伊州卡本代尔，那年六月被咬了两次。

paras.en: Tiguila went home and the next morning, as she was drinking coffee with her usual supplement of bovine collagen for joint, hair and nail health, the test results came in. She had developed a red meat allergy that’s activated by tick bites. "I immediately dumped that coffee down the sink," says Tiguila. She started avoiding all mammal products — the main way to manage this rising and occasionally life-threatening allergy.
paras.zh: 蒂吉拉回到家，第二天早上，当她喝咖啡时，她通常补充牛胶原蛋白以维持关节、头发和指甲的健康，测试结果出来了。她对红肉过敏，蜱虫叮咬会引起这种过敏。 “我立即把咖啡倒进水槽里，”蒂吉拉说。她开始避免使用所有哺乳动物产品——这是控制这种不断上升、有时甚至危及生命的过敏症的主要方法。

paras.en: Known as alpha-gal syndrome, the condition arises when the immune system reacts to a certain sugar molecule, called alpha-gal, that’s found in red meat. Symptoms range from a mild rash or stomach upset to anaphylactic shock; in 2025, alpha-gal syndrome was blamed for the death of an otherwise healthy 47-year-old man. The syndrome has only recently been characterized and is still not fully understood. Though Tiguila, who is a nurse, was aware of the allergy, she says she still failed to connect her rash to her meaty meals and earlier tick bites.
paras.zh: 这种疾病被称为α-半乳糖综合症，当免疫系统对红肉中的某种糖分子（称为α-半乳糖）发生反应时就会出现这种情况。症状范围从轻微皮疹或胃部不适到过敏性休克； 2025 年，一名原本健康的 47 岁男子的死亡被归咎于 alpha-gal 综合症。该综合征最近才被定性，但仍未完全了解。尽管蒂吉拉是一名护士，她知道自己过敏，但她说，她仍然无法将皮疹与她吃的肉和之前被蜱虫叮咬联系起来。

paras.en: As ticks have spread northward, so too have alpha-gal diagnoses. Up to 450,000 people in the United States may have been affected since 2010, the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention estimates.
paras.zh: 随着蜱虫向北传播，α-gal 诊断也随之向北传播。据美国疾病控制与预防中心估计，自 2010 年以来，美国可能有多达 45 万人受到影响。

paras.en: "It's emerging as one of the top adult-onset food allergies," says Onyinye Iweala, an allergist and immunologist at the University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill.
paras.zh: “它正在成为最常见的成人食物过敏之一，”北卡罗来纳大学教堂山分校的过敏症专家和免疫学家 Onyinye Iweala 说。

paras.en: Allergies are often mysterious, but this one is extra weird. "Alpha-gal follows none of the rules that I was taught in training about how a food allergy behaves," says Maya Jerath, an allergist and immunologist at Washington University in St. Louis and one of Tiguila's physicians. For example, unlike with other food allergies, where reactions are immediate, alpha-gal symptoms often show up hours after eating meat.
paras.zh: 过敏往往很神秘，但这一种更奇怪。 “阿尔法半乳糖不遵循我在培训中学到的有关食物过敏行为的任何规则，”圣路易斯华盛顿大学的过敏症专家和免疫学家、蒂吉拉的医生之一玛雅·杰拉斯 (Maya Jerath) 说。例如，与其他立即反应的食物过敏不同，α-半乳糖过敏症状通常在吃肉数小时后出现。

paras.en: Get the world’s most fascinating discoveries delivered straight to your inbox.
paras.zh: 将世界上最迷人的发现直接发送到您的收件箱。

paras.en: And, strangely, the allergy often arises after a tick bite. In the early 2000s, Jerath recalls, Australian allergist and clinician Sheryl van Nunen first shared tales on the scientific-conference circuit of patients with a delayed allergic reaction to red meat after tick bites. "Nobody believed her," Jerath says.
paras.zh: 而且，奇怪的是，过敏通常是在蜱虫叮咬后出现的。 Jerath 回忆道，2000 年代初，澳大利亚过敏症专家兼临床医生 Sheryl van Nunen 首次在科学会议上分享了一些患者在被蜱虫叮咬后对红肉出现迟发性过敏反应的故事。 “没有人相信她，”杰拉斯说。

paras.en: The eventual unraveling of the mystery would happen on the other side of the world, where immunologist Thomas Platts-Mills, unaware of van Nunen's findings, was pursuing two parallel projects in his lab at the University of Virginia in Charlottesville. In one, his group was collecting blood samples from people claiming weird meat sensitivities. In the other, they were investigating patients' strange reactions to the cancer drug cetuximab. It would take both projects to crack the case, recalls Scott Commins, an allergist who was then part of the lab and now works at the University of North Carolina.
paras.zh: The eventual unraveling of the mystery would happen on the other side of the world, where immunologist Thomas Platts-Mills, unaware of van Nunen's findings, was pursuing two parallel projects in his lab at the University of Virginia in Charlottesville.在其中一项研究中，他的团队正在从那些声称对肉类过敏的人身上采集血液样本。另一方面，他们正在调查患者对癌症药物西妥昔单抗的奇怪反应。斯科特·康明斯 (Scott Commins) 回忆道，需要两个项目才能破案。斯科特·康明斯当时是该实验室的一员，现在在北卡罗来纳大学工作。

paras.en: First, the cancer strand. Cetuximab is a drug designed to stick to cancer cells and block their overzealous growth. It was first approved to treat colorectal cancer in 2004, but as its testing and use spread, an odd pattern appeared. In the Southeastern United States, more than one in five patients had allergic reactions to the drug — hives, difficulty breathing and even anaphylaxis.
paras.zh: 首先，癌症链。西妥昔单抗是一种旨在粘附癌细胞并阻止其过度生长的药物。它于 2004 年首次被批准用于治疗结直肠癌，但随着其测试和使用的扩展，出现了一种奇怪的模式。在美国东南部，超过五分之一的患者对该药物有过敏反应——荨麻疹、呼吸困难甚至过敏反应。

paras.en: It took about a year and a half, Commins recalls, but Platts-Mills' group found the culprit. People who reacted badly to cetuximab, they discovered, had blood loaded with proteins called IgE antibodies. When activated inappropriately, IgE causes allergies. The cancer patients with the allergic reactions to cetuximab had IgE antibodies that were reacting specifically to the sugar alpha-gal, the researchers reported in 2008.
paras.zh: 康明斯回忆说，花了大约一年半的时间，但普拉茨-米尔斯的团队找到了罪魁祸首。他们发现，对西妥昔单抗反应严重的人的血液中含有称为 IgE 抗体的蛋白质。当 IgE 激活不当时，会引起过敏。研究人员于 2008 年报道，对西妥昔单抗过敏的癌症患者体内存在对糖 α-gal 产生特异性反应的 IgE 抗体。

paras.en: Now, humans (and many other primates) don't make alpha-gal. But most mammals do. It's one of several sugars that cells attach to proteins to regulate their final structure and function. And cetuximab, like many drugs, is manufactured in lab-grown mouse cells. These cells had attached alpha-gal molecules to the cetuximab. That's what triggered the allergic reactions in the cancer patients.
paras.zh: 现在，人类（和许多其他灵长类动物）不产生α-gal。但大多数哺乳动物都是如此。它是细胞附着在蛋白质上以调节其最终结构和功能的几种糖之一。与许多药物一样，西妥昔单抗是在实验室培养的小鼠细胞中制造的。这些细胞已将 α-gal 分子附着到西妥昔单抗上。这就是引发癌症患者过敏反应的原因。

paras.en: But it only happened in some of the people taking the drug. Why them? And why only in the Southeastern United States?
paras.zh: 但这种情况只发生在一些服用药物的人身上。为什么是他们？为什么只发生在美国东南部？

paras.en: The next clues came from the lab's other work, on meat sensitivities. This puzzle, of course, also involved exposure to tissues from non-primate mammals — so the researchers hypothesized that this allergy had the same cause as the drug reactions. Sure enough, they found that people with meat sensitivity also had elevated IgE antibodies to alpha-gal, causing a "novel and severe food allergy," the team reported in 2009.
paras.zh: 接下来的线索来自该实验室关于肉类敏感性的其他工作。当然，这个谜题还涉及接触非灵长类哺乳动物的组织，因此研究人员假设这种过敏与药物反应的原因相同。果然，他们发现对肉类敏感的人的 α-半乳糖 IgE 抗体也升高，导致“新奇且严重的食物过敏”，该团队在 2009 年报告。

paras.en: The allergy is bizarre for several reasons. There's the delay that van Nunen had noticed. And food allergies are typically triggered by protein: egg protein, nut protein, etc. While some carbohydrates have been linked to mild allergies, a sugar causing such severe reactions was unheard of, says Jeffrey Wilson, an allergist and immunologist at UVA Health in Charlottesville, Virginia.
paras.zh: 这种过敏现象很奇怪，有几个原因。范努南注意到了延迟。食物过敏通常是由蛋白质引发的：鸡蛋蛋白、坚果蛋白等。弗吉尼亚州夏洛茨维尔 UVA Health 的过敏症专家和免疫学家杰弗里·威尔逊 (Jeffrey Wilson) 表示，虽然某些碳水化合物与轻度过敏有关，但引起如此严重反应的糖却闻所未闻。

paras.en: Plus, food allergies were supposed to be all-or-nothing: A person allergic to peanuts will always react to peanuts. Not so with alpha-gal. For example, some people react to meat alone; others might be bothered by dairy or other mammal products, such as gelatin in cosmetics or medications.
paras.zh: 另外，食物过敏被认为是要么全有要么全无：对花生过敏的人总是会对花生产生反应。 α-gal 则不然。例如，有些人只对肉有反应；有些人只对肉有反应。 others might be bothered by dairy or other mammal products, such as gelatin in cosmetics or medications.

paras.en: Because those products are common, people are exposed to alpha-gal all the time. The sugar can even be made by natural gut bacteria. In other words, most people have no problem with alpha-gal. Platts-Mills, Commins and colleagues were still missing an explanation for why only some people developed this odd sensitivity.
paras.zh: Because those products are common, people are exposed to alpha-gal all the time.这种糖甚至可以由天然肠道细菌产生。换句话说，大多数人对α-gal没有任何问题。 Platts-Mills, Commins and colleagues were still missing an explanation for why only some people developed this odd sensitivity.

paras.en: So Commins led a study of people with and without meat allergy to see what the allergic ones had in common. Might they have been exposed to some kind of fungus, or maybe a worm? No, and no.
paras.zh: 因此，康明斯领导了一项针对肉类过敏者和非肉类过敏者的研究，以了解过敏者的共同点。他们可能接触过某种真菌，或者蠕虫吗？不，也不。

paras.en: Then, a key clue emerged from a colleague down the hall. He'd had the meat allergy and joined the study, but had been doing well, so he dared to eat a sausage. Big mistake: He had a bad reaction. Testing showed his alpha-gal IgE had risen to "freakishly high levels," Commins recalls.
paras.zh: 然后，一条关键线索从大厅另一头的同事那里透露出来。他对肉类过敏并参加了这项研究，但一直表现良好，所以他敢于吃香肠。大错误：他的反应很糟糕。康明斯回忆道，测试显示他的 alpha-gal IgE 已升至“异常高的水平”。

paras.en: The colleague also had itchy spots — from recent tick bites. That got the team thinking. Commins went back to his meat-sensitive subjects to ask if they'd had tick bites. Most of the nearly 200 people answered yes. The team then learned of van Nunen's work, published in 2009, bolstering confidence that they were on the right track. Everything pointed to a tick link: The regions where people had alpha-gal antibodies overlapped with the range of the lone star tick; people who got bitten developed more alpha-gal antibodies, and people with those antibodies often also had antibodies to other lone star tick proteins, the team reported in 2011.
paras.zh: 这位同事的斑点也很痒——是最近被蜱虫叮咬造成的。这引起了团队的思考。康明斯回到对肉类敏感的受试者身上，询问他们是否被蜱虫叮咬。近200人中，大多数人的回答是肯定的。随后，团队了解到了 van Nunen 于 2009 年发表的研究成果，这增强了他们的信心：他们走在正确的道路上。一切都指向蜱虫的联系：人们拥有α-半乳糖抗体的区域与孤星蜱虫的范围重叠；研究小组在 2011 年报告说，被咬伤的人会产生更多的 α-gal 抗体，而拥有这些抗体的人通常也有针对其他孤星蜱蛋白的抗体。

paras.en: Later, biologist Shahid Karim of the University of Southern Mississippi in Hattiesburg and colleagues found alpha-gal in lone star tick salivary glands. The final clincher implicating ticks came in 2023: Commins and collaborators at the CDC reported that people with alpha-gal syndrome were more than 11 times more likely to recall finding a tick on their body than those who didn't have the allergy.
paras.zh: 后来，哈蒂斯堡南密西西比大学的生物学家沙希德·卡里姆（Shahid Karim）及其同事在孤星蜱的唾液腺中发现了α-gal。涉及蜱虫的最终结论出现在 2023 年：康明斯和 CDC 的合作者报告称，患有 alpha-gal 综合征的人回忆起自己身上有蜱虫的可能性是那些没有过敏症的人的 11 倍以上。

paras.en: Around the world, about a dozen tick species are now associated with alpha-gal allergy. In the United States, the lone star tick is the major player, and it's spreading northward, helped by warmer temperatures and exploding populations of deer that the tick feeds on.
paras.zh: Around the world, about a dozen tick species are now associated with alpha-gal allergy.在美国，孤星蜱是主要参与者，在气温升高和蜱以蜱为食的鹿数量激增的帮助下，它正在向北传播。

paras.en: Given the expanding health concerns, the CDC has pledged $10 million to support alpha-gal surveillance and awareness among health providers and the public. Scientists, meanwhile, have lingering questions about how the mysterious allergy works.
paras.zh: 鉴于日益严重的健康问题，疾病预防控制中心已承诺投入 1000 万美元来支持 alpha-gal 监测和提高卫生服务提供者和公众的认识。与此同时，科学家们对于这种神秘的过敏是如何发生的仍然存在疑问。

paras.en: The pathway from tick bite to meat allergy remains murky. Commins, who hosts a podcast about alpha-gal syndrome, speculates that the body can treat alpha-gal as either something to tolerate or something to react to. The route of exposure seems to be key: Alpha-gal in the gut, from food or bacteria, seems to promote tolerance. But exposure via the skin is a great way to trigger an allergic reaction. That reaction can overshadow the tolerance, often temporarily, Commins says. This hypothesis fits some of the allergy's features: A strong reaction to the initial bite, or getting lots of bites, boosts risk. Fresh tick bites can also exacerbate or reactivate the sensitivity.
paras.zh: 从蜱虫叮咬到肉类过敏的途径仍然不明朗。康明斯主持了一个有关α-半乳糖综合症的播客，他推测身体可以将α-半乳糖视为可以耐受的东西或可以对其做出反应的东西。暴露途径似乎是关键：肠道中来自食物或细菌的α-半乳糖似乎可以促进耐受性。但通过皮肤接触是引发过敏反应的好方法。康明斯说，这种反应可能会掩盖耐受性，而且通常是暂时的。这个假设符合过敏的一些特征：对最初的叮咬或多次叮咬的强烈反应会增加风险。新鲜的蜱虫叮咬也会加剧或重新激活敏感性。

paras.en: Researchers don't really know why certain ticks cause the allergy and others don’t. One possibility: Perhaps the lone star tick's taste for human blood, combined with, as Commins notes, its wickedly long skin-piercing mouthparts, underlie this species' proclivity to incite allergy.
paras.zh: 研究人员并不真正知道为什么某些蜱虫会引起过敏，而另一些蜱虫却不会。一种可能性是：正如康明斯指出的那样，也许孤星蜱对人类血液的嗜好，再加上其邪恶的长刺穿皮肤的口器，导致了该物种诱发过敏的倾向。

paras.en: Also puzzling: Some people get tick bites and don't develop the allergy, and some alpha-gal patients don't report any history of tick bites. Some people have high levels of IgE antibodies to alpha-gal but can enjoy cheeseburgers freely. Others are sensitive to meats but have low concentrations of the allergic IgE.
paras.zh: Also puzzling: Some people get tick bites and don't develop the allergy, and some alpha-gal patients don't report any history of tick bites.有些人的 alpha-gal IgE 抗体水平很高，但可以随意享用芝士汉堡。 Others are sensitive to meats but have low concentrations of the allergic IgE.

paras.en: Karim, for his part, is trying to figure out what causes some tick victims' immune reactions to flip from alpha-gal tolerance to allergy. Some research suggests that blood type is a risk factor. Type B blood proteins contain a structure similar to the alpha-gal sugar, and this could promote tolerance, making people with type B or AB blood less likely to develop IgE antibodies to alpha-gal.
paras.zh: 卡里姆则试图找出是什么原因导致一些蜱虫受害者的免疫反应从α-半乳糖耐受性转变为过敏。一些研究表明血型是一个危险因素。 B 型血蛋白含有与 α-gal 糖相似的结构，这可以促进耐受性，使 B 型或 AB 型血的人不太可能产生针对 α-gal 的 IgE 抗体。

paras.en: Another unresolved question is the odd symptom delay. Wilson speculates that it could be explained if the alpha-gal sugar is hooked to meat fats, rather than meat proteins. Fats take longer for the body to digest and transmit into the bloodstream, so only then would the alpha-gal sugar gain the notice of immune cells.
paras.zh: 另一个未解决的问题是奇怪的症状延迟。威尔逊推测，如果α-半乳糖与肉脂肪而不是肉蛋白结合，就可以解释这一点。脂肪需要更长的时间才能被身体消化并传输到血液中，因此只有这样，α-半乳糖才会引起免疫细胞的注意。

paras.en: For some people, their elevated IgE levels will drop and the allergy will go away. In others, it lingers. And sometimes it seems to morph into a generalized disorder where people have allergy-like symptoms even when they avoid meat, says Iweala.
paras.zh: 对于某些人来说，升高的 IgE 水平会下降，过敏也会消失。在其他方面，它却挥之不去。伊韦拉说，有时它似乎会演变成一种全身性疾病，即使人们不吃肉，也会出现类似过敏的症状。

paras.en: For now, there are no specific therapies for alpha-gal. Allergists can suggest antihistamines and offer EpiPens to thwart a reaction. Some prescribe Xolair (omalizumab), a general allergy treatment that can minimize symptoms if a person encounters alpha-gal. To avoid activating or exacerbating alpha-gal syndrome, the best approach is to avoid tick-ridden areas or use insect repellents like picaridin on skin and permethrin on clothing.
paras.zh: 目前，还没有针对 alpha-gal 的具体疗法。过敏症专家可以建议使用抗组胺药并提供 EpiPens 来阻止反应。有些人会开 Xolair（奥马珠单抗），这是一种一般过敏治疗方法，可以在一个人遇到 α-gal 时最大程度地减轻症状。为了避免激活或加剧α-半乳糖综合症，最好的方法是避开蜱虫出没的地方或在皮肤上使用派卡瑞丁和在衣服上使用氯菊酯等驱虫剂。

paras.en: And Commins hopes to create a better treatment. It's known that an immune signaling molecule called IL-4 is key to the allergic response. He's in discussions with pharmaceutical companies to test a treatment that would interrupt this IL-4 messaging.
paras.zh: 康明斯希望创造出更好的治疗方法。众所周知，一种称为 IL-4 的免疫信号分子是过敏反应的关键。他正在与制药公司讨论测试一种可以中断 IL-4 信息传递的治疗方法。

paras.en: Better therapeutics would certainly be welcome. Alpha-gal syndrome can cause anxiety, since mammal-derived products are ubiquitous and hard to avoid. Tiguila, when she was first diagnosed, went into a label-checking frenzy; she almost threw a bag of prunes across the room because it contained a possibly mammal-derived additive.
paras.zh: 更好的治疗方法肯定会受到欢迎。 Alpha-gal 综合症会引起焦虑，因为哺乳动物衍生产品无处不在且难以避免。当蒂吉拉第一次被确诊时，她陷入了疯狂的标签检查之中。她差点把一袋李子扔到房间另一边，因为里面含有可能来自哺乳动物的添加剂。

paras.en: After visiting the Washington University clinic and being advised to relax around foods that didn't bother her, Tiguila calmed down. She still enjoys the great outdoors but is careful to slather on insect repellent first.
paras.zh: 在参观了华盛顿大学诊所并被建议在不困扰她的食物周围放松后，蒂吉拉平静了下来。她仍然喜欢户外活动，但会先小心地涂上厚厚的驱虫剂。

paras.en: She recently received more good news: In August of 2026, her blood tested negative for IgE antibodies against alpha-gal, suggesting that her allergy might be gone. Her physicians prescribed a reintroduction protocol they had developed for patients who hit this milestone. She started with an ounce of filet mignon, a low-fat cut, and amped up the exposure from there. "I've successfully returned many people to eating meat again," Jerath says. In one study, her protocol worked for all 19 participants.
paras.zh: 她最近收到了更多好消息：2026年8月，她的血液检测发现针对α-gal的IgE抗体呈阴性，这表明她的过敏可能已经消失了。她的医生为达到这一里程碑的患者制定了重新引入方案。她从一盎司菲力牛排（低脂切块）开始，然后增加了曝光度。 “我成功地让很多人重新吃肉，”杰拉斯说。在一项研究中，她的方案对所有 19 名参与者都有效。

paras.en: Add Tiguila to that total: As of late September, she is back to her usual diet. "I'm very grateful to be cleared and not have to be so cautious," she says.
paras.zh: 将 Tiguila 添加到这个总数中：截至 9 月下旬，她已恢复正常饮食。她说：“我很高兴能够获得许可，不必那么谨慎。”

paras.en: Amber Dance is an award-winning freelance science writer based in Southern California. She is a contributor at Knowable Magazine, program director for the New Horizons in Science Briefings at the Sciencewriters annual conference for the Council for the Advancement of Science Writing and an instructor teaching Science Writing I for UCLA Extension.
paras.zh: 安布尔·丹斯 (Amber Dance) 是一位居住在南加州的屡获殊荣的自由科普作家。她是《Knowable》杂志的撰稿人、科学写作促进委员会科学作家年会上科学简报新视野项目的主任，也是加州大学洛杉矶分校扩展课程科学写作 I 的讲师。

articles.title: Oldest male orca on record may have been identified thanks to historical atomic bomb testing
articles.author: Patrick Pester

paras.en: Nuclear fallout has potentially revealed the oldest male orca ever recorded, scientists have found.
paras.zh: 科学家发现，核尘埃可能揭示了有史以来最古老的雄性虎鲸。

paras.en: The radioactive residue, a result of bomb testing in previous decades, was preserved in the teeth of orcas (Orcinus orca) and sperm whales (Physeter macrocephalus) that washed up over the years in Scotland, according to a recent study.
paras.zh: 根据最近的一项研究，这些放射性残留物是前几十年炸弹测试的结果，保存在苏格兰多年来被冲上岸的逆戟鲸（Orcinus orca）和抹香鲸（Physeter macrocephalus）的牙齿中。

paras.en: "It gives us what we call a kind of bomb pulse," study first author Kieran Tierney, a research scientist at the Scottish Universities Environmental Research Centre, told Live Science.
paras.zh: “它给我们带来了一种所谓的炸弹脉冲，”该研究的第一作者、苏格兰大学环境研究中心的研究科学家基兰·蒂尔尼告诉《生活科学》。

paras.en: Male orcas are thought to have a maximum lifespan of around 50 to 60 years. However, in the recent study, published Oct. 1 in the journal Frontiers in Marine Science, the radiocarbon signature identified in one stranded male suggested he had lived to more than 65 years old.
paras.zh: 据认为，雄性虎鲸的最长寿命约为 50 至 60 年。然而，在 10 月 1 日发表在《海洋科学前沿》杂志上的最新研究中，在一名搁浅男性身上发现的放射性碳特征表明，他已经活到了 65 岁以上。

paras.en: The research team noted that the radiocarbon data doesn't provide a precise age. However, that doesn't mean the estimate is implausible.
paras.zh: 研究小组指出，放射性碳数据并不能提供精确的年龄。然而，这并不意味着这个估计不可信。

paras.en: Maximum ages are notoriously difficult to measure in nature — researchers can't track every animal to see which individual lives longest in all species — and there isn't an extensive worldwide record of orca longevity.
paras.zh: 众所周知，自然界中的最大年龄很难测量——研究人员无法追踪每一种动物来了解所有物种中哪一个个体寿命最长——而且全球范围内也没有关于虎鲸寿命的广泛记录。

paras.en: "The age estimates we have from life history studies are only a few decades old and researchers have only looked at limited numbers of individuals from a few orca populations," said Erich Hoyt, co-chair of the IUCN Important Marine Mammal Area Specialist Group and author of "Orca: The Whale Called Killer" (Firefly Books, 2019). "It would not surprise me if male killer whales were sometimes living to age 65 and beyond," Hoyt, who was not involved in the study, told Live Science in an email.
paras.zh: IUCN 重要海洋哺乳动物区域专家组联合主席、《逆戟鲸：被称为杀手的鲸鱼》（Firefly Books，2019 年）一书的作者埃里希·霍伊特 (Erich Hoyt) 说：“我们从生活史研究中得出的年龄估计只有几十年的历史，研究人员只研究了少数虎鲸种群中数量有限的个体。” “如果雄性虎鲸有时能活到 65 岁甚至更久，我不会感到惊讶，”未参与这项研究的霍伊特在一封电子邮件中告诉《Live Science》。

paras.en: Get the world’s most fascinating discoveries delivered straight to your inbox.
paras.zh: 将世界上最迷人的发现直接发送到您的收件箱。

paras.en: Orcas and sperm whales have banded growth layers in their teeth, which researchers believe form every year, like the rings in a tree trunk. To test this idea and learn more about the animals washing up in Scotland, the authors of the new study examined teeth from three orcas stranded between 1995 and 2016, and from two sperm whales stranded in the 1990s.
paras.zh: 逆戟鲸和抹香鲸的牙齿上有带状生长层，研究人员认为这些生长层每年都会形成，就像树干上的年轮一样。为了验证这个想法并更多地了解苏格兰被冲上岸的动物，这项新研究的作者检查了 1995 年至 2016 年间搁浅的三头虎鲸和 1990 年代搁浅的两只抹香鲸的牙齿。

paras.en: Atomic weapons testing, particularly during the middle of the 20th century, unleashed vast quantities of radioactive material, including radiocarbon, which subsequently entered the marine environment and is preserved in the teeth of cetaceans like sperm whales and orcas. Radiocarbon exists naturally in the atmosphere, but the detonation of these bombs significantly spiked environmental levels of this radioactive isotope, so by measuring levels of this compound, researchers could identify whether animals lived through the testing era.
paras.zh: 原子武器试验，特别是在 20 世纪中叶，释放了大量放射性物质，包括放射性碳，这些物质随后进入海洋环境，并保存在抹香鲸和逆戟鲸等鲸目动物的牙齿中。放射性碳自然存在于大气中，但这些炸弹的爆炸显着提高了这种放射性同位素的环境水平，因此通过测量这种化合物的水平，研究人员可以确定动物是否经历了测试时代。

paras.en: Banded layers in the sperm whale teeth matched the atomic data, with the two whales estimated to have died in their 20s and 40s, respectively, suggesting that the layers formed annually at least in early- to mid-life. However, while the tooth layers and atomic age matched for one of the orcas — estimating the animal was in its early 20s — the other male's data didn't match at all, according to the study.
paras.zh: 抹香鲸牙齿中的带状层与原子数据相匹配，两条鲸鱼估计分别在 20 多岁和 40 多岁时死亡，这表明这些层至少每年在生命早期到中年形成。然而，根据研究，虽然其中一只虎鲸的牙齿层和原子年龄相匹配（估计该动物只有 20 岁出头），但另一只雄性虎鲸的数据却完全不匹配。

paras.en: The oddball orca, named KW2, stranded in Uist, an island in western Scotland in 2015. The tooth analysis suggested that KW2 lived into his 50s, but the radiocarbon analysis suggested he was at least 65 when he died. Tierney speculated that either a cluster of layers appeared in the tooth as a single year, or new layers stopped forming in later years.
paras.zh: 这只奇怪的逆戟鲸名叫 KW2，于 2015 年搁浅在苏格兰西部的尤伊斯特岛。牙齿分析表明 KW2 活到了 50 多岁，但放射性碳分析表明他死时至少有 65 岁。蒂尔尼推测，要么在一年内牙齿中出现了一层簇，要么在以后的几年里新的层停止形成。

paras.en: "We think that the tooth effectively ran out of space to put down any more layers," Tierney said.
paras.zh: 蒂尔尼说：“我们认为，牙齿实际上已经没有足够的空间来放下更多的层了。”

paras.en: The banded layers and atomic data also didn't match for the study's only female orca, named Lulu. In Lulu's case, she didn't have a clear bomb pulse signal, making comparisons difficult. The tooth layers suggested she was in her 30s when she died, while her radiocarbon signal was indicative of historic nuclear plant discharges in the Irish Sea in the latter half of the 20th century, which were carried to the Scottish west coast.
paras.zh: 带状层和原子数据也与该研究中唯一的雌性虎鲸（名叫露露）不匹配。就露露而言，她没有明显的炸弹脉冲信号，因此很难进行比较。牙齿层显示她去世时年龄为 30 多岁，而她的放射性碳信号表明 20 世纪下半叶爱尔兰海历史性核电站的排放，这些排放被带到了苏格兰西海岸。

paras.en: By looking at stable isotopes of carbon and nitrogen in the tooth samples, the researchers identified traces of what the animals might have eaten. Lulu appears to have had a higher proportion of marine mammals in her diet than the males, which seemed to eat more fish, according to the study.
paras.zh: 通过观察牙齿样本中碳和氮的稳定同位素，研究人员确定了动物可能吃过的食物的痕迹。研究显示，露露的饮食中海洋哺乳动物的比例似乎高于雄性，而雄性似乎吃更多的鱼。

paras.en: Orcas' diets vary across different populations, and Lulu's is likely tied to her community. She was part of Scotland's West Coast Community — a genetically distinct orca population on the brink of extinction — before she stranded in 2016. The West Coast Community is known to prey on other marine mammals.
paras.zh: 逆戟鲸的饮食因不同种群而异，而露露的饮食可能与她的社区有关。在 2016 年搁浅之前，她是苏格兰西海岸社区的一部分，该社区是一个基因独特的逆戟鲸种群，濒临灭绝。众所周知，西海岸社区捕食其他海洋哺乳动物。

paras.en: Lulu was famous for being the last known female in the West Coast Community. The population hasn't produced any calves in the decades researchers have studied it. Now down to just two surviving males, the remaining bulls are expected to be the last of their kind.
paras.zh: 露露因是西海岸社区最后一位已知的女性而闻名。研究人员研究了几十年来，这个种群没有产下任何幼崽。现在只剩下两只幸存的公牛，剩下的公牛预计将是同类中的最后一头。

paras.en: While the West Coast Community's living bulls weren't part of the new study, they are thought to be more than 50 years old. This longevity, combined with the estimated age of KW2, raises tantalizing questions for future orca research.
paras.zh: 虽然西海岸社区的活牛并未被纳入这项新研究中，但据信它们的年龄已超过 50 岁。这种长寿，加上 KW2 的估计年龄，为未来虎鲸研究提出了诱人的问题。

paras.en: Tierney noted that until now, orca studies have mostly focused on populations off the Pacific coast of North America. There, males have a mama's boy reputation; they're typically observed spending their entire lives with their mothers, with life expectancy dropping significantly after their mothers die. But if male orcas are living longer lives off Scotland, and the West Coast Community's bulls are getting by without their mothers' support, then it's possible they could be more independent than their North American Pacific counterparts.
paras.zh: 蒂尔尼指出，到目前为止，虎鲸研究主要集中在北美太平洋沿岸的种群。在那里，男性享有“妈妈男孩”的美誉；人们通常观察到他们一生都与母亲一起度过，母亲去世后预期寿命显着下降。但如果雄性虎鲸在苏格兰附近的寿命更长，并且西海岸社区的公牛在没有母亲支持的情况下也能生存，那么它们可能会比北美太平洋的同类更加独立。

paras.en: "It looks like the killer whales around our shores maybe do something a little bit different," Tierney said.
paras.zh: “看起来我们海岸附近的虎鲸可能会做一些不同的事情，”蒂尔尼说。

paras.en: Tierney, K. M., McGill, R. A. R., Brownlow, A., Sayle, K. L., Tripney, B. G., Dunbar, E., Newton, J., Terrapon, M., Doeschate, M. T. I. T., Davison, N. J., Timmons, Z., & Kitchener, A. C. (2026). Integrating radiocarbon and stable isotopes in odontocete teeth to reveal life histories. Frontiers in Marine Science, 13. https://doi.org/10.3389/fmars.2026.1934180
paras.zh: Tierney, K. M.、McGill, R. A. R.、Brownlow, A.、Sayle, K. L.、Tripney, B. G.、Dunbar, E.、Newton, J.、Terrapon, M.、Doschate, M. T. I. T.、Davison, N. J.、Timmons, Z. 和 Kitchener, A. C. (2026)。将放射性碳和稳定同位素整合到齿鲸牙齿中以揭示生命史。海洋科学前沿，13。https://doi.org/10.3389/fmars.2026.1934180

paras.en: Patrick Pester is the trending news writer at Live Science. His work has appeared on other science websites, such as BBC Science Focus and Scientific American. Patrick retrained as a journalist after spending his early career working in zoos and wildlife conservation. He was awarded the Master's Excellence Scholarship to study at Cardiff University where he completed a master's degree in international journalism. He also has a second master's degree in biodiversity, evolution and conservation in action from Middlesex University London. When he isn't writing news, Patrick investigates the sale of human remains.
paras.zh: 帕特里克·佩斯特 (Patrick Pester) 是《Live Science》的热门新闻撰稿人。他的作品曾出现在其他科学网站上，例如 BBC Science Focus 和 Scientific American。帕特里克在其早期职业生涯从事动物园和野生动物保护工作后，接受了记者再培训。他获得了硕士卓越奖学金，前往卡迪夫大学学习，并在那里完成了国际新闻学硕士学位。他还拥有伦敦密德萨斯大学生物多样性、进化和保护实践的第二个硕士学位。当帕特里克不写新闻时，他会调查人类遗骸的买卖。

articles.title: What Can 300 Years of European Portraits Reveal About Evolving Beauty Standards?

paras.en: Long before the invention of photography, wealthy Europeans commissioned portraits to preserve their likenesses for posterity. But portraits aren’t necessarily faithful reproductions of reality. Like photos, they can be manipulated to accentuate flattering features, portraying subjects as they wish to be seen.
paras.zh: 早在摄影术发明之前，富有的欧洲人就委托拍摄肖像来为子孙后代保存自己的肖像。但肖像不一定是现实的忠实再现。就像照片一样，它们可以被操纵来突出迷人的特征，以他们希望被看到的方式描绘主题。

paras.en: As it happens, those choices can tell us a great deal about how ideal beauty standards have evolved over time. According to a study published last week in the journal Proceedings of the Royal Society B, historic portraits serve as “cognitive fossils” that shed new light on “historical shifts in psychological preferences and reproductive strategies.”
paras.zh: 事实上，这些选择可以告诉我们很多关于理想的美容标准如何随着时间的推移而演变的信息。根据上周发表在《英国皇家学会学报 B》杂志上的一项研究，历史肖像作为“认知化石”，为“心理偏好和生殖策略的历史转变”提供了新的线索。

paras.en: “They cover a much longer timespan than photographs, which allows us to observe changes across several centuries,” lead author Jeanne Bovet, a behavioral scientist at England’s Northumbria University, tells El País’ Miguel Ángel Criado. “They were created to be seen by others—suitors, relatives, society—and therefore reflect the messages people wanted to convey.”
paras.zh: “它们涵盖的时间跨度比照片长得多，这使我们能够观察几个世纪以来的变化，”主要作者、英国诺森比亚大学的行为科学家珍妮·博韦特 (Jeanne Bovet) 告诉国家报的米格尔·安赫尔·克里亚多 (Miguel Ángel Criado)。 “它们的创建是为了让其他人——追求者、亲戚、社会——看到，因此反映了人们想要传达的信息。”

paras.en: The researchers analyzed 606 women in 486 European portraits created between 1650 and 1950. They then recruited roughly 1,500 participants to assess various aspects of the subjects’ appearances. One group received cropped images of subjects’ faces and guessed their ages, while another group rated their attractiveness. A third group estimated each woman’s waist-to-hip ratio by examining full portraits with blurred-out faces.
paras.zh: 研究人员分析了 1650 年至 1950 年间创作的 486 幅欧洲肖像画中的 606 名女性。然后，他们招募了大约 1,500 名参与者来评估受试者外貌的各个方面。一组收到受试者脸部的裁剪图像并猜测他们的年龄，而另一组则评估他们的吸引力。第三组通过检查脸部模糊的完整肖像来估计每个女性的腰臀比。

paras.en: Waist-to-hip ratio is calculated by dividing someone’s waist circumference by their hip circumference. Women with lower ratios have more of an hourglass shape, with larger hips and smaller waists, while those with higher ratios have a straighter silhouette.
paras.zh: 腰臀比是通过将某人的腰围除以臀围来计算的。比例较低的女性更倾向于沙漏型身材，臀部较大，腰部较小，而比例较高的女性则有更直的轮廓。

paras.en: - In 2019, a study published in the journal Archives of Sexual Behavior found that the contrapposto pose—standing with weight shifted onto one leg—can lower perceived waist-to-hip ratio.
paras.zh: - 2019 年，发表在《性行为档案》杂志上的一项研究发现，反向姿势（站立并将重量转移到一条腿上）可以降低腰臀比。

paras.en: - This pose appears in many famous artworks, from Sandro Botticelli’s Birth of Venus (circa 1485) to Michelangelo’s David (1504).
paras.zh: - 这个姿势出现在许多著名的艺术作品中，从桑德罗·波提切利的《维纳斯的诞生》（约 1485 年）到米开朗基罗的《大卫》（1504 年）。

paras.en: The researchers found that subjects’ perceived waist-to-hip ratios have increased over time. “We confirmed an upward trend across those three centuries, although there were fluctuations,” Bovet tells El País. Ratios bottomed out in the mid-18th century, which produced works like The Souvenir (circa 1776-78) by Jean-Honoré Fragonard, a French Rococo painter. The painting depicts a woman in a light pink dress, cinched tightly around the waist. Her perceived waist-to-hip ratio was 0.51.
paras.zh: 研究人员发现，随着时间的推移，受试者感知到的腰臀比有所增加。 “我们证实了这三个世纪的上升趋势，尽管存在波动，”播维告诉《国家报》。比率在 18 世纪中叶触底，出现了法国洛可可画家让-奥诺雷·弗拉戈纳尔 (Jean-Honoré Fragonard) 的《纪念品》（约 1776-78 年）等作品。这幅画描绘了一个穿着浅粉色连衣裙的女人，腰间紧紧地系着。她的感知腰臀比为 0.51。

paras.en: A century later, the French artist Pierre-Paul-Léon Glaize created Before the Mirror (1873), which depicts a woman in a looser gown that isn’t fitted to accentuate her curves. Raters estimated this subject’s waist-to-hip ratio at 0.72.
paras.zh: 一个世纪后，法国艺术家皮埃尔-保罗-莱昂·格莱兹 (Pierre-Paul-Léon Glaize) 创作了《镜前》(Before the Mirror)（1873 年），画中描绘了一位穿着宽松礼服的女性，礼服不合身，无法凸显她的曲线。评估者估计该受试者的腰臀比为 0.72。

paras.en: What drove this evolution? The study’s authors explain that lower waist-to-hip ratios are traditionally linked to youth and fertility. “Evolutionary psychologists have proposed that a preference for a low [waist-to-hip ratio], or a more hourglass-shaped silhouette, might reflect a preference for more fertile partners,” Bovet tells Science magazine’s Jack Tamisiea.
paras.zh: 是什么推动了这种演变？该研究的作者解释说，较低的腰臀比传统上与年轻和生育能力有关。 “进化心理学家提出，对低腰臀比或沙漏形轮廓的偏好可能反映出对生育能力更强的伴侣的偏好，”播维告诉《科学》杂志的杰克·塔米西亚。

paras.en: The researchers think that the upward trend may be connected to other societal shifts during this 300-year period. Women began having children at older ages—and having fewer children overall. Infant mortality declined, and women spent more time pursuing education.
paras.zh: 研究人员认为，这种上升趋势可能与这 300 年间的其他社会转变有关。女性开始生孩子的年龄较大，而且总体上生孩子的数量较少。婴儿死亡率下降，女性花更多时间接受教育。

paras.en: According to the raters, subjects in later portraits also appeared to be older. While women’s waist-to-hip ratios do increase with age, the upward trend in ratios persisted even when researchers controlled for perceived facial age. Perceived body weight, meanwhile, remained relatively stable.
paras.zh: 据评估者称，后来的肖像画中的拍摄对象似乎也更老了。虽然女性的腰臀比确实随着年龄的增长而增加，但即使研究人员控制了感知的面部年龄，比例的上升趋势仍然持续。与此同时，感知体重保持相对稳定。

paras.en: “Women’s education kept rising during that time, but models’ proportions barely changed,” he tells Science. “To me, that suggests the fashion industry itself shapes its body ideals at least as much as social change does.”
paras.zh: “在那段时间里，女性的教育程度不断提高，但模特的比例几乎没有变化，”他告诉《科学》杂志。 “对我来说，这表明时尚业本身对身体理想的塑造至少与社会变革一样多。”

articles.title: Look Up This Week to See November's Full Beaver Moon—the First of Four Back-to-Back Supermoons Over the Coming Months

paras.en: We’re in for a dazzling treat over the next few months. Four consecutive supermoons will grace our skies from November through February. The second in the series—and the last of 2026—will fall on Christmas Eve and represents the closest full moon to Earth since 2018, according to Live Science’s Jamie Carter.
paras.zh: 在接下来的几个月里，我们将迎来一场令人眼花缭乱的盛宴。从十一月到二月，连续四次超级月亮将为我们的天空增光添彩。据 Live Science 的杰米·卡特 (Jamie Carter) 称，该系列中的第二颗满月，也是 2026 年的最后一颗满月，将于圣诞节前夕发生，这是自 2018 年以来距离地球最近的满月。

paras.en: The supermoon sequence starts with this month’s full moon on the 24th, which will reach peak illumination at 9:53 a.m. Eastern time. The orb won’t be visible from North America then, so the best time to see it is after sunset on the day before or day of. The next supermoons in the spectacular series will take place on December 24, January 22 and February 20, according to AstroPixels.com, a website by the late astrophysicist Fred Espenak.
paras.zh: 超级月亮序列从本月 24 日的满月开始，将于东部时间上午 9:53 达到峰值亮度。届时从北美将看不到该球体，因此观看它的最佳时间是前一天或当天的日落之后。据已故天体物理学家 Fred Espenak 的网站 AstroPixels.com 称，这一壮观系列的下一次超级月亮将于 12 月 24 日、1 月 22 日和 2 月 20 日发生。

paras.en: The moon’s 27-day orbit around our planet is shaped like an oval, which means it drifts closer and farther from us as it transitions through its phases. The closest point along its orbital path, or perigee, is around 226,000 miles from Earth, while its farthest point, or apogee, is around 251,000 miles away.
paras.zh: 月球绕地球运行 27 天的轨道形状像一个椭圆形，这意味着它随着相位的转变，离我们越来越近。其轨道路径上的最近点（或近地点）距地球约 226,000 英里，而最远点（或远地点）距地球约 251,000 英里。

paras.en: When perigee roughly “coincides with a full moon, it is called a supermoon,” Devon Salasin, head astronomer and site manager at Stargazing Moab, tells National Geographic’s Stefanie Waldek. In other words, a supermoon is a full moon that occurs when the moon is near its closest point to Earth.
paras.zh: 当近地点大致“与满月重合时，它被称为超级月亮”，观星摩押的首席天文学家兼现场经理德文·萨拉辛（Devon Salasin）告诉国家地理杂志的斯蒂芬妮·瓦尔德克（Stefanie Waldek）。换句话说，超级月亮是当月球接近地球最近点时发生的满月。

paras.en: While the term suggests an impressive celestial display, a supermoon is actually only 7 percent bigger than an average full moon, according to Josh Morley at the Farmer’s Almanac. It can look up to 14 percent brighter and 30 percent bigger than the faintest moon of the year, which happens at apogee. However, skywatchers probably won’t notice a difference if viewing our celestial companion with the naked eye.
paras.zh: 根据《农民年鉴》的乔什·莫利 (Josh Morley) 的说法，虽然这个词暗示着令人印象深刻的天象，但超级月亮实际上只比普通满月大 7%。它看起来比一年中最暗的月亮（发生在远地点）亮 14%，大 30%。然而，如果用肉眼观察我们的天体同伴，天文观察者可能不会注意到任何差异。

paras.en: Additionally, supermoon is not an official astronomical term, so which moons count as one depends on who you ask. According to NASA and the Royal Observatory Greenwich in London, a supermoon is a full moon that occurs within 10 percent of perigee. Some astronomers have stricter guidelines, however, saying that supermoons only occur when the moon is within about 223,694 miles of Earth, says Carys Herbert, an astronomer at the Royal Observatory Greenwich, to BBC Newsround.
paras.zh: 此外，超级月亮并不是一个官方的天文学术语，因此哪些卫星算作超级月亮取决于你问的是谁。根据美国国家航空航天局 (NASA) 和伦敦格林威治皇家天文台的说法，超级月亮是指发生在近地点 10% 范围内的满月。然而，格林威治皇家天文台的天文学家卡里斯·赫伯特 (Carys Herbert) 向 BBC Newsround 表示，一些天文学家制定了更严格的指导方针，称只有当月球距离地球约 223,694 英里时，才会出现超级月亮。

paras.en: November’s full moon will be 224,171 miles away from Earth; December’s will be 221,668 miles away; January’s will be 222,230 miles away; and February’s will be 225,748 miles away. Some astronomers using the more rigid definition don’t consider the last one to be a supermoon.
paras.zh: 11 月的满月将距离地球 224,171 英里； 12 月的距离为 221,668 英里；一月的距离为 222,230 英里； 2 月的距离为 225,748 英里。一些使用更严格定义的天文学家不认为最后一个是超级月亮。

paras.en: Which guidance you follow also determines just how rare the December 24 supermoon is.
paras.zh: 您遵循的指南也决定了 12 月 24 日超级月亮的罕见程度。

paras.en: “Taking the stricter definition, the most recent Christmas Eve full moon perigee was 1787, but with the more generous definition which appears to increasingly be the standard, then this also occurred in 2007 and 1912,” Herbert tells BBC Newsround.
paras.zh: “按照更严格的定义，最近的圣诞夜满月近地点是 1787 年，但随着更宽松的定义似乎越来越成为标准，那么这也发生在 2007 年和 1912 年，”赫伯特告诉 BBC Newsround。

paras.en: Whether or not it’s a supermoon, November’s full moon is always dubbed the “beaver” moon. During this month, the furry animals reinforce their lodges and dams for winter, which is a popular Algonquin and colonial explanation for the name, according to Daniel Higgins at the Farmer’s Almanac. Another possible reason is that November kicks off trapping season: It’s cold enough for the large rodents to have grown their thick winter coats, but there’s little snow on the ground to get in trappers’ way.
paras.zh: 无论是否是超级月亮，十一月的满月总是被称为“海狸”月亮。根据《农民年鉴》中的丹尼尔·希金斯的说法，在这个月里，毛茸茸的动物会加固它们的小屋和水坝过冬，这是阿尔冈昆和殖民时期对这个名字的流行解释。另一个可能的原因是十一月开始了诱捕季节：天气足够冷，大型啮齿类动物已经长出了厚厚的冬毛，但地面上的积雪很少，无法妨碍诱捕者。

paras.en: Tomorrow’s celestial event might get in the way of Thanksgiving travel, unfortunately. The alignment of the sun, Earth and moon produces full moons that cause a greater difference between high and low tides than usual, meteorologist Brian Lada writes for AccuWeather. The effect can be stronger when full moons are closer to Earth, so the beaver moon might contribute to coastal flooding just before the holiday.
paras.zh: 不幸的是，明天的天体活动可能会妨碍感恩节旅行。气象学家布赖恩·拉达 (Brian Lada) 为 AccuWeather 撰文，太阳、地球和月球的排列产生了满月，导致涨潮和低潮之间的差异比平常更大。当满月距离地球较近时，这种影响可能会更强，因此海狸月可能会在假期前导致沿海洪水。

articles.title: Peggy Guggenheim's First Art Gallery Lasted Just 18 Months. But Its 21 Exhibitions Showed a Multitude of Modern Art Masterpieces

paras.en: Long before Peggy Guggenheim became synonymous with her palazzo art museum on Venice’s Grand Canal, she launched her art collecting career in a modest storefront on London’s Cork Street. Between January 1938 and June 1939, her short-lived gallery, Guggenheim Jeune, introduced skeptical British audiences to radical European modernism and laid the groundwork for one of the 20th century’s most influential art collections.
paras.zh: 早在佩吉·古根海姆成为威尼斯大运河上的宫殿艺术博物馆的代名词之前，她就在伦敦科克街的一家不起眼的店面开始了自己的艺术收藏生涯。 1938 年 1 月至 1939 年 6 月期间，她的短命画廊古根海姆·杰恩 (Guggenheim Jeune) 向持怀疑态度的英国观众介绍了激进的欧洲现代主义，并为 20 世纪最有影响力的艺术收藏之一奠定了基础。

paras.en: Now, a new exhibition at London’s Royal Academy of Arts, “Peggy Guggenheim in London: The Making of a Collector,” brings together more than 80 artworks and archival artifacts to re-examine that pivotal 18-month chapter. Running through March 14, 2027, after an earlier stint in Venice, the show argues that Guggenheim’s prewar London venture has been unfairly overshadowed by her later fame and sensationalized personal life.
paras.zh: 现在，伦敦皇家艺术学院举办的新展览“佩吉·古​​根海姆在伦敦：收藏家的成长”汇集了 80 多件艺术品和档案文物，重新审视这长达 18 个月的关键篇章。该剧在威尼斯短暂停留后，一直持续到 2027 年 3 月 14 日，该剧认为，古根海姆战前在伦敦的事业不公平地被她后来的名声和耸人听闻的个人生活所掩盖。

paras.en: “I think she’s been underrated,” Gražina Subelytė, a curator at the Peggy Guggenheim Collection in Venice and a co-curator of the London exhibition tells the BBC’s Cath Pound. “People talk so much about her relationships, all the advisors who helped her make decisions, but Peggy was really groundbreaking herself.”
paras.zh: “我认为她被低估了，”威尼斯佩吉·古根海姆美术馆馆长、伦敦展览的联合策展人格拉齐娜·苏贝利特 (Gražina Subelytė) 告诉英国广播公司 (BBC) 的凯思·庞德 (Cath Pound)。 “人们谈论了很多她的人际关系，以及所有帮助她做出决定的顾问，但佩吉本人确实具有开创性。”

paras.en: Born in New York in 1898, Guggenheim grew up on the fringes of immense family wealth; her father, Benjamin Guggenheim, squandered much of his fortune before dying aboard the Titanic in 1912. Eager to escape upper-crust convention, she volunteered in her youth at New York’s woman-owned, avant-garde Sunwise Turn Bookshop, an experience that showed her how “a woman could do something extremely creative and independent,” Simon Grant, co-curator of the exhibition, tells the BBC.
paras.zh: 古根海姆 1898 年出生于纽约，在巨大的家庭财富的边缘长大。她的父亲本杰明·古根海姆 (Benjamin Guggenheim) 于 1912 年在泰坦尼克号上去世前挥霍了自己的大部分财产。为了摆脱上流社会的传统，她年轻时曾在纽约女性拥有的前卫 Sunwise Turn 书店做志愿者，这次经历向她展示了如何“一个女人可以做一些极具创意和独立的事情”，展览联合策展人西蒙·格兰特 (Simon Grant) 告诉 BBC。

paras.en: Guggenheim consorted with major figures in the creative world, who helped shape her views on abstraction and modern art. During a trip to Paris, Irish playwright Samuel Beckett urged her to devote herself to contemporary art as “a living thing,” per the BBC. Marcel Duchamp tutored her on the nuances of abstraction and surrealism, the Guardian’s Olivia McEwan reports. In 1937, a $450,000 inheritance (around $5 million today) following her mother’s death gave the 39-year-old Guggenheim the means to act.
paras.zh: 古根海姆与创意界的主要人物交往，他们帮助塑造了她对抽象和现代艺术的看法。据英国广播公司报道，在巴黎之行期间，爱尔兰剧作家塞缪尔·贝克特敦促她将当代艺术视为“有生命的事物”投身其中。据《卫报》的奥利维亚·麦克尤恩报道，马塞尔·杜尚指导她了解抽象和超现实主义的细微差别。 1937 年，39 岁的古根海姆在母亲去世后得到了 45 万美元的遗产（如今约为 500 万美元），这为她提供了采取行动的手段。

paras.en: Peggy Guggenheim’s uncle, Solomon R. Guggenheim, commissioned architect Frank Lloyd Wright to design a museum in New York City for his vast art collection. Sixteen years later, the Solomon R. Guggenheim Museum opened its doors.
paras.zh: 佩吉·古根海姆的叔叔所罗门·R·古根海姆委托建筑师弗兰克·劳埃德·赖特在纽约市为其庞大的艺术收藏品设计一座博物馆。十六年后，所罗门·R·古根海姆博物馆开门迎客。

paras.en: - Peggy was unwilling to have the works she collected be shown at what she called “my uncle’s garage, that Frank Lloyd Wright thing on Fifth Avenue.”
paras.zh: - 佩吉不愿意让她收集的作品在她所说的“我叔叔的车库，第五大道上弗兰克·劳埃德·赖特的车库”展出。

paras.en: Back in London, influential British art historian and critic Herbert Read served as Guggenheim’s “general galvanizer” in shaking up the Mayfair gallery scene, the London Times’ Laura Freeman writes. Gallery manager Winifred “Wyn” Henderson secured the 30 Cork Street premises and tapped her professional network ahead of the January 1938 opening.
paras.zh: 《伦敦时报》的劳拉·弗里曼 (Laura Freeman) 写道，回到伦敦后，颇具影响力的英国艺术史学家和评论家赫伯特·里德 (Herbert Read) 成为古根海姆的“总动员”，撼动了梅​​菲尔区的画廊界。画廊经理 Winifred “Wyn” Henderson 在 1938 年 1 月开业之前锁定了科克街 30 号的场地，并利用了她的专业网络。

paras.en: Over the next year and a half, the gallery staged 21 exhibitions. It hosted the United Kingdom’s first solo shows for Jean Cocteau, Wassily Kandinsky and Yves Tanguy, who also painted a pair of tiny shell-and-pearl earrings for Guggenheim with miniature surrealist works, according to a statement. Other shows spotlighted women artists and children’s art—including a painting by a teenage Lucian Freud.
paras.zh: 在接下来的一年半里，画廊举办了 21 场展览。据一份声明称，这里举办了让·谷克托 (Jean Cocteau)、瓦西里·康定斯基 (Wassily Kandinsky) 和伊夫·唐吉 (Yves Tanguy) 在英国的首次个展，他们还为古根海姆 (Guggenheim) 创作了一对带有超现实主义微型作品的小型贝壳珍珠耳环。其他展览则重点关注女性艺术家和儿童艺术，其中包括青少年卢西恩·弗洛伊德的画作。

paras.en: “Guggenheim Jeune is where Peggy Guggenheim defined herself through action: exhibiting, taking risks, and forming friendships with artists,” Subelytė and Grant tell Wallpaper’s Hannah Silver.
paras.zh: “古根海姆青年号是佩吉·古根海姆通过行动定义自己的地方：展览、冒险以及与艺术家建立友谊，”苏贝利特和格兰特告诉《壁纸》的汉娜·西尔弗。

paras.en: Those risks frequently collided with British institutional conservatism. When Guggenheim imported sculptures by Constantin Brâncuși, Jean Arp and Henry Moore for a group show, British customs officials refused to recognize the abstract works as art and moved to tax them as raw stone. Tate director J.B. Manson backed the officials, declaring the pieces were not art, a ruling that sparked a debate in the House of Commons before Guggenheim ultimately prevailed. “Mr. Manson not only lost his case, but pretty soon his job as well,” Guggenheim later wrote. “I thus rendered a great service to foreign artists and to England.”
paras.zh: 这些风险经常与英国机构保守主义发生冲突。当古根海姆进口康斯坦丁·布朗库西、让·阿尔普和亨利·摩尔的雕塑进行群展时，英国海关官员拒绝承认这些抽象作品是艺术品，并开始将它们作为原石征税。泰特美术馆馆长 J.B. 曼森 (J.B. Manson) 支持官员的决定，宣称这些作品不是艺术品，这一裁决在古根海姆最终获胜之前在下议院引发了一场辩论。 “曼森先生不仅输掉了官司，而且很快也失去了工作，”古根海姆后来写道。 “因此，我为外国艺术家和英国提供了巨大的服务。”

paras.en: According to the exhibition catalogue, at least 60 percent of the works currently on view at the Royal Academy were originally displayed at Guggenheim Jeune, reflecting the difficulty of fully reassembling a long-lost gallery, per the Guardian. Original highlights include a Salvador Dalí painting, Kandinsky’s Dominant Curve and Wolfgang Paalen’s sponge-covered umbrella.
paras.zh: 据《卫报》报道，根据展览目录，目前在皇家艺术学院展出的作品中，至少有 60% 最初是在新古根海姆展出的，这反映出完全重新组建一个失落已久的画廊的难度。原创亮点包括萨尔瓦多·达利的画作、康定斯基的主曲线和沃尔夫冈·帕伦的海绵雨伞。

paras.en: Concluding, as she confided to a friend, that “the London public [was] apathetic to modern art,” Guggenheim closed the gallery in June 1939, according to the Telegraph’s Alastair Sooke.
paras.zh: 据《每日电讯报》的阿拉斯泰尔·苏克 (Alastair Sooke) 报道，古根海姆向一位朋友透露，她得出的结论是“伦敦公众对现代艺术漠不关心”，并于 1939 年 6 月关闭了画廊。

paras.en: Months later, as World War II erupted, she traveled to France, snapping up works by Pablo Picasso, Piet Mondrian and Paul Klee even after the Louvre declined to safeguard her collection from the Nazis because it was deemed too modern. Smuggling the art out of Europe before fleeing to New York and later settling in Venice, she cemented a legacy that began in London.
paras.zh: 几个月后，第二次世界大战爆发，她前往法国，抢购巴勃罗·毕加索、皮特·蒙德里安和保罗·克利的作品，尽管卢浮宫拒绝保护她的藏品免受纳粹分子的侵害，因为她认为这些藏品过于现代。她将艺术品偷运出欧洲，然后逃往纽约，后来定居威尼斯，巩固了始于伦敦的遗产。

paras.en: “She undeniably left her mark,” Guggenheim’s granddaughter Karole Vail tells the London Times’ Etan Smallman. “And, thanks to this exhibition, people—at least I hope—will understand how critical she really was to the development of modern and contemporary art in England.”
paras.zh: “无可否认，她留下了自己的印记，”古根海姆的孙女卡罗尔·韦尔告诉伦敦时报的伊坦·斯莫曼。 “而且，通过这次展览，人们——至少我希望——能够理解她对英国现当代艺术的发展到底有多么重要。”

paras.en: “Peggy Guggenheim in London: The Making of a Collector” is on view at the Royal Academy of Arts in London through March 14, 2027.
paras.zh: “佩吉·古​​根海姆在伦敦：收藏家的成长”将于 2027 年 3 月 14 日在伦敦皇家艺术学院展出。

articles.title: 10 Best Office Chairs of 2026—We Tested 70 to Pick Them
articles.author: Matthew Korfhage,  Nena Farrell

paras.en: There Are Three things you don’t skimp on if you want a happy life: a good mattress, a good pair of shoes, and the best office chair you can find. Each is key to a world free of unnecessary pain. Finding the right ergonomic chair can be the difference between a satisfying and focused home office life and a squirmy day filled with cricks and small dissatisfactions.
paras.zh: 如果你想要幸福的生活，有三样东西是你不能吝惜的：一张好床垫、一双好鞋和一张你能找到的最好的办公椅。每一个都是通往一个没有不必要痛苦的世界的关键。找到合适的符合人体工程学的椅子可能是令人满意和专注的家庭办公生活与充满颤抖和小不满的不安一天之间的区别。

paras.en: The best desk chair is almost always an adjustable chair—one that can be tailored to your body’s unique shape and that offers enough lumbar support to avoid back problems even after long hours at the grind. Many chairs also utilize materials that can dissipate body heat, so you’re not stuck in Zoom meetings with a sweaty back. But the chair options out there can be bewildering. Luckily, the WIRED Reviews team has spent more than seven years sorting them out. WIRED Gear editor Julian Chokkattu has tested more than 60 chairs at his last tally. Former reviewer Matthew Korfhage and other staffers have tried more than a dozen more, and most of our top picks have been tested by multiple people with different heights and body types.
paras.zh: 最好的办公椅几乎总是一把可调节的椅子，它可以根据您身体的独特形状量身定制，并且提供足够的腰部支撑，即使在长时间工作后也能避免背部问题。许多椅子还采用可以散热的材料，这样您就不会在 Zoom 会议中背部出汗。但市面上的椅子选择可能会让人眼花缭乱。幸运的是，《连线》评论团队花了七年多的时间来整理它们。 WIRED Gear 编辑 Julian Chokkattu 在上次统计中测试了 60 多把椅子。前审稿人马修·科尔夫哈格（Matthew Korfhage）和其他工作人员已经尝试了十多种，我们的大多数首选都经过了多个不同身高和体型的人的测试。

paras.en: WIRED’s favorite office chair for most people is the Branch Ergonomic Chair Pro ($499) because of its balance between value, features, comfort, and adjustability. That chair, and its lower-budget Ergonomic Chair ($369) cousin, have been tested and attested to by multiple WIRED reviewers. But we also offer chairs for every budget, from the preternaturally comfortable Steelcase Gesture ($1,611) to a $150 chair from Staples that leaves cheap Amazon brands in the dust.
paras.zh: 《连线》杂志最喜欢的办公椅是 Branch Ergonomic Chair Pro（499 美元），因为它在价值、功能、舒适性和可调节性之间取得了平衡。该椅子及其低预算人体工学椅子（369 美元）已经过《连线》多位评论家的测试和证明。但我们也提供适合各种预算的椅子，从极其舒适的 Steelcase Gesture（1,611 美元）到 150 美元的 Staples 椅子，让廉价的亚马逊品牌望尘莫及。

paras.en: We all have differing body types and needs, which is why we’ve put together a broad collection of recommendations—and why we enlist people of all sizes to keep testing our top picks for comfort and durability. Hopefully, we have a home office chair for you here.
paras.zh: 我们都有不同的体型和需求，这就是为什么我们汇总了广泛的建议，也是为什么我们招募各种身材的人来不断测试我们的首选产品的舒适性和耐用性。希望我们在这里为您提供一把家庭办公椅。

paras.en: For more home office buying guides, check out our Best Standing Desks, Best Laptop Stands, Best Home Office Gear, Best Mechanical Keyboards, and Best Webcams guides.
paras.zh: 有关更多家庭办公室购买指南，请查看我们的最佳站立式办公桌、最佳笔记本电脑支架、最佳家庭办公装备、最佳机械键盘和最佳网络摄像头指南。

paras.en: Updated November 2026: We've added Uplift's Clarksville Ergonomic Drafting Chair as a pick and ensured up-to-date links and prices.
paras.zh: 2026 年 11 月更新：我们添加了 Uplift 的 Clarksville 人体工学绘图椅作为选择，并确保提供最新的链接和价格。

paras.en: Love WIRED? Add us as a preferred source on Google to see more of us.
paras.zh: 喜欢《连线》吗？将我们添加为 Google 上的首选来源，以了解更多我们的信息。

paras.en: The right chair can only go so far. Your sitting habits and posture matter too. We've rounded up several tips on how to set up your desk properly here, and how to avoid tech neck, but here are a few highlights.
paras.zh: 正确的椅子只能走这么远。您的坐姿习惯和姿势也很重要。我们在这里总结了一些关于如何正确设置办公桌以及如何避免技术瓶颈的提示，但这里有一些亮点。

paras.en: Sitting for long stretches during a day is not good for your health, no matter what chair you use. It increases the risk of type 2 diabetes, stroke, and heart disease. The best thing you can do is get up and move every half hour. If you can, a 40-minute walk per day can, according to a recent study, make a big difference in countering some effects of a sedentary lifestyle. You probably don't need to bother with an active chair. Home office users should consider a standing desk that lets you swap between standing and sitting work positions during the day. A smartwatch can help too. Most have movement reminders that encourage you to stretch your legs. If you're dealing with back pain, consult your physician first.
paras.zh: 无论您使用什么椅子，一天中长时间坐着都不利于您的健康。它会增加患 2 型糖尿病、中风和心脏病的风险。你能做的最好的事情就是每半小时站起来活动一下。根据最近的一项研究，如果可以的话，每天步行 40 分钟可以在对抗久坐生活方式的一些影响方面发挥巨大作用。您可能不需要费心使用活动椅子。家庭办公室用户应该考虑使用站立式办公桌，让您可以在白天在站立和坐着工作位置之间切换。智能手表也能提供帮助。大多数都有运动提醒，鼓励您伸展双腿。如果您患有背痛，请先咨询您的医生。

paras.en: Make sure your chair's armrests are adjustable. Your palms should be elevated over your desk, which should be at elbow level, and your wrists should be straight. If the bottom of your palm is resting on the desk or wrist rest, there's a chance you're putting too much pressure on your nerves, which could lead to issues like carpal tunnel syndrome. Talk to your physician if you're feeling any kind of pain. A gaming mouse, often more ergonomic than a standard mouse, might be helpful; just make sure to find one that fits your palm size.
paras.zh: 确保椅子的扶手是可调节的。您的手掌应高于桌面，桌面应与肘部齐平，并且手腕应伸直。如果您的手掌底部放在桌子或腕托上，则可能会对神经施加太大压力，这可能会导致腕管综合症等问题。如果您感到任何疼痛，请咨询您的医生。游戏鼠标通常比标准鼠标更符合人体工程学，可能会有所帮助；只需确保找到一款适合您手掌大小的产品即可。

paras.en: When you look forward, your eyes should align with the top of your monitor or laptop. That might mean finding a chair that can adjust up and down, elevating your laptop with a stand, or raising the height of your monitor. This puts less pressure on your neck and spine—you shouldn't be craning your neck up or down.
paras.zh: 当您向前看时，您的眼睛应与显示器或笔记本电脑的顶部对齐。这可能意味着找到一把可以上下调节的椅子，用支架抬高笔记本电脑，或者提高显示器的高度。这会减轻颈部和脊柱的压力——您不应该向上或向下伸长脖子。

paras.en: A good rule of thumb is that the more adjustable a chair is, the better. This gives you the possibility to mold it to your body shape, which hopefully makes it a comfier and more supportive seat. Here's what you should be able to adjust on a chair.
paras.zh: 一个好的经验法则是椅子的可调节性越强越好。这使您可以根据您的体型塑造它，这有望使其成为一个更舒适且更具支撑性的座椅。以下是您应该能够在椅子上进行调整的内容。

paras.en: Armrests: Most chairs let you move the armrests side to side, up and down, forward and back. It's even nicer when you're able to lock the armrest into place so that they don't slide around as your elbows rest on them. The armrest should naturally allow your palms to slightly hover over the desk. You'll often see descriptors like “4D” and “5D" adjustable armrests, which denote how many directions you can adjust them.
paras.zh: 扶手：大多数椅子都可以让您左右、上下、前后移动扶手。如果您能够将扶手锁定到位，这样当您的肘部放在扶手上时，扶手就不会滑动，那就更好了。扶手应该自然地让你的手掌稍微悬停在桌子上。您经常会看到诸如“4D”和“5D”可调节扶手之类的描述符，它们表示您可以调节扶手的多个方向。

paras.en: Seat height: It's worth checking a chair's maximum and minimum height before you buy because they might not work for your current desk (unless you have a standing desk where you can adjust the height). This is usually controlled with a pneumatic lift lever under the chair—pull the lever and get off the seat to let the chair go up, then sit on it and pull the lever to bring it down to your preference. Your feet should be planted on the floor at a 90- or 100-degree angle. If your chair arrives and it doesn't get as high as you'd like, don't worry, there's a very simple fix. Some office chair brands offer “tall cylinders" for not a lot of money, and if not, you can usually find third-party options on retailers like Amazon (make sure you buy for your specific chair!). Simply swap your existing cylinder with the tall version, and you'll have a greater height range to work with. You may be able to choose this option before checking out, or reach out to the company to see if they can swap it for you.
paras.zh: 座椅高度：在购买之前检查椅子的最大和最小高度是值得的，因为它们可能不适用于您当前的办公桌（除非您有一张可以调节高度的站立式办公桌）。这通常是通过椅子下方的气动升降杆来控制的——拉动杠杆并离开座椅，让椅子升起，然后坐在上面并拉动杠杆，将其降低到您喜欢的位置。你的脚应该以 90 度或 100 度角放在地板上。如果您的椅子到达后没有达到您想要的高度，请不要担心，有一个非常简单的修复方法。一些办公椅品牌提供的“高筒”价格并不高，如果没有，您通常可以在亚马逊等零售商上找到第三方选项（确保您购买的是您的特定椅子！）。只需将现有的气缸更换为高版本，您就可以使用更大的高度范围。您可以在结账之前选择此选项，或者联系该公司，看看他们是否可以为您更换。

paras.en: Seat depth: Seat depth is important for taller folks. There is usually a mechanism that lets you pull the seat out so that your thighs get the proper support. There should be one to two inches between the front of the seat and the back of your knees. Taller people with longer legs may not get the best support if they can't adjust the seat depth.
paras.zh: 座椅深度：座椅深度对于身材较高的人来说很重要。通常有一种机制可以让您将座椅拉出，以便您的大腿得到适当的支撑。座椅前部和膝盖后部之间应有一到两英寸的距离。如果身材较高、腿较长的人无法调节座椅深度，他们可能无法获得最佳支撑。

paras.en: Seat tilt: This isn't as common as the above adjustments, but tilting the seat up or down may help posture and prevent back pain, though it can take some getting used to.
paras.zh: 座椅倾斜：这并不像上述调整那么常见，但向上或向下倾斜座椅可能有助于调整姿势并防止背部疼痛，尽管可能需要一些时间来适应。

paras.en: Lumbar support: Most office chairs offer lumbar support, which can look like a separate piece attached to the backrest that can slide up and down or back and forth. This piece supports your lower back (the lumbar region), specifically maintaining the curve of the spine to maintain good posture as you sit and, ideally, warding off back pain. Check your chair manufacturer's assembly instructions to learn how to adjust the lumbar support, and place the support on the curve of your lower back. What I like to do is run my hand along my spine until I reach the natural dip, then I try to make sure the lumbar support sits at that exact location. Some chairs also let you adjust the depth of the lumbar support, pushing it further inward or outward. Make sure it feels natural and that it's not digging in. Play around with this until it feels comfortable. Your shoulders should align with your hips, and you shouldn't feel like you're leaning forward.
paras.zh: 腰部支撑：大多数办公椅都提供腰部支撑，它看起来像是连接在靠背上的一个单独部件，可以上下或前后滑动。该产品支撑您的下背部（腰部区域），特别是保持脊柱的弯曲，以在您坐着时保持良好的姿势，并在理想情况下避免背部疼痛。检查椅子制造商的组装说明，了解如何调整腰部支撑，并将支撑放置在下背部的曲线上。我喜欢做的就是用手沿着脊柱移动，直到达到自然倾斜，然后我尝试确保腰部支撑位于该确切位置。有些椅子还可以让您调整腰部支撑的深度，将其进一步向内或向外推。确保它感觉自然并且不会陷入困境。尝试这个直到感觉舒服为止。你的肩膀应该与臀部对齐，并且你不应该感觉自己向前倾斜。

paras.en: Recline: Almost every office chair lets you lock or unlock the recline, but some go a step further and let you tweak the tension of the recline. This allows you to use more or less force when you lean back, which comes down to how much resistance you want when you lean back.
paras.zh: 倾斜：几乎每把办公椅都可以让您锁定或解锁倾斜，但有些更进一步，可以让您调整倾斜的张力。这使您在向后倾斜时可以使用或多或少的力量，这取决于您向后倾斜时需要多少阻力。

paras.en: Testing home office chairs is not for the minimalist. Former WIRED reviewer Matthew Korfhage and WIRED editor Julian Chokkattu—who's tested office chairs for seven years—might have four or five office chairs in their home at any given time. That's because office chairs take time to test. We sit in each for at least two weeks before we offer the barest opinion, because it takes time to gauge comfort. Some chairs take a moment to break in, and it can take even longer to gauge the supportiveness of each chair. Julian is 6' 4," and Matthew is 6' 1." But we solicit feedback from people of various heights while testing, including Julian's 5' 1" wife. Any chair that Matthew recommends but can't keep is used long-term by a durability tester, ideally a different height.
paras.zh: 测试家庭办公椅不适合极简主义者。 《连线》前评论员 Matthew Korfhage 和《连线》编辑朱利安·乔卡图（Julian Chokkattu）对办公椅进行了七年的测试，在任何特定时间，他们家里可能有四到五把办公椅。那是因为办公椅需要时间来测试。在我们提供最简单的意见之前，我们每个人都会坐至少两周，因为需要时间来衡量舒适度。有些椅子需要一段时间才能磨合，甚至可能需要更长的时间来衡量每把椅子的支撑性。朱利安身高 6 英尺 4 英寸，马修身高 6 英尺 1 英寸。但我们在测试时征求了不同身高的人的反馈，包括朱利安身高 5 英尺 1 英寸的妻子。任何马修推荐但无法保留的椅子都会由耐用性测试人员长期使用，最好是不同的高度。

paras.en: We try out all the adjustments throughout the testing period, both to see how the settings affect comfort, but also to check for tolerances and jiggle, which are red flags for durability: Seat adjustments, and armrest adjustments, are often the places where lesser chairs can fail first, long before the fabric starts to pill.
paras.zh: 我们在整个测试期间尝试所有的调整，既是为了看看设置如何影响舒适度，也是为了检查公差和抖动，这是耐用性的危险信号：座椅调整和扶手调整通常是较小的椅子最先出现故障的地方，早在织物开始起球之前。

paras.en: But it's not just about durability and lumbar support. These chairs will live in a home office for years, so aesthetics are important as well. We also research each chair company, looking into their warranties, customer service, customer feedback, reports to consumer agencies, and overall reliability. An office chair is meant to be a long-term investment. If a company can't stand behind its products, WIRED won't either.
paras.zh: 但这不仅仅是耐用性和腰部支撑。这些椅子将在家庭办公室中使用多年，因此美观也很重要。我们还研究每家主席公司，调查他们的保修、客户服务、客户反馈、向消费者机构的报告以及整体可靠性。办公椅是一项长期投资。如果一家公司不能为其产品提供支持，《连线》杂志也不会。

paras.en: How Does WIRED Select Chairs to Be Reviewed?
paras.zh: 《连线》如何选择接受评审的主席？

paras.en: We routinely look at the market to find new office chairs that have hit the scene, whether it's from a newcomer or an established brand like Herman Miller. We check in on most chairs that someone credible has called their favorite, though we might not end up agreeing—and we're always on the lookout for chairs that fill a specific niche in the market. Julian and Matthew typically reach out to these companies to ask for the product, but do not promise any kind of editorial coverage—that goes against WIRED's editorial policies. Yes, WIRED earns affiliate revenue if you purchase an office chair using our link, but this is not factored into the decision-making process.
paras.zh: 我们经常关注市场，寻找流行的新办公椅，无论是新品牌还是像 Herman Miller 这样的老牌品牌。我们检查了大多数被可信人士称为他们最喜欢的椅子，尽管我们最终可能不会同意——而且我们总是在寻找能够填补市场上特定利基的椅子。朱利安和马修通常会联系这些公司索取产品，但不承诺提供任何形式的社论报道——这违反了《连线》的社论政策。是的，如果您使用我们的链接购买办公椅，《连线》将获得联属收入，但这不会纳入决策过程。

paras.en: This said, we can't test every single chair that hits the market, in part because our testing regimen usually involves weeks of testing. And so you may indeed find some notable missing options in this guide, even after seven years of testing. We'll keep filling in the blanks on the top options in the market, and test new entrants.
paras.zh: 也就是说，我们无法测试上市的每把椅子，部分原因是我们的测试方案通常需要数周的测试。因此，即使经过七年的测试，您确实可能会在本指南中发现一些值得注意的缺失选项。我们将继续填补市场上顶级选项的空白，并测试新进入者。

paras.en: After we've finished testing a chair, we either donate to Goodwill or keep it on hand for durability testing. Julian keeps top picks like the Branch Ergonomic Chair Pro, Herman Miller Embody, and Anthros V2 on hand to test against future contenders. Matthew does the same, but also places some chairs in the hands of durability testers of different heights, in order to see how they fare with different body types and how they hold up over time.
paras.zh: 当我们完成椅子的测试后，我们要么捐赠给慈善机构，要么将其保留在手边进行耐用性测试。 Julian 保留了 Branch Ergonomic Chair Pro、Herman Miller Embody 和 Anthros V2 等首选产品，以与未来的竞争者进行测试。马修也做了同样的事情，但也将一些椅子放在不同高度的耐久性测试人员手中，以了解它们在不同体型下的表现以及随着时间的推移它们的承受力如何。

paras.en: Does My Office Chair Need Lumbar Support?
paras.zh: 我的办公椅需要腰部支撑吗？

paras.en: In short, probably. If you sit in a chair all day, you likely want a chair with lumbar support.
paras.zh: 简而言之，可能是。如果您整天坐在椅子上，您可能需要一把有腰部支撑的椅子。

paras.en: We lead unnatural lives, evolutionarily speaking: The human body was not meant to sit for eight hours at a time in the same position. Unless you, blessed creature, have perfect posture—a difficult achievement when typing at a keyboard and looking at a monitor—the lower curve of your back might need a little extra support when sitting for long spans.
paras.zh: 从进化的角度来说，我们过着不自然的生活：人体不应该以同一个姿势连续坐八个小时。除非你，受祝福的生物，拥有完美的姿势——在键盘上打字和看着显示器时这是一个困难的成就——当你长时间坐着时，你的背部下部曲线可能需要一点额外的支撑。

paras.en: A relatively flat-backed or concave chair will often grant excellent support to your shoulders and back, but leave your lower back to fend for itself. Eventually, it complains.
paras.zh: 相对平背或凹面的椅子通常可以为您的肩膀和背部提供出色的支撑，但会让您的下背部自行保护。最终，它抱怨了。

paras.en: “Your back has this natural curve to it, and if you're sitting in a chair that doesn't help support that natural S-curve, over time, it's going to feel a little bit less comfortable,” said Kristianne Egbert, an ergonomist at Briotix Health, in an interview with WIRED about lumbar support in late 2025. “When you're sitting in a forward, hunched position, and don't have that curve in your lower back, it increases the forces on the discs in your lower back, definitely resulting in discomfort.”
paras.zh: “你的背部有这种自然的曲线，如果你坐在一张不能帮助支撑自然 S 曲线的椅子上，随着时间的推移，你会感觉有点不舒服，”Briotix Health 的人体工学家 Kristianne Egbert 在 2025 年底接受《连线》杂志关于腰部支撑的采访时说道。增加了下背部椎间盘的受力，肯定会导致不适。”

paras.en: Experts are pretty univocal on the benefits of lumbar support. But not all lumbar support is created equal. Look for lumbar support that's adjustable, especially vertically so that the curve of the chair can line up with the curve of your back. Horizontal adjustability can adjust support to the level that's most comfortable for you. Cheaper chairs are less likely to offer adjustable support, and can instead make you feel like you're being pushed.
paras.zh: 专家们对于腰部支撑的好处非常明确。但并非所有腰部支撑都是一样的。寻找可调节的腰部支撑，尤其是垂直调节的，以便椅子的曲线可以与背部的曲线对齐。水平可调性可以将支撑调整到最适合您的水平。较便宜的椅子不太可能提供可调节的支撑，反而会让您感觉自己被推着。

paras.en: This said, if you can't afford a chair with excellent adjustable lumbar support, you're not doomed to a life of pain. A low-cost lumbar pillow like this one from LoveHome offers a workable fix.
paras.zh: 也就是说，如果您买不起具有出色的可调节腰部支撑的椅子，您也不会注定要过痛苦的生活。 LoveHome 提供的一款低成本腰枕提供了一种可行的解决方案。

paras.en: Here are a few other chairs we recommend for specific needs and use cases.
paras.zh: 以下是我们针对特定需求和用例推荐的其他一些椅子。

paras.en: Arguably, the smartest-designed reclining chair we've ever tested is the Humanscale Freedom, which we first wrote about more than 20 years ago and which still inspires lean-back bliss. The reason is the way the chair adjusts itself to the weight of your body, cradling your shape at any and all reclining positions without the need for fiddly levers. Designed by legendary designer Niels Diffrient, this chair combines lovely materials and colors, plush but firm support, adjustable seat height and depth, height-adjustable lumbar support, and a headrest that both fellow WIRED reviewer Julian Chokkattu and I heartily recommend. The recline system is fundamentally unique, with the back and lumbar moving semi-independently from the headrest to keep you facing forward, not at the ceiling. It takes getting used to, but is a nice perk if you're leaning back and looking at a screen. The Humanscale is also ecologically net-positive—think rainwater catchment systems—and also quite durable. The model I tested, the Freedom Ocean, is made using recycled ocean fishnets in its headrest and reclining mechanism. The 15-year warranty is a nice assurance, as well.
paras.zh: 可以说，我们测试过的设计最智能的躺椅是 Humanscale Freedom，我们在 20 多年前首次写过它，至今仍然激发着人们向后靠的幸福感。原因在于椅子可以根据您身体的重量进行自我调整，在任何倾斜位置都可以支撑您的形状，而无需繁琐的杠杆。这把椅子由传奇设计师 Niels Diffrient 设计，结合了可爱的材料和颜色、毛绒但坚固的支撑、可调节的座椅高度和深度、可调节高度的腰部支撑，以及《连线》评论员 Julian Chokkattu 和我都衷心推荐的头枕。倾斜系统从根本上来说是独一无二的，背部和腰部从头枕半独立地移动，让您面朝前方，而不是面对天花板。这需要习惯，但如果你向后靠并看着屏幕，这是一个很好的好处。 Humanscale 在生态上也具有净积极性（想想雨水集水系统），而且也相当耐用。我测试的“Freedom Ocean”模型的头枕和倾斜机构采用回收的海洋渔网制成。 15 年保修也是一个很好的保证。

paras.en: The Vari is a much more affordable option that is also excellent for those prone to leaning back. The first time former reviewer Matthew Korfhage leaned back all the way and closed his eyes while sitting on the Vari Align office chair, he nearly conked out and missed an afternoon meeting. Despite its mesh-backed office-chair minimalism, this Align is somehow as comfortable as an old BarcaLounger when you dip it back. The reasons for this comfort are twofold. The first is the suspension system that maintains lower back support and stable balance while allowing a full 45-degree recline. The second is a cleverly designed mesh headrest that’s integrated into the chair back, forming a single sinuous curve that avoids hard edges. Like our top-pick Branch Ergonomic Pro, this Vari pairs a comfortable foam seat with the breathability and flexibility of a soft, non-abrasive mesh back. The Align is priced about as affordably, but does not offer quite the level of adjustability of the Branch. It might also be a bit too roomy or tall for those under 5' 6". The depth, but not the height, of the lumbar support can be adjusted. So can the seat depth and height, and pretty much everything about the arm position. Like all things Vari, the chair is among the easiest to assemble of any chairs we've tested, a five-minute job once you’re done unpacking.
paras.zh: Vari 是一种更实惠的选择，对于那些倾向于向后倾斜的人来说也非常适合。前审稿人 Matthew Korfhage 第一次坐在 Vari Align 办公椅上全程向后靠并闭上眼睛时，差点昏倒并错过了下午的会议。尽管这款 Align 的网背办公椅极简主义，但当你把它向后倾斜时，它在某种程度上就像旧的 BarcaLounger 一样舒适。这种舒适感的原因是双重的。第一个是悬挂系统，可保持腰部支撑和稳定的平衡，同时允许完全 45 度倾斜。第二个是设计巧妙的网状头枕，它集成到椅背中，形成一条蜿蜒的曲线，避免了硬边。与我们的首选 Branch Ergonomic Pro 一样，这款 Vari 将舒适的泡沫座椅与柔软、无磨损的网状靠背的透气性和灵活性相结合。 Align 的价格相当实惠，但无法提供 Branch 的可调节性。对于身高 5 英尺 6 英寸以下的人来说，它可能有点太宽敞或太高。腰部支撑的深度（但不是高度）可以调整。座椅深度和高度以及几乎所有有关手臂位置的东西也可以调整。与 Vari 的所有产品一样，这把椅子是我们测试过的所有椅子中最容易组装的椅子之一，打开包装后只需五分钟即可完成。

paras.en: Most ergonomic office chairs provide lumbar support to alleviate the ill effects of long-term sitting. These chairs have a different philosophy. They allow or even encourage you to move around a lot, thus avoiding the problems of sitting in one place for too long. Look for more info on these kinds of active chairs here. The consensus, after speaking with experts, is that you're better off getting a normal chair and introducing more movement into your workday, even if you're just standing up to get some water every hour. But if you need extra encouragement, these are the best options we've found.
paras.zh: 大多数符合人体工程学的办公椅都提供腰部支撑，以减轻长期坐着的不良影响。这些椅子有不同的理念。它们允许甚至鼓励您经常走动，从而避免在一个地方坐太久的问题。在这里查找有关此类活动椅子的更多信息。在与专家交谈后，大家一致认为，你最好买一把普通的椅子，并在工作日中进行更多的运动，即使你只是每小时站起来喝点水。但如果您需要额外的鼓励，这些是我们发现的最佳选择。

paras.en: The Ariel chair is designed to keep you moving. It's also the best active chair WIRED reviewer Julian Chokkattu found after testing several active chairs. The Ariel's shape targets the sitz bones in your pelvis to ensure you sit upright. Its base rocks around slightly, so your body will continually shift a little throughout the day. But also, the chair's generally aggressive form will cause you to get up more often, and move around more. There's a bit of a learning curve, noted WIRED gear team editor Julian Chokkattu, but over time he found himself with less back pain and better posture. The newer Ariel 2.0 is pricier but has a comfier seat and more stability, even with the wheels add-on. For $100 less, the 1.0 remains a solid option but has lower weight capacity.
paras.zh: Ariel 椅子旨在让您保持活动状态。这也是《连线》评论员 Julian Chokkattu 在测试了几把活动椅子后发现的最好的活动椅子。 Ariel 的形状针对您骨盆的坐骨，以确保您坐直。它的底座会轻微晃动，因此您的身体会在一天中不断移动。而且，椅子通常具有侵略性的形状会导致您更频繁地站起来，并更多地走动。 《连线》装备团队编辑朱利安·乔卡图 (Julian Chokkattu) 指出，有一点学习曲线，但随着时间的推移，他发现自己的背痛减轻了，姿势也更好了。较新的 Ariel 2.0 价格更高，但即使配备了轮子，座椅也更舒适，稳定性也更高。价格便宜 100 美元，1.0 仍然是一个不错的选择，但承重能力较低。

paras.en: A crisscross chair is designed for those for whom armrests are often the enemy: knee tuckers, crisscross sitters, stretchers, squirmers, fidgeters, and yoga practitioners. The idea is simple, allowing the armrests to fold down and be sat upon. The viral Pipersong Meditation Chair is the most famous of these, but we found the stool and chair back too small to be comfortable. WIRED contributing reviewer Nicole Kinning found this Amseatec Crisscross Chair to be wider, cushier, and more affordable.
paras.zh: 十字形椅子是为那些扶手经常成为敌人的人设计的：膝盖弯曲者、十字形坐者、担架者、蠕动者、坐立不安者和瑜伽练习者。这个想法很简单，让扶手可以折叠下来并坐在上面。其中最著名的是病毒式的 Pipersong 冥想椅，但我们发现凳子和椅背太小，不太舒服。 《连线》特约评论员 Nicole Kinning 发现这款 Amseatec Crisscross 椅子更宽、更舒适且更实惠。

paras.en: The Zeph from Herman Miller is a unicorn, mixing minimalist, mid-century modern stylings with the ergonomic considerations of a modern office chair. It hearkens to a classic Saarinen tulip, with two-tone seat pads and dozens of fetching color options. But unlike most office chairs, adjustments are nearly nil, making this more of a task chair and lovely statement piece, but with surprising comfort. The Zeph is meant to mold around your body, and mostly succeeds in doing so. It's a great compact chair for smaller spaces, as well, and the 12-year warranty is a boon.
paras.zh: Herman Miller 的 Zeph 是一只独角兽，将极简主义、中世纪现代风格与现代办公椅的人体工程学考虑融为一体。它模仿了经典的沙里宁郁金香，配有双色座垫和数十种迷人的颜色选择。但与大多数办公椅不同的是，它的调节几乎为零，这使得它更像是一把工作椅和可爱的个性单品，但具有令人惊讶的舒适度。 Zeph 旨在围绕您的身体塑造，并且基本上成功地做到了这一点。它也是一款非常适合较小空间的紧凑型椅子，并且 12 年保修期是一个福音。

paras.en: LiberNovo is a relatively new and mostly untested Hong Kong brand, and its chairs are quite literally humming with new ideas. The flashiest thing about the LiberNovo Omni Pro, released in July as the upgrade to last year's LiberNovo Omni, is the battery-powered motor that repositions the lumbar support—avoiding cumbersome fiddling with adjustments behind the chair back. This battery also runs a nifty little fan below the seat to draw away heat from the chair's cushy foam. It even has a little spinal stretching massage function that's mostly a novelty. These features are attention-getting, but also lead to worries about longevity if the motor fails.
paras.zh: LiberNovo 是一个相对较新且大多未经测试的香港品牌，它的椅子确实充满了新想法。 LiberNovo Omni Pro 于 7 月发布，是去年 LiberNovo Omni 的升级版，它最引人注目的地方是电池供电的电机，可以重新定位腰部支撑，避免在椅背后面进行繁琐的调整。该电池还在座椅下方运行一个漂亮的小风扇，以带走椅子舒适泡沫中的热量。它甚至还有一点脊柱伸展按摩功能，这在很大程度上是一个新奇的功能。这些功能很引人注目，但如果电机出现故障，也会引发人们对使用寿命的担忧。

paras.en: Gaming chairs must lean back well. They must be comfy for long hours of intense focus. And they must feel like something meant for play, not work. For more context and options, check in on WIRED's full gaming chair guide. But here are a couple standouts.
paras.zh: 游戏椅必须向后倾斜。它们必须能够舒适地长时间集中注意力。而且它们一定让人觉得是用来玩的，而不是用来工作的。如需更多背景信息和选项，请查看《连线》完整的游戏椅指南。但这里有几个突出的例子。

paras.en: Maybe it should come as no surprise, but the gaming version of WIRED's favorite office chair is also WIRED's favorite gaming chair. As with the main Branch Ergonomic Chair Pro, assembly is a breeze, the price is approachable, and the chair is both sturdy and wonderfully adjustable across a broad range of heights. The “gaming” element is mostly aesthetic, offering any of three Sega-branded styles that include a mesh-backed blue Sonic chair that offers the same breathability as the original. But if you're into leather, gaming chair reviewer Louryn Strampe found that the Dreamcast and Genesis-colorway leather-backed chairs were not sweaty when leaning back and locking in for a long gaming session. Just note that if you're 5' 1" like she is, you won't get much use out of the headrest.
paras.zh: 也许这并不奇怪，但《连线》最喜欢的办公椅的游戏版也是《连线》最喜欢的游戏椅。与主要的 Branch 人体工学椅 Pro 一样，组装轻而易举，价格平易近人，而且椅子既坚固又可在各种高度范围内进行出色的调节。 “游戏”元素主要是美观的，提供三种世嘉品牌风格中的任何一种，其中包括网背蓝色索尼克椅子，其透气性与原版相同。但如果您喜欢皮革，游戏椅评论家 Louryn Strampe 发现 Dreamcast 和 Genesis-colorway 皮革靠背椅子在长时间游戏时向后靠并锁定时不会出汗。请注意，如果您像她一样身高 5 英尺 1 英寸，那么头枕就没有多大用处。

paras.en: The Razer Iskur V2 NewGen does a solid job of mixing the typical flashy gaming chair design with something that doesn’t scream “Discord moderator.” In her few months with the chair, tester Louryn Strampe grew to really appreciate its mix of comfort and aesthetics—with adaptive lumbar support, 4D armrests, wide shoulders and a comfy seat. It's designed to stay a bit cooler than its predecessor, and remains accommodating even to cross-legged sitting. Strampe says she has successfully sat in this chair for literally 36 hours over a two-day stretch during a particularly intense Slay the Spire 2 marathon. (Judgment-free space, people.)
paras.zh: Razer Iskur V2 NewGen 出色地将典型的华丽游戏椅设计与不会尖叫“Discord 主持人”的设计融为一体。在使用这把椅子的几个月里，测试者 Louryn Strampe 逐渐真正欣赏到它的舒适性和美观性的结合——自适应腰部支撑、4D 扶手、宽肩和舒适的座椅。它的设计比其前身要凉爽一些，甚至可以盘腿坐着。 Strampe 表示，在一场特别激烈的 Slay the Spire 2 马拉松比赛中，她在为期两天的时间内成功坐在这把椅子上 36 个小时。 （人们，没有评判的空间。）

paras.en: The wheels on the bottom of your chair are among the easiest parts to replace. If your current casters don't roll smoothly or are too loud, it might be worth replacing them instead of buying a whole new chair. These from Stealtho, a Ukrainian company, are a good pick tested by WIRED reviewer Julian Chokkattu. They'll work with nearly every office chair, though the company notes they don't fit Ikea products. The soft polyurethane material means these won't scratch or chip hardwood floors, as some plastic casters do, plus it'll feel like you're silently gliding as you roll from your desk to the fridge (don't judge).
paras.zh: 椅子底部的轮子是最容易更换的部件之一。如果您当前的脚轮滚动不顺畅或声音太大，则可能值得更换它们，而不是购买全新的椅子。这些来自乌克兰公司 Stealtho 的产品是经过 WIRED 评论员 Julian Chokkattu 测试的不错选择。它们几乎适用于所有办公椅，但该公司指出它们不适合宜家产品。柔软的聚氨酯材料意味着这些脚轮不会像某些塑料脚轮那样划伤或碎裂硬木地板，而且当您从办公桌滚到冰箱时，感觉就像在无声地滑行（不要评判）。

paras.en: Fair warning: Since these are more frictionless than normal casters, they can cause your chair to roll around sometimes, like when you stand up and walk away. Stealtho has locking casters if you're worried about your chair rolling, and they don't cost much more (these weren’t in stock last time we checked).
paras.zh: 公平警告：由于这些脚轮比普通脚轮更无摩擦，因此它们有时会导致您的椅子滚动，例如当您站起来走开时。如果您担心椅子滚动，Stealtho 配有锁定脚轮，而且它们的价格也不会贵太多（上次我们检查时没有库存）。

paras.en: Do you need a mat for your chair? Probably not. However, casters can scuff up hard floors, which is why we recommend upgrading them to rollerblade wheels (see above). If you're on a carpet, it can also be hard to move around. A mat can help with both of these issues. WIRED senior gear editor Julian Chokkattu used this glass one from Vitrazza for two years and was pleasantly surprised. (You can go for much cheaper mats made from other materials, too.) The safety glass is thick, and Julian did not see any notable scratches even after that time. It holds 1,000 pounds and doesn't touch your hardwood floor, as you need to affix rubber bumpers to keep them apart. You can choose from several sizes, and Vitrazza sells various shapes too. It's just a bit difficult to clean since you have to lift it to get to all the dirt underneath.
paras.zh: 您的椅子需要垫子吗？可能不会。然而，脚轮可能会磨损硬地板，这就是为什么我们建议将它们升级为直排轮（见上文）。如果您在地毯上，也可能很难移动。垫子可以帮助解决这两个问题。 《连线》高级装备编辑朱利安·乔卡图 (Julian Chokkattu) 使用了 Vitrazza 的这款玻璃杯两年，并感到惊喜。 （您也可以选择由其他材料制成的更便宜的垫子。）安全玻璃很厚，即使在那之后，朱利安也没有看到任何明显的划痕。它可承受 1,000 磅的重量，并且不会接触硬木地板，因为您需要粘贴橡胶缓冲器将它们分开。您可以选择多种尺寸，Vitrazza 还出售各种形状的产品。只是清洁起来有点困难，因为你必须抬起它才能清除下面的所有污垢。

paras.en: If you can't upgrade your seat just yet, a cushion or backrest might help. Here are a few we like:
paras.zh: 如果您还无法升级座椅，垫子或靠背可能会有所帮助。以下是我们喜欢的一些：

paras.en: Cushion Lab Seat Cushion for $60: This memory foam seat is comfortable, and I had no problems sitting on it for hours on end. It's best paired with an adjustable chair, as it adds a decent amount of height to your seat, which might make typing on a keyboard awkward. It does a great job of keeping out bad odors, and you can also wash the cover.
paras.zh: Cushion Lab Seat 坐垫售价 60 美元：这款记忆海绵座椅非常舒适，我连续坐上几个小时也没有任何问题。它最好与可调节的椅子搭配使用，因为它会为您的座椅增加相当多的高度，这可能会使在键盘上打字变得尴尬。它可以很好地防止异味，而且您还可以清洗盖子。

paras.en: LoveHome Memory Foam Lumbar Support for $23: If you slouch in your seat, this comfortable memory foam pillow can help. It keeps your back straight and supported, and it's an affordable fix to try before shelling out hundreds for a new chair. It's good to use in a car or wheelchair, too. The cover is washable, and it has two adjustable straps (plus an extension strap) that go around your seat to keep it in position.
paras.zh: LoveHome 记忆泡沫腰部支撑，售价 23 美元：如果您在座位上无精打采，这款舒适的记忆泡沫枕头可以提供帮助。它可以让你的背部挺直并得到支撑，而且在花费数百美元购买一把新椅子之前，这是一个经济实惠的解决方案。它也适合在汽车或轮椅上使用。椅套可清洗，并且有两条可调节带子（加上一条延长带），可以围绕您的座椅以将其固定到位。

paras.en: Secretlab Premium Footrest for $79: Ideally, your feet are planted on the ground as you sit, but it's nice to be able to prop them up on something soft every so often. I have tried a handful of footrests, and Secretlab's Premium Footrest is easily the best—I have been using mine for more than three years. Not only is the PlushCell memory foam material soft and cushy, but it also stays remarkably clean. I have a tiny dog, and his hair gets everywhere except the quilted fabric cover. (You can handwash this cover to get dirt out.) The patterned silicone base does a good job of keeping it in place, too.
paras.zh: Secretlab Premium Footrest 售价 79 美元：理想情况下，您坐下时双脚会踩在地面上，但能够时常将它们支撑在柔软的东西上也很好。我尝试过几种脚踏板，而 Secretlab 的高级脚踏板显然是最好的——我的脚踏板已经使用三年多了。 PlushCell 记忆海绵材料不仅柔软舒适，而且保持非常干净。我有一只小狗，除了绗缝布罩外，他的毛发到处都是。 （您可以手洗此盖子以清除污垢。）带图案的硅胶底座也能很好地将其固定到位。

paras.en: Uplift Desk Intuition Ergonomic Chair With Headrest for $649: At a slightly higher price point, the ergonomically designed, breathable-mesh Intuition was a strong contender for favorite reclining chair. It's also a strong contender in general, and the chair back's three overlapping mesh panels make it distinctly techy-looking.
