paras.en: An aerial projectile has hit an oil refinery in Saudi Arabia’s city of Jazan, killing one worker and injuring several other people, according to the country’s Ministry of Energy.
paras.zh: 据沙特阿拉伯能源部称，一枚空中射弹击中了沙特阿拉伯吉赞市的一家炼油厂，造成一名工人死亡，多人受伤。

paras.en: Thursday’s attack on the facility on the kingdom’s Red Sea coast caused a fire and temporarily halted some operations, the ministry said.
paras.zh: 该部表示，周四对该国红海沿岸设施的袭击引发火灾，并暂时停止了部分业务。

paras.en: The statement did not identify who carried out the strike, but earlier the Saudi-led military coalition fighting Yemen’s Houthis said that the Iranian-backed group had attacked the refinery. It came after Saudi Arabia’s civil defence agency had issued an alert about potential danger in Jazan province.
paras.zh: 声明没有透露是谁实施了这次袭击，但早些时候，沙特领导的打击也门胡塞武装的军事联盟表示，伊朗支持的组织袭击了炼油厂。此前，沙特阿拉伯民防机构就吉赞省的潜在危险发出了警报。

paras.en: The strike was the Houthis‘ latest blow against key Saudi facilities, a day after the group claimed attacks on Ras Tanura, the kingdom’s largest refinery and a major crude export hub, and the Red Sea ports of Jeddah and Jazan, amid escalating hostilities between the two sides.
paras.zh: 这次袭击是胡塞武装对沙特主要设施的最新打击，此前一天，该组织声称袭击了沙特最大的炼油厂和主要原油出口中心拉斯坦努拉以及红海港口吉达和吉赞，双方之间的敌对行动不断升级。

paras.en: The Saudi Ministry of Energy said the worker who died was Nepali, while the injured were of various nationalities.
paras.zh: 沙特能源部表示，死亡工人是尼泊尔人，受伤者来自不同国籍。

paras.en: The injured received medical care, while emergency personnel and specialised technical teams arrived at the site to assess the damage and verify the safety of the facilities following the attack, the ministry added.
paras.zh: 该部补充说，伤者接受了医疗救治，紧急救援人员和专业技术小组抵达现场评估损失情况并核实袭击后设施的安全性。

paras.en: The refinery in southwestern Saudi Arabia, near the Yemeni border, is designed to process up to 400,000 barrels of crude oil per day.
paras.zh: 该炼油厂位于沙特阿拉伯西南部，靠近也门边境，设计产能为每天 40 万桶原油。

paras.en: The Saudi-led coalition, which is backing Yemen’s internationally recognised government in its fight with the Houthis, condemned the strike and threatened a counterattack.
paras.zh: 沙特领导的联盟支持国际公认的也门政府与胡塞武装的战斗，该联盟谴责这次袭击并威胁进行反击。

paras.en: “Targeting civilians and civilian infrastructure would be met with a firm military ‌‌response,” coalition spokesman Turki al-Maliki posted on X.
paras.zh: 联军发言人图尔基·马利基 (Turki al-Maliki) 在 X 上发帖称：“针对平民和民用基础设施的攻击将得到坚决的军事反应。”

paras.en: Later on Thursday, the coalition claimed its forces had destroyed a Houthi ballistic missile launch platform in Yemen’s Hodeidah governorate used by the armed group to stage the attack on the Jazan refinery, according to al-Maliki. There was no immediate statement from the Houthis regarding the strike.
paras.zh: 据马利基称，周四晚些时候，联军声称其部队摧毁了也门荷台达省的胡塞弹道导弹发射平台，胡塞武装利用该平台袭击吉赞炼油厂。胡塞武装没有立即就这次袭击发表声明。

paras.en: On the ground in Yemen, meanwhile, Saudi-backed government forces claimed they had carried out 767 strikes on Houthi positions on Thursday.
paras.zh: 与此同时，在也门，沙特支持的政府军声称周四对胡塞武装阵地进行了 767 次袭击。

paras.en: In a post on X, the forces’ spokesman Majed Abdullah al-Nuzaili said the strikes had “neutralised” 117 Houthi fighters and destroyed 87 vehicles and combat assets.
paras.zh: 胡塞武装发言人马吉德·阿卜杜拉·努扎利 (Majed Abdullah al-Nuzaili) 在 X 上发帖称，袭击“消灭”了 117 名胡塞武装人员，摧毁了 87 辆车辆和战斗资产。

paras.en: Al-Nuzaili added that government forces continued to confront Houthi formations on the front lines in northern and western Marib governorate, as well as in the governorates of al-Jawf, Taiz, Lahj, Shabwah and Hajjah.
paras.zh: 努扎利补充说，政府军继续在马里布省北部和西部前线以及焦夫、塔伊兹、拉赫季、沙布瓦和哈杰等省与胡塞武装对抗。

paras.en: Earlier on Thursday, a series of air strikes targeted Yemen’s Houthi-held capital, Sanaa, according to media affiliated with the armed group, which is also known as Ansar Allah – Arabic for Supporters of God.
paras.zh: 据隶属于胡塞武装组织的媒体报道，周四早些时候，一系列空袭针对也门胡塞武装控制的首都萨那。该武装组织也被称为安萨尔安拉（Ansar Allah，阿拉伯语，意为上帝的支持者）。

paras.en: Elsewhere, Houthi forces targeted Habib al-Sarm and al-Hujalla, as well as al-Aqroud in al-Masrakh district.
paras.zh: 在其他地方，胡塞武装的目标是 Habib al-Sarm 和 al-Hujalla，以及马斯拉赫地区的 al-Aqroud。

paras.en: The Houthis, who control the most populous areas of Yemen, have launched missiles and drones at Saudi airports, oil facilities and office buildings since the country’s civil war reignited in July, in a spillover from the US-Iran war.
paras.zh: 控制也门人口最多地区的胡塞武装自 7 月美伊战争蔓延以来，该国内战重新燃起，向沙特机场、石油设施和办公楼发射了导弹和无人机。

paras.en: The attacks have previously temporarily disrupted some of Aramco’s operations and caused the cancellation of most international flights to Riyadh. They also forced Saudi Arabia to postpone or cancel major international events, including football’s AFC Asian Cup and the flagship FII investment conference.
paras.zh: 这些袭击此前曾暂时扰乱阿美公司的部分业务，并导致大多数飞往利雅得的国际航班取消。他们还迫使沙特阿拉伯推迟或取消重大国际赛事，包括足球亚足联亚洲杯和旗舰国际足联投资会议。

paras.en: The fighting has also exacerbated dire humanitarian conditions for Yemeni civilians.
paras.zh: 战斗还加剧了也门平民严峻的人道主义状况。

paras.en: The World Health Organization (WHO) reported that as of Monday, 2,361 people had been killed and 10,982 injured since fighting in Yemen escalated in August. More than 360,000 people have also been forced to flee their homes in Yemen since the start of August, according to the UN.
paras.zh: 世界卫生组织 (WHO) 报告称，自 8 月也门战斗升级以来，截至周一，已有 2,361 人死亡、10,982 人受伤。据联合国称，自 8 月初以来，也门也有超过 36 万人被迫逃离家园。

articles.title: Egypt detains driver over Cairo fuel tanker fire that killed 31

paras.en: Prosecutors in Egypt have ordered the detention of a 21-year-old driver suspected of causing a collision on Wednesday that overturned a fuel tanker on Cairo’s ring road, starting a fire that killed 31 people.
paras.zh: 埃及检方已下令拘留一名涉嫌于周三在开罗环路发生撞车事故的 21 岁司机，该司机在开罗环城公路上撞翻了一辆油罐车，引发火灾，造成 31 人死亡。

paras.en: The Public Prosecution announced on Thursday that it had ordered the man to be held pending an investigation, and sent him to the Forensic Medicine Authority for tests to determine whether he had taken drugs.
paras.zh: 检察机关周四宣布，已下令拘留该男子等待调查，并将他送往法医管理局进行检查，以确定他是否吸毒。

paras.en: The tanker burst into flames at about 6:30pm (16:30 GMT) on Wednesday, at the height of the evening rush hour, on an elevated stretch of the ring road in al-Waraq, a densely populated district of Giza on the western edge of the capital. The fire spread to passing traffic and destroyed 27 vehicles, including cars and motorcycles.
paras.zh: 周三下午 6:30 左右（格林威治标准时间 16:30），这辆油轮在晚高峰时段的阿尔瓦拉克环路高架上起火，瓦拉克是首都西部边缘吉萨人口稠密的地区。火势蔓延至过往车辆，烧毁了包括汽车和摩托车在内的 27 辆汽车。

paras.en: In an earlier statement, prosecutors said the driver told investigators he had been travelling from al-Marg towards al-Haram at 110km/h (68mph), with his father in the car, and was switching lanes to overtake other vehicles when the front left of his car struck the rear right of the tanker.
paras.zh: 检察官在早些时候的一份声明中表示，司机告诉调查人员，他当时正以 110 公里/小时（68 英里/小时）的速度从 al-Marg 前往 al-Haram，父亲在车里，当时他正在变换车道以超越其他车辆，这时他的车左前部撞到了油罐车的右后部。

paras.en: The man told prosecutors he then lost control and his car veered to the far right of the road. One of the tanker’s tyres burst, the statement said, before the vehicle hit a concrete barrier and overturned. Petrol leaking from the truck caught fire.
paras.zh: 该男子告诉检察官，他随后失去了控制，他的车转向了道路的最右侧。声明称，油罐车的一个轮胎爆裂，然后车辆撞上混凝土屏障并翻倒。卡车泄漏的汽油着火了。

paras.en: Prosecutors said they identified the driver after inspecting the scene and interviewing witnesses, and had since spoken to all the injured whose condition allowed them to be questioned. Forensic teams are taking DNA samples from victims’ relatives to identify some of the bodies. Relatives posted appeals on Facebook for men who had been on the road and had not been heard from since, the Reuters news agency reported.
paras.zh: 检察官表示，他们在检查现场并采访目击者后确认了司机的身份，并与所有伤者进行了交谈，伤者的情况允许他们接受讯问。法医小组正在从受害者亲属身上提取 DNA 样本，以鉴定部分尸体的身份。据路透社报道，亲属在脸书上为那些一直在路上但自那以后就杳无音讯的男子发出呼吁。

paras.en: The investigation will determine whether the driver bears criminal responsibility.
paras.zh: 调查将确定司机是否承担刑事责任。

paras.en: The Ministry of Health and Population on Thursday put the final toll at 31 dead and 26 injured, up from the 21 injured it had reported on Wednesday. Five of the injured have left hospital. The other 21 are still being treated, including eight transferred to other hospitals for further care. The bodies of the dead are in the custody of prosecutors, the ministry said.
paras.zh: 卫生和人口部周四公布的最终死亡人数为 31 人、26 人受伤，高于周三报告的 21 人受伤人数。五名伤者已出院。其余21人仍在接受治疗，其中8人已转往其他医院接受进一步治疗。内政部表示，死者尸体已由检察官保管。

paras.en: By Thursday morning, traffic was moving again after crews cleared most of the burned wreckage. Salah Ahmed, a microbus driver, told the AP news agency that he had been on the ring road when the tanker caught fire but was held back by traffic, which saved his life.
paras.zh: 到周四早上，在工作人员清理了大部分被烧毁的残骸后，交通再次恢复畅通。小型客车司机萨拉·艾哈迈德 (Salah Ahmed) 告诉美联社，油罐车着火时他正在环路上，但被交通堵塞，这才救了他的命。

paras.en: “It was God’s hellfire on the ring road,” he said. “Why is a truck like this on the ring road at a rush hour? Who gets penalised for this happening?”
paras.zh: “这是上帝在环路上的地狱之火，”他说。 “为什么这样的卡车在高峰时段出现在环城公路上？谁会因此受到处罚？”

paras.en: A 2018 cabinet decision barred trucks carrying more than four tonnes from the ring road between 6am and midnight, the AFP news agency reported. Prosecutors have not said why the tanker was on the road at the time.
paras.zh: 据法新社报道，2018 年内阁的一项决定禁止卡车在早上 6 点至午夜期间从环路行驶超过 4 吨的卡车。检察官尚未说明油轮当时为何在路上。

paras.en: “The tanks were exploding, the tyres were exploding, and there was fire,” Zaghlol al-Me, a local resident who reached the scene shortly after the crash, told Reuters. “We just didn’t know what to do or how to save anyone.”
paras.zh: 事故发生后不久到达现场的当地居民扎格洛尔·阿尔·梅 (Zaghlol al-Me) 告诉路透社：“坦克爆炸，轮胎爆炸，并发生火灾。” “我们只是不知道该怎么做或如何拯救任何人。”

paras.en: The Public Prosecution’s statements are the first official account of how the crash happened. Early reports in local media suggested that a high-voltage cable had fallen in front of the tanker. On Wednesday night, the Ministry of Transport denied issuing any statement to that effect and said the cause was a matter for prosecutors.
paras.zh: 检方的声明是对坠机事件发生过程的第一份官方说明。当地媒体的早期报道显示，一根高压电缆掉落在油轮前面。周三晚间，交通运输部否认就此发表任何声明，并表示原因由检察官负责。

paras.en: The Ministry of Electricity and Renewable Energy said the overhead lines were taut when the fire began and that two circuits tripped only after it started. The ministry’s spokesman, Mansour Abdel Ghani, told the Egyptian Youm7 daily newspaper that the lines had no connection to the crash and melted in the heat. A high-voltage line lay twisted on the ground on Thursday, AP reported.
paras.zh: 电力和可再生能源部表示，火灾发生时，架空线路处于拉紧状态，直到火灾发生后，两条电路才跳闸。该部发言人曼苏尔·阿卜杜勒·加尼 (Mansour Abdel Ghani) 告诉埃及《Youm7》日报，这些管线与坠机事件无关，只是在高温下融化了。据美联社报道，周四，地面上有一条高压线扭曲。

paras.en: President Abdel Fattah el-Sisi ordered full medical care for the injured and support for the families of those killed. Prime Minister Mostafa Madbouly visited the injured on Thursday with Health Minister Khaled Abdel Ghaffar and Social Solidarity Minister Maya Morsy. Madbouly said the government, civil society and businesspeople would provide bank investment certificates to give bereaved families a stable income, and replacement vehicles for people whose cars burned.
paras.zh: 总统阿卜杜勒·法塔赫·塞西下令为伤者提供全面医疗护理，并为遇难者家属提供支持。周四，总理穆斯塔法·马德布利与卫生部长哈立德·阿卜杜勒·加法尔和社会团结部长玛雅·穆尔西一起探望了伤者。马德布利表示，政府、民间社会和商界人士将提供银行投资证书，为失去亲人的家庭提供稳定的收入，并为汽车烧毁的人提供更换车辆。

paras.en: “We realise that no compensation or money can make up for those we have lost,” Madbouly said.
paras.zh: “我们意识到没有任何补偿或金钱可以弥补我们所失去的，”马德布利说。

paras.en: Egypt’s Ministry of Social Solidarity said on Thursday that people could donate through the InstaPay app to help the injured and the families of those killed. It also opened an account at Nasser Social Bank for donations from businesses and civil society groups. The cabinet said the ministry had received 24 million Egyptian pounds (about $445,000) from seven charities.
paras.zh: 埃及社会团结部周四表示，人们可以通过 InstaPay 应用程序捐款，以帮助受伤者和遇难者家属。它还在纳赛尔社会银行开设了一个账户，用于接受企业和民间社会团体的捐款。内阁表示，该部已从七个慈善机构收到了 2400 万埃及镑（约合 445,000 美元）。

paras.en: The crash has renewed questions about road safety in Egypt. The Ministry of Transport says it spent about $37bn on transport between 2014 and 2024, yet 5,829 people were killed on the country’s roads in 2025, up 10.8 percent from the year before, and about 84,000 were injured, according to the state statistics agency, CAPMAS.
paras.zh: 此次事故再次引发人们对埃及道路安全的质疑。交通运输部表示，2014 年至 2024 年间，该国交通运输支出约为 370 亿美元，但根据国家统计机构 CAPMAS 的数据，2025 年该国道路上死亡人数为 5,829 人，比前一年增加 10.8%，约 84,000 人受伤。

paras.en: Egyptian legislators demanded accountability on Thursday. Mahmoud Samy, an MP, said the government needed to move from “building roads and expanding them to managing their safety professionally”. Abdel Moneim Imam, a politician who chairs the liberal Justice Party, said the cabinet bore full responsibility and should resign.
paras.zh: 埃及立法者周四要求追究责任。议员马哈茂德·萨米 (Mahmoud Samy) 表示，政府需要从“修建和扩建道路转向专业管理道路安全”。自由正义党主席、政治家阿卜杜勒·莫奈姆·伊玛目表示，内阁负有全部责任，应该辞职。

paras.en: Amr Moussa, Egypt’s former foreign minister and former secretary-general of the Arab League, also criticised what he described as a deterioration in government oversight.
paras.zh: 埃及前外交部长、阿拉伯联盟前秘书长阿姆鲁·穆萨也批评了他所说的政府监督恶化。

paras.en: “Trading accusations and evading responsibility leads to the next disaster,” Moussa said, according to Reuters.
paras.zh: 据路透社报道，穆萨表示：“相互指责和逃避责任会导致下一场灾难。”

paras.en: Transport Minister Kamel al-Wazir was appointed in 2019 after a train crash at Cairo’s Ramses station triggered a fire that killed 25 people, according to Reuters. He has rejected calls to resign since then, including after a lorry crash in the Nile Delta that killed 19 people, almost all of them young women, last year. The ministry declined to comment further when contacted by Reuters.
paras.zh: 据路透社报道，交通部长卡梅尔·瓦齐尔 (Kamel al-Wazir) 于 2019 年被任命，此前开罗拉美西斯火车站发生火车相撞事故并引发火灾，造成 25 人死亡。此后他一直拒绝辞职，包括去年尼罗河三角洲发生的卡车相撞事故，造成 19 人死亡，其中几乎全是年轻女性。当路透社联系该部时，该部拒绝进一步置评。

paras.en: Earlier this month, a train crash, also in Giza, killed at least seven people and injured more than 125, prompting calls from legislators for accountability over recurring transport accidents.
paras.zh: 本月早些时候，同样在吉萨发生的火车相撞事故造成至少 7 人死亡、超过 125 人受伤，促使立法者呼吁对反复发生的交通事故追究责任。

articles.title: Storms disrupt Thanksgiving travel. And, FCC violated ABC's free speech, judge says
articles.author: Brittney Melton

paras.en: Storms disrupt Thanksgiving travel. And, FCC violated ABC's free speech, judge says
paras.zh: 暴风雨扰乱了感恩节旅行。而且，法官称 FCC 侵犯了 ABC 的言论自由

paras.en: Severe storms sweeping across the nation threaten to cause widespread travel delays today, as millions of people gather with their loved ones. New York City officials announced that the Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade has been rescheduled to Saturday due to the threat of powerful wind gusts that could reach up to 60 mph. This year marked the 100th procession, and the first time the iconic event is being postponed.
paras.zh: 今天，席卷全国的强风暴可能会导致大范围的旅行延误，数百万人与亲人相聚。纽约市官员宣布，由于时速可能达到 60 英里的强阵风威胁，梅西百货感恩节大游行已改期至周六举行。今年是第 100 届游行，也是这一标志性活动首次被推迟。

paras.en: - 🎧 Something is happening across almost every part of the country right now, NPR's Kat Lonsdorf tells Up First. Extreme high tides are affecting the West Coast, snow is expected in parts of the Midwest, and in the South and Southeast, a major storm is advancing up the East Coast. Meteorologist Richard Bann with the National Weather Service Weather Prediction Center tells Lonsdorf the East Coast storm is the primary concern. Bann says the storm will become better organized throughout the day, bringing strong winds and heavy rain that could lead to coastal flooding. The good news: Forecasters expect the East Coast's major storm to move on, mostly wrapping up by Saturday, Lonsdorf says.
paras.zh: - 🎧 NPR 的 Kat Lonsdorf 告诉 Up First，现在全国几乎每个地方都在发生一些事情。极端涨潮正在影响西海岸，中西部部分地区预计会下雪，而在南部和东南部，一场大风暴正在向东海岸推进。国家气象局天气预报中心的气象学家理查德·班恩告诉朗斯多夫，东海岸风暴是首要问题。班恩表示，风暴将在全天变得更加有组织，带来强风和大雨，可能导致沿海洪水。好消息：朗斯多夫说，预报员预计东海岸的大风暴将继续下去，大部分在周六结束。

paras.en: The Trump administration has proposed new tariffs targeting goods from 14 major U.S. trading partners, including China, Japan and the European Union. Administration officials argue the measures counter unfair foreign trade practices, though critics question their ultimate effectiveness. Proposed rates may reach 40% on Chinese imports, 35% on Vietnamese goods, and 20-25% on products from other targeted nations. Additional tariffs on Brazilian sugar and aircraft are also being suggested.
paras.zh: 特朗普政府提议对来自中国、日本和欧盟等美国 14 个主要贸易伙伴的商品征收新关税。政府官员认为这些措施旨在打击不公平的外贸行为，但批评者质疑其最终效果。拟议的对中国进口商品征收的关税可能达到 40%，对越南商品征收 35%，对来自其他目标国家的产品征收 20-25%。还建议对巴西糖和飞机征收额外关税。

paras.en: - 🎧 U.S. Trade Ambassador Jamieson Greer said that new tariffs could take effect within a couple of months. For each country, the White House has listed a "proposed" rate and a "deal" rate, NPR's Danielle Kurtzleben says. For example, if talks with China progress positively, they may receive a deal rate of 20%, which is different from its proposed rate of 40%. Although the Supreme Court overturned President Trump's previous tariffs, the new ones fall under Section 301, a law meant to counter unfair trade practices. The administration says these countries exhibit "structural excess capacity" in various manufactured goods, a situation caused by policies that lead to overproduction, which can distort the global market.
paras.zh: - 🎧 美国贸易大使杰米森·格里尔表示，新关税可能会在几个月内生效。 NPR 的丹妮尔·库茨莱本 (Danielle Kurtzleben) 表示，对于每个国家，白宫都列出了“提议”利率和“交易”利率。例如，如果与中国的谈判取得积极进展，他们可能会获得20%的交易率，这与提议的40%不同。尽管最高法院推翻了特朗普总统之前的关税，但新关税属于旨在打击不公平贸易行为的第 301 条法律的管辖范围。美国政府表示，这些国家在各种制成品方面表现出“结构性产能过剩”，这是由导致生产过剩的政策造成的，这可能会扭曲全球市场。

paras.en: Federal scientists are testing the air, soil and water in Eastern Iowa for lead contamination after the U.S. Army detonated thousands of pounds of unstable lead azide at the Iowa Army Ammunition Plant in Middletown yesterday. Officials said the controlled explosion was the only safe way to dispose of the bomb-making compound.
paras.zh: 美国陆军昨天在米德尔敦的爱荷华州陆军弹药厂引爆了数千磅不稳定的叠氮化铅后，联邦科学家正在测试爱荷华州东部的空气、土壤和水的铅污染情况。官员们表示，受控爆炸是处理炸弹制造化合物的唯一安全方法。

paras.en: - 🎧 Eliza Billingham of NPR network station Iowa Public Radio says the major concern is the potential release of lead into the air from the explosion. She adds that the U.S. Environmental Protection Agency has tested the area since the detonation and hasn't found lead in the air. The EPA has deployed around 300 people to sample the air, ground and nearby water. Lead is a neurotoxin that especially endangers children and pregnant people because it can impede childhood development. After a week and a half of delays and inconsistent communication from the Army, residents have grown hesitant about the Army and the EPA's initial findings, Billingham says. Residents want independent monitoring and the University of Iowa and the University of Illinois are conducting regional sampling. Results are expected in a few days and should show if their measurements align with the EPA's data, Billingham says.
paras.zh: - 🎧 NPR 网络电台爱荷华州公共广播电台的 Eliza Billingham 表示，主要担心的是爆炸可能导致铅释放到空气中。她补充说，自爆炸以来，美国环境保护局已经对该地区进行了测试，没有在空气中发现铅。 EPA 已部署约 300 人对空气、地面和附近的水进行采样。铅是一种神经毒素，特别危害儿童和孕妇，因为它会阻碍儿童发育。比林厄姆说，经过一周半的延误和陆军的沟通不一致，居民对陆军和环保局的初步调查结果越来越犹豫。居民希望进行独立监测，爱荷华大学和伊利诺伊大学正在进行区域抽样。比林厄姆说，预计几天后就会得出结果，并且应该显示他们的测量结果是否与美国环保局的数据相符。

paras.en: A federal judge has blocked Trump from challenging the ABC television network's broadcast licenses. U.S. District Court Judge Loren AliKhan ruled that the president retaliating against satire and commentary he dislikes is unconstitutional. AliKhan issued the preliminary injunction yesterday and dismissed the administration's request to throw out ABC and Disney's lawsuit challenging the review of the local license. Licenses typically last eight years and are rarely revoked. AliKhan's decision drew heavily on Trump's public statements and social media posts against ABC and Disney, as well as comments from Brendan Carr, the president's pick for chair of the Federal Communications Commission.
paras.zh: 一名联邦法官阻止特朗普质疑美国广播公司电视网络的广播许可证。美国地方法院法官洛伦·阿里汗裁定，总统对他不喜欢的讽刺和评论进行报复是违宪的。阿里汗昨天发布了初步禁令，并驳回了政府的要求，即驳回美国广播公司和迪士尼对当地许可证审查提出质疑的诉讼。许可证的有效期通常为八年，很少被撤销。阿里汗的决定在很大程度上参考了特朗普针对美国广播公司和迪士尼的公开声明和社交媒体帖子，以及总统提名的联邦通信委员会主席布伦丹·卡尔的评论。

paras.en: Holiday shopping season is in full swing. Before you spend, consider if you actually need what's in your cart. Sales are exciting because our brains are wired to seek newness. Retailers capitalize on that urge. To escape the cycle of constantly wanting more, shop intentionally and appreciate what you already own, says Eric Athas, author of Saying No to New. He shares his insights on breaking this cycle and finding joy in your current possessions with Life Kit.
paras.zh: 假日购物季正如火如荼地进行。在消费之前，请考虑您是否确实需要购物车中的商品。销售令人兴奋，因为我们的大脑天生就喜欢寻求新鲜事物。零售商利用了这种冲动。 《对新事物说不》一书的作者埃里克·阿萨斯说，为了摆脱不断想要更多的循环，有意识地购物并欣赏你已经拥有的东西。他通过 Life Kit 分享了他关于打破这个循环并在你当前拥有的东西中找到快乐的见解。

paras.en: - 🛒 Delete the app or remove your credit card info if you have one-click checkout with a company.
paras.zh: - 🛒 如果您与公司进行一键结帐，请删除应用程序或删除您的信用卡信息。

paras.en: - 🛒 Add an item to your online shopping cart and leave it for 24 hours. Research shows that delaying a purchase decreases your interest in it.
paras.zh: - 🛒 将商品添加到您的在线购物车并保留 24 小时。研究表明，延迟购买会降低您的兴趣。

paras.en: - 🛒 Make intentional choices. Don't reject all new things. After you understand this, you can learn to say no to the wrong items and yes to the right ones.
paras.zh: - 🛒 做出有意的选择。不要拒绝一切新事物。了解这一点后，您可以学会对错误的项目说“不”，对正确的项目说“是”。

paras.en: - 🛒 Revisiting old things can provide you with untapped enjoyment in them, research has found. You can apply this by rereading a book or by traveling to a city you have visited before.
paras.zh: - 🛒 研究发现，重温旧事物可以给你带来前所未有的乐趣。您可以通过重读一本书或前往您以前访问过的城市来应用此方法。

paras.en: - The Pittsburgh Steelers have cut quarterback Aaron Rodgers after he claimed in an interview that the team's head coach sleeps in meetings.
paras.zh: - 匹兹堡钢人队裁掉了四分卫亚伦·罗杰斯，因为他在接受采访时声称球队主教练在会议中睡觉。

paras.en: - The Ariston Cafe opened in 1924 along Illinois's Route 66, serving classic American diner fare. The National Register landmark attracts international travelers and hosts local milestones, from wedding proposals to 65th anniversaries.
paras.zh: - Ariston 咖啡馆于 1924 年在伊利诺伊州 66 号公路旁开业，供应经典的美式晚餐。这个国家名录地标吸引了国际游客，并举办了当地的里程碑活动，从求婚到 65 周年纪念日。

paras.en: - In this week's Far-Flung Postcards, NPR's Emily Feng brings readers views of the peak of Mount Kilimanjaro. She was able to see it during a camping trip at altitude.
paras.zh: - 在本周的《遥远明信片》中，NPR 的 Emily Feng 为读者带来了乞力马扎罗山峰顶的景色。她在一次高海拔露营旅行中看到了它。

articles.title: North Korea's Kim vows to build more nuclear weapons after ignoring Trump's overture
articles.author: The Associated Press

paras.en: North Korea's Kim vows to build more nuclear weapons after ignoring Trump's overture
paras.zh: 朝鲜金正恩无视特朗普的提议后誓言要制造更多核武器

paras.en: SEOUL, South Korea — North Korean leader Kim Jong Un visited facilities that produce nuclear ingredients and called for building more nuclear weapons, days after ignoring U.S. President Donald Trump's offer to meet during his recent visit to Asia.
paras.zh: 韩国首尔——朝鲜领导人金正恩视察了生产核原料的设施，并呼吁制造更多核武器，几天前，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普在最近访问亚洲期间提出了会面的提议。

paras.en: Experts say Kim likely wants to show off his evolving nuclear arsenal, the backbone of his authoritarian rule, and reaffirm his rejection of any future talks on dismantling his nuclear program.
paras.zh: 专家表示，金正恩可能想炫耀他不断发展的核武库，这是他独裁统治的支柱，并重申他拒绝未来任何有关废除核计划的谈判。

paras.en: The North's official Korean Central News Agency said Thursday that Kim inspected two nuclear materials production factories, one newly inaugurated and the other being expanded. KCNA photos showed Kim and senior military officials walking between dense rows of what appeared to be centrifuges used to produce weapons-grade uranium and touring halls displaying what were believed to be warheads. Some of the images were blurred.
paras.zh: 朝鲜官方通讯社朝中社周四称，金正恩视察了两家核材料生产工厂，一家是新落成的，另一家正在扩建。朝中社的照片显示，金正恩和高级军事官员在密集的一排似乎是用于生产武器级铀的离心机和展示据信是弹头的参观大厅之间行走。一些图像变得模糊。

paras.en: KCNA said Kim visited a nuclear-powered equipment production base and a nuclear research institute as well on Wednesday.
paras.zh: 朝中社称，金正恩周三还参观了核动力设备生产基地和核研究所。

paras.en: North Korea has disclosed a uranium enrichment site a few times since it showed one at its main Yongbyon nuclear complex to visiting American scholars in 2010. North Korea didn't say where the nuclear materials production factories that Kim visited this week are located. In June, when North Korea disclosed parts of a uranium enrichment site while reporting on Kim's visit there, outside experts assessed it was likely an additional uranium enrichment facility at Yongbyon.
paras.zh: 自2010年向来访的美国学者展示其主要宁边核设施的铀浓缩设施以来，朝鲜已多次披露了铀浓缩设施。朝鲜没有透露金正恩本周访问的核材料生产工厂位于何处。 6月，当朝鲜在报道金正恩访问那里时披露了铀浓缩设施的部分内容时，外部专家评估这可能是宁边的另一个铀浓缩设施。

paras.en: Kim justifies nuke program by citing threats from US, South KoreaKim said his latest inspection visit was part of efforts to strengthen North Korea's defense capabilities in response to "variable nuclear threats approaching the Korean Peninsula moment by moment." He accused the U.S. of inciting its regional allies to possess nuclear-powered submarines and committing to sharing its nuclear weapons with them, KCNA said.
paras.zh: 金正恩以来自美国的威胁为核计划辩护 金正恩表示，他最近的视察是加强朝鲜防御能力的努力的一部分，以应对“时时刻刻逼近朝鲜半岛的各种核威胁”。朝中社称，他指责美国煽动其地区盟友拥有核动力潜艇，并承诺与它们分享核武器。

paras.en: "The validity and substantiality of our possession of nuclear weapons and the trend of bolstering up its nuclear capability in quality and quantity are an irreversible reality," Kim said, according to KCNA.
paras.zh: 据朝中社报道，金正恩表示：“我们拥有核武器的有效性和实质性以及在质量和数量上增强核能力的趋势是不可逆转的现实。”

paras.en: Kim also said the deployment of low-yield battlefield nuclear weapons across multiple domains for various missions is crucial and urgent given North Korea's "inevitable reality facing the border with the most dangerous enemy state," a reference to South Korea. North Korea has in recent years focused on developing such tactical nuclear weapons amid heightened animosity with South Korea.
paras.zh: 金正恩还表示，鉴于朝鲜“不可避免地面临与最危险敌国边境的现实”（指的是韩国），在多个领域部署低当量战场核武器以执行各种任务至关重要且紧迫。近年来，在与韩国的敌意加剧的情况下，朝鲜一直致力于发展此类战术核武器。

paras.en: "Trump has talked about a willingness to meet Kim Jong Un, but the basic U.S. position that North Korea must denuclearize remains unchanged. So Kim Jong Un wants to say 'Look at how powerful we are. Don't talk about denuclearization if you want to meet us,'" said Moon Seong Mook, an analyst for the Seoul-based Korea Research Institute for National Strategy.
paras.zh: “特朗普已经谈到愿意与金正恩会面，但美国关于朝鲜必须无核化的基本立场没有改变。所以金正恩想说，‘看看我们有多强大。如果你想见我们，就不要谈论无核化，’”首尔韩国国家战略研究院分析师文成穆(Moon Seong Mook)表示。

paras.en: Moon said Kim's visit to the nuclear facilities was also likely meant to check on how state objectives on the nuclear program have progressed this year and what future goals must be set ahead of a year-end Workers' Party conference.
paras.zh: 文在寅表示，金正恩访问核设施也可能是为了检查今年国家核计划目标的进展情况，以及在年底劳动党会议之前必须制定哪些未来目标。

paras.en: South Korea's Defense Ministry said it takes Kim's comments on battlefield nuclear weapons seriously and added that Seoul maintains a firm military readiness against Pyongyang's nuclear threats under an alliance with the U.S. South Korea's Joint Chiefs of Staff declined to share an analysis of the North Korean nuclear facilities reported by KCNA, calling it confidential information for South Korea and the U.S.
paras.zh: 韩国国防部表示，认真对待金正恩关于战场核武器的评论，并补充说，首尔在与美国结盟的情况下，对平壤的核威胁保持坚定的军事准备状态。韩国参谋长联席会议拒绝分享朝中社报道的朝鲜核设施的分析，称其为韩国和美国的机密信息。

paras.en: Trump still hopes to meet KimTrump reiterated his eagerness to restore diplomacy with Kim as he visited China last week for the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation summit. But a Trump-Kim meeting didn't happen, with Pyongyang not publicly responding to Trump's overture.
paras.zh: 特朗普仍希望与金正恩会面 特朗普上周访问中国参加亚太经合组织峰会时重申了他与金正恩恢复外交的渴望。但特金会并没有发生，平壤也没有公开回应特朗普的提议。

paras.en: In an interview with the New York Post this week, Trump dismissed the suggestion that Kim had rebuffed his outreach, saying, "No, he didn't ignore it. You know, we had many leaders there … There'll be a time when we meet … It was just not really the right time. It was a very busy two-day period."
paras.zh: 在本周接受《纽约邮报》采访时，特朗普驳斥了有关金正恩拒绝与他接触的说法，他说：“不，他并没有忽视这一点。你知道，我们那里有很多领导人……我们会有一个会面的时间……只是时机不太合适。那是非常忙碌的两天。”

paras.en: Trump also claimed he could revive diplomacy with Kim at any time by restarting the exchange of letters they maintained during his first term, although he acknowledged that the two leaders had not corresponded "recently."
paras.zh: 特朗普还声称，他可以随时恢复与金正恩的外交关系，恢复他们在第一个任期内保持的信函往来，尽管他承认两位领导人“最近”没有进行过通信。

paras.en: Kim has previously said he could return to talks if the U.S. drops its "hostile policy" against his country and respects what he calls the North's status as a nuclear state. Experts say Kim aims to win international recognition as a nuclear state so that he could demand the lifting of international sanctions.
paras.zh: 金正恩此前曾表示，如果美国放弃对朝鲜的“敌对政策”并尊重他所说的朝鲜核国家地位，他可能会重返会谈。专家表示，金正恩的目标是赢得国际社会对核国家的承认，以便他可以要求取消国际制裁。

paras.en: Last week, International Atomic Energy Agency Director General Rafael Grossi assessed North Korea has been expanding its original uranium enrichment facility at Yongbyon, calling the move "a cause for serious concern."
paras.zh: 上周，国际原子能机构总干事拉斐尔·格罗西评估朝鲜一直在扩建其位于宁边的原始铀浓缩设施，称此举“引起严重关切”。

paras.en: Nuclear weapons can be built using either highly enriched uranium or weapons-grade plutonium, and North Korea has facilities to produce both at Yongbyon. Last year, South Korea's Unification Minister Chung Dong-young said that North Korea was operating four uranium enrichment facilities and that they were running every day.
paras.zh: 核武器可以使用高浓缩铀或武器级钚来制造，朝鲜在宁边拥有生产这两种材料的设施。去年，韩国统一部长官郑东泳表示，朝鲜正在运营四个铀浓缩设施，而且它们每天都在运行。

articles.title: Congo Ebola outbreak reaches 12,000 cases as some responders evacuate
articles.author: The Associated Press

paras.en: Congo Ebola outbreak reaches 12,000 cases as some responders evacuate
paras.zh: 刚果埃博拉疫情已达 12,000 例，部分急救人员撤离

paras.en: BUNIA, Congo — The fast-moving Ebola outbreak in eastern Congo has topped 12,000 confirmed cases, government data showed Thursday, as fighting between rebels and the army disrupts efforts to contain the spread of the disease.
paras.zh: 刚果布尼亚——政府数据周四显示，刚果东部埃博拉疫情快速蔓延，确诊病例已突破 12,000 例，叛乱分子与军队之间的战斗扰乱了遏制埃博拉疫情蔓延的努力。

paras.en: It is the fastest-growing Ebola outbreak in history and nearly half the 12,021 people confirmed to have the virus have died, according to data from Congo's Ministry of Health. It is also the deadliest of Congo's 17 outbreaks and is on track to surpass the death toll from the West African outbreak that killed 11,000 people between 2014 and 2016.
paras.zh: 刚果卫生部的数据显示，这是历史上增长最快的埃博拉疫情，确诊感染该病毒的 12,021 人中近一半已经死亡。这也是刚果 17 次疫情中最致命的一次，并且有望超过 2014 年至 2016 年间西非疫情造成 11,000 人死亡的死亡人数。

paras.en: The outbreak declared in May is caused by the rare Bundibugyo virus, for which there is no approved vaccine or treatment. Response teams are battling armed conflict, poor roads and violence from residents fueled by mistrust and misinformation.
paras.zh: 五月份宣布的疫情是由罕见的本迪布焦病毒引起的，目前尚无批准的疫苗或治疗方法。响应小组正在与武装冲突、道路状况不佳以及因不信任和错误信息而引发的居民暴力作斗争。

paras.en: Ebola spreads through direct contact with the blood or other bodily fluids of people who are sick or have died from the disease. Containing the disease requires quickly identifying and treating patients in isolation, monitoring people who may have been exposed and safely burying the dead.
paras.zh: 埃博拉病毒通过直接接触患病或死亡者的血液或其他体液进行传播。遏制这种疾病需要快速识别和隔离患者、监测可能接触过病毒的人并安全埋葬死者。

paras.en: Fighting between the army and the Convention pour la révolution populaire rebels resumed Thursday morning in Iga-Barrière, a mining town about 25 kilometers (15 miles) north of Bunia in eastern Congo, sending new waves of displaced people toward the city. Bunia is the capital of northeastern Ituri province and a major hub for the Ebola response.
paras.zh: 周四上午，军队与人民革命大会叛乱分子之间的战斗在刚果东部布尼亚以北约 25 公里（15 英里）的采矿小镇伊加巴里尔重新爆发，新一波流离失所者涌入该市。布尼亚是东北部伊图里省的首府，也是应对埃博拉病毒的主要中心。

paras.en: CRP is one of more than 100 armed groups in eastern Congo, where conflict has created one of the world's most severe humanitarian crises. The group was founded last year by former warlord Thomas Lubanga, who was convicted by the International Criminal Court in 2012 of recruiting children under 15 and using them in fighting.
paras.zh: CRP 是刚果东部 100 多个武装团体之一，那里的冲突造成了世界上最严重的人道主义危机之一。该组织由前军阀托马斯·卢班加 (Thomas Lubanga) 去年创立，他于 2012 年因招募 15 岁以下儿童并利用他们参加战斗而被国际刑事法院定罪。

paras.en: Fighting between the army and the rebels earlier this week had already prevented teams from reaching some communities, disrupted monitoring of people exposed to the virus and left some treatment centers with fewer staff, Dr. Catherine Smallwood, the World Health Organization's Ebola incident manager, said Wednesday.
paras.zh: 世界卫生组织埃博拉事件负责人凯瑟琳·斯莫尔伍德博士周三表示，本周早些时候，军队和叛军之间的战斗已经导致医疗队无法到达一些社区，扰乱了对病毒感染者的监测，并导致一些治疗中心的人员减少。

paras.en: Smallwood said that about a dozen people, including two WHO personnel and Congolese health officials, were evacuated to Bunia on Tuesday after three full days trapped in a hospital in Akwe, northeast of the provincial capital, amid intense crossfire.
paras.zh: 斯莫尔伍德说，在激烈的交火中，包括两名世卫组织人员和刚果卫生官员在内的大约十几人被困在省会东北部阿克维的一家医院三天后，于周二被疏散到布尼亚。

articles.title: Kevin Durant dishes on Steelers coach Mike McCarthy’s alleged ice cream snack habits after making NBA history

paras.en: Aaron Rodgers’ time with the Pittsburgh Steelers ended abruptly just one day before Thanksgiving. The team cut ties with the veteran quarterback shortly after benching him and following his disparaging comments about coach Mike McCarthy during an appearance on "The Pat McAfee Show" on Wednesday.
paras.zh: 亚伦·罗杰斯在匹兹堡钢人队的时光在感恩节前一天突然结束。在这位经验丰富的四分卫周三出现在“帕特·麦卡菲秀”上并对教练迈克·麦卡锡发表贬低言论后不久，球队就与这位经验丰富的四分卫断绝了关系。

paras.en: Rodgers, who was in his second season with the Steelers, made a series of allegations questioning McCarthy’s focus and work ethic. He claimed the coach had been caught "snoring" during team meetings and recently inadvertently ended a speech with "one, two, three, Packers."
paras.zh: 罗杰斯在钢人队的第二个赛季提出了一系列质疑麦卡锡的专注和职业道德的指控。他声称教练在球队会议期间被发现“打鼾”，最近无意中结束了与“一、二、三，包装工队”的演讲。

paras.en: Another allegation came from former Steelers defensive lineman Breiden Fehoko, who claimed that a Steelers player sent him a message reading: "McCarthy has a personal assistant who brings him ice cream sandwiches on demand."
paras.zh: 另一项指控来自前钢人队防守锋线球员布雷登·费霍科，他声称一名钢人队球员给他发了一条消息，上面写着：“麦卡锡有一名私人助理，可以根据需要为他送冰淇淋三明治。”

paras.en: Several sports figures have weighed in on Rodgers’ abrupt departure, with NBA star Kevin Durant among the latest to comment.
paras.zh: 几位体育界人士对罗杰斯的突然离开发表了看法，NBA球星凯文·杜兰特是最新发表评论的人之一。

paras.en: "Happy Thanksgiving, hiring a ice cream sandwich assistant for the day, great idea Mike," the Houston Rockets forward wrote on X on Thanksgiving morning.
paras.zh: “感恩节快乐，今天雇用一名冰淇淋三明治助理，好主意迈克，”这位休斯顿火箭队前锋在感恩节早上在 X 上写道。

paras.en: Durant's post surfaced hours after a 3-pointer in the first half of the Rockets game against the Phoenix Suns on Wednesday, made him the fifth NBA player to score 33,000 career points. Houston went to defeat Durant's former team 116-104, with Durant ending the game with 20 points.
paras.zh: 杜兰特在周三火箭队对阵菲尼克斯太阳队的比赛上半场投进三分球数小时后，他的帖子浮出水面，使他成为第五位职业生涯得分达到 33,000 分的 NBA 球员。火箭队以116-104击败杜兰特的老东家，杜兰特拿下20分结束比赛。

paras.en: McCarthy addressed the allegations raised by Rodgers, telling reporters the team's front office was ""very in tune with everything that goes on in football operations as far as my job responsibility."
paras.zh: 麦卡锡回应了罗杰斯提出的指控，他告诉记者，球队的管理层“就我的工作职责而言，与足球运营中发生的一切非常一致”。

paras.en: Rodgers acknowledged that his time with the Steelers was over, saying, "That ship has sailed."
paras.zh: 罗杰斯承认他在钢人队的时光已经结束，他说：“那艘船已经起航了。”

paras.en: Mason Rudolph is expected to start when the Black Friday game against the Denver Broncos kicks off. Rodgers suggested he was unaware he wouldn't be the starter going forward until a teammate alerted him.
paras.zh: 梅森·鲁道夫预计将在黑色星期五对阵丹佛野马队的比赛开始时首发。罗杰斯表示，直到队友提醒他，他才意识到自己不会成为首发。

paras.en: Steelers owner and president Art Rooney II responded with a show of support for McCarthy, telling the Post-Gazette that he "expects" McCarthy to "be our coach this season, next season and beyond."
paras.zh: 钢人队老板兼总裁阿特·鲁尼二世回应，表达了对麦卡锡的支持，他告诉《邮报》，他“希望”麦卡锡“成为我们本赛季、下赛季及以后的教练”。

paras.en: Rodgers expected to enter the waiver wire
paras.zh: 罗杰斯有望进入弃权线

paras.en: The NFL's trade deadline for this season had already passed by the time Rodgers was released, meaning the four-time league MVP will have to go through waivers before another potentially interested team claims him. If Rodgers makes it through waivers unclaimed, he would then be an unrestricted free agent.
paras.zh: 当罗杰斯被释放时，NFL 本赛季的交易截止日期已经过去，这意味着这位四届联盟 MVP 必须在另一支可能感兴趣的球队认领他之前先通过豁免。如果罗杰斯在无人认领的情况下通过弃权，那么他将成为一名不受限制的自由球员。

paras.en: Durant addresses confrontation with Dillon Brooks
paras.zh: 杜兰特谈到与狄龙布鲁克斯的对抗

paras.en: The Rockets-Suns game also managed to produce some holiday fireworks, as Durant and Dillon Brooks got wrapped up in a heated verbal back-and-forth. While players jawing back and forth isn't a new phenomenon, the exchange between Durant and Brooks raised eyebrows because it happened during a live play.
paras.zh: 火箭队与太阳队的比赛也上演了一些节日烟火，杜兰特和狄龙布鲁克斯陷入了激烈的争吵。虽然球员们互相吐槽并不是什么新鲜事，但杜兰特和布鲁克斯之间的交流却引起了人们的注意，因为这发生在现场比赛中。

paras.en: Durant untucked his Rockets jersey and pushed his forehead up against Brooks' forehead. Referees whistled for double technical fouls, with Brooks leaving the game due to a technical foul he received a few minutes prior to the confrontation with Durant.
paras.zh: 杜兰特解开火箭球衣，将额头抵在布鲁克斯的额头上。裁判吹罚两次技术犯规，布鲁克斯因在与杜兰特对抗前几分钟领到技术犯规而离场。

paras.en: Durant address the confrontation after the game, telling reporters, "I mean, I just love basketball. That simple."
paras.zh: 杜兰特赛后在面对冲突时告诉记者，“我的意思是，我只是喜欢篮球。就这么简单。”

paras.en: "I love to play ball. I love everything about the game, all the details that add up to winning. I care about that and I don't mind if somebody got a grievance with me. I don't mind addressing it right there in the moment. I'm sure he has some. I said some things that he probably didn't like, and he addressed it right there. And I can respect that as a man. And it didn't get farther than that. But if it does get farther than that, I'll be ready for that, too."
paras.zh: “我喜欢打球。我喜欢比赛的一切，所有有助于获胜的细节。我关心这一点，我不介意有人对我有不满。我不介意当场解决。我确信他有一些不满。我说了一些他可能不喜欢的话，他就在那里解决了。作为一个男人，我可以尊重这一点。而且没有比这更进一步的了。但如果确实比这更进一步，我会也为此做好准备。”

articles.title: Trump takes on Somali welfare dependency in Thanksgiving message, lays out who should stay in US

paras.en: In a lengthy Thanksgiving message on Truth Social Thursday, President Donald Trump praised a small fraction of the Somali community, saying they should be allowed to remain in the United States, while calling for the immediate removal of those receiving government assistance while unemployed.
paras.zh: 周四，唐纳德·特朗普总统在《真相社会》发表的长篇感恩节致辞中赞扬了索马里社区的一小部分人，称他们应该被允许留在美国，同时呼吁立即驱逐那些在失业期间接受政府援助的人。

paras.en: The holiday post mixed praise for "AMERICAN PATRIOTS" with criticism of the "Radical Far Left" and Minnesota’s Somali community, which Trump has frequently accused of public assistance fraud in the state.
paras.zh: 这篇假日帖子既赞扬了“美国爱国者”，又批评了“激进极左”和明尼苏达州的索马里社区，特朗普经常指责该州的索马里社区存在公共援助欺诈行为。

paras.en: "I want to thank the 2% of our Somalian population that have a job, and are actually willing to work, without receiving Government Assistance," Trump wrote in the post. "These are wonderful American ‘citizens,’ and should be allowed to stay in our Country, and celebrate Thanksgiving with us. The others should be thrown out, immediately, thereby saving the Great State of Minnesota, which has no chance if they are allowed to stay."
paras.zh: 特朗普在帖子中写道：“我要感谢索马里人口中 2% 的人有工作，而且实际上愿意在没有接受政府援助的情况下工作。” “这些都是很棒的美国‘公民’，应该被允许留在我们的国家，和我们一起庆祝感恩节。其他人应该立即被赶出去，从而拯救伟大的明尼苏达州，如果他们被允许留下来，明尼苏达州就没有机会了。”

paras.en: Trump’s remarks echo ongoing criticism from some Republicans regarding public benefit usage and fraud cases within the community.
paras.zh: 特朗普的言论呼应了一些共和党人对社区内公共福利使用和欺诈案件的持续批评。

paras.en: During a House Oversight Committee hearing in January, Rep. Brandon Gill, R-Texas, highlighted data on government support programs, noting that 54% of Somali-headed households in Minnesota receive food stamps.
paras.zh: 在 1 月份的众议院监督委员会听证会上，德克萨斯州共和党众议员布兰登·吉尔 (Brandon Gill) 强调了政府支持计划的数据，指出明尼苏达州 54% 的索马里人户主家庭收到了食品券。

paras.en: Elsewhere in the post, Trump claimed that "murderers, drug dealers, and criminals" — who he said illegally entered the U.S. from foreign prisons and mental institutions — have largely been deported.
paras.zh: 特朗普在帖子的其他地方声称，“杀人犯、毒贩和罪犯”——他说这些人是从外国监狱和精神病院非法进入美国的——大部分已被驱逐出境。

paras.en: "They are mostly gone now, brought back to their point of origin and, hopefully, living a beautiful and idyllic life, and promising, ideally, never to kill innocent people again," he wrote.
paras.zh: 他写道：“他们现在大多已经离开了，被带回了原点，希望能够过上美丽而田园诗般的生活，并承诺，理想情况下，永远不会再杀害无辜的人。”

paras.en: "We won’t have to worry about that, because they are GONE — but, Happy Thanksgiving to them anyway, even though from Faraway Lands," he added. "We miss you dearly, but you will never be back, and America will never allow what you have done to us to happen again!"
paras.zh: “我们不必担心这一点，因为他们已经走了——但是，无论如何，祝他们感恩节快乐，即使来自遥远的土地，”他补充道。 “我们非常想念你，但你永远不会回来，美国也不会允许你对我们所做的事情再次发生！”

paras.en: Secretary of State Marco Rubio also shared a holiday message on social media, with a video focused on opportunities provided by the U.S.
paras.zh: 美国国务卿马可·卢比奥也在社交媒体上分享了节日致辞，并发布了一段重点介绍美国提供的机会的视频。

paras.en: "We know how special this country is. It's the place that gave us freedom. It's a place that gave us opportunity. It's a place that's given our parents, our grandparents, and many of you the chance not just to do well in life, but to leave our children better off than ourselves," Rubio said in the video.
paras.zh: 卢比奥在视频中说：“我们知道这个国家有多特别。这是一个给了我们自由的地方。这是一个给了我们机会的地方。这个地方给了我们的父母、祖父母和你们中的许多人，不仅有机会过上好日子，而且让我们的孩子过得比我们自己更好。”

paras.en: In the attached caption, he added, "Being an American is a gift unlike any ever afforded to any other peoples throughout human history — we have so much to be thankful for. Happy Thanksgiving."
paras.zh: 在附加的标题中，他补充道，“作为一个美国人是一份不同于人类历史上任何其他民族所得到的礼物——我们有很多值得感激的事情。感恩节快乐。”

articles.title: UK shields fighter jets, contacts reservists in Cold War-scale push amid Russia threat

paras.en: The United Kingdom is bolstering its military readiness amid growing threats from Russia, contacting former service members to assess its reserves as the Royal Air Force reportedly strengthens defenses against potential drone attacks.
paras.zh: 在来自俄罗斯的威胁日益严重的情况下，英国正在加强军事准备，并联系前军人评估其储备，据报道，英国皇家空军加强了对潜在无人机袭击的防御。

paras.en: Britain's Ministry of Defence has written to former service members to verify their contact information and military skills to ensure the country is prepared for a national emergency or potential conflict, Secretary of State for Defence Wes Streeting confirmed Friday.
paras.zh: 英国国防部长韦斯·斯特里廷周五证实，英国国防部已致函退伍军人，核实他们的联系信息和军事技能，以确保英国为国家紧急情况或潜在冲突做好准备。

paras.en: The outreach comes as the International Institute for Strategic Studies warned Thursday that suspected Russian-directed sabotage across Europe could trigger a "mass-casualty event."
paras.zh: 此次外展活动正值国际战略研究所周四警告称，欧洲各地疑似俄罗斯主导的破坏活动可能引发“大规模伤亡事件”。

paras.en: The think tank found that sabotage incidents rose 16% in the year through September 2026, with Germany and Poland accounting for more than half of the cases. Researchers warned that a major attack could spark calls for retaliation and divide European governments.
paras.zh: 该智库发现，截至 2026 年 9 月的一年中，破坏事件增加了 16%，其中德国和波兰占案件的一半以上。研究人员警告说，一次重大袭击可能会引发报复的呼声，并导致欧洲各国政府分裂。

paras.en: "I want the country to be alert, not alarmed," Streeting told BBC Radio 4's "Today" program.
paras.zh: “我希望这个国家保持警惕，而不是惊慌，”斯特里廷告诉英国广播公司第四台“今日”节目。

paras.en: "You can't not look at what's going on in Europe and not be concerned about a threat environment which has deteriorated in recent years and is sadly increasing," he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“你不能不关注欧洲正在发生的事情，也不担心威胁环境近年来恶化，而且令人遗憾的是，威胁环境还在增加。”

paras.en: Streeting said the government needed updated records of its strategic reserve in case former service members were called upon to respond to a domestic disaster or overseas conflict.
paras.zh: 斯特里廷表示，政府需要更新其战略储备记录，以防前服役人员被要求应对国内灾难或海外冲突。

paras.en: He cited Russian incursions into Polish airspace, suspected Russian-sponsored sabotage across Europe and Iran-linked threats to British military bases.
paras.zh: 他列举了俄罗斯入侵波兰领空、涉嫌俄罗斯支持的欧洲各地破坏活动以及与伊朗有关的对英国军事基地的威胁。

paras.en: Last week, a suspected Russian projectile landed in eastern Poland about 60 miles from a British-led military exercise. The incident happened the same day Britain's defense secretary and chief of the air staff visited troops.
paras.zh: 上周，一枚疑似俄罗斯弹丸落在波兰东部，距离英国领导的军事演习约 60 英里。该事件发生在英国国防部长和空军参谋长视察军队的同一天。

paras.en: "And so against that backdrop, against that threat environment, the government and the country has to be ready to face down those risks," Streeting said. "Because the more ready we are, the less likely we are to find ourselves in a conflict, in a war. That is my goal. That is the goal of this government."
paras.zh: “因此，在这种背景下，在这种威胁环境下，政府和国家必须做好应对这些风险的准备，”斯特里廷说。 “因为我们准备得越充分，我们就越不可能陷入冲突、战争。这是我的目标，也是本届政府的目标。”

paras.en: The Ministry of Defence said in a news release it was contacting thousands of former military personnel this week as part of a drive to "strengthen the UK’s readiness and deliver on recommendations made in the Strategic Defence Review."
paras.zh: 英国国防部在一份新闻稿中表示，本周正在联系数千名前军事人员，以“加强英国的战备状态并落实《战略防御评估》中提出的建议”。

paras.en: "Service Chiefs are writing to members of the Strategic Reserve, asking them to stay connected and update their details, providing Defence with a better understanding of the skills and experience it could draw upon if needed."
paras.zh: “各军种首长正在写信给战略预备队成员，要求他们保持联系并更新详细信息，让国防部更好地了解需要时可以利用的技能和经验。”

paras.en: "In the coming months, Strategic Reservists will have the opportunity to volunteer for training and exercises, such as the UK’s participation in NATO’s flagship Steadfast Defender next spring."
paras.zh: “在接下来的几个月里，战略预备役军人将有机会自愿参加训练和演习，例如明年春天英国参加北约旗舰“坚定卫士”。”

paras.en: The outreach marks the first time since the Cold War that Britain's defense ministry has contacted reservists on such a scale to encourage participation in military exercises, according to The Telegraph.
paras.zh: 据《每日电讯报》报道，此次外展活动标志着自冷战以来英国国防部首次如此大规模地联系预备役军人以鼓励他们参加军事演习。

paras.en: Meanwhile, Britain's domestic intelligence agency, MI5, and the defense ministry have reportedly warned British companies supplying military equipment to Ukraine that they could be targeted by Russian saboteurs.
paras.zh: 与此同时，据报道，英国国内情报机构军情五处和国防部警告向乌克兰提供军事装备的英国公司，它们可能成为俄罗斯破坏分子的目标。

paras.en: The Royal Air Force is strengthening security at military bases, using hardened aircraft shelters and installing anti-drone netting to protect exposed fighter jets, according to The Times.
paras.zh: 据《泰晤士报》报道，英国皇家空军正在加强军事基地的安全，使用加固的飞机掩体并安装反无人机网来保护暴露的战斗机。

paras.en: The measures follow Iranian threats against military bases in England that prompted tighter security and the relocation of U.S. military aircraft.
paras.zh: 这些措施是在伊朗对英国军事基地发出威胁后采取的，这促使美国加强了安全保障，并迁移了美国军用飞机。

paras.en: Suspected drone incursions over European airfields have also heightened concerns about Russian aggression.
paras.zh: 疑似无人机入侵欧洲机场也加剧了人们对俄罗斯侵略的担忧。

paras.en: "We take the security of our bases, equipment and personnel very seriously and are always adapting to counter any potential threats," a Ministry of Defence spokesperson told Fox News Digital.
paras.zh: 国防部发言人告诉福克斯新闻数字频道：“我们非常重视基地、设备和人员的安全，并始终采取措施应对任何潜在威胁。”

paras.en: "This includes investing an additional £470 million to strengthen security at military sites, including better physical protection, surveillance and counter-drone capabilities.
paras.zh: “这包括额外投资 4.7 亿英镑来加强军事地点的安全，包括更好的实物保护、监视和反无人机能力。

paras.en: "We have already invested £15 million in drone and counter-drone technology and introduced restricted airspace over 44 critical Defence sites."
paras.zh: “我们已经在无人机和反无人机技术上投资了 1500 万英镑，并在 44 个关键防御地点引入了限制空域。”

paras.en: The developments come as President Donald Trump said Thursday he had asked Russian President Vladimir Putin to "pull back all military aggression" against Europe, signaling a shift in tone toward the Russian leader, whom he called a friend last week.
paras.zh: 事态发展正值唐纳德·特朗普总统周四表示，他已要求俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京“撤回对欧洲的所有军事侵略”，这表明他对这位上周称其为朋友的俄罗斯领导人的态度发生了转变。

paras.en: Trump said he made the request during a meeting with Putin in China last week, adding that he believed it could help secure a deal to end Russia's war in Ukraine.
paras.zh: 特朗普表示，他上周在中国与普京会面时提出了这一要求，并补充说，他相信这有助于达成协议，结束俄罗斯在乌克兰的战争。

paras.en: Trump's comments came a day after he hosted NATO Secretary-General Mark Rutte in Florida. The two leaders issued a joint statement urging Russia not to expand its war in Ukraine.
paras.zh: 特朗普发表此番言论的前一天，他在佛罗里达州接待了北约秘书长马克·吕特。两国领导人发表联合声明，敦促俄罗斯不要扩大在乌克兰的战争。

paras.en: "During my conversations in China with President Vladimir Putin, of Russia, I spent a lot of time talking about the fact that I would like to see President Putin pull back all Military aggression against territories throughout Europe," Trump said on Truth Social.
paras.zh: “在中国与俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京交谈期间，我花了很多时间谈论这样一个事实，即我希望看到普京总统撤回对整个欧洲领土的所有军事侵略，”特朗普在《真相社会》上表示。

articles.title: Nine injured, three critically, after Bangkok oil refinery explosion

paras.en: Nine people have been injured after an explosion at an oil refinery in Bangkok, authorities have said.
paras.zh: 当局称，曼谷一家炼油厂发生爆炸，造成九人受伤。

paras.en: Three of them are in critical condition, according to news agency AFP, which said the local hospital had revised its earlier assessment of four.
paras.zh: 据法新社报道，其中三人情况危急，当地医院已修改了之前对四人的评估。

paras.en: A fire broke out after the blast at the Phra Khanong facility run by energy giant Bangchak Corporation in the east of Thailand's capital at around 14:45 (07:45 GMT).
paras.zh: 14:45 左右（格林威治标准时间 07:45），泰国首都东部能源巨头 Bangchak Corporation 运营的 Phra Khanong 工厂发生爆炸，随后发生火灾。

paras.en: The company said the fire was brought under control and put out within 30 minutes, adding that the cause of the incident was being investigated.
paras.zh: 该公司表示，火势在30分钟内得到控制并被扑灭，并补充说正在调查事故原因。

paras.en: Black smoke could be seen across Bangkok's skyline after the blast, as local officials told residents to leave the area.
paras.zh: 爆炸发生后，曼谷天际线上可见黑烟，当地官员要求居民离开该地区。

paras.en: An alert sent to mobile phones by Bangkok authorities confirmed that the fire was under control, but urged people to avoid the area.
paras.zh: 曼谷当局向手机发送的警报证实火势已得到控制，但敦促人们避开该地区。

paras.en: Eyewitnesses shared video clips on social media of flames and smoke rising above the refinery.
paras.zh: 目击者在社交媒体上分享了炼油厂上方火焰和浓烟的视频片段。

paras.en: On a visit to the scene, Thailand's energy minister Akanat Promphan said it appeared the impact of the explosion was limited because the fire started in a distillation tower about 100m (330ft) from where oil was being stored.
paras.zh: 泰国能源部长 Akanat Promphan 在视察现场时表示，爆炸的影响似乎有限，因为火灾是从距离石油储存处约 100m（330 英尺）的蒸馏塔开始的。

paras.en: He said the incident was concerning as the refinery was in a residential area and the government was suspending production until it could be confident that operations would resume without any issues.
paras.zh: 他表示，这一事件令人担忧，因为炼油厂位于住宅区，政府正在暂停生产，直到有信心恢复运营而不会出现任何问题。

paras.en: Bangchak Corporation said air quality monitoring in the immediate area around the refinery was within normal ranges.
paras.zh: Bangchak公司表示，炼油厂附近区域的空气质量监测处于正常范围内。

paras.en: It confirmed that production at the site, which can process up to 120,000 barrels of oil a day had been shut down. The company has a second refinery in Chonburi province, about 50 miles (80km) from Bangkok, handling a daily capacity of about 180,000 barrels.
paras.zh: 该公司证实，该工厂每天可加工多达 12 万桶石油，其生产已被关闭。该公司在春武里府拥有第二家炼油厂，距离曼谷约 50 英里（80 公里），日处理能力约为 180,000 桶。

paras.en: An explosion occurred at the Bangkok refinery in July 2012, sparking a fire but no reported injuries.
paras.zh: 2012 年 7 月，曼谷炼油厂发生爆炸，引发火灾，但没有人员伤亡报告。

articles.title: Watch: Roofs torn off and streets under water as severe weather hits US

paras.en: Watch: Roofs torn off and streets under water as severe weather hits US
paras.zh: 观看：恶劣天气袭击美国，屋顶被掀翻，街道被水淹没

paras.en: Powerful storms are battering both US coasts as the Thanksgiving holiday weekend gets under way.
paras.zh: 随着感恩节假期周末的到来，强大的风暴正在袭击美国两个海岸。

paras.en: Hundreds of flights have been cancelled and hundreds of thousands are without power, in states including Virginia, North Carolina and New Jersey.
paras.zh: 在弗吉尼亚州、北卡罗来纳州和新泽西州等州，数百架航班被取消，数十万人断电。

paras.en: Strong winds have blown roofs off houses and floodwater has submerged streets.
paras.zh: 强风吹走了房屋的屋顶，洪水淹没了街道。

articles.title: Two Italians killed in strike in Kuwait, as Iran denies responsibility

paras.en: Two Italian nationals have died following a strike on a facility in Kuwait which both countries have blamed on Iran.
paras.zh: 科威特一处设施遭到袭击，造成两名意大利国民死亡，两国均将此次袭击归咎于伊朗。

paras.en: The pair were technicians working for German arms manufacturing company Rheinmetall, Italy's foreign ministry said.
paras.zh: 意大利外交部称，两人是德国武器制造公司莱茵金属公司的技术人员。

paras.en: Iran has denied responsibility for the attack, with Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi saying the incident looked "suspicious" and that Tehran would work with Kuwait and Italy to "determine the cause".
paras.zh: 伊朗否认对此次袭击负责，外交部长阿巴斯·阿拉格奇表示，这一事件看起来“可疑”，德黑兰将与科威特和意大利合作“确定原因”。

paras.en: Kuwait's defence ministry said earlier that four people - the two Italians, a Kuwaiti national and Pakistani national - had been injured from falling shrapnel after a number of drones from Iran were detected and intercepted.
paras.zh: 科威特国防部早些时候表示，在发现并拦截了多架来自伊朗的无人机后，有四人——两名意大利人、一名科威特公民和一名巴基斯坦公民——因坠落的弹片受伤。

paras.en: It comes just over a week after Kuwait said it had repelled overnight Iranian drone attacks on an airbase which hosts US forces - the first strikes in more than two months on the country.
paras.zh: 就在一周多前，科威特表示已击退伊朗无人机夜间对驻有美军的空军基地的袭击，这是两个多月以来对该国的首次袭击。

paras.en: Recent exchanges of fire between the US and Iran, and a deadlock in negotiations, have raised fears of a major escalation in the war.
paras.zh: 最近美国和伊朗之间的交火以及谈判陷入僵局，引发了人们对战争大幅升级的担忧。

paras.en: The conflict began when US and Israel attacked Iran in late February, with Iran retaliating by launching missiles and drones at Israel and Gulf Arab states hosting US military assets and personnel.
paras.zh: 冲突始于二月底美国和以色列袭击伊朗，伊朗向以色列和驻有美国军事资产和人员的海湾阿拉伯国家发射导弹和无人机进行报复。

paras.en: On Thursday, Araghchi said he had expressed condolences over the deaths in calls with his Italian and Kuwaiti counterparts and that the incident looked like a "precooked recipe for war", without expanding further.
paras.zh: 周四，阿拉格奇表示，他已在与意大利和科威特同行的电话中对死亡事件表示哀悼，并表示这一事件看起来像是“预先准备好的战争处方”，没有进一步扩大。

paras.en: Earlier, the country's armed forces spokesperson Abolfazl Shekarchi said "no military or offensive operations have been conducted" by Iran.
paras.zh: 早些时候，该国武装部队发言人阿博法兹尔·谢卡奇表示，伊朗“没有进行任何军事或进攻行动”。

paras.en: Kuwait's Army said the latest attack was on a "vital site in the country" and was the result of "heinous Iranian aggression", while confirming the deaths of the two Italian nationals.
paras.zh: 科威特陆军表示，最新的袭击发生在“该国的一个重要地点”，是“令人发指的伊朗侵略”的结果，同时证实了两名意大利国民的死亡。

paras.en: Italy's foreign minister was quoted by Italian media as saying that investigations showed that the drone used in the attack was manufactured in Iran and that Iranian proxies were known to carry out attacks in the region.
paras.zh: 意大利媒体援引意大利外交部长的话说，调查显示，袭击中使用的无人机是在伊朗制造的，并且已知伊朗代理人在该地区实施袭击。

paras.en: The two Italian nationals were working at an air defence detection station and performing maintenance work on systems used by the Kuwaiti Armed Forces, according to Italian press agency Ansa, citing Italy's foreign ministry.
paras.zh: 据意大利安莎通讯社援引意大利外交部的消息称，这两名意大利国民当时正在一个防空探测站工作，并对科威特武装部队使用的系统进行维护工作。

paras.en: Italian media outlets have named the two individuals. One of the men was reported to be 36, while the other was 65 and nearing retirement.
paras.zh: 意大利媒体已经点名了这两个人。据报道，其中一名男子 36 岁，另一名男子 65 岁，即将退休。

paras.en: Italian Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni wrote on X: "On my own behalf and on behalf of the government, I express my deepest sympathy and offer my heartfelt condolences to the victims' families.
paras.zh: 意大利总理梅洛尼在X上写道：“我谨代表我个人和政府，向遇难者家属表示最深切的同情和诚挚的慰问。

paras.en: "My thoughts are with all those affected by the attack and their families."
paras.zh: “我的心与所有受袭击影响的人及其家人同在。”

paras.en: European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen wrote on social media: "We must step up pressure on Iran to end these unacceptable attacks against its neighbours and our partners in the Gulf.
paras.zh: 欧盟委员会主席乌苏拉·冯德莱恩在社交媒体上写道：“我们必须加大对伊朗的压力，以结束对其邻国和海湾合作伙伴的这些不可接受的袭击。

paras.en: "Today's events are a further reminder that security in the Gulf is a security issue for us all."
paras.zh: “今天的事件进一步提醒我们，海湾地区的安全是我们所有人的安全问题。”

articles.title: Carlisle Launches EL121 Disc Brakes for Improved Performance and Wear Life

paras.en: Carlisle Launches EL121 Disc Brakes for Improved Performance and Wear Life
paras.zh: Carlisle 推出 EL121 盘式制动器，以提高性能和磨损寿命

paras.en: (MEDINA, OH, September 12, 2023) – Carlisle Brake & Friction is excited to announce the launch of EL121 Disc Brake Pads for mine haul truck applications. The new product series will be named Extended Life, or the EL Series, and EL121 will be the first friction formulation of the series to launch.
paras.zh: （俄亥俄州梅迪纳，2023 年 9 月 12 日）——Carlisle Brake & Friction 很高兴地宣布推出适用于矿用卡车应用的 EL121 盘式制动片。新产品系列将被命名为Extend Life，即EL系列，EL121将是该系列中首款推出的摩擦配方。

paras.en: Carlisle’s EL121 Series friction material nearly doubles the service life of front-axle, mine haul truck brake pads. The result is increased equipment uptime, and reduced maintenance costs when utilizing the OEM calipers and rotors.
paras.zh: 卡莱尔的 EL121 系列摩擦材料使前轴、矿用运输卡车刹车片的使用寿命几乎延长了一倍。使用 OEM 卡钳和转子时，可以增加设备的正常运行时间并降低维护成本。

paras.en: Autonomous haul trucks experience higher pad temperatures, which drive elevated pad wear from increased braking cycles as the retarder and the service brake are applied. EL121 features a highly wear-resistant friction material blend that provides extended brake pad life with consistent and fade-resistant braking performance. EL121 is the ideal solution for today’s autonomous mine haul trucks (may also be used in manned mine haul trucks for increased performance and longevity).
paras.zh: 自动运输卡车的刹车片温度较高，当使用缓速器和行车制动器时，制动周期的增加会导致刹车片磨损加剧。 EL121 采用高度耐磨的摩擦材料混合物，可延长刹车片的使用寿命，并具有一致且防褪色的制动性能。 EL121 是当今自动矿用运输卡车的理想解决方案（也可用于载人矿用运输卡车，以提高性能和使用寿命）。

paras.en: “We understand that mine operators need to keep their haul trucks on the job and not in the shop for brake service. Our latest innovation allows for up to double the service life of the front-axle mine haul truck brake pads and are a will-fit replacement to existing OEM pads. These were thoroughly lab tested as well as field tested on Komatsu 830E-1 trucks,” said Ron Ratell, Product Line Director Friction Products at Carlisle Brake & Friction.
paras.zh: 卡莱尔制动与摩擦公司摩擦产品产品线总监 Ron Ratell 表示：“我们了解矿山运营商需要让运输卡车继续工作，而不是在车间进行制动维修。我们的最新创新技术可将前轴矿用运输卡车制动片的使用寿命延长一倍，并且是现有 OEM 制动片的理想替代品。这些制动片经过了彻底的实验室测试以及小松 830E-1 卡车的现场测试。”

paras.en: EL121 friction has been dyno tested to replicate the application and is proven to deliver an innovative, high-energy material to meet market needs. EL121 disc brake pads also feature an industry-proven mechanical retention system with backing plate technology designed for superior bonding and durability, capable of withstanding abusive conditions in even the harshest Off-Highway environments.
paras.zh: EL121 摩擦力经过测功机测试以复制应用，并被证明可以提供创新的高能材料来满足市场需求。 EL121 盘式刹车片还采用经过行业验证的机械固定系统，采用背板技术，旨在实现卓越的粘合性和耐用性，甚至能够承受最恶劣的非公路环境中的恶劣条件。

paras.en: Carlisle’s EL121 Series disc brake pads are available now through authorized Carlisle dealers and distributors. To learn more, visit https://www.carlislecbf.com/products/brake-friction/disc-brake-pads/off-highway-disc-brake-pads/el. To locate an authorized Carlisle dealer near you, search our online distributor listing https://www.carlislecbf.com/support/find-a-distributor.
paras.zh: Carlisle 的 EL121 系列盘式刹车片现已通过 Carlisle 授权经销商和分销商发售。要了解更多信息，请访问 https://www.carlislecbf.com/products/brake-friction/disc-brake-pads/off-highway-disc-brake-pads/el。要查找您附近的卡莱尔授权经销商，请搜索我们的在线经销商列表 https://www.carlislecbf.com/support/find-a-distributor。

paras.en: Carlisle Brake & Friction is a globally recognized leader in the development and manufacture of highly innovative brake and friction system solutions to service a diverse range of motion control applications. The comprehensive nature of Carlisle’s brake system expertise includes hydraulic control products, industrial brake assemblies, wet and dry friction material for brake, clutch, and transmission applications as well as aftermarket replacement products. Our full-system product offering, supported by our industry-experience staff of experts, provides our customers with brake system solutions that set them apart from their competition. www.carlislecbf.com
paras.zh: Carlisle Brake & Friction 是全球公认的高度创新制动和摩擦系统解决方案开发和制造领域的领导者，为各种运动控制应用提供服务。卡莱尔制动系统专业知识的综合性包括液压控制产品、工业制动组件、用于制动、离合器和变速箱应用的湿式和干式摩擦材料以及售后替换产品。我们的全系统产品由具有行业经验的专家团队提供支持，为我们的客户提供制动系统解决方案，使他们在竞争中脱颖而出。 www.carlislecbf.com

articles.title: Carlisle Releases Video Highlighting Solutions for Ag

paras.en: Carlisle Releases Video Highlighting Solutions for Ag
paras.zh: Carlisle 发布 Ag 视频突出显示解决方案

paras.en: Carlisle Brake & Friction launches a new product solutions video: Carlisle Solutions for Tractor Applications, to showcase all of the latest motion control technologies available for agriculture equipment, specifically tractor applications.
paras.zh: 卡莱尔制动与摩擦公司推出了新产品解决方案视频：卡莱尔拖拉机应用解决方案，展示适用于农业设备（特别是拖拉机应用）的所有最新运动控制技术。

paras.en: From power valves, to disc brakes, to PTO and shuttle clutch friction options, this video breaks down all of the features and benefits of Carlisle’s newest brake system and powertrain solutions.
paras.zh: 从动力阀到盘式制动器，再到取力器和梭式离合器摩擦选项，该视频详细介绍了卡莱尔最新制动系统和动力总成解决方案的所有功能和优点。

paras.en: For improved visualization, the video features 3D animation and demonstrations of the product fitments within a standard tractor model.
paras.zh: 为了提高可视化效果，该视频采用 3D 动画和标准拖拉机模型中的产品配件演示。

articles.title: Carlisle Suzhou Achieves Caterpillar SER Certification

paras.en: Carlisle Suzhou Achieves Caterpillar SER Certification
paras.zh: 卡莱苏州获得卡特彼勒 SER 认证

paras.en: (MEDINA, January 25, 2024) – Carlisle Brake & Friction announced its Suzhou facility has won a Supplier Excellence Recognition (SER) Certification from Caterpillar Inc. The Caterpillar SER is a new supplier management system featuring "Certified" and "Excellent" levels. Caterpillar officially launched the program in 2022. Carlisle's Suzhou manufacturing facility achieved a "Certified" level of recognition and celebrated the achievement alongside the Caterpillar team with a ceremony at the Carlisle Suzhou plant.
paras.zh: （梅迪纳，2024 年 1 月 25 日）——卡莱尔制动与摩擦公司宣布其苏州工厂获得卡特彼勒公司颁发的供应商卓越认可 (SER) 认证。卡特彼勒 SER 是一种新的供应商管理体系，具有“认证”和“优秀”级别。卡特彼勒于 2022 年正式启动该计划。卡莱尔苏州制造工厂获得了“认证”级别的认可，并与卡特彼勒团队在卡莱尔苏州工厂举行了仪式，庆祝这一成就。

paras.en: Of 27,000 suppliers, 250 were among the selected companies awarded by Caterpillar. Carlisle, a leading global supplier of brake, clutch, and transmission friction products, is the only friction products manufacturer worldwide to win the coveted certification.
paras.zh: 在 27,000 家供应商中，有 250 家入选卡特彼勒授予的奖项。 Carlisle 是全球领先的制动器、离合器和变速箱摩擦产品供应商，也是全球唯一一家获得这一令人垂涎的认证的摩擦产品制造商。

paras.en: "We are honored to be recognized by Caterpillar as a Certified level supplier," said Doug Wagner, Global VP of Sales, Carlisle Brake & Friction. "This award recognizes the superior efforts and dedication of the entire Suzhou team that supports our global business."
paras.zh: “我们很荣幸被 Caterpillar 认可为认证级供应商，”Carlisle 制动与摩擦部全球销售副总裁 Doug Wagner 说道。 “该奖项是对支持我们全球业务的整个苏州团队的卓越努力和奉献精神的认可。”

paras.en: Carlisle earned SER Certification in recognition of the company's exemplary commitment to supporting Caterpillar's global growth strategy goals.
paras.zh: Carlisle 获得了 SER 认证，以表彰该公司对支持 Caterpillar 全球增长战略目标的模范承诺。

paras.en: Carlisle Brake & Friction is a globally recognized leader in the development and manufacture of highly innovative brake and friction system solutions to service a diverse range of motion control applications. The comprehensive nature of Carlisle’s brake system expertise includes hydraulic control products, industrial brake assemblies, wet and dry friction material for brake, clutch, and transmission applications as well as aftermarket replacement products. Our full-system product offering, supported by our industry-experience staff of experts, provides our customers with brake system solutions that set them apart from their competition. www.carlislecbf.com

articles.title: Milwaukee Tool Introduces New M18 REDLITHIUM FORGE HD15 Battery Pack
articles.author: Jason Stahl

paras.en: Milwaukee Tool has introduced the M18 REDLITHIUM FORGE HD15 Battery Pack, delivering increased power and runtime for demanding applications across the M18 system.
paras.zh: Milwaukee Tool 推出了 M18 REDLITHIUM FORGE HD15 电池组，为 M18 系统中要求苛刻的应用提供更高的功率和运行时间。

paras.en: This new battery delivers 50% more power than the M18 REDLITHIUM HIGH OUTPUT HD12.0 Battery Pack and 25% more runtime than the M18 REDLITHIUM FORGE HD12.0 Battery Pack, giving users the ability to get more work done than ever before. The new HD15 is also the same size as the M18 REDLITHIUM FORGE HD12.0, giving the user more capability without sacrificing size and weight.
paras.zh: 这款新型电池的电量比 M18 REDLITHIUM HIGH OUTPUT HD12.0 电池组多 50%，运行时间比 M18 REDLITHIUM FORGE HD12.0 电池组多 25%，让用户能够比以往完成更多工作。新款 HD15 的尺寸也与 M18 REDLITHIUM FORGE HD12.0 相同，在不牺牲尺寸和重量的情况下为用户提供更多功能。

paras.en: “Our users continue to push cordless equipment into increasingly demanding applications, creating a need for greater power and runtime without sacrificing size,” said Zafir Farooque, director of product marketing at Milwaukee Tool. “With the M18 REDLITHIUM FORGE HD15 Battery Pack, we’re expanding the capability of the M18 system by delivering our highest-capacity M18 REDLITHIUM FORGE battery with the power, runtime and durability professionals need for demanding work.”
paras.zh: Milwaukee Tool 产品营销总监 Zafir Farooque 表示：“我们的用户不断将无绳设备推向要求越来越高的应用，从而需要在不牺牲尺寸的情况下提高功率和运行时间。” “借助 M18 REDLITHIUM FORGE HD15 电池组，我们提供最高容量的 M18 REDLITHIUM FORGE 电池，为专业人士提供高要求工作所需的功率、运行时间和耐用性，从而扩展了 M18 系统的功能。”

paras.en: Built for high-demand applications, the M18 REDLITHIUM FORGE HD15 provides 15 amp hours of runtime and reaches PWR Level 5 on the REDLITHIUM Power Scale. The combination of increased power and capacity gives users the performance and runtime needed to take on long-duration and demanding applications, and continue conversion from AC, gas and pneumatic solutions.
paras.zh: M18 REDLITHIUM FORGE HD15 专为高要求应用而打造，可提供 15 安培小时的运行时间，并达到 REDLITHIUM 功率等级上的 PWR 5 级。增加的功率和容量相结合，为用户提供了执行长期和要求苛刻的应用所需的性能和运行时间，并继续从交流、气体和气动解决方案转换。

paras.en: The M18 REDLITHIUM FORGE HD15 is engineered to minimize downtime in high-demand applications. When paired with the M18 and M12 Four Bay Simultaneous Super Charger, the battery can supercharge in 25 minutes to 80%, making it our fastest charging M18 battery. The battery is also COOL-CYCLE capable, providing high-speed cooling with COOL-CYCLE capable chargers to charge hot batteries 3x faster, helping users achieve less downtime in demanding applications and hot environments. Designed for demanding jobsite conditions, the battery features a patented ingress coating and upgraded venting design for increased protection while maximizing active cooling. A resistant housing further enhances durability by providing increased protection against exposure to common oils, greases and solvents.
paras.zh: M18 REDLITHIUM FORGE HD15 旨在最大限度地减少高要求应用中的停机时间。与 M18 和 M12 四槽同时超级充电器配合使用时，电池可在 25 分钟内超级充电至 80%，使其成为我们充电速度最快的 M18 电池。该电池还支持 COOL-CYCLE，通过支持 COOL-CYCLE 的充电器提供高速冷却，使热电池充电速度提高 3 倍，帮助用户在要求苛刻的应用和炎热环境中减少停机时间。该电池专为苛刻的工作现场条件而设计，具有专利入口涂层和升级的通风设计，可在最大限度地提高主动冷却的同时增强保护。耐用的外壳可提供更好的保护，防止接触常见的油、油脂和溶剂，从而进一步增强耐用性。

paras.en: For more information, visit milwaukeetool.com.
paras.zh: 欲了解更多信息，请访问 milwaukeetool.com。

articles.title: NABC, Partners Donate Recycled Ride to Navy Veteran
articles.author: Jason Stahl

paras.en: On Tuesday, Nov. 17, a U.S. Navy veteran and single mother from the Twin Cities received a refurbished vehicle to help her maintain employment, continue building a sustainable future and create greater opportunities for herself and her family. The donation was made possible by the NABC Recycled Rides program, vehicle donor Farmers and repair partner Heppner’s Auto Body & Glass.
paras.zh: 11 月 17 日星期二，一位来自双城的美国海军退伍军人和单身母亲收到了一辆翻新车辆，以帮助她维持就业、继续建设可持续的未来并为自己和家人创造更多机会。此次捐赠是由 NABC Recycled Rides 计划、车辆捐赠者 Farmers 和维修合作伙伴 Heppner’s Auto Body & Glass 共同促成的。

paras.en: The recipient was nominated by the Minnesota Assistance Council for Veterans, whose mission is to end veteran homelessness in Minnesota.
paras.zh: 获奖者是由明尼苏达州退伍军人援助委员会提名的，该委员会的使命是结束明尼苏达州退伍军人无家可归的现象。

paras.en: Stacya May is a U.S. Navy veteran who proudly served from 2012 to 2017, conducting mine countermeasures. During her military service, she deployed to Bahrain in June 2014 and earned her Air Warfare pin. She was honorably discharged after five years of service.
paras.zh: Stacya May 是一名美国海军退伍军人，她自豪地在 2012 年至 2017 年期间服役，从事扫雷反制工作。服役期间，她于2014年6月被部署到巴林，并获得了空战勋章。服役五年后，她光荣退伍。

paras.en: Today, May is focused on building a stable and successful future for her and her family. She is currently attending college, pursuing a degree in supply chain logistics. Her goal is to complete her two-year degree and transfer to the University of Minnesota to continue her education.
paras.zh: 如今，梅专注于为她和她的家人打造稳定和成功的未来。她目前正在上大学，攻读供应链物流学位。她的目标是完成两年制学位并转学到明尼苏达大学继续学业。

paras.en: This vehicle will allow her to transport her disabled cousin to medical appointments, provide safer and more dependable transportation for her child, help maintain her educational commitments and support the stability that she has worked hard to achieve.
paras.zh: 这辆车将使她能够运送她残疾的表弟去就医，为她的孩子提供更安全、更可靠的交通，帮助维持她的教育承诺，并支持她努力实现的稳定。

paras.en: Additional partners in this presentation included: Enterprise; O’Reilly; Finishing Touch Car Care; Roseville Midway Ford; Auto Images; Southeast Towing; Showroom Auto Care; PPG; Inver Grove Honda; Advanced Vehicle Solutions; Advanced Remarketing Services; Cars for Charity; and Copart.
paras.zh: 本次演示中的其他合作伙伴包括：Enterprise；奥莱利；画龙点睛的汽车护理；罗斯维尔中途福特；汽车图像；东南拖车；展厅汽车护理； PPG；因弗格罗夫本田；先进的车辆解决方案；高级再营销服务；慈善汽车；和科帕特。

paras.en: Individuals in the community can support this program in two ways — donate to the program directly or donate their unwanted or non-running vehicle through the Changing and Saving Lives Keys for Change program. They will receive a tax donation for their contribution, and proceeds will help provide reliable transportation for those in need across the country — and in their community.
paras.zh: 社区中的个人可以通过两种方式支持该计划——直接向该计划捐款，或者通过“改变和拯救生命钥匙促进改变”计划捐赠他们不需要或未运行的车辆。他们的贡献将获得税收捐赠，收益将有助于为全国各地及其社区有需要的人提供可靠的交通。

paras.en: Farmers, a level one partner of the NABC, has donated nearly 100 vehicles to people and organizations through the Recycled Rides program.
paras.zh: Farmers 是 NABC 的一级合作伙伴，已通过“回收乘车”计划向个人和组织捐赠了近 100 辆车辆。

paras.en: Heppner’s Auto Body & Glass is an I-CAR Gold Class repair facility. With six locations, they have been serving the Twin Cities for more than 65 years, and have presented multiple Recycled Rides to people in need in their local community.
paras.zh: Heppner 的车身和玻璃是 I-CAR 黄金级维修厂。他们拥有六个地点，为双子城提供服务已超过 65 年，并向当地社区有需要的人们提供了多个回收游乐设施。

paras.en: For more information on Recycled Rides, click here.
paras.zh: 有关回收游乐设施的更多信息，请单击此处。

articles.title: MANN+HUMMEL’s Hasmeet Kaur and Cedric Dackam on Anticipating What’s Next
articles.author: Jason Stahl

paras.en: This episode of DriveTime features Hasmeet Kaur, president, Transportation Division, MANN+HUMMEL, and Cedric Dackam, president & GM, Automotive Aftermarket, MANN+HUMMEL.
paras.zh: 本期《DriveTime》由曼胡默尔运输部门总裁 Hasmeet Kaur 和曼胡默尔汽车售后市场总裁兼总经理 Cedric Dackam 担任嘉宾。

paras.en: As the automotive industry undergoes significant transformation, MANN+HUMMEL is leveraging its presence in both the original equipment and aftermarket sectors to deliver solutions throughout a vehicle’s lifecycle. Kaur explained how the company’s integrated business model enables it to anticipate customer needs, beginning with vehicle design and continuing through aftermarket service and repair. Rather than treating OE and aftermarket operations as separate businesses, Kaur emphasized how the two segments complement each other, allowing MANN+HUMMEL to address evolving customer requirements while positioning both for long-term growth.
paras.zh: 随着汽车行业经历重大转型，曼胡默尔正在利用其在原始设备和售后市场领域的影响力，在车辆的整个生命周期中提供解决方案。考尔解释了该公司的综合业务模式如何使其能够预测客户需求，从车辆设计开始，一直到售后服务和维修。考尔没有将原配设备和售后市场业务视为独立的业务，而是强调这两个部门如何相互补充，使曼胡默尔能够满足不断变化的客户需求，同时为两者的长期增长做好准备。

paras.en: Dackam highlighted the growing complexity facing aftermarket suppliers and customers. An aging vehicle fleet, electrification, advanced vehicle technologies and increasing parts proliferation are reshaping the industry’s challenges and opportunities. He said customers increasingly expect more than quality products, placing greater importance on predictive analytics, accurate coverage and access to vehicle data. He also emphasized how MANN+HUMMEL’s OE engineering expertise helps the company prepare aftermarket solutions for emerging technologies, including filtration applications in battery safety, thermal management and battery venting. Its established WIX, Purolator and MANN-FILTER brands further support the company’s ability to serve different market segments and distribution channels.
paras.zh: 达卡姆强调了售后市场供应商和客户面临的日益复杂的问题。车队老化、电气化、先进的车辆技术和零部件的激增正在重塑该行业的挑战和机遇。他表示，客户对优质产品的期望越来越高，他们更加重视预测分析、准确的覆盖范围和车辆数据的访问。他还强调了曼胡默尔的原厂工程专业知识如何帮助公司为新兴技术准备售后解决方案，包括电池安全、热管理和电池通风方面的过滤应用。其成熟的 WIX、Purolator 和 MANN-FILTER 品牌进一步支持了公司服务不同细分市场和分销渠道的能力。

paras.en: Looking ahead, Kaur emphasized MANN+HUMMEL’s commitment to innovation, sustainability and its core mission of separating the useful from the harmful. She pointed to investments in filtration media development and vertical integration that enable the company to accelerate innovation and tailor solutions to customer needs. Kaur also discussed her leadership philosophy, emphasizing trust, empowerment and creating an environment where teams can perform at their best. Dackam reinforced the importance of anticipating industry change and translating emerging technologies into aftermarket opportunities, noting that the company’s engineering capabilities, established brands and customer relationships provide a foundation for navigating the industry’s evolving landscape.
paras.zh: 展望未来，考尔强调了曼胡默尔对创新、可持续发展的承诺以及将有用与有害分开的核心使命。她指出，在过滤介质开发和垂直整合方面的投资使公司能够加速创新并根据客户需求定制解决方案。考尔还讨论了她的领导理念，强调信任、授权以及创造一个让团队能够发挥最佳水平的环境。达卡姆强调了预测行业变化并将新兴技术转化为售后市场机会的重要性，并指出公司的工程能力、知名品牌和客户关系为驾驭行业不断发展的格局奠定了基础。

paras.en: To hear more of Kaur’s and Dackam’s insights, be sure to watch the above video.
paras.zh: 要了解更多考尔和达卡姆的见解，请务必观看上面的视频。

paras.zh: - 曼胡默尔的集成原厂和售后市场业务模式如何在整个车辆生命周期内为客户提供支持。 (1:04)
