articles.title: Popular Skincare Ingredient Lowers Inflammation Markers in 12-Week Clinical Trial
articles.author: Peter Dockrill

paras.en: They say beauty is only skin deep, but a common skincare ingredient appears to have effects that extend much further than that.
paras.zh: 人们说美丽只是表面现象，但一种常见的护肤成分似乎具有比这更深远的影响。

paras.en: Hyaluronic acid is a naturally occurring compound in the body, where it contributes to tissue structure and hydration.
paras.zh: 透明质酸是体内天然存在的化合物，有助于组织结构和水合作用。

paras.en: While most people might be familiar with hyaluronic acid as an oral supplement or topical skincare product, it's also been shown to have broader therapeutic actions, delivering benefits in cases of joint pain and intestinal inflammation.
paras.zh: 虽然大多数人可能熟悉透明质酸作为口服补充剂或外用护肤产品，但它也被证明具有更广泛的治疗作用，对关节疼痛和肠道炎症有好处。

paras.en: There's still a lot we don't know about how hyaluronic acid delivers these benefits, but new research is offering some clues, as well as providing more evidence of how the substance may boost health.
paras.zh: 关于透明质酸如何提供这些益处，我们还有很多不了解的地方，但新的研究提供了一些线索，并提供了更多证据来证明该物质如何促进健康。

paras.en: A recent clinical trial – described in Scientific Reports – suggests that swallowing hyaluronic acid can lower signs of inflammation in the body, even in people who are already healthy.
paras.zh: 《科学报告》中描述的最近一项临床试验表明，吞咽透明质酸可以降低体内炎症迹象，即使对于已经健康的人也是如此。

paras.en: In the study, researchers in the Czech Republic recruited 150 healthy adults and randomly assigned them to drink a daily solution containing either 60 mg of hyaluronic acid, a stronger 120 mg dose, or a placebo, for a period of 12 weeks.
paras.zh: 在这项研究中，捷克共和国的研究人员招募了 150 名健康成年人，并随机分配他们每天饮用含有 60 毫克透明质酸、更强剂量的 120 毫克或安慰剂的溶液，为期 12 周。

paras.en: In terms of skin outcomes, the hyaluronic acid produced a number of beneficial effects to the participants' skin condition and structure, particularly in those taking the 120 mg dose. These results were reported in a paper published last year.
paras.zh: 就皮肤效果而言，透明质酸对参与者的皮肤状况和结构产生了许多有益的影响，特别是对于服用 120 毫克剂量的参与者。这些结果发表在去年发表的一篇论文中。

paras.en: But it wasn't just the participants' skin that saw changes.
paras.zh: 但发生变化的不仅仅是参与者的皮肤。

paras.en: In addition to skin evaluations, the researchers also analyzed blood samples taken from the participants both before and after the hyaluronic acid supplementation.
paras.zh: 除了皮肤评估之外，研究人员还分析了参与者补充透明质酸之前和之后采集的血液样本。

paras.en: Results showed that the participants taking 120 mg of hyaluronic acid saw significant reductions in two markers of inflammation, C-reactive protein (CRP) and interleukin–1 beta (IL–1β), along with lower levels of arachidonic acid, which serves as a building block for signaling molecules that drive inflammation.
paras.zh: 结果显示，服用 120 毫克透明质酸的参与者发现两种炎症标志物 C 反应蛋白 (CRP) 和白细胞介素 - 1 β (IL - 1 β) 显着减少，同时花生四烯酸水平降低，花生四烯酸是驱动炎症的信号分子的组成部分。

paras.en: "Interestingly, statistically significant differences were observed despite the fact that these were healthy volunteers with physiologically very low levels of these mediators," the researchers write in their paper.
paras.zh: 研究人员在论文中写道：“有趣的是，尽管这些志愿者都是健康的志愿者，但生理上这些介质的水平非常低，但观察到了统计学上的显着差异。”

paras.en: "Together, these observations suggest a potentially favorable pattern in selected inflammation-related markers."
paras.zh: “总的来说，这些观察结果表明选定的炎症相关标记物存在潜在有利的模式。”

paras.en: The 120 mg dose also produced reductions in the proteins fetuin-A and adipsin – which are linked to metabolic syndrome, obesity, inflammation, and insulin resistance.
paras.zh: 120 毫克剂量还导致胎球蛋白 A 和脂肪素蛋白减少，这两种蛋白与代谢综合征、肥胖、炎症和胰岛素抵抗有关。

paras.en: But not all the changes were necessarily beneficial.
paras.zh: 但并非所有的改变都一定是有益的。

paras.en: The group taking 120 mg of hyaluronic acid also showed lower levels of two anti-inflammatory proteins – IL–10 and IL–1 receptor antagonist (IL–1RA) – which the researchers suggest could reflect a reduced need for the body to counteract inflammation.
paras.zh: 服用 120 毫克透明质酸的实验组还发现两种抗炎蛋白——IL-10 和 IL-1 受体拮抗剂 (IL-1RA) 的水平较低，研究人员认为这可能反映出身体对抗炎症的需求减少。

paras.en: The study was partly funded by Contipro, a Czech biotech company that researches and manufactures hyaluronic acid, and a number of the study's authors are Contipro employees, in addition to researchers from Masaryk University.
paras.zh: 该研究的部分资金由 Contipro（一家研究和生产透明质酸的捷克生物技术公司）资助，该研究的许多作者都是 Contipro 的员工，此外还有来自马萨里克大学的研究人员。

paras.en: Overall, the results suggest orally administered hyaluronic acid can produce measurable changes beyond the skin even in people without diagnosed disease.
paras.zh: 总体而言，结果表明，即使对于没有诊断出疾病的人来说，口服透明质酸也可以产生皮肤以外的可测量的变化。

paras.en: But while the study identified reductions in several key inflammation markers, the trial only lasted 12 weeks, and it's unclear whether these changes would ultimately translate into meaningful health benefits.
paras.zh: 尽管该研究发现了几个关键炎症标志物的减少，但试验只持续了 12 周，目前尚不清楚这些变化是否最终会转化为有意义的健康益处。

paras.en: Further, the researchers note a number of potential confounding factors were not strictly controlled during the experiment, including diet, lifestyle, transient infections, physical activity, and hormonal status.
paras.zh: 此外，研究人员指出，实验过程中并未严格控制一些潜在的混杂因素，包括饮食、生活方式、短暂感染、体力活动和荷尔蒙状态。

paras.en: Because of the limitations, more research is needed to establish whether these biological changes translate into genuine health benefits, but there are promising signs here.
paras.zh: 由于这些限制，需要更多的研究来确定这些生物学变化是否转化为真正的健康益处，但这里已经出现了有希望的迹象。

paras.en: "These findings suggest a modest shift toward a less inflammatory and more metabolically favorable systemic profile, consistent with a potential role of oral hyaluronic acid in immune–metabolic regulation," the researchers conclude.
paras.zh: 研究人员总结道：“这些研究结果表明，炎症减轻、代谢更有利的全身状况发生了适度的转变，这与口服透明质酸在免疫代谢调节中的潜在作用一致。”

paras.en: "However, the effects were rather selective. Further studies using targeted mechanistic approaches and microbiome analysis are needed to confirm hyaluronic acid-specific effects and clarify the pathways linking oral hyaluronic acid intake with systemic and tissue-level outcomes."
paras.zh: “然而，效果相当有选择性。需要使用有针对性的机制方法和微生物组分析进行进一步研究，以确认透明质酸的特异性效果，并阐明口服透明质酸摄入与全身和组织水平结果之间的联系途径。”

paras.en: The findings are reported in Scientific Reports.
paras.zh: 研究结果发表在《科学报告》中。

articles.title: First Close-Up Images of Asteroid Struck by NASA Reveal a Giant Crater – And a Swarm of Mysterious Flying Boulders
articles.author: Michelle Starr

paras.en: Four years ago, a monumental collision took place, 11 million kilometers (6.8 million miles) from Earth.
paras.zh: 四年前，距地球 1100 万公里（680 万英里）处发生了一次巨大的碰撞。

paras.en: It wasn't the biggest commotion that the Solar System had ever seen, but it was a huge moment for humanity.
paras.zh: 这并不是太阳系有史以来最大规模的骚乱，但对人类来说却是一个重要时刻。

paras.en: NASA sent a spacecraft to a small asteroid and deliberately crashed it into the space rock – a first-ever test of a technology that could one day save us from an asteroid on an Earth-bound trajectory.
paras.zh: 美国宇航局向一颗小型小行星发射了一艘航天器，并故意将其撞向太空岩石——这是对一项技术的首次测试，有朝一日可以将我们从地球轨道上的小行星中拯救出来。

paras.en: The asteroid itself was innocent – an acceptable casualty in a much larger war. And oh, what a casualty it was.
paras.zh: 小行星本身是无辜的——在一场规模大得多的战争中，这是可以接受的伤亡。哦，这是多么严重的伤亡啊。

paras.en: For a little over two years, the European Space Agency's spacecraft Hera had been winging its way to Dimorphos to investigate the scene of the crime – and now it has revealed a giant scar across the entire width of the asteroid.
paras.zh: 两年多来，欧洲航天局的赫拉号宇宙飞船一直在飞往迪莫福斯调查犯罪现场，现在它发现了横跨小行星整个宽度的巨大疤痕。

paras.en: "Scientists debated whether Dimorphos had sustained an impact crater, changed its shape, or stayed the same," says Hera principal investigator Patrick Michel of the CNRS's Observatoire de la Côte d'Azur.
paras.zh: 法国国家科学研究中心蔚蓝海岸天文台的赫拉首席研究员帕特里克·米歇尔说：“科学家们争论迪莫福斯是否存在撞击坑、改变了形状，还是保持不变。”

paras.en: "Much to our surprise, the answer turns out to be all three at once! The face struck by DART has been flattened into an impact crater the size of a sports stadium, which extends across the asteroid's entire width."
paras.zh: “令我们惊讶的是，答案竟然同时是三个！被 DART 击中的表面已被夷为体育场大小的撞击坑，延伸到小行星的整个宽度。”

paras.en: The mission was called the Double Asteroid Redirection Test, or DART, and the question it posed was a simple one: Can we change the trajectory of an asteroid by physically smacking it?
paras.zh: 这项任务被称为双小行星重定向测试（DART），它提出的问题很简单：我们能否通过物理撞击小行星来改变它的轨道？

paras.en: The target was a pair of asteroids gravitationally bound to one another – the larger, named Didymos, measuring about 730 meters across (2,395 feet), and the smaller, called Dimorphos, about 151 meters across.
paras.zh: 目标是一对相互引力束缚的小行星——较大的小行星名为 Didymos，直径约 730 米（2,395 英尺），较小的小行星名为 Dimorphos，直径约 151 米。

paras.en: Since Dimorphos is the smaller of the two, it would be easier to move, and any change in its orbit around Didymos could be readily measured using telescopes on Earth. So Dimorphos was DART's target.
paras.zh: 由于 Dimorphos 是两者中较小的一个，因此它更容易移动，并且它围绕 Didymos 的轨道的任何变化都可以使用地球上的望远镜轻松测量。所以 Dimorphos 是 DART 的目标。

paras.en: On 26 September 2022, after the spacecraft had traveled for a little over 10 months, the collision took place. Dust spewed forth, DART was toast, and the success was greater than anyone had dared to dream.
paras.zh: 2022 年 9 月 26 日，飞船飞行了 10 个多月后，发生了碰撞。灰尘四溅，DART 被干杯，其成功程度超乎任何人的想象。

paras.en: NASA had set a minimum benchmark for success: reducing Dimorphos's orbital period around Didymos by 73 seconds.
paras.zh: NASA 设定了成功的最低基准：将 Dimorphos 围绕 Didymos 的轨道周期缩短 73 秒。

paras.en: The actual reduction was a whopping 33 minutes – and the pair's entire orbit around the Sun had also changed.
paras.zh: 实际缩短了 33 分钟，而且这对行星绕太阳的整个轨道也发生了变化。

paras.en: But alas, the cameras of a small Italian spacecraft named LICIACube, which had accompanied DART to photograph the impact, couldn't see the damage through the enormous cloud of debris ejected by the impact. By the time the dust settled, LICIACube was long gone.
paras.zh: 但遗憾的是，伴随 DART 拍摄这次撞击的意大利小型航天器 LICIACube 的相机无法透过撞击喷射出的巨大碎片云看到损坏情况。等到尘埃落定，LICIACube 早已不见踪影。

paras.en: Whatever scars Dimorphos had retained from the encounter remained a mystery.
paras.zh: 无论迪莫福斯在这次遭遇中留下了什么伤疤，仍然是个谜。

paras.en: It wasn't an idle question. Dimorphos is what is known as a rubble-pile asteroid. Rather than a single, solid chunk of rock, it's an agglomeration of smaller rocks held together by their mutual gravity – and that gravity is exceedingly weak.
paras.zh: 这不是一个无聊的问题。 Dimorphos 是一颗碎石堆小行星。它不是一块单一的、坚固的岩石，而是由相互重力聚集在一起的较小岩石的聚集体，而且重力非常弱。

paras.en: This complicates predictions about how such an asteroid might respond to an impact. In fact, simulations published in 2024 suggested that DART might not have left a distinct crater at all, instead reorganizing the asteroid's constituent rocks into an entirely different shape.
paras.zh: 这使得关于这样的小行星如何应对撞击的预测变得更加复杂。事实上，2024 年发布的模拟表明，DART 可能根本没有留下明显的陨石坑，而是将小行星的组成岩石重新组织成完全不同的形状。

paras.en: To find out, it required sending something that could give us visual confirmation – and that's where Hera enters the scene. Launched in October 2024, the spacecraft carries a suite of instruments designed to investigate DART's impact on the Didymos-Dimorphos system.
paras.zh: 为了找到答案，需要发送一些可以给我们视觉确认的东西——这就是赫拉登场的地方。该航天器于 2024 年 10 月发射，携带一套仪器，旨在研究 DART 对 Didymos-Dimorphos 系统的影响。

paras.en: And what it has found is a curious combination of destruction and preservation.
paras.zh: 它发现了破坏与保护的奇妙结合。

paras.en: On the side of Dimorphos struck by DART, the asteroid's once-rounded profile has been dramatically flattened. The impact crater is so large relative to the asteroid itself that it has changed the rock's overall shape.
paras.zh: 在 Dimorphos 被 DART 撞击的一侧，这颗小行星曾经呈圆形的轮廓已急剧变平。撞击坑相对于小行星本身来说太大了，以至于改变了岩石的整体形状。

paras.en: Elsewhere, however, the landscape looks remarkably familiar. Scientists comparing the new images with those obtained by DART before the collision have been able to recognize individual boulders that appear to have remained in place.
paras.zh: 然而，在其他地方，风景看起来却非常熟悉。科学家们将新图像与碰撞前 DART 获得的图像进行比较，从而识别出似乎仍留在原处的单个巨石。

paras.en: So DART did excavate a crater, and it did reshape the asteroid – but it also left some of the terrain apparently untouched.
paras.zh: 因此，DART 确实挖掘了一个陨石坑，也确实重塑了小行星​​的形状，但它也留下了一些明显未受影响的地形。

paras.en: But the changes to Dimorphos go beyond the superficial.
paras.zh: 但 Dimorphos 的变化不仅仅是表面上的。

paras.en: Prior to the impact, Dimorphos was thought to be tidally locked to Didymos, much as the Moon is to Earth, perpetually presenting the same face to its larger companion. Well, not so much anymore.
paras.zh: 在撞击之前，迪莫福斯被认为被潮汐锁定在迪迪莫斯上，就像月球与地球一样，永远向其更大的同伴呈现相同的面孔。好吧，不再那么多了。

paras.en: "In addition, as Hera returned more images, it became clear that the DART impact has left Dimorphos tumbling wildly in its orbit," says Hera mission scientist Michael Kueppers of the ESA.
paras.zh: “此外，随着赫拉传回更多图像，很明显，DART 撞击导致迪莫佛斯在其轨道上剧烈翻滚，”欧空局赫拉任务科学家迈克尔·库珀斯 (Michael Kueppers) 说道。

paras.en: "Another big surprise is that Hera is showing that the asteroids are surrounded by hundreds of orbiting boulders, just a few meters in size. The team will have to take account of these objects in the coming weeks as the mission moves in closer to acquire higher-resolution images of the asteroids."
paras.zh: “另一个大惊喜是赫拉显示小行星被数百个轨道巨石包围，大小只有几米。随着任务越来越近，团队将不得不在未来几周内考虑这些物体，以获取更高分辨率的小行星图像。”

paras.en: It's possible that at least some of these boulders are souvenirs of DART's visit. In 2023, observations from the Hubble Space Telescope revealed a swarm of 37 boulders that appeared to have been dislodged from Dimorphos by the impact.
paras.zh: 这些巨石中至少有一些可能是 DART 访问的纪念品。 2023 年，哈勃太空望远镜的观测结果显示，一大群 37 块巨石似乎因撞击而从迪莫弗斯上脱落。

paras.en: Subsequent simulations suggested that some of the ejected rocks could remain gravitationally bound to the asteroid pair long enough for Hera to encounter them.
paras.zh: 随后的模拟表明，一些喷射出的岩石可能会在重力作用下与这对小行星保持足够长的距离，以便赫拉能够遇到它们。

paras.en: Establishing the origin of this much larger population of boulders observed by Hera could help scientists piece together the aftermath of the collision.
paras.zh: 确定赫拉观测到的大量巨石的起源可以帮助科学家们拼凑出碰撞的后果。

paras.en: But the investigation has only just started. Hera reached the asteroid on 4 November 2026, and has a lot of plans for the months ahead.
paras.zh: 但调查才刚刚开始。赫拉于 2026 年 11 月 4 日抵达小行星，并为未来几个月制定了很多计划。

paras.en: At time of writing, it is at a distance of around 25 to 30 kilometers (16 to 19 miles) from the asteroid pair; in December, it will move in as close as 13 kilometers to capture progressively higher-resolution views.
paras.zh: 在撰写本文时，它距离这对小行星约 25 至 30 公里（16 至 19 英里）； 12 月，它将移动近 13 公里，以捕捉逐渐更高分辨率的视图。

paras.en: In January, it will deploy a pair of cubesats that will get closer still – Juventas, which will take the first-ever radar measurements of an asteroid's interior, and Milani, which will measure the external environment.
paras.zh: 一月份，它将部署一对更加接近的立方体卫星——Juventas，它将首次对小行星的内部进行雷达测量，而Milani将测量外部环境。

paras.en: Together, their intel is expected to provide invaluable insights. By determining Dimorphos's mass and structure, scientists will be able to better understand how efficiently DART transferred its momentum to the asteroid – and how other asteroids might respond to a similar wallop.
paras.zh: 他们的情报预计将提供宝贵的见解。通过确定 Dimorphos 的质量和结构，科学家将能够更好地了解 DART 如何有效地将其动量转移到小行星上，以及其他小行星如何响应类似的冲击力。

paras.en: "Sixty-six million years ago, an asteroid impact changed the course of life on Earth. Today, for the first time in history, humanity is validating how to prevent such an event from happening again," says Hera mission manager Ian Carnelli of the ESA.
paras.zh: “六千六百万年前，小行星撞击改变了地球生命的进程。今天，人类历史上第一次正在验证如何防止此类事件再次发生，”欧空局赫拉任务经理伊恩·卡内利说。

paras.en: "NASA's DART mission demonstrated that we can change an asteroid's orbit. Hera is now revealing what happened to the asteroid itself. By combining these two missions, humanity is taking a decisive step towards making asteroid deflection a reliable tool for protecting our planet."
paras.zh: “美国宇航局的 DART 任务证明我们可以改变小行星的轨道。赫拉现在正在揭示小行星本身发生的事情。通过将这两项任务结合起来，人类正在朝着使小行星偏转成为保护我们的星球的可靠工具迈出决定性的一步。”

articles.title: Another Organism Created GMO Sweet Potatoes Long Before Humans
articles.author: Carly Cassella

paras.en: Humans were not the first genetic engineers.
paras.zh: 人类并不是第一个基因工程师。

paras.en: Other organisms were creating GMO plants millions of years before we began splicing foreign DNA into crops.
paras.zh: 在我们开始将外源 DNA 拼接到农作物中之前数百万年，其他生物体就已经开始培育转基因植物了。

paras.en: One staple of the Thanksgiving table is a perfect example of this.
paras.zh: 感恩节餐桌上的一道主食就是一个完美的例子。

paras.en: The sweet potato was cultivated thousands of years ago by people in Central and South America, yet another organism had tampered with its genes long before our species came along and plucked it from the soil.
paras.zh: 红薯是数千年前由中美洲和南美洲的人们种植的，早在我们物种出现并将其从土壤中采摘之前，另一种生物体就已经篡改了它的基因。

paras.en: In 2015, researchers discovered that cultivated sweet potatoes from around the world contained foreign DNA, some of which was actively expressed by the plant.
paras.zh: 2015年，研究人员发现来自世界各地的栽培红薯含有外源DNA，其中一些在植物中活跃表达。

paras.en: This "rather remarkable" genetic insertion was observed in every single cultivated crop analyzed, but not in any wild relatives.
paras.zh: 在分析的每一种栽培作物中都观察到了这种“相当显着”的基因插入，但在任何野生近缘种中都没有观察到。

paras.en: The genetic engineer in question is a tiny soil microbe called Agrobacterium.
paras.zh: 所讨论的基因工程师是一种叫做农杆菌的微小土壤微生物。

paras.en: This special bacterium is quite the tinker. When it infects plant tissue, it can transfer a small segment of its own DNA into the host's cells.
paras.zh: 这种特殊的细菌非常善于修补。当它感染植物组织时，它可以将一小段自身DNA转移到宿主细胞中。

paras.en: This is called transfer DNA, or T-DNA, and the foreign genes can enter a cell's nucleus, permanently altering the plant's genome.
paras.zh: 这称为转移 DNA，或 T-DNA，外源基因可以进入细胞核，永久改变植物的基因组。

paras.en: From then on, the plant may 'read' and 'express' the genes of this foreign pathogen. It can even pass the T-DNA on when it reproduces.
paras.zh: 从那时起，植物就可以“读取”并“表达”这种外来病原体的基因。它甚至可以在繁殖时传递 T-DNA。

paras.en: The use of T-DNA is a super unique skill set, primarily associated with Agrobacterium.
paras.zh: T-DNA 的使用是一项超级独特的技能，主要与农杆菌相关。

paras.en: When it was discovered in the late 1970s, it gave scientists an idea.
paras.zh: 当它在 20 世纪 70 年代末被发现时，它给了科学家一个想法。

paras.en: If humans could remove the disease-causing genes from T-DNA, it could theoretically allow us to genetically engineer plants for the better.
paras.zh: 如果人类能够从 T-DNA 中去除致病基因，理论上我们就能对植物进行基因改造，使其变得更好。

paras.en: While these products are often vilified for being unnatural, they are actually based on a very natural process.
paras.zh: 虽然这些产品经常被诟病为不自然，但它们实际上是基于非常自然的过程。

paras.en: In nature, the T-DNA that a pathogen inserts into its host's genome is for its own survival, but sometimes it can share unexpected advantages, too.
paras.zh: 在自然界中，病原体插入宿主基因组的T-DNA是为了自身的生存，但有时它也能带来意想不到的优势。

paras.en: This seems to have happened with the sweet potato.
paras.zh: 这似乎发生在红薯身上。

paras.en: In October of this year, scientists published new evidence in Planta that shows a foreign gene in sweet potatoes, naturally acquired from Agrobacterium, could help plants withstand temperature changes, defend against disease, and reduce oxidative damage.
paras.zh: 今年10月，科学家在《Planta》上发表了新证据，表明甘薯中的一种从农杆菌天然获得的外源基因可以帮助植物抵御温度变化、抵御疾病并减少氧化损伤。

paras.en: The authors tested this gene in thale cress (Arabidopsis thaliana), which is a widely used model plant for genetic engineering. It seemed to benefit the plant in numerous ways.
paras.zh: 作者在拟南芥（Arabidopsis thaliana）中测试了该基因，拟南芥是一种广泛用于基因工程的模式植物。它似乎在很多方面都使工厂受益。

paras.en: These results are supported by another study in 2025 that found two bacterial-derived genes in sweet potato that may actually help tissue growth and antioxidant production.
paras.zh: 这些结果得到了 2025 年另一项研究的支持，该研究在甘薯中发现了两种细菌衍生的基因，它们实际上可能有助于组织生长和抗氧化剂的产生。

paras.en: One possibility is that over evolutionary time, harmful bacterial genes were lost from sweet potato, while more beneficial genes persisted.
paras.zh: 一种可能性是，随着进化时间的推移，有害细菌基因从甘薯中消失，而更多有益基因却保留了下来。

paras.en: When ancient humans began cultivating these crops, they may have even unwittingly sped up the process by selecting the crops with the best bacterial genes.
paras.zh: 当古代人类开始种植这些作物时，他们甚至可能在不知不觉中通过选择具有最好细菌基因的作物来加速这一过程。

paras.en: That's a longer, natural version of how humans create GMO crops today.
paras.zh: 这是当今人类创造转基因作物的更长、更自然的版本。

paras.en: And it's not just sweet potatoes that are a good example of natural GMOs, either.
paras.zh: 不仅仅是红薯是天然转基因生物的一个很好的例子。

paras.en: There's another key plate on the Thanksgiving table that also contains genes from Agrobacterium: cranberries (Vaccinium macrocarpon).
paras.zh: 感恩节餐桌上的另一个关键菜肴也含有农杆菌基因：蔓越莓（Vaccinium macrocarpon）。

paras.en: In fact, it's looking more like natural GMO plants are all around us.
paras.zh: 事实上，它看起来更像是我们周围的天然转基因植物。

paras.en: In August of this year, for instance, researchers published a paper that identified more than 2,600 species of naturally occurring GMO plants.
paras.zh: 例如，今年 8 月，研究人员发表了一篇论文，鉴定了 2,600 多种天然转基因植物。

paras.en: The team estimates that 12 percent of all land plant species may carry DNA inserted by bacteria.
paras.zh: 研究小组估计，12% 的陆地植物物种可能携带细菌插入的 DNA。

paras.en: These foreign genes are in the cinnamon of our pumpkin pies, the pepper we crack over our turkey, and the coffee we sip after a good meal with friends and family.
paras.zh: 这些外来基因存在于我们南瓜派的肉桂中、我们在火鸡上撒的胡椒粉以及我们与朋友和家人美餐后喝的咖啡中。

paras.en: Perhaps this is the year to offer your thanks to Agrobacterium.
paras.zh: 也许今年是您向农杆菌表示感谢的一年。

articles.title: World’s largest trial of robotic knee replacement reveals surprising results

paras.en: Worldâs largest trial of robotic knee replacement reveals surprising results
paras.zh: 世界上最大规模的机器人膝关节置换试验揭示了令人惊讶的结果

paras.en: Robot-assisted knee replacement surgery offers greater surgical precision, but a landmark clinical trial has revealed a surprising limitation. Despite the advanced technology, patients experienced no meaningful improvements in pain, mobility, or recovery compared with conventional surgery after one year.
paras.zh: 机器人辅助膝关节置换手术提供了更高的手术精度，但一项具有里程碑意义的临床试验揭示了一个令人惊讶的局限性。尽管技术先进，但与传统手术相比，一年后患者的疼痛、活动能力或恢复情况没有明显改善。

paras.en: Robotic technology can help surgeons perform knee replacement operations with greater precision, but that accuracy does not necessarily translate into better results for patients. The RACER-Knee trial, the world's largest clinical study of its kind, found that patients who underwent robot-assisted knee replacement experienced similar levels of pain, mobility, and recovery to those who received conventional surgery. The findings provide important evidence about the use of robotics in health care and highlight where future technological developments and research could make a difference. Coordinated by the University of Warwick and University Hospitals Coventry and Warwickshire (UHCW) NHS Trust, the trial was published in The Lancet, the world's oldest and one of its best-known general medical journals.
paras.zh: 机器人技术可以帮助外科医生更精确地进行膝关节置换手术，但这种准确性并不一定能为患者带来更好的结果。 RACER-Knee 试验是世界上规模最大的同类临床研究，它发现接受机器人辅助膝关节置换术的患者与接受传统手术的患者经历了相似的疼痛、活动能力和恢复程度。这些发现提供了有关机器人技术在医疗保健中的使用的重要证据，并强调了未来的技术发展和研究可以产生影响的领域。该试验由华威大学和考文垂和沃里克郡大学医院 (UHCW) NHS Trust 协调，发表在世界上最古老、最著名的普通医学期刊之一《柳叶刀》上。

paras.en: Robotic technology is becoming increasingly common in knee replacement surgery around the world. It is now used in 6% of procedures in the UK, 16% in the US, and 42% in Australia. The technology is designed to help surgeons position artificial knee joints more accurately and customize procedures to suit each patient's anatomy.
paras.zh: 机器人技术在世界各地的膝关节置换手术中变得越来越普遍。目前，英国 6%、美国 16% 和澳大利亚 42% 的手术均使用该技术。该技术旨在帮助外科医生更准确地定位人工膝关节，并根据每位患者的解剖结构定制手术程序。

paras.en: The UK-wide RACER-Knee trial was funded by the National Institute for Health and Care Research (NIHR) in partnership with Stryker, the manufacturer of the robotic equipment evaluated in the study. The Warwick Clinical Trials Unit, UHCW NHS Trust, and the Royal Orthopaedic Hospital in Birmingham led the research. It represents the world's largest double-blinded, randomized controlled trial comparing traditional total knee replacement with procedures performed using the Stryker Mako robotic system, the most widely used system of its kind worldwide.
paras.zh: 英国范围内的 RACER-Knee 试验由国家健康与护理研究所 (NIHR) 与研究中评估的机器人设备制造商 Stryker 合作资助。华威临床试验中心、UHCW NHS Trust 和伯明翰皇家骨科医院领导了这项研究。它代表了世界上最大的双盲、随机对照试验，将传统全膝关节置换术与使用 Stryker Mako 机器人系统（全球同类系统中使用最广泛的系统）进行的手术进行比较。

paras.en: Greater Precision Does Not Improve Recovery
paras.zh: 更高的精度并不能改善恢复

paras.en: Twelve months after surgery, patients in both groups reported comparable recovery, mobility, and pain levels. Although the robotic system enabled surgeons to operate with greater precision, patients did not experience measurable improvements in their overall outcomes during the first year. The researchers also found no increased risk of serious adverse events associated with robotic assistance, suggesting that it was as safe as conventional surgery.
paras.zh: 手术后十二个月，两组患者的恢复情况、活动能力和疼痛程度相当。尽管机器人系统使外科医生能够更精确地进行手术，但患者在第一年的总体结果并没有出现明显的改善。研究人员还发现，与机器人辅助相关的严重不良事件的风险没有增加，这表明它与传统手术一样安全。

paras.en: The trial was jointly led by two chief investigators in the UK.
paras.zh: 该试验由英国两名首席调查员共同领导。

paras.en: Professor Andrew Metcalfe, of Warwick Medical School at the University of Warwick and a consultant orthopedic surgeon at UHCW NHS Trust, said: "We are delighted to have completed this world-leading randomized trial of an exciting technology that is now being used globally and at scale. It is an important step in the process of innovation and will stimulate lots more high-quality studies. We are very grateful for the support of the many patients who took part which is so important, but also the NIHR and Stryker for working so well together to support this critical study. Technology such as this could really help the care we give for patients, but for robotic-assisted knee replacements, there is still work to do before we see benefits such as less pain or better movement."
paras.zh: 沃里克大学沃里克医学院的安德鲁·梅特卡夫教授、UHCW NHS Trust 的整形外科医生顾问表示：“我们很高兴完成了这项世界领先的随机试验，该试验目前正在全球范围内大规模使用。这是创新过程中的重要一步，将刺激更多高质量的研究。我们非常感谢众多参与试验的患者的支持，这一点非常重要，同时也感谢 NIHR 和 Stryker 的出色工作。共同支持这项重要的研究，这样的技术确实可以帮助我们为患者提供护理，但对于机器人辅助膝关节置换术，在我们看到诸如减少疼痛或更好的运动等好处之前，仍然有很多工作要做。”

paras.en: Professor Edward Davis, a consultant orthopedic surgeon at The Royal Orthopaedic Hospital NHS Foundation Trust and honorary professor at the University of Birmingham, said: "The trial demonstrates robotic-arm-assistance allows for higher precision, and in theory the system should allow surgeons to customize the procedure according to a patient's anatomy. These results are by no means a condemnation of the robotic systems, but more understanding of the ideal position for a knee replacement and personalization for each patient is needed. We'll then be able to truly take advantage of the advanced precision of robotic systems."
paras.zh: 英国皇家骨科医院 NHS 基金会信托基金的整形外科医生顾问、伯明翰大学名誉教授爱德华·戴维斯 (Edward Davis) 教授表示：“该试验表明，机械臂辅助可以实现更高的精度，理论上，该系统应该允许外科医生根据患者的解剖结构定制手术。这些结果绝不是对机器人系统的谴责，而是需要更多地了解膝关节置换的理想位置和针对每位患者的个性化定制。然后我们就能够真正利用机器人系统的先进精度。”

paras.en: Professor Anthony Gordon, director of the NIHR Health Technology Assessment (HTA) Programme, said: "Innovation in healthcare depends on evaluating promising technologies rigorously and at scale. While this study shows robotic-assisted knee replacement is not yet improving patient outcomes, it highlights opportunities to refine these technologies and harness their precision to deliver better care in the future. The NIHR continues to fund robust studies, such as RACER, ensuring we learn how to deliver the latest technologies most effectively within the NHS."
paras.zh: NIHR 健康技术评估 (HTA) 项目主任 Anthony Gordon 教授表示：“医疗保健领域的创新取决于对有前途的技术进行严格和大规模的评估。虽然这项研究表明机器人辅助膝关节置换术尚未改善患者的治疗效果，但它强调了改进这些技术并利用其精度在未来提供更好护理的机会。NIHR 继续资助 RACER 等强有力的研究，确保我们了解如何在 NHS 内最有效地提供最新技术。”

paras.en: Total knee replacement is among the most frequently performed elective surgical procedures worldwide for people with knee arthritis. During traditional surgery, orthopedic surgeons use standard surgical instruments and rely on their training and experience to position the artificial joint.
paras.zh: 全膝关节置换术是全球膝关节炎患者最常进行的选择性手术之一。在传统手术中，骨科医生使用标准手术器械，并依靠他们的培训和经验来定位人工关节。

paras.en: Robotic technology offers an alternative approach in which the surgeon controls a robotic arm during the operation. The system helps position surgical instruments with exceptional accuracy and allows surgeons to adjust the angles and depths of their cuts with greater flexibility. These capabilities make it possible to customize procedures to individual anatomy in ways that are not achievable with conventional techniques.
paras.zh: 机器人技术提供了另一种方法，外科医生在手术过程中控制机械臂。该系统有助于以极高的精度定位手术器械，并使外科医生能够更灵活地调整切割的角度和深度。这些功能使得能够以传统技术无法实现的方式根据个体解剖结构定制程序。

paras.en: Landmark Trial Finds Similar Patient Outcomes
paras.zh: 具有里程碑意义的试验发现了类似的患者结果

paras.en: The study involved 339 patients treated by 33 surgeons at 10 hospitals across the UK. Despite the potential advantages of robotic technology, researchers found no meaningful difference between the two groups in the trial's primary outcome measure, the Forgotten Joint Score, one year after surgery.
paras.zh: 该研究涉及英国 10 家医院的 33 名外科医生治疗的 339 名患者。尽管机器人技术具有潜在优势，但研究人员发现，手术一年后，两组在试验的主要结果指标“遗忘关节评分”中没有显着差异。

paras.en: This assessment measures how conscious patients are of their artificial joint while carrying out everyday activities. Ideally, a successful knee replacement allows patients to go about their daily lives without frequently noticing the artificial joint. Patients achieved similar scores regardless of which surgical technique was used.
paras.zh: 该评估测量患者在进行日常活动时对其人工关节的意识程度。理想情况下，成功的膝关节置换术可以让患者正常生活，而不会经常注意到人工关节。无论使用哪种手术技术，患者都获得相似的分数。

paras.en: Other measures also showed comparable results. These included walking ability, pain during hospitalization, pain during the first three months of recovery and at 12 months, and the likelihood of requiring another operation.
paras.zh: 其他措施也显示出类似的结果。其中包括行走能力、住院期间的疼痛、康复前三个月和 12 个月期间的疼痛，以及需要再次手术的可能性。

paras.en: Researchers plan to monitor participants for ten years to determine whether differences between the two surgical approaches emerge over a longer period. One particularly important question is whether robotic assistance reduces the number of patients who eventually need additional knee surgery.
paras.zh: 研究人员计划对参与者进行十年的监测，以确定两种手术方法之间是否会在较长时间内出现差异。一个特别重要的问题是机器人辅助是否会减少最终需要额外膝盖手术的患者数量。

paras.en: Robotic Knee Surgery Takes Longer and Costs More
paras.zh: 机器人膝关节手术需要更长的时间且成本更高

paras.en: Operations performed with robotic assistance required additional time (on average 10.5 minutes) and cost approximately £950 more per procedure.
paras.zh: 在机器人辅助下进行的手术需要额外的时间（平均 10.5 分钟），并且每次手术的成本增加约 950 英镑。

paras.en: Although the robotic system improved surgical precision, it was not associated with a higher risk of serious adverse events, indicating that the procedure appeared to be as safe as traditional knee replacement.
paras.zh: 尽管机器人系统提高了手术精度，但它与严重不良事件的较高风险无关，这表明该手术似乎与传统膝关节置换术一样安全。

paras.en: However, when assessed against current NHS spending thresholds, the robotic technology evaluated in the trial was not considered cost-effective during the first year following surgery.
paras.zh: 然而，根据当前的 NHS 支出阈值进行评估时，试验中评估的机器人技术在手术后的第一年被认为不具有成本效益。

paras.en: The Future of Personalized Knee Replacement
paras.zh: 个性化膝关节置换术的未来

paras.en: The researchers believe that robotic technology could become more valuable if surgeons learn how to use its enhanced precision to better accommodate differences in individual patients' anatomy.
paras.zh: 研究人员认为，如果外科医生学会如何利用其增强的精度来更好地适应个体患者解剖结构的差异，机器人技术可能会变得更有价值。

paras.en: Determining the ideal placement of an artificial knee joint for each patient could eventually allow surgeons to turn greater technical accuracy into meaningful improvements in recovery, pain relief, and mobility. Achieving those benefits will require further technological development and additional research, making personalized robotic surgery a promising area for future investigation.
paras.zh: 确定每位患者人工膝关节的理想位置最终可以让外科医生将更高的技术准确性转化为康复、缓解疼痛和活动能力方面的有意义的改善。实现这些好处将需要进一步的技术发展和额外的研究，使个性化机器人手术成为未来研究的一个有希望的领域。

paras.en: The findings of the RACER-Knee trial were published in The Lancet.
paras.zh: RACER-Knee 试验的结果发表在《柳叶刀》上。

paras.en: The research was organized by University Hospitals Coventry and Warwickshire NHS Trust and the University of Warwick. Funding was provided by the UK NHS research organization, the National Institute for Health Research, through its Health Technology Assessment Programme (NIHR128768).
paras.zh: 该研究由考文垂和沃里克郡国民保健服务信托大学医院和华威大学组织。英国 NHS 研究组织国家健康研究所通过其健康技术评估计划 (NIHR128768) 提供了资金。

paras.en: Stryker, the company that manufactures the robotic system, covered the additional expenses associated with performing robotic surgery during the trial. The company did not participate in analyzing or interpreting the study results.
paras.zh: 制造机器人系统的史赛克公司承担了试验期间与执行机器人手术相关的额外费用。该公司没有参与分析或解释研究结果。

paras.zh: 材料由华威大学提供。注意：内容的风格和长度可能会被编辑。

articles.title: Astronomers may have discovered a black hole born before the first stars

paras.en: Astronomers may have discovered a black hole born before the first stars
paras.zh: 天文学家可能发现了一个诞生于第一批恒星之前的黑洞

paras.en: A mysterious object named Phoebe, detected when it briefly magnified a distant star, could be a primordial black hole formed just after the Big Bang. With an estimated mass only three times that of the Moon, it may be a 13-billion-year-old cosmic relic that offers new clues to the mystery of dark matter.
paras.zh: 一个名为菲比的神秘物体，在短暂放大一颗遥远恒星时被发现，它可能是大爆炸后形成的原始黑洞。据估计，它的质量仅为月球的三倍，它可能是一个 130 亿年前的宇宙遗迹，为解开暗物质之谜提供了新的线索。

paras.en: On December 18, 2019, astronomers recorded something unusual happening to a star in the Large Magellanic Cloud, a satellite galaxy of the Milky Way. For approximately one hour, the star gradually grew brighter before fading back to its usual appearance. The change was smooth and symmetrical, with no sudden explosion or flare. It looked as though an invisible object had moved between Earth and the star, bending its light in our direction. Afterward, the star returned to normal and showed no further changes in brightness.
paras.zh: 2019 年 12 月 18 日，天文学家记录到银河系卫星星系大麦哲伦星云中的一颗恒星发生了一些不寻常的事情。在大约一个小时的时间里，这颗恒星逐渐变亮，然后又恢复到原来的样子。变化平稳、对称，没有突然爆发或耀斑。看起来好像有一个看不见的物体在地球和恒星之间移动，将其光线转向我们的方向。随后，恒星恢复正常，亮度不再发生变化。

paras.en: Researchers have named the mysterious object Phoebe, but its true identity remains unknown. The event appears to be an example of gravitational microlensing, a phenomenon predicted by Einstein's general theory of relativity. When a compact object with sufficient mass passes in front of a distant star, its gravity bends the star's light and temporarily magnifies its brightness. This produces a recognizable pattern that differs from the changes caused by variable stars, stellar flares, or passing asteroids.
paras.zh: 研究人员将这个神秘物体命名为菲比，但其真实身份仍然未知。该事件似乎是引力微透镜的一个例子，这是爱因斯坦广义相对论所预测的现象。当一个具有足够质量的致密天体经过一颗遥远恒星的前方时，它的引力会使恒星的光线弯曲并暂时放大其亮度。这会产生一种可识别的模式，与变星、恒星耀斑或经过的小行星引起的变化不同。

paras.en: Astronomers at Swinburne University in Melbourne identified the signal while examining observations from a survey that frequently monitored stars in the Large Magellanic Cloud. The distinctive pattern convinced the team that they had detected a genuine gravitational microlensing event. What remained uncertain was the nature of the invisible object responsible.
paras.zh: 墨尔本斯威本大学的天文学家在检查一项经常监测大麦哲伦星云中恒星的调查观测结果时发现了这一信号。这种独特的模式让团队相信他们已经检测到了真正的引力微透镜事件。仍然不确定的是负责的隐形物体的性质。

paras.en: Three Possible Explanations for the Mysterious Object
paras.zh: 对于这个神秘物体的三种可能的解释

paras.en: Researchers have identified three potential explanations for Phoebe. One possibility is a rogue planet that was expelled from its original solar system and now travels alone through the Milky Way. Another is a similar wandering planet located within the Large Magellanic Cloud. If the second explanation proves correct, Phoebe would become the first planet discovered through gravitational microlensing beyond our galaxy.
paras.zh: 研究人员为菲比找到了三种可能的解释。一种可能性是一颗流氓行星被逐出了原来的太阳系，现在独自穿过银河系。另一个是位于大麦哲伦星云内的类似流浪行星。如果第二种解释被证明是正确的，菲比将成为第一颗通过引力微透镜在我们银河系之外发现的行星。

paras.en: The third possibility is far more extraordinary. Phoebe could be a primordial black hole, an ancient object that formed in the earliest moments of the universe. Unlike ordinary black holes, which develop when massive stars collapse, primordial black holes could have emerged from extremely dense regions of space during the first fractions of a second after the Big Bang. Such objects would have formed long before the first stars appeared.
paras.zh: 第三种可能性要非同寻常得多。菲比可能是一个原始黑洞，一个在宇宙诞生之初形成的古老物体。与大质量恒星坍缩时形成的普通黑洞不同，太初黑洞可能是在大爆炸后的最初几分之一秒内从极其致密的空间区域中出现的。这些物体早在第一批恒星出现之前就已经形成了。

paras.en: A One-Hour Signal Reveals a Surprising Clue
paras.zh: 一小时信号揭示了令人惊讶的线索

paras.en: The unusually short duration of the brightening provides an important clue about Phoebe's mass. Gravitational microlensing events depend partly on how massive the intervening object is. Generally, lighter objects produce shorter events, although their speed and position also influence how long the magnification lasts.
paras.zh: 异常短暂的增亮持续时间提供了有关菲比质量的重要线索。引力微透镜事件部分取决于介入物体的质量。一般来说，较轻的物体产生的事件较短，尽管它们的速度和位置也会影响放大的持续时间。

paras.en: Phoebe's signal lasted approximately 60 minutes, placing it near the detection limit of current astronomical surveys. Using the observed duration and their models of the event, researchers estimated that the object has a mass roughly three times that of the Moon. That would make it considerably less massive than any planet in our solar system and far too small to be a conventional black hole formed by a collapsing star.
paras.zh: 菲比的信号持续了大约 60 分钟，接近当前天文观测的探测极限。利用观测到的持续时间和事件模型，研究人员估计该物体的质量大约是月球的三倍。这将使它比我们太阳系中的任何行星都要小得多，而且对于由坍缩恒星形成的传统黑洞来说也太小了。

paras.en: Black holes produced through stellar collapse typically have masses of at least about five times that of the Sun. Phoebe's estimated mass falls enormously below that threshold. If the mysterious object really is a black hole, its tiny mass would point toward a primordial origin rather than the death of a star.
paras.zh: 恒星塌缩产生的黑洞的质量通常至少约为太阳的五倍。菲比的估计质量大大低于该阈值。如果这个神秘物体确实是一个黑洞，那么它的微小质量将指向原始起源而不是恒星的死亡。

paras.en: Could Phoebe Be a Primordial Black Hole Linked to Dark Matter?
paras.zh: 菲比可能是与暗物质有关的原始黑洞吗？

paras.en: To investigate where Phoebe might belong, the researchers compared the likelihood that the object originated from different populations. These included stars in the Milky Way, stars in the Large Magellanic Cloud, and objects associated with the surrounding dark matter halo.
paras.zh: 为了调查菲比可能属于哪里，研究人员比较了该物体起源于不同人群的可能性。其中包括银河系中的恒星、大麦哲伦星云中的恒星以及与周围暗物质晕相关的物体。

paras.en: The results strongly favored the dark matter halo. According to the team's calculations, Phoebe is approximately 100,000 times more likely to belong to this population than to one associated with ordinary stellar matter. This enormous difference makes a potential connection to dark matter particularly intriguing, although it does not establish that Phoebe is a primordial black hole.
paras.zh: 结果强烈支持暗物质晕。根据该团队的计算，菲比属于这一族群的可能性比普通恒星物质族群的可能性高出大约 100,000 倍。这种巨大的差异使得与暗物质的潜在联系特别有趣，尽管它并不能证明菲比是一个原始黑洞。

paras.en: If the primordial black hole interpretation is correct, Phoebe could be among the oldest objects ever detected. It may have formed before the first atoms and stars existed, when the universe was still experiencing the extreme conditions that followed the Big Bang.
paras.zh: 如果原始黑洞的解释是正确的，菲比可能是迄今为止发现的最古老的天体之一。它可能是在第一个原子和恒星存在之前形成的，当时宇宙仍在经历大爆炸后的极端条件。

paras.en: For roughly 13 billion years, such an object could have traveled unseen through space, leaving almost no trace of its existence. Then, on a single night in December 2019, its gravity may have briefly magnified the light of a distant star, offering astronomers a remarkable glimpse of something born near the very beginning of the universe.
paras.zh: 在大约 130 亿年的时间里，这样的物体可能在太空中悄无声息地旅行，几乎没有留下任何存在的痕迹。然后，在 2019 年 12 月的一个晚上，它的引力可能短暂地放大了一颗遥远恒星的光，让天文学家得以一睹在宇宙诞生之初附近诞生的物体。

articles.title: Scientists discover mysterious lakes more than a mile beneath the Red Sea

paras.en: Scientists discover mysterious lakes more than a mile beneath the Red Sea
paras.zh: 科学家在红海下方一英里多处发现神秘湖泊

paras.en: University of Miami Rosenstiel School of Marine, Atmospheric, and Earth Science
paras.zh: 迈阿密大学罗森斯蒂尔海洋、大气和地球科学学院

paras.en: More than a mile beneath the surface of the Red Sea, scientists have discovered rare underwater lakes that could reveal secrets about Earth's ancient oceans and the possibility of alien life. Known as brine pools, these extremely salty, oxygen-free environments are surprisingly teeming with microbial life, challenging our understanding of where living organisms can survive.
paras.zh: 在红海表面一英里多的地方，科学家们发现了罕见的水下湖泊，这些湖泊可以揭示有关地球古代海洋的秘密以及外星生命的可能性。这些极咸、无氧的环境被称为盐水池，令人惊讶地充满了微生物，挑战了我们对生物体可以生存的理解。

paras.en: More than a mile below the surface of the Red Sea, researchers from the University of Miami (UM) Rosenstiel School of Marine and Atmospheric Science discovered rare deep-sea brine pools in the Gulf of Aqaba, a northern extension of the Red Sea. These unusually salty underwater lakes could provide clues to how Earth's oceans formed millions of years ago and help guide the search for life on other planets.
paras.zh: 迈阿密大学 (UM) 罗森斯蒂尔海洋与大气科学学院的研究人员在红海表面一英里多的地方，在红海北部延伸的亚喀巴湾发现了罕见的深海盐水池。这些异常咸的水下湖泊可以提供数百万年前地球海洋如何形成的线索，并有助于指导在其他行星上寻找生命。

paras.en: The discovery was made by Sam Purkis, professor and chair of the UM Department of Marine Geosciences, and his colleagues in collaboration with OceanX. The researchers located the pools at a depth of more than one mile (1,770 meters) using a remotely operated underwater vehicle (ROV) deployed from the OceanXplorer, an advanced research vessel equipped to investigate some of the least accessible environments on Earth.
paras.zh: 这一发现是由密歇根大学海洋地球科学系教授兼系主任 Sam Purkis 及其同事与 OceanX 合作完成的。研究人员使用 OceanXplorer 部署的远程操作水下航行器 (ROV) 将水池定位在超过一英里（1,770 米）的深度，OceanXplorer 是一艘先进的研究船，配备用于调查地球上一些最难以接近的环境。

paras.en: "Until we understand the limits of life on Earth, it will be difficult to determine if alien planets can host any living beings," said Purkis. "Our discovery of a rich community of microbes that survive in extreme environments can help trace the limits of life on Earth and can be applied to the search for life elsewhere in our solar system and beyond."
paras.zh: 普尔基斯说：“在我们了解地球上生命的极限之前，很难确定外星行星是否可以容纳任何生物。” “我们发现了在极端环境中生存的丰富微生物群落，可以帮助追踪地球上生命的极限，并可以应用于寻找太阳系其他地方及以外的生命。”

paras.en: Life thrives in extreme underwater lakes
paras.zh: 生命在极端水下湖泊中繁衍生息

paras.en: Brine pools rank among the harshest environments on our planet. Their waters contain exceptionally high concentrations of salt, feature unusual chemical conditions, and are completely devoid of oxygen. Despite these seemingly inhospitable conditions, the pools support abundant microbial life. Previous research on microbes inhabiting Red Sea brine pools has even identified biologically active molecules with potential anticancer properties.
paras.zh: 盐水池是地球上最恶劣的环境之一。他们的水域含有极高浓度的盐，具有不寻常的化学条件，并且完全缺乏氧气。尽管条件看似恶劣，但这些水池却维持着丰富的微生物生命。此前对红海盐水池中微生物的研究甚至发现了具有潜在抗癌特性的生物活性分子。

paras.en: The findings, published in Communications Earth & Environment, mark the first documented discovery of brine pools in the Gulf of Aqaba. Remarkably, the researchers nearly missed them.
paras.zh: 该发现发表在《通讯地球与环境》上，标志着亚喀巴湾首次有记录的盐水池发现。值得注意的是，研究人员几乎错过了他们。

paras.en: "We were very lucky," said Purkis. "The discovery came in the last five minutes of the ten-hour ROV dive that we could dedicate to this project."
paras.zh: “我们非常幸运，”普基斯说。 “这一发现是在我们可以致力于该项目的十小时 ROV 潜水的最后五分钟内得出的。”

paras.en: Hidden records of ancient tsunamis and earthquakes
paras.zh: 古代海啸和地震的隐藏记录

paras.en: Beyond their biological significance, the pools serve as natural archives of the region's geological history. Situated relatively close to the coastline, their extremely salty waters and absence of oxygen help preserve evidence of tsunamis, flash floods, and earthquakes that occurred in the Gulf of Aqaba thousands of years ago. Regional tectonic activity has produced numerous faults and fractures across the seabed in this part of the gulf.
paras.zh: 除了其生物学意义外，这些水池还是该地区地质历史的自然档案。由于位置相对靠近海岸线，其海水极其咸且缺乏氧气，有助于保存数千年前亚喀巴湾发生的海啸、山洪和地震的证据。区域构造活动在海湾这一部分的海底产生了许多断层和裂缝。

paras.en: Earlier in 2022, Purkis and his colleagues uncovered evidence of a 500-year-old underwater landslide that likely generated a substantial tsunami. Understanding the region's history of such events could have important implications for coastal development in Egypt and Saudi Arabia.
paras.zh: 2022 年初，Purkis 和他的同事发现了 500 年前的水下山体滑坡的证据，该山体滑坡可能引发了大规模海啸。了解该地区此类事件的历史可能会对埃及和沙特阿拉伯的沿海发展产生重要影响。

paras.en: The study, titled "Discovery of the deep-sea NEOM Brine Pools in the Gulf of Aqaba, Red Sea," was published on June 27, 2022, in Communications Earth & Environment.
paras.zh: 该研究题为“红海亚喀巴湾深海 NEOM 盐水池的发现”，于 2022 年 6 月 27 日发表在《通讯地球与环境》杂志上。

paras.en: The research team included Sam J. Purkis, Hannah Shernisky, Peter K. Swart, Arash Sharifi, Amanda Oehlert, Gaëlle Duchâtellier, James Klaus, Gregor P. Eberli, Larry Peterson, and Graham Kolodziej from the UM Rosenstiel School; Fabio Marchese and Francesca Benzoni from King Abdullah University of Science and Technology's Red Sea Research Center; Giovanni Chimienti from the University of Bari Aldo Moro in Italy; Andrew Craig and Mattie Rodrigue from OceanX; Jürgen Titschack from MARUM -- Center for Marine Environmental Sciences in Germany; and Ameer Abdulla from NEOM.
paras.zh: 研究团队包括来自 UM Rosenstiel 学院的 Sam J. Purkis、Hannah Shernisky、Peter K. Swart、Arash Sharifi、Amanda Oehlert、Gaëlle Duchâtellier、James Klaus、Gregor P. Eberli、Larry Peterson 和 Graham Kolodziej；来自阿卜杜拉国王科技大学红海研究中心的 Fabio Marchese 和 Francesca Benzoni； Giovanni Chimienti，来自意大利巴里阿尔多莫罗大学；来自 OceanX 的安德鲁·克雷格和玛蒂·罗德里格；来自德国海洋环境科学中心 MARUM 的 Jürgen Titschack；和来自 NEOM 的 Ameer Abdulla。

paras.en: NEOM, a company developing the Saudi Arabian coastline, provided funding for the four-week research expedition aboard the OceanXplorer.
paras.zh: NEOM 是一家开发沙特阿拉伯海岸线的公司，为 OceanXplorer 号为期四周的研究考察提供了资金。

paras.en: Watch the NEOM OceanX documentary about the discovery: https://youtu.be/bWNftnYDx9c
paras.zh: 观看有关这一发现的 NEOM OceanX 纪录片：https://youtu.be/bWNftnYDx9c

articles.title: ‘Blade Runner 2099’ cast praise the incredible set designs that brought the sci-fi universe to life: ‘it was all so well-realized’ (interview)
articles.author: Jeff Spry

paras.en: Prime Video’s "Blade Runner 2099" has arrived with an 8-episode limited series revealing what the "Blade Runner" world looks like 50 years after the events of director Denis Villeneuve’s "Blade Runner 2049."
paras.zh: Prime Video 的《银翼杀手 2099》推出了 8 集限量剧集，揭示了导演丹尼斯·维伦纽瓦的《银翼杀手 2049》事件 50 年后的《银翼杀手》世界是什么样子。

paras.en: The most obvious change in this depressing dystopia is that replicants are running the LA show after some unmentionable ecological disaster and humans are now the ones relegated to underclass citizens.
paras.zh: 在这个令人沮丧的反乌托邦中，最明显的变化是，在一些不可提及的生态灾难之后，复制人正在洛杉矶主持节目，而人类现在沦为下层公民。

paras.en: Starring Michelle Yeoh as a replicant cop named Olwen whose life clock is running out and Hunter Schafer as Cora, a desperate human posing as a replicant blade runner, "Blade Runner 2099" unties these two in a mystery revolving around a rogue blade runner and a deadly secret that might cause their city to implode.
paras.zh: 《银翼杀手 2099》由杨紫琼饰演一名生命周期即将耗尽的名叫奥尔文的复制人警察，亨特·谢弗饰演冒充复制人银翼杀手的绝望人类科拉，《银翼杀手 2099》解开了这两个人的谜团，围绕着一名流氓银翼杀手和一个可能导致他们的城市崩溃的致命秘密。

paras.en: We connected with three of the sci-fi show’s main co-stars, Matthew Needham ("House of the Dragon"), Lewis Gribben ("T2 Trainspotting") and Dimitri Abold ("Love Addicts") to hear more about working with creator/showrunner Silka Louisa, and immersing themselves in "Blade Runner 2099's" vivid futuristic worldbuilding.
paras.zh: 我们联系了这部科幻剧的三位主要联合主演马修·尼达姆（《龙之家》）、刘易斯·格里本（《T2 猜火车》）和迪米特里·阿伯德（《爱情成瘾者》），了解更多关于与创作者/剧集主管西尔卡·路易莎合作的信息，以及如何沉浸在《银翼杀手 2099》生动的未来主义世界构建中。

paras.en: "For me it's a lot simpler than egos because he's such a goal-oriented person and all of his stuff has such a police procedural quality to it," Needham tells SPACE regarding his role as Yahya, an emotionless replicant who despises all humans.
paras.zh: “对我来说，这比自我要简单得多，因为他是一个以目标为导向的人，他的所有东西都具有警察程序的品质，”尼达姆在谈到自己扮演的叶海亚这个角色时告诉《太空》，叶海亚是一个蔑视所有人类、没有感情的复制人。

paras.en: "It was really fun to just follow what Silka [Louisa] did. She wrote this great, really exciting mystery thriller, and I just got to play in that.”
paras.zh: “跟随 Silka [Louisa] 所做的事情真的很有趣。她写了这部伟大的、非常令人兴奋的悬疑惊悚片，我就必须参与其中。”

paras.en: Scottish actor Gribben portrays Cora's ailing younger brother Elias, who has compromised mobility and a rocky relationship with his overprotective sister.
paras.zh: 苏格兰演员格里本饰演科拉生病的弟弟埃利亚斯，他行动不便，与过度保护的妹妹关系不稳定。

paras.en: "I've played a few characters that were fairly vulnerable or insular," he notes. "Then seeing the journey of this character grow in strength and confidence and feel like becoming his own man was so compelling to me. It’s almost a relationship that falls apart between brother and sister, and that's fascinating to me because that’s such a cool dynamic you don’t always really see in television shows. That was quite interesting and made me want to try and be in it."
paras.zh: “我扮演过一些相当脆弱或孤立的角色，”他指出。 “然后看到这个角色的力量和信心不断增长，感觉自己成为了自己的男人，这对我来说是如此引人注目。这几乎是一种兄弟姐妹之间的关系，这对我来说很有趣，因为这是一种很酷的动态，你在电视节目中并不总是能看到。这很有趣，让我想尝试参与其中。”

paras.en: As Bebeto, a doctor, veteran of the replicants vs. humans war, and a black-market dealer helping his species procure IDs and passports off-world, Abold enjoyed exploring the many facets of his character.
paras.zh: 贝贝托是一名医生，是复制人与人类战争的老兵，也是一名帮助他的物种在外星世界获取身份证和护照的黑市商人，阿伯德喜欢探索自己角色的许多方面。

paras.en: "Much like Matthew and Lewis, for me it was the journey that Bebeto goes on," Abold adds. "Starting out as someone who’s so hopeful and has to try and scrape up the last dregs of hope as things start falling apart. Being subject to circumstances like that inherently make for an interesting story arc and story in general. Throwing myself into that, especially after how well Silka crafted the story and script, was something I was totally ready for."
paras.zh: “就像马修和刘易斯一样，对我来说，这是贝贝托继续的旅程，”阿博尔德补充道。 “作为一个充满希望的人，当事情开始分崩离析时，必须尝试并拾起最后一丝希望。受到这样的环境的影响，本质上会产生一个有趣的故事情节和故事。全身心投入其中，尤其是在西尔卡精心制作了故事和剧本之后，我已经做好了准备。”

paras.en: "Blade Runner 2099’s" sets and locations feature detailed production design that allowed the actors to experience a seamless transition into the complex shoot.
paras.zh: 《银翼杀手 2099》的场景和场景采用了详细的制作设计，让演员能够体验到复杂拍摄的无缝过渡。

paras.en: "For me and Dimitri, our first day was in Bebeto’s apartment, and it was all so well-realized,” Gribben recalls.
paras.zh: “对我和迪米特里来说，我们的第一天是在贝贝托的公寓里，这一切都是那么清晰，”格里本回忆道。

paras.en: "You saw all the gadgets because obviously Bebeto was a bit of a tinkerer of a character and had lots of machinery and works and stuff. It took up about 70% of the acting, and we just had to come with compelling conviction. It made it so easy. When you audition for these things, you feel like you have to act more because you’re in a blue screen vacuum. But then you’re there, and it’s so visually well created like that, it made it so easy to be immersed in it."
paras.zh: “你看到所有的小玩意是因为贝贝托显然是一个喜欢修补角色的人，有很多机械和作品之类的东西。它占据了大约 70% 的表演时间，我们只需要带着令人信服的信念来。它让一切变得如此简单。当你试镜这些东西时，你觉得你必须表演更多，因为你处于蓝屏真空中。但当你在那里时，它在视觉上创造得如此出色，它让你很容易沉浸在其中它。”

paras.en: "Blade Runner 2099" is currently airing all 8 episodes exclusively on Prime Video.
paras.zh: 《银翼杀手 2099》的全部 8 集目前正在 Prime Video 上独家播出。

paras.en: Jeff Spry is an award-winning screenwriter and veteran freelance journalist covering TV, movies, video games, books, and comics. His work has appeared at SYFY Wire, Inverse, Collider, Bleeding Cool and elsewhere. Jeff lives in beautiful Bend, Oregon amid the ponderosa pines, classic muscle cars, a crypt of collector horror comics, and two loyal English Setters.
paras.zh: 杰夫·斯普里 (Jeff Spry) 是一位屡获殊荣的编剧和资深自由记者，报道电视、电影、视频游戏、书籍和漫画。他的作品曾出现在 SYFY Wire、Inverse、Collider、Bleeding Cool 等网站上。杰夫住在俄勒冈州美丽的本德，周围有黄松、经典肌肉车、收藏恐怖漫画的地窖和两只忠诚的英国塞特犬。

paras.zh: - 我们还为您提供了最佳望远镜、双筒望远镜、星光投影仪、相机、无人机、乐高、流媒体等的评论和排名。

paras.en: It's an impressive balance Vaonis have struck here between usability and premium astrophotography output. Prior to the pro-line of Vespera smart telescopes, I would have thought that this quality of astrophotography would require the highest levels of astronomy knowledge, alongside a pricey lineup of separate instruments. Don't get me wrong, the Vespera Pro 2 is not cheap but it really does have everything you need for capturing the wonders of the night sky with ease.
paras.zh: Vaonis 在可用性和优质天文摄影输出之间取得了令人印象深刻的平衡。在推出专业版 Vespera 智能望远镜之前，我本以为这种质量的天文摄影需要最高水平的天文学知识，以及一系列昂贵的独立仪器。不要误会我的意思，Vespera Pro 2 并不便宜，但它确实拥有轻松捕捉夜空奇观所需的一切。

paras.en: Operation is controlled from the Singularity app on a smart device and setup takes minutes. After connecting the telescope, simply click on your chosen target to start automatic location and imaging. The app is intuitive and helpful for beginners, suggesting a range of night sky targets that are observable from your location and customisable plans that allow you to set a range of targets for automatic imaging throughout the night, so you can get some rest.
paras.zh: 操作由智能设备上的 Singularity 应用程序控制，设置只需几分钟。连接望远镜后，只需点击您选择的目标即可开始自动定位和成像。该应用程序直观且对初学者很有帮助，它会建议一系列可从您所在位置观测到的夜空目标，并可自定义计划，让您设置一系列目标以在整个晚上自动成像，以便您得到一些休息。

paras.en: We wrote about an early Black Friday deal on the the Vaonis Vespera Pro last week when it dropped in price, but Vaonis has now made both models of their Vespera Pro the same price. If you were thinking of getting a pro smart telescope for highly detailed nebula photography, you may as well get the better version. It comes with a fully adjustable tripod, enhanced data transfer and an overhauled optical design for maximum performance.
paras.zh: 上周，我们曾报道过 Vaonis Vespera Pro 的黑色星期五促销活动，当时它的价格有所下降，但 Vaonis 现在已将两款 Vespera Pro 的价格定为相同价格。如果您正在考虑购买专业智能望远镜来进行高度详细的星云摄影，那么您不妨购买更好的版本。它配备了完全可调的三脚架、增强的数据传输和彻底改进的光学设计，以实现最佳性能。

paras.en: This is a great model for expanding your knowledge of different types of objects in the universe. Do you know what a dark nebula is? I didn't until I decided to try and image one with the Vespera Pro 2. My attempts are not the best, but you can make out the clouds of dark dust that block out starlight behind them in the Dark Shark Nebula and the Seahorse Nebula. I'm sure that if I set these targets for "multi-night observation" in the app, those images would keep getting stronger and more detailed.
paras.zh: 这是一个很好的模型，可以扩展您对宇宙中不同类型物体的了解。你知道什么是暗星云吗？直到我决定尝试使用 Vespera Pro 2 拍摄一张照片时，我才开始这样做。我的尝试并不是最好的，但您可以在暗鲨鱼星云和海马星云中辨认出遮挡其后面星光的暗尘埃云。我确信，如果我在应用程序中设置“多夜观察”的目标，这些图像将会变得更强大、更详细。

paras.en: On top of continuing observations from past sessions, the Vespera Pro 2 also offers mosaic mode for expanding your field of view on a certain target. This means that you can image vast expanses of the night sky without having to manually stitch together all the frames yourself. The Vespera Pro 2 does it for you. Here is my attempt at capturing the monumental supernova remnant, The Cygnus Loop. Again, it is fairly faint apart from the Eastern and Western Veil nebulas, but enabling multi-night observation will keep adding to this image whenever you get the chance to pick up where you left off.
paras.zh: 除了对过去的持续观察之外，Vespera Pro 2 还提供马赛克模式，用于扩展特定目标的视野。这意味着您可以拍摄广阔的夜空图像，而无需自己手动将所有帧拼接在一起。 Vespera Pro 2 可以为您做到这一点。这是我尝试捕捉巨大的超新星遗迹——天鹅座环。同样，与东部和西部面纱星云相比，它相当微弱，但是只要您有机会从上次停下的地方继续进行多夜观测，就会不断增加该图像的质量。

paras.zh: 价格历史：Vaonis Vespera Pro 2 通常零售价为 2,990 美元，但这一价格使其降至 2,490 美元，这是其有史以来的最低价格。

articles.title: Green light for Starmind: SpaceX gets approval to deploy 1 million AI satellites
articles.author: Mike Wall

paras.en: Earth orbit could get a lot more crowded in the coming years.
paras.zh: 未来几年，地球轨道可能会变得更加拥挤。

paras.en: The U.S. Federal Communications Commission (FCC) just granted SpaceX approval to deploy one million of its Starmind AI data-center satellites in orbit.
paras.zh: 美国联邦通信委员会 (FCC) 刚刚批准 SpaceX 在轨道上部署 100 万颗 Starmind AI 数据中心卫星。

paras.en: "This action opens a bold new frontier for the computing infrastructure needed to power America's leadership and growth," FCC Chairman Brendan Carr said today (Nov. 25) in a statement announcing the approval.
paras.zh: FCC 主席布伦丹·卡尔 (Brendan Carr) 今天（11 月 25 日）在宣布批准的声明中表示：“这一行动为推动美国领导力和增长所需的计算基础设施开辟了大胆的新领域。”

paras.en: AI has become central to SpaceX's business plans and identity over the past year or so. For example, the company has said that it's eyeing a "total addressable market" of $28.5 trillion over the long haul — and nearly $23 trillion of that is in "enterprise AI applications."
paras.zh: 在过去一年左右的时间里，人工智能已经成为 SpaceX 商业计划和形象的核心。例如，该公司表示，其长期目标是实现 28.5 万亿美元的“总潜在市场”，其中近 23 万亿美元用于“企业人工智能应用”。

paras.en: Starmind is key to those lofty ambitions. SpaceX founder and CEO Elon Musk believes that the future of AI compute is in space, where energy (from the sun) is unlimited and there are no land-owning neighbors to lodge NIMBY complaints.
paras.zh: Starmind 是实现这些远大抱负的关键。 SpaceX 创始人兼首席执行官埃隆·马斯克 (Elon Musk) 认为，人工智能计算的未来在于太空，那里的能源（来自太阳）是无限的，而且没有拥有土地的邻居提出邻避投诉。

paras.en: SpaceX aims to launch the first of its Starmind satellites in the third quarter of 2027. The spacecraft will fly on the company's fully reusable Starship megarocket, which has deployed 26 of SpaceX's next-gen Starlink satellites on its most recent two test flights.
paras.zh: SpaceX 的目标是在 2027 年第三季度发射第一颗 Starmind 卫星。该航天器将在该公司完全可重复使用的 Starship 巨型火箭上飞行，该火箭在最近的两次测试飞行中部署了 26 颗 SpaceX 的下一代 Starlink 卫星。

paras.en: Those 52 spacecraft are the vanguard of another enormous constellation: Musk has said that the next-gen Starlink network will eventually consists of about 100,000 satellites.
paras.zh: 这 52 艘航天器是另一个庞大星座的先锋：马斯克曾表示，下一代星链网络最终将由约 10 万颗卫星组成。

paras.en: The planned numbers for Starlink and Starmind are truly mind-boggling. To put them into perspective: Since the dawn of the space age in 1957, humanity has launched a total of just 28,000 satellites, give or take a few hundred. And the biggest constellation ever operated to date, the current iteration of Starlink, consists of about 11,000 spacecraft.
paras.zh: Starlink 和 Starmind 的计划数量确实令人难以置信。客观来看：自 1957 年太空时代到来以来，人类总共发射了 28,000 颗卫星，大约有几百颗。迄今为止运行的最大的星座，即当前的星链，由约 11,000 艘航天器组成。

paras.en: These coming buildouts will require an enormous number of launches. Starship can carry a maximum of 60 V3 Starlink satellites per launch, for instance, so it will take about 1,700 liftoffs just to assemble that network (and more to maintain it, as the operational life of each satellite is expected to be about five years).
paras.zh: 这些即将到来的扩建将需要大量的发射。例如，星舰每次发射最多可携带 60 颗 V3 星链卫星，因此仅组装该网络就需要大约 1,700 次升空（并且需要更多的时间来维护它，因为每颗卫星的使用寿命预计约为五年）。

paras.en: Putting so many satellites into orbit also raises the risks of collisions. SpaceX has proven to be extremely proficient in this regard with its current Starlink satellites, which can detect and avoid potential collisions autonomously. But more evasive maneuvers will be required as space gets more and more crowded.
paras.zh: 将如此多的卫星送入轨道也增加了碰撞的风险。事实证明，SpaceX 现有的 Starlink 卫星在这方面非常精通，这些卫星可以自主检测并避免潜在的碰撞。但随着空间变得越来越拥挤，将需要更多的规避机动。

paras.en: SpaceX isn't the only company that aims to operate data centers in space; Cowboy Space, Starcloud, Blue Origin and Google, among other companies, have voiced similar ambitions. Starcloud and Google, in fact, have already launched AI pathfinder satellites.
paras.zh: SpaceX 并不是唯一一家致力于在太空运营数据中心的公司； Cowboy Space、Starcloud、蓝色起源和谷歌等公司也表达了类似的雄心。事实上，星云和谷歌已经发射了人工智能探路卫星。

paras.en: "Compute campuses or data centers are essential to sustaining America's leadership in SI," Carr said in the same statement. ("SI" stands for super intelligence, the Trump administration's preferred term for AI.)
paras.zh: 卡尔在同一份声明中表示：“计算园区或数据中心对于维持美国在 SI 领域的领导地位至关重要。” （“SI”代表超级智能，这是特朗普政府对人工智能的首选术语。）

paras.en: "By moving compute capacity beyond Earth, SpaceX and the many competitors working on their own orbital data centers are meeting the moment," Carr added. "This is the kind of American ingenuity that can unite our strengths in space and advanced technology, reinforce our economic leadership, and expand prosperity here at home."
paras.zh: 卡尔补充道：“通过将计算能力转移到地球之外，SpaceX 和许多在自己的轨道数据中心工作的竞争对手正在迎接这一时刻。” “这种美国的独创性可以结合我们在太空和先进技术方面的优势，加强我们的经济领导地位，并扩大国内的繁荣。”

paras.en: Michael Wall is the Spaceflight and Tech Editor for Space.com and joined the team in 2010. He primarily covers human and robotic spaceflight, military space, and exoplanets, but has been known to dabble in the space art beat. His book about the search for alien life, "Out There," was published on Nov. 13, 2018. Before becoming a science writer, Michael worked as a herpetologist and wildlife biologist. He has a Ph.D. in evolutionary biology from the University of Sydney, Australia, a bachelor's degree from the University of Arizona, and a graduate certificate in science writing from the University of California, Santa Cruz. To find out what his latest project is, you can follow Michael on Twitter.
paras.zh: Michael Wall 是 Space.com 的太空飞行和技术编辑，于 2010 年加入该团队。他主要报道人类和机器人太空飞行、军事太空和系外行星，但以涉足太空艺术领域而闻名。他关于寻找外星生命的书《Out There》于 2018 年 11 月 13 日出版。在成为科普作家之前，迈克尔曾是一名爬行动物学家和野生动物生物学家。他拥有博士学位。澳大利亚悉尼大学进化生物学博士学位、亚利桑那大学学士学位以及加州大学圣克鲁斯分校科学写作研究生证书。要了解他的最新项目是什么，您可以在 Twitter 上关注 Michael。

articles.title: What role does industry play in Europe’s space sovereignty push?
articles.author: SpaceNews Editor

paras.en: In this episode, SpaceNews’ Jason Rainbow interviews Atle Woello, the CEO and senior vice president of the space systems and surveillance business unit at Kongsberg NanoAvionics. They discuss the role space plays for defense systems that are increasingly interconnected across domains, as well as the role that the European industrial base can play in the continent’s recent political and fundraising push to bolster sovereignty, independence and resilience in space.
paras.zh: 在本集中，SpaceNews 的 Jason Rainbow 采访了 Kongsberg NanoAvionics 空间系统和监视业务部门的首席执行官兼高级副总裁 Atle Woello。他们讨论了太空对于跨领域互联日益紧密的防御系统的作用，以及欧洲工业基础在欧洲大陆最近为加强太空主权、独立和复原力而进行的政治和筹款活动中可以发挥的作用。

paras.en: This episode is sponsored by Xiphos Systems.
paras.zh: 本集由 Xiphos Systems 赞助。

paras.en: Xiphos Systems develops compact, high-performance embedded computing solutions for spacecraft and aerospace applications. Founded in 1996 and based in Montreal, the company specializes in commercial off-the-shelf processing platforms designed for space, combining processors, programmable logic, storage, networking, and RF capabilities in low size, weight, power, and cost designs. Its portfolio includes processor boards, onboard computers, RF payload systems, and AI-capable computing platforms for satellites, launch vehicles, lunar missions, and robotics. With more than two decades of experience and over 1,000 processor cards delivered, Xiphos supports customers from system integration through deployment, helping bring reliable computing closer to the mission.
paras.zh: Xiphos Systems 为航天器和航空航天应用开发紧凑、高性能的嵌入式计算解决方案。该公司成立于 1996 年，总部位于蒙特利尔，专注于为太空设计的商用现成处理平台，将处理器、可编程逻辑、存储、网络和射频功能与低尺寸、重量、功耗和成本设计相结合。其产品组合包括处理器板、机载计算机、射频有效载荷系统以及用于卫星、运载火箭、月球任务和机器人的人工智能计算平台。 Xiphos 拥有二十多年的经验和交付的 1,000 多个处理器卡，为客户提供从系统集成到部署的支持，帮助实现可靠的计算更接近使命。

articles.title: UARX Space Marks a Milestone for Spain’s Space Industry with the Maiden Flight of OSSIE-D, Featuring a Complete Power Subsystem Supplied by DHV Technology
articles.author: UARX Space

paras.en: Nigrán, Spain | November 12 2026 – UARX Space has achieved a major milestone for Spain’s space industry with the deployment of OSSIE-D, an Orbital Transfer Vehicle (OTV) designed and manufactured entirely in Spain, with 75% of its components developed in-house by the company. Launched aboard a SpaceX Falcon 9 rocket, OSSIE-D was deployed using SAU&RON 24, UARX Space’s proprietary separation system. The achievement marks a world first, bringing together an orbital transfer vehicle and a separation system developed by the same company in a single mission.
paras.zh: 西班牙尼格兰| 2026 年 11 月 12 日 – UARX Space 部署了 OSSIE-D，实现了西班牙航天工业的一个重要里程碑。OSSIE-D 是一种完全在西班牙设计和制造的轨道传输飞行器 (OTV)，其 75% 的组件由该公司内部开发。 OSSIE-D 由 SpaceX Falcon 9 火箭发射，并使用 UARX Space 的专有分离系统 SAU&RON 24 进行部署。这一成就标志着世界首创，将同一家公司开发的轨道传输飞行器和分离系统结合在一次任务中。

paras.en: The mission represents a significant advance in Spain’s space technology capabilities, demonstrating the ability to develop and integrate key technologies for in-space transportation and orbital operations. By combining its OTV with its own SAU&RON 24 separation system, UARX Space reinforces its integrated approach to spacecraft development, spanning the vehicle itself and the technology required for its deployment into orbit.
paras.zh: 该任务代表了西班牙空间技术能力的重大进步，展示了开发和集成空间运输和轨道运行关键技术的能力。通过将其 OTV 与其自己的 SAU&RON 24 分离系统相结合，UARX Space 强化了其航天器开发的集成方法，涵盖航天器本身及其部署到轨道所需的技术。

paras.en: OSSIE-D also highlights the importance of collaboration between specialized companies across the European space industry. For this mission, DHV Technology designed, qualified and manufactured the vehicle’s complete electrical power subsystem, including the solar arrays, Power Conditioning and Distribution Unit (PCDU), main battery modules, SADA (Solar Array Drive Assembly) and additional supporting subsystems required to meet the mission’s power requirements.
paras.zh: OSSIE-D 还强调了欧洲航天工业专业公司之间合作的重要性。对于此次任务，DHV Technology 设计、鉴定和制造了车辆的完整电力子系统，包括太阳能电池阵列、功率调节和配电单元 (PCDU)、主电池模块、SADA（太阳能阵列驱动组件）以及满足任务电力要求所需的其他支持子系统。

paras.en: “OSSIE-D represents a milestone for the Spanish aerospace industry and shows how collaboration between companies with complementary capabilities can turn ambitious missions into reality. DHV Technology has been a key partner, with its expertise, highly reliable solutions and team commitment making a significant contribution to the mission’s energy capabilities. This partnership also highlights the potential of the Spanish space sector to innovate and compete at both European and global level,” said Dr. Andrés Villa, CTO and Co-Founder of UARX Space.
paras.zh: UARX Space 首席技术官兼联合创始人 Andrés Villa 博士表示：“OSSIE-D 代表了西班牙航空航天业的一个里程碑，展示了具有互补能力的公司之间的合作如何能够将雄心勃勃的任务变为现实。DHV Technology 一直是关键合作伙伴，其专业知识、高度可靠的解决方案和团队承诺为任务的能源能力做出了重大贡献。这种合作伙伴关系还凸显了西班牙航天部门在欧洲和全球层面的创新和竞争潜力。”

paras.en: Following launch, DHV Technology’s electrical power subsystem is operating nominally in orbit, starting from the generation of the power with the solar arrays, control and distribution with the PCDU and storage with the battery, including initial telemetry which confirms that the system is performing as expected. This represents an important milestone for DHV Technology’s engineering team and for the OSSIE-D mission as a whole.
paras.zh: 发射后，DHV Technology 的电力子系统名义上在轨道上运行，从太阳能电池阵列发电、PCDU 控制和分配以及电池存储开始，包括确认系统按预期运行的初始遥测。 This represents an important milestone for DHV Technology’s engineering team and for the OSSIE-D mission as a whole.

paras.en: “Seeing the full electrical power subsystem fully developed by DHV for OSSIE-D operating as expected in orbit is an important milestone for our team and for our collaboration with UARX Space,” said Dr. Vicente Díaz, Managing Director and Co-Founder of DHV Technology. “This achievement reflects the close cooperation between both engineering teams and the work invested throughout the design, manufacturing, testing and integration phases. We are proud to contribute to this mission and look forward to OSSIE-D continuing to deliver positive results for UARX Space and all the partners involved.”
paras.zh: DHV Technology 董事总经理兼联合创始人 Vicente Díaz 博士表示：“看到 DHV 完全开发的用于 OSSIE-D 的完整电力子系统在轨道上按预期运行，对于我们的团队以及我们与 UARX Space 的合作来说是一个重要的里程碑。” “这一成就反映了两个工程团队之间的密切合作以及在整个设计、制造、测试和集成阶段所投入的工作。我们很自豪能为这一任务做出贡献，并期待 OSSIE-D 继续为 UARX Space 和所有相关合作伙伴带来积极的成果。”

paras.en: Beyond supplying the electrical power subsystem, DHV Technology is using OSSIE-D as a platform to test innovative technological concepts in orbit. The results obtained during the mission will help increase the technological maturity of several of the company’s solutions, extending the value of the mission beyond its immediate operational objectives. These developments include novel electrical interconnection methods, improved solar panel deployment and hinge mechanisms, as well as advanced photovoltaic technologies.
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: The collaboration between UARX Space and DHV Technology underscores the importance of combining specialized engineering capabilities to deliver increasingly advanced space missions. While UARX Space leads the development of the OTV and its deployment architecture, DHV Technology’s electrical power subsystem provides a critical element for the vehicle’s operation while enabling the evaluation of new technologies under real space operating conditions.
paras.zh: UARX Space 和 DHV Technology 之间的合作强调了结合专业工程能力来交付日益先进的太空任务的重要性。虽然 UARX Space 引领 OTV 及其部署架构的开发，但 DHV Technology 的电力子系统为车辆的运行提供了关键要素，同时能够在真实的空间运行条件下评估新技术。

paras.en: OSSIE-D therefore represents progress on two fronts: it strengthens UARX Space’s capabilities and position in the in-space transportation sector, while providing an opportunity to validate technologies that could support future missions. The combination of an OTV developed in Spain, a proprietary separation system and a complete electrical power subsystem supplied by DHV Technology demonstrates the potential of Spain’s space industry to deliver increasingly complex technological projects.
paras.zh: 因此，OSSIE-D 代表了两个方面的进展：它增强了 UARX Space 在太空运输领域的能力和地位，同时提供了验证可支持未来任务的技术的机会。西班牙开发的 OTV、专有的分离系统和 DHV Technology 提供的完整电力子系统的结合展示了西班牙航天工业交付日益复杂的技术项目的潜力。
